| 冰晶 `ice_crystal` | 上下双六棱锥拼成悬浮棱晶，自旋+上下浮动+冷光+雪雾 | 甄姬 2 技能、王昭君 1 技能 |
| 飞剑 `swords` | 4 柄实体剑从四周错峰刺向目标 + 命中火花 | 李白 1/2 技能 |
| 法球 `orbs` | 3 颗发光球体绕施法者公转 | 安琪拉、妲己、东皇太一 |
| 太阳 `sun_orb` | 大发光球 + 8 道旋转光芒 + 脉动 | 后羿 1/2 技能 |

- `SpellFxTable.SKILL_PROPS` 按「英雄 → 槽位 → 道具」配置，未配置的走原有形态特效；
- 实体道具独立预算 `MAX_PROPS = 10`，不挤占爆发粒子（`GROUP_FX`）；

Now I have a clear picture of selection UIs:

Single-player (BattleManager):
- 920×600 panel, centered, dark 0.06 bg, border 0.25
- Title 24px "选择英雄 · 召唤师技能"
- left scroll 580×420, cards 128×54 (name+role)
- right summoner list 280×420 cards 256×62 with CD + desc
- summary 14px grey, confirm "开始游戏" 180×40
- panel scale-in animation

Multiplayer (NetLobby):
- scroll canvas ~1440×980 (min 900×480)
- Title 42px gold "大厅选人 · 选择英雄 + 召唤师技能", subtitle 18px
- seat overview label 20px
- left hero scroll 820×560, cards 150×54
- right summoner 380×560, cards 150×54 (no CD/desc)
- status 20, summary 24 gold, buttons 560×76 font 26: 锁定选择, 开始对局, 离开房间
- COL palette: bg 0.045/0.062/0.095, title gold, text 0.92, dim, ok, err

They're quite different. To "make consistent", the cheaper direction: restyle single-player select to mirror lobby tokens and layout scale. Since single-player is not multiplayer, adapt wording: title "选择英雄 · 召唤师技能" (same as lobby but without 大厅), subtitle explaining AI fill; keep left/right columns with lobby sizes? At 2400 viewport, lobby content up to 1440 wide; single player could use same 1440×980 scroll, same fonts (42 title, 18 sub, 20/24 labels), same card style (150×54 buttons) — but single-player cards need click-to-select highlight; lobby uses Buttons with disabled states; single-play can use same `_mk_card_btn`-like buttons with pressed → select, and highlight selected by style change.

Also add the seat/summary line: single-player can show "你：角色 · 英雄 + 召唤师" and a "锁定并开始" button, plus "返回大厅" button, matching lobby buttons 560×76 font 26.

This is a meaningful rewrite of `_show_hero_select_ui` (~130 lines) + `_create_hero_card`/`_create_summ_card` replaced by button-based cards. Risk: `_on_hero_selected` expects Panel card and style updates (`selected_hero_card`), `_on_card_hover`, `_update_confirm_button_style`, `select_summary_label`, `select_confirm_btn` used elsewhere (e.g., in `_on_hero_selected`, `_on_summoner_selected`, `_on_confirm`). Need to check all usages of these vars to keep in sync.

grep in BattleManager for selected_hero_card, selected_summ_card, select_confirm_btn, select_summary_label, _create_hero_card, _create_summ_card, _update_confirm_button_style, _on_card_hover.

That reveals how much refactor. If we keep Panel-based cards but restyle sizes/colors and restructure panel layout, less risk.

Alternative minimal-risk approach achieving visual consistency: keep existing Panel cards & logic, but:
- panel size 1440×980 (like lobby), centered
- title 42 gold gold; subtitle 18 sub
- role headers 19
- hero cards 150×54 (matching lobby card size), fonts 20
- summoner cards 150×54? But summoner cards show CD/desc; lobby summoner cards are just names. To match, make summoner cards 150×54 with name only (and maybe CD small)? Consistency with lobby favors simple name buttons, but losing CD/desc info hurts single-player UX. Could keep 256×62 with desc; but then not identical.
- summary 24 gold; confirm 560×76 font 26 "✔  锁定选择并开始"; add "离开" button to lobby? Single-player has no lobby to leave (battle scene). Could add "返回大厅" that changes scene to lobby.tscn — nice parity but scope.

Hmm. This is drifting.

MAYBE the intended inconsistency is simpler: in-battle HUD. Let me check if client *actually* has all host HUD pieces by comparing what host UI_Manager creates vs what NetClientBattle builds:
Host: fx_flash, death_overlay, target panel, skill bar (hidden), info labels, buff icons, attribute panel, hero detail (C), recall, yuanliu, death recap, team decision panel. Plus shop? Let me grep UI_Manager for shop/recommend/result creation:
- `_create_shop_panel`? Not in func list. Search "shop" in UI_Manager function names. Maybe UI_Manager has `_create_shop` inside `_create_info_labels`. Let me grep.

Client: HUD(world bars), pad, minimap, target panel, buff row, yuanliu, roster (C/T), shop, rec bar, kill feed, recall, death recap, result panel. Missing vs host: fx_flash (screen flash — client P0 Vfx.screen_flash will call ui.flash_screen on client... client has no "ui" group? Vfx.screen_flash looks up group "ui" → on client, no UI_Manager (NetClientBattle owns HUD), so local player's ult flash doesn't work on client! That's a real in-battle inconsistency: host gets flash/shake, client? camera_shake/fov_punch/hitstop call BattleManager via group "battle_manager" — client NetClientBattle isn't in that group, so client gets none. But that's VFX, not UI.)

Also host death_overlay (desaturate/grey on death?) — client death recap only; difference possibly.

This audit is large either way. Perhaps the right move is to ask the user which UI they mean, with options; but the user expects us to compare. We could do both: present comparison findings + fix the clearest, most visible one.

Given constraints, I think the best deliverable: **unify the hero selection UI** (single-player in-battle select vs multiplayer lobby select) because it's the single biggest and clearest inconsistency between 单机版 and 联机版 flows, and it's fully within one file (BattleManager) plus maybe NetLobby shared style. Implement restyle in BattleManager to mirror lobby tokens/layout while keeping its logic.

But hold on: is single-player select even used? `_show_hero_select_ui` called in BattleManager._ready unless net host with picks. Single-player route: NetLobby._start_singleplayer → change_scene battle.tscn → BattleManager shows select UI. Yes.

Let me check all references to select UI vars before rewriting. Grep.

The select UI logic is self-contained in ~320 lines (2071-2400). I could restyle it wholesale to match NetLobby's visual language while preserving callbacks (`_on_hero_selected`, `_on_summoner_selected`, `_update_selection_summary`, `_update_confirm_button_style`).

Rather than rewrite layout deeply, do a "theme unification" pass:
1. Panel: use full-screen scroll like lobby? Lobby uses centered VBox in _stack with ScrollContainer. Single-player: panel 920×600 → change to 1440×980 (or responsive min) with scroll? Simpler: enlarge panel to `Vector2(1440, 980) * _ui_scale`? At 2400×1400 with ui_scale 1.35 → 1944×1323 too big. Lobby uses raw px (no ui_scale) with min size vs viewport. Since lobby's 1440×980 fits 2400×1400 (with title 74 etc.), single-player should use raw px too (like lobby) instead of ui_scale.

Better approach: single-player select uses same raw-pixel design as lobby (no _ui_scale). That alone makes them visually consistent across resolutions (lobby already responds via scroll container min sizes). But host battle itself uses _ui_scale for in-battle HUD, so selection screen in battle will look like lobby (raw px) — that's what we want: consistent *with multi-player selection*.

Concretely restyle:
- Container: full-screen dark ColorRect + centered VBox (not Panel 920×600), like lobby's `_stack`? Lobby's `_build_base` likely creates background + centered VBox; read lines 83-114 to copy exact structure/tokens.
- Title: "选择英雄 · 召唤师技能" 42px gold (lobby uses 42 gold for select title; menu uses 74 for game title).
- Subtitle 18 sub: "单机人机对局：选择英雄与召唤师技能，其余席位由 AI 补齐。"
- Left hero scroll: 820×560, role headers 19, cards 150×54 buttons-like (keep Panel but 150×54 with name 20 + role 13).
- Right summoner scroll: 380×560, cards 150×54? Lobby summoner cards are 150×54 name-only, stacked vertically. Single-player cards currently 256×62 with CD+desc. For consistency use 150×54 name-only? Loses info. Alternatively 256×54 with name + CD in one row, desc tooltip... I'd match lobby: name-only buttons 150×54, and show CD/desc in the bottom summary when selected (or a description line under title). To keep info: add a details label line under summoner list showing selected summoner CD + desc. Nice.
- Bottom: status label 20 (COL_ERR), summary 24 gold, buttons 560×76 font 26: "✔  开始游戏" and "返回大厅".
- Buttons style same as lobby `_btn_style` (bg colors, radius 10, borders, margins).
- Cards style same as lobby `_card_style` (radius 8, border 0.9 alpha 0.15/0.3, bg tinted).
- Selected state: brighten bg / border gold (lobby has no selected state since cards are buttons with disabled for blocked; single player needs selection highlight). Implement via style override on select.

Also return-to-lobby button: `get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/lobby.tscn")`? Check NetLobby route; single-player launch uses change_scene_to_file battle.tscn. To return, change scene to lobby.tscn. Is there existing return? Search "lobby.tscn" usages. Probably NetResultPanel has return-to-lobby. Check for "change_scene_to_file" occurrences to mirror. Also NetSession mode must be reset? For single-player, NetSession.mode likely OFF; returning to lobby is safe. But maybe avoid adding return button (scope). Lobby's select has "离开房间"; single-player equivalent "返回大厅" adds parity and is useful. Risk: leaving battle scene while Main? Fine.

However, hidden risk: `_ui_scale` used in BattleManager select code and also `select_ui`; after rewrite keep `_ui_scale` for nothing? It's used elsewhere? Only select UI (grep shows lines 2072, 2082...). `_ui_scale` var declared line 8; if unused after rewrite, remove or keep (unused var fine). Don't remove to minimize risk? Keep set to 1.0 or delete uses. I'll keep `_ui_scale` assigned but unused—harmless warning.

Additionally, in-battle parity check: worth also fixing the client's missing **ult screen flash / shake**? Vfx.screen_flash uses group "ui"; client doesn't add group. But that's gameplay FX not UI; the user asked UI. Skip.

But wait: maybe better to first confirm with user? Time. Let me also quickly audit in-battle top/HUD parity to mention in final answer, but not necessarily change. Actually user asked to "争取让它们一致" — we should change things. Selection UI is the biggest.

Hmm, but is single-player select actually visible to user? Yes.

Then rewrite BattleManager select UI functions:
- `_show_hero_select_ui` (~2071-2207)
- `_create_hero_card` (2208-2239)
- `_create_summ_card` (2241-2278)
- keep `_on_card_hover` but adapt (Panel still).
- Keep selection logic 2314-2400 mostly (styles references: they fetch style and set bg color — works if our style is StyleBoxFlat).
- `_update_confirm_button_style` sets button styles based on disabled; adapt colors to lobby palette; keep text.

Also need `COL_*` constants in BattleManager? Add local consts mirroring NetLobby palette (or reuse via preload of NetLobby? NetLobby is a Control script with class? no class_name). Define consts in BattleManager with same values.

```gdscript
	# main HBox
	var main := HBoxContainer.new(); separation 18
	var hero_scroll := ScrollContainer.new() custom_minimum_size Vector2(820, 560)
	var hero_box := VBoxContainer...
	... same role grouping, headers 19 + color bar 4x20, flow, cards _create_hero_card
	var summ_panel := VBoxContainer.new(); custom_min 380,560
	stitle "召唤师技能（点击选择）" 19 left
	var summ_scroll := ScrollContainer.new(); custom min 380x? 
	...
	# details label under summoner list (CD + desc)
	select_summ_detail = Label.new()
	# bottom status/summary/buttons
```
Need new var for summ detail label? Add `var select_summ_detail: Label = null` near other select vars (line 17-20 region). Since `_on_summoner_selected` updates summary, we can also update detail there. To minimize logic edits, set detail text in `_on_summoner_selected` via new field.

But adding info: CD + desc; `_create_summ_card` currently gets cd/desc; if new card only shows name, pass data through? Simplest: summoner cards keep name + small CD text in a 150×54 card? Lobby uses name-only 150×54; to be consistent, name-only, and detail label shows "闪现 · CD 120s — 描述". Store summoner metadata dict for lookup: `SUMMONER_DESCRIPTIONS` exists and cd via SkillDatabase.get_skill(sid).cooldown; `_on_summoner_selected(sid,sname,card)` can compute.

Implement `_create_summ_card(sname, sid)` signature change → update call at 2174 and function; `_on_summoner_selected` unchanged signature.

Also `_on_card_hover` styles: with new card styles (bg tinted by role color at 0.55 alpha?), hover uses bg change; selection changes border/bg. Existing `_on_hero_selected` sets prev style bg back to Color(0.12,0.12,0.16,0.9) (hardcoded) for deselected cards — with tinted cards, reset should restore role-tinted bg. Simplest: make card bg consistent neutral dark (0.15,0.17,0.21 like lobby disabled) with role-colored 1px border; then hardcoded reset color should match. But `_on_hero_selected` line 2317-2335: read to see exact style operations.

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Original: "请你给出优化各个法术的动画的方案，使它们看起来更加逼真，待我确认后再修改" — produce a plan to make every spell's animation more realistic, wait for confirmation before code changes.
- Confirmed scope via structured questions: (1) full P0→P3 in 5 batches; (2) visual windup only, no damage/cooldown/judgment timing changes; (3) extend generic FX events with host/client parity.
- Subsequent: "继续" (proceed P1), "下一步吧" (proceed P2), then current: "请把法术的各种道具逼真化，比如小乔的扇子和旋风，甄姬的冰柱等" — make spell *props* physical/realistic (Xiao Qiao's fan & tornado, Zhen Ji's ice pillars, etc.).

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot **4.7.2 stable**, GDScript, mobile renderer, Android target; glow+ACES enabled; no test suite/build; verification via Godot headless load/run.
- Hero GLBs contain 30 clips: `idle/walk/sprint/jump/fall/crouch/sit/drive/die/pick-up/emote-yes-no/holding-right|left|both/holding-*-shoot/attack-melee-left|right/attack-kick-*/interact-*/wheelchair-*`; ~7 joints (`root, arm-left, arm-right, head, head-mesh`).
- No imported art assets — all meshes are procedural (`BoxMesh/SphereMesh/CylinderMesh/TorusMesh/PlaneMesh`, plus new `SurfaceTool` fan mesh).
- Existing VFX were primitive meshes + Tween; now GPUParticles3D + 4 shaders + data-driven shapes/props.
- Net FX currently whitelist kinds in `NetSession.gd` (`FX_SPELL=1 … FX_XQ_WHIRL=22`), `push_net_fx()`, client catalog in `NetClientBattle.gd`; P3 parity still pending.
- Important data quirk: `SkillDataBase.gd:3625` sets `skill.is_channeling = true` for **all** `type` 1/3/4 (means "non-targeted"), so it cannot be used to detect real channels.
- `Skill.charge` / `skill.cast_time` are never read anywhere; damage timing untouched by design.

## Files and Code
- `docs/spell-animation-plan.md` — plan + implementation records. Sections: 现状体检, 6-module architecture, 28 heroes × 3 skills proposals, P0–P3 batches; added 「七、P0 实施记录」「八、P1 实施记录」「九、P2 实施记录」. Needs a P2.5 (props) record appended.
- `scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd` (autoload `Vfx`) — main FX factory. Contains:
  - Palettes `ELEMENTS` (10 elements: fire/ice/water/lightning/shadow/holy/blade/wind/earth/arcane with `c,c2,light,size,gravity,speed`), `HERO_ELEMENT` (28 heroes).
  - Budget: `MAX_ACTIVE=40`, `MAX_TRAILS=24`, `MAX_LIGHTS=2`, groups `vfx_fx`/`vfx_trail`/`vfx_light`, `quality: int = 2` (0=off,1=low,2=med,3=high).
  - `_ready()` loads `_soft_tex`, `_spark_tex`, `shaders/fx_beam.gdshader`, `shaders/fx_glow.gdshader`.
  - API: `element_of`, `element_data`, `color_for_hero`, `color2_for_hero`, `team_color`, `cast_burst`, `hit_spark`, `cast_glow`, `shockwave`, `beam`, `attach_trail`, `camera_shake`, `camera_punch`, `hitstop`, `screen_flash`, `play_spell`, `sigil`, `pillar`, `nova`, `slash_fx`, `dash_fx`, `_delayed_ring`, `_delayed_pillar`, prop funcs (`_prop_mat`, `_fan_mesh`, `_spawn_skill_prop`, `fan_fx`, `tornado_fx`, `ice_pillars_fx`, `ice_crystal_fx`, `swords_fx`, `orbs_fx`, `sun_orb_fx`), `_burst`, `_ring`, `_particles`, `_light`, `_add_root`, `_near_limit`, `_scaled_amount`, `_make_radial_texture`.
  - `const SPELL_FX = preload("res://scripts/core/SpellFxTable.gd")`.
  - `play_spell(hero_name, slot, caster_pos, target_pos, skill, facing, is_local)`: ult+table → signature shape; else type-based shape (`zone/line/dash/aura/bolt/channel`); both paths then call `_spawn_skill_prop(...)`.
  - **Temporary debug line still present**: `print("[PROP] ", hero_name, " ", slot, " ", prop)` after `if _near_limit(1): return` in `_spawn_skill_prop` — MUST be removed.
- `scripts/core/SpellFxTable.gd` — `extends RefCounted`, static data:
  - `ULTS` (16 signature entries, e.g. `"吕布": {"el":"shadow","shape":"target_big","shake":0.18,"heavy":true}`), `get_ult`, `has_ult`.
  - `get_skill_shape(skill)` → type 1 `zone`, 3 `line`, 4 `dash`, 6 `aura`, else `bolt` (channeling removed from dispatch).
  - `SKILL_PROPS` (P2.5 map): `小乔 {0:"fan",1:"tornado"}`, `甄姬 {0:"ice_pillars",1:"ice_crystal"}`, `王昭君 {0:"ice_crystal",1:"ice_pillars"}`, `安琪拉 {0:"orbs",1:"orbs"}`, `妲己 {0:"orbs",1:"orbs"}`, `李白 {0:"swords",1:"swords"}`, `后羿 {0:"sun_orb",1:"sun_orb"}`, `东皇太一 {0:"orbs"}`; `get_prop(hero_name, slot) -> String`.
- `shaders/fx_beam.gdshader` — axial flowing additive beam (`beam_color`, `intensity=2.4`, `flow_speed`, `flow_density`).
- `shaders/fx_glow.gdshader` — radial soft glow/ring decal (`glow_color`, `intensity`, `softness`, `ring_width`, `pulse_speed`).
- `scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd`:
  - New vars `_shield_fx`, `_hit_react_active`, `_last_feedback_msec`.
  - `_process` adds `_update_shield_visual()`; new funcs `_update_shield_visual()`, `_damage_feedback(actual, _is_magic)` (hero-only sparks, camera shake throttle 90 ms, `-0.14 rad` hit-react tween on `hm.visual_mesh`).
  - `take_damage`: `_damage_feedback(actual, is_magic)` in shield-absorb branch and after `health -= actual`.
  - `_play_anim`: now skips if `current_anim == anim_name and anim_player.is_playing()`.
- `scripts/entities/Hero.gd`:
  - `const CAST_ANIM_MELEE`, `CAST_ANIM_TWOHAND`; `_melee_anim_flip`.
  - `_cast_anim_name`, `_attack_anim` (ranged `holding-*-shoot`, melee alternating left/right), `_muzzle_pos`, `_cast_feedback`.
  - `_start_casting` calls `_cast_feedback(skill, index)`.
  - `_finish_casting` after `var pos = pending_skill_target`: `Vfx.play_spell(display_name, pending_skill_index, global_position + Vector3.UP*1.2 + _cast_fwd*0.65, pos, skill, _cast_fwd, not is_ai)`.
  - `_perform_attack` uses `_attack_anim()`; ranged basic adds muzzle `cast_burst`; melee dash sites also `_attack_anim()`.
  - `_use_summoner` all 9 branches have Vfx calls (闪现 bursts/shake, 终结 beam+shockwave, 惩击 beam+spark, etc.).
- `scripts/entities/Bullet.gd`: `_ready` attaches hero trail; `on_hit()` spawns `hit_spark` iff `source is Hero and (target is Hero or Turret or JungleMonster)`.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd`: `const SPELL_FX = preload(...)`; vars `_shake_amp/_shake_dur/_shake_t/_cam_base_fov/_hitstop_until_msec`; `camera_shake`, `_apply_camera_shake(delta)` (called after camera position set), `fov_punch`, `hitstop` (Engine.time_scale 0.12, restore via `create_timer(dur,true,false,true)`), `on_big_cast(hero)` (table shake/heavy hitstop, element-colored `Vfx.screen_flash`).
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`: `_fx_flash` ColorRect + `_fx_flash_tween`, `_create_fx_flash()` (called at start of `_ready`, `move_child(...,0)`), `flash_screen(color, dur)`.
- `project.godot`: autoload `Vfx="*res://scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd"` after `SfxManager`.

## Errors and Fixes
- `git log` fails: workspace is **not a git repo** → no diff/rollback; keep edits surgical.
- `edit` on `project.godot`/`BattleManager.gd` failed with "file has not been read" → must `read` each file region with the read tool before edit.
- `--check-only --script` reports false `Identifier not found: Vfx/ItemDatabase/NetSession` because autoloads are not created → not a real error; use `--headless --path . --editor --quit` and a headless battle instead.
- Running battle headless prints many `ERROR: Condition "!is_inside_tree()" is true. Returning: Transform3D()` with backtrace `spawn_single_minion (BattleManager.gd:3079)` — pre-existing (global_position before add_child), unrelated.
- Pre-existing `SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Class "Minimap" hides a global script class` + case-mismatch `MiniMap.gd` vs `Minimap.gd` on every import — unrelated, ignore.
- P2 first attempt: 104/166 skills hit `channel` because `is_channeling` is true for type 1/3/4 → fixed by dispatching purely on `skill.type`; verified distribution bolt 48 / zone 41 / line 36 / dash 9 / aura 5.
- Godot logs `Failed to open 'user://logs/...'` / `Failed to read the root certificate store` in headless → harmless.

## Pending Jobs
- Remove temporary `print("[PROP] ", ...)` from `VfxFactory._spawn_skill_prop`, then rerun a short headless battle to confirm 0 errors.
- Append 「十、P2.5 法术道具实施记录」 to `docs/spell-animation-plan.md` (props list, mapping, verification numbers).
- Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · 法术道具" -Message "<one-line result>"` (mandatory per CLAUDE.md).
- P3 (remaining batch): status visuals (stun/slow/silence/stealth), net FX event parity per confirmed option A, mobile quality tiers/LOD, overall tuning.

## Current Work
- P2.5 props implemented and parse-verified (`--editor --quit` only shows pre-existing Minimap error).
- Last run: `battle.tscn --headless --quit-after 3000 -- --net-test` → `exit=0 skills=177 bad=0` (no script/invalid-property errors), but the `[PROP]` grep table printed **empty**: the grouped output section was blank, suggesting props may not have spawned (or `_near_limit(1)`/distance gate filtered them all, or grep/group formatting failed). Needs diagnosis before declaring complete.

## Next Step
- Diagnose why no `[PROP]` lines appeared: re-run and dump raw `Select-String '\[PROP\]'` count/lines; check gates (`_near_limit(1)`, 30-unit distance from `bm.hero`, `SPELL_FX.get_prop`), loosen/verify if necessary, confirm fan/tornado/ice_pillars/swords/orbs actually spawn; then remove the debug print and finish doc+notification.

## Critical Context
- Hero count is 28 in `SkillDataBase.gd` (CLAUDE.md's "17 heroes" is stale).
- Design thesis: realism = timing structure + caster body + light/ground interaction + hit feedback + consistent element palette; props now extend "physical object" layer.
- User explicitly wants **visible physical props** (扇子/旋风/冰柱), not just auras — prioritize readable silhouettes; all built procedurally since no art assets.
- All FX are local-only visual; damage/cooldown/judgment untouched; host remains authoritative; net event parity is P3.
- Budget discipline: ≤40 burst systems, ≤24 trails, ≤2 lights; props added to `vfx_fx` group and skipped via `_near_limit(1)`/30-unit distance.
- Godot binary: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`; verify with `--headless --path . --editor --quit` and `--headless --path . res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after N -- --net-test`.
- Workspace `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king` (workspace-write), Windows notification script `scripts/dev/notify.ps1` prints `popup shown: …`.
- CLAUDE.md: minimal changes, token-frugal reads, no unnecessary agents, minimal verification, concise output, notification at every delivery.

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

```gdscript
func _sel_label(text: String, size: int, color: Color, centered: bool = true) -> Label:

	lab.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	lab.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if centered else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	return lab
```

```gdscript
func _sel_btn_style(color: Color, hovered: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
```

```
	sb.content_margin_right = 26
	sb.content_margin_top = 10

func _sel_card_style(color: Color, hovered: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()

func _sel_btn(text: String, color: Color) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
```

```
func _sel_label(text: String, size: int, color: Color, centered: bool = true) -> Label:

	lab.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	lab.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if centered else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
	return lab

func _sel_btn_style(color: Color, hovered: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:

	sb.content_margin_right = 26
	sb.content_margin_top = 10
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 10
	return sb

func _sel_card_style(color: Color, hovered: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = color
	sb.border_color = Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 0.3) if hovered else Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 0.15)
	sb.set_border_width_all(1)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.content_margin_left = 8
	sb.content_margin_right = 8
	sb.content_margin_top = 6
	sb.content_margin_bottom = 6
	return sb

func _sel_btn(text: String, color: Color) -> Button:

	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 76)
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sel_btn_style(color, false))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sel_btn_style(color.lightened(0.18), true))

	b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_TEXT)
	b.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color.WHITE)
	return b
```

```powershell
function Conv([string]$s) {
    $s = [regex]::Replace($s, '(?m)^( +)', { param($m) "`t" * [int]([math]::Floor($m.Groups[1].Value.Length / 4)) })
    return $s.Replace("`n", $eol)
}

function Rep([ref]$text, [string]$start, [string]$end, [string]$new) {
    $i = $text.Value.IndexOf($start)
    if ($i -lt 0) { throw "start marker missing: $start" }
    $j = $text.Value.IndexOf($end, $i)
    if ($j -lt 0) { throw "end marker missing: $end" }
```
    $text.Value = $text.Value.Substring(0, $i) + $eol + (Conv $new) + $eol + $text.Value.Substring($j)
}

# ---------- 单机选人界面：视觉/规格对齐联机大厅选人（NetLobby._show_select） ----------
const SEL_BG := Color(0.045, 0.062, 0.095)
const SEL_TITLE := Color(0.98, 0.84, 0.36)
const SEL_SUB := Color(0.65, 0.72, 0.83)
const SEL_TEXT := Color(0.92, 0.94, 0.97)
const SEL_DIM := Color(0.5, 0.56, 0.66)
const SEL_GOLD := Color(0.95, 0.78, 0.4)
const SEL_SUMM_COLOR := Color(0.36, 0.46, 0.66)

func _sel_label(text: String, size: int, color: Color, centered: bool = true) -> Label:
    var lab := Label.new()
    lab.text = text
    lab.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", size)
    lab.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
    lab.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER if centered else HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
    return lab

func _sel_btn_style(color: Color, hovered: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
    var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
    sb.bg_color = color
    sb.border_color = Color(0.85, 0.85, 0.95, 0.25) if hovered else Color(0.85, 0.85, 0.95, 0.12)
    sb.set_border_width_all(1)
    sb.set_corner_radius_all(10)
    sb.content_margin_left = 26
    sb.content_margin_right = 26
    sb.content_margin_top = 10
    sb.content_margin_bottom = 10
    return sb

func _sel_card_style(color: Color, hovered: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
    var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
    sb.bg_color = color
    sb.border_color = Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 0.3) if hovered else Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 0.15)
    sb.set_border_width_all(1)
    sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
    sb.content_margin_left = 8
    sb.content_margin_right = 8
    sb.content_margin_top = 6
    sb.content_margin_bottom = 6
    return sb

func _sel_btn(text: String, color: Color) -> Button:
    var b := Button.new()
    b.text = text
    b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(560, 76)
    b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 26)
    b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sel_btn_style(color, false))
    b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sel_btn_style(color.lightened(0.18), true))
    b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _sel_btn_style(color.darkened(0.25), false))
    b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_TEXT)
    b.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color.WHITE)
    return b

func _style_card(card: Panel, base_color: Color, selected: bool) -> void:
    var style = card.get_theme_stylebox("panel", "Panel") as StyleBoxFlat
    if not style: return
    style.bg_color = base_color.lightened(0.25) if selected else base_color
    style.border_color = SEL_GOLD if selected else Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 0.15)
    style.set_border_width_all(3 if selected else 1)

# 与联机大厅选人（NetLobby._show_select）同款：同背景/标题字号/卡片尺寸/按钮规格
func _show_hero_select_ui():
    var vpsz := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
    select_ui = CanvasLayer.new()
    select_ui.layer = 10
    var bg := ColorRect.new()
    bg.color = SEL_BG
    bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    select_ui.add_child(bg)
    var center := CenterContainer.new()
    center.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    select_ui.add_child(center)
    var sc := ScrollContainer.new()
    sc.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(maxf(900, minf(vpsz.x * 0.96, 1440)), maxf(480, minf(vpsz.y * 0.94, 980)))
    sc.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_AUTO
    center.add_child(sc)
    var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
    vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
    sc.add_child(vbox)
    vbox.add_child(_sel_label("选择英雄 · 召唤师技能", 42, SEL_TITLE))
    vbox.add_child(_sel_label("单机人机对局：选择一名英雄与召唤师技能，同队其余席位与红方 5 人由 AI 补齐。", 18, SEL_SUB))
    var main := HBoxContainer.new()
    main.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
    vbox.add_child(main)
    # 左：按职责分组的英雄卡（同大厅选人）
    var hero_scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
    hero_scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(820, 560)
    hero_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
    var hero_box := VBoxContainer.new()
    hero_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
    hero_scroll.add_child(hero_box)
    main.add_child(hero_scroll)
    var roles_order := ["战士", "法师", "刺客", "射手", "辅助"]
    var roles_grouped := {}
    for role in roles_order: roles_grouped[role] = []
    for type2 in hero_configs:
        var cfg2 = hero_configs[type2]
        var role2 = cfg2.get("role", "战士")
        if not roles_grouped.has(role2): roles_grouped[role2] = []
        roles_grouped[role2].append(type2)
    for role in roles_order:
        var heroes_in_role = roles_grouped[role]
        if heroes_in_role.is_empty(): continue
        var role_color = ROLE_COLORS.get(role, Color.GRAY)
        var hrow := HBoxContainer.new()
        hrow.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
        var bar := ColorRect.new()
        bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(4, 20)
        bar.color = role_color
        hrow.add_child(bar)
        hrow.add_child(_sel_label("%s（%d）" % [role, heroes_in_role.size()], 19, role_color, false))
        hero_box.add_child(hrow)
        var flow := HFlowContainer.new()
        flow.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 6)
        flow.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 6)
        for hero_name in heroes_in_role:
            var cfg3 = hero_configs[hero_name]
            flow.add_child(_create_hero_card(hero_name, cfg3.get("role", ""), role_color))
        hero_box.add_child(flow)
    # 右：召唤师技能（同大厅选人：名称卡；选中后下方显示冷却与说明）
    var summ_panel := VBoxContainer.new()
    summ_panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(380, 560)
    summ_panel.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
    main.add_child(summ_panel)
    summ_panel.add_child(_sel_label("召唤师技能（点击选择）", 19, SEL_TEXT, false))
    var summ_scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
    summ_scroll.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(380, 480)
    summ_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
    summ_scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
    var summ_list := VBoxContainer.new()
    summ_list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
    summ_scroll.add_child(summ_list)
    summ_panel.add_child(summ_scroll)
    var summons := {"闪现": "flash", "疾跑": "sprint", "传送": "teleport", "治疗术": "heal", "终结": "execute", "狂暴": "frenzy", "晕眩": "stun", "净化": "cleanse_summoner", "弱化": "weaken", "惩击": "smite"}
    for sname in summons:
        summ_list.add_child(_create_summ_card(sname, str(summons[sname])))
    select_summ_detail = _sel_label("选中后显示冷却与说明", 16, SEL_DIM, false)
    select_summ_detail.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
    select_summ_detail.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(380, 0)
    summ_panel.add_child(select_summ_detail)
    # 底部：摘要 + 开始 + 返回大厅（同大厅选人按钮规格）
    select_summary_label = _sel_label("请先选英雄与召唤师技能", 24, SEL_DIM)
    vbox.add_child(select_summary_label)
    var bottom := HBoxContainer.new()
    bottom.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    bottom.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 22)
    vbox.add_child(bottom)
    select_confirm_btn = _sel_btn("✔  开始游戏", Color(0.30, 0.62, 0.35))
    select_confirm_btn.disabled = true
    select_confirm_btn.pressed.connect(_on_confirm)
    bottom.add_child(select_confirm_btn)
    var leave := _sel_btn("返回大厅", Color(0.42, 0.22, 0.24))
    leave.pressed.connect(_on_select_leave)
    bottom.add_child(leave)
    _update_selection_summary()
    _update_confirm_button_style()
    add_child(select_ui)
'@

$b2 = @'
func _create_hero_card(hero_name: String, role: String, role_color: Color) -> Panel:
    var card = Panel.new()
    card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(150, 54)
    card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _sel_card_style(role_color, false))
    var inner_v = VBoxContainer.new()
    inner_v.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    inner_v.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    card.add_child(inner_v)
    var name_label = Label.new()
    name_label.text = hero_name
    name_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    name_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
    name_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_TEXT)
    inner_v.add_child(name_label)
    var role_label = Label.new()
    role_label.text = role
    role_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    role_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
    role_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1, 1, 1, 0.62))
    inner_v.add_child(role_label)
    card.gui_input.connect(_on_hero_card_clicked.bind(hero_name, card, role_color))
    card.mouse_entered.connect(_on_card_hover.bind(card, true, role_color))
    card.mouse_exited.connect(_on_card_hover.bind(card, false, role_color))
    return card
'@

$b3 = @'
func _create_summ_card(sname: String, sid: String) -> Panel:
    var card = Panel.new()
    card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(150, 54)
    card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _sel_card_style(SEL_SUMM_COLOR, false))
    var lbl = Label.new()
    lbl.text = sname
    lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    lbl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
    lbl.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
    lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
    lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_TEXT)
    card.add_child(lbl)
    card.gui_input.connect(_on_summ_card_clicked.bind(sid, sname, card))
    card.mouse_entered.connect(_on_card_hover.bind(card, true, SEL_SUMM_COLOR))
    card.mouse_exited.connect(_on_card_hover.bind(card, false, SEL_SUMM_COLOR))
    return card
'@

$b4 = @'
func _on_card_hover(card: Panel, hover: bool, base_color: Color):
    var style = card.get_theme_stylebox("panel", "Panel") as StyleBoxFlat
    if not style: return
    if card == selected_hero_card or card == selected_summ_card: return
    style.bg_color = base_color.lightened(0.2) if hover else base_color
'@

$b5 = @'
func _on_hero_selected(type: String, card: Panel = null, role_color: Color = Color.WHITE):
    if selected_hero_card:
        var prev_role = hero_configs.get(selected_hero_type, {}).get("role", "")
        _style_card(selected_hero_card, ROLE_COLORS.get(prev_role, Color.GRAY), false)
    selected_hero_type = type
    selected_hero_card = card
    if card:
        _style_card(card, role_color, true)
    _update_selection_summary()
    _update_confirm_button_style()
'@

$b6 = @'
func _on_summoner_selected(id: String, sname: String = "", card: Panel = null):
    selected_summoner = id
    if selected_summ_card:
        _style_card(selected_summ_card, SEL_SUMM_COLOR, false)
    selected_summ_card = card
    if card:
        _style_card(card, SEL_SUMM_COLOR, true)
    if select_summ_detail:
        var sdata = SkillDatabase.get_skill(id)
        var cd := 0.0
        if sdata:
            cd = sdata.cooldown
        select_summ_detail.text = "%s · 冷却 %d 秒\n%s" % [sname, int(round(cd)), SUMMONER_DESCRIPTIONS.get(sname, "")]
    _update_selection_summary()
    _update_confirm_button_style()
'@

$b7 = @'
func _update_selection_summary():
    if not select_summary_label: return
    if selected_hero_type != "":
        var role = hero_configs[selected_hero_type].get("role", "")
        var summ_name := ""
        var summ_map := {"闪现": "flash", "疾跑": "sprint", "传送": "teleport", "治疗术": "heal", "终结": "execute", "狂暴": "frenzy", "晕眩": "stun", "净化": "cleanse_summoner", "弱化": "weaken", "惩击": "smite"}
        for sn in SUMMONER_DESCRIPTIONS:
            if summ_map.get(sn, "") == selected_summoner: summ_name = sn; break
        if summ_name != "":
            select_summary_label.text = "待开始：%s · %s + %s" % [role, selected_hero_type, summ_name]
            select_summary_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_GOLD)
        else:
            select_summary_label.text = "已选英雄：%s（%s），请选择召唤师技能" % [selected_hero_type, role]
            select_summary_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_TEXT)
    else:
        select_summary_label.text = "请先选英雄与召唤师技能"
        select_summary_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_DIM)
'@

$b8 = @'
func _update_confirm_button_style():
    if not select_confirm_btn: return
    var ready := selected_hero_type != ""
    select_confirm_btn.disabled = not ready
    var base := Color(0.30, 0.62, 0.35)
    if ready:
        select_confirm_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sel_btn_style(base, false))
        select_confirm_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sel_btn_style(base.lightened(0.18), true))
        select_confirm_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _sel_btn_style(base.darkened(0.25), false))
        select_confirm_btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", SEL_TEXT)
    else:
        var off := Color(0.15, 0.17, 0.21)
        select_confirm_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", _sel_btn_style(off, false))
        select_confirm_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", _sel_btn_style(off, false))
        select_confirm_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _sel_btn_style(off, false))
        select_confirm_btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.42, 0.46, 0.54))

func _on_select_leave():
    get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/lobby.tscn")
'@

Rep ([ref]$t) "func _create_hero_card" "func _create_summ_card" $b2

Rep ([ref]$t) "func _on_card_hover" "func _on_hero_card_clicked" $b4

Rep ([ref]$t) "func _on_summoner_selected" "func _update_selection_summary" $b6

Rep ([ref]$t) "func _update_confirm_button_style" "func _on_confirm" $b8

$t = $t.Replace("var select_summary_label: Label = null" + $eol, "var select_summary_label: Label = null" + $eol + "var select_summ_detail: Label = null" + $eol)

[IO.File]::WriteAllText($p, $t)
Write-Output "patched"
"}

139: static func _build_ground_shader() -> Shader:
140: 	var sh := Shader.new()
141: 	sh.code = _GROUND_CODE
142: 	return sh
143: 
144: const _GROUND_CODE := """
145: shader_type spatial;
146: render_mode diffuse_burley, specular_schlick_ggx, cull_back;
147: 
148: uniform sampler2D layout_tex : filter_linear, repeat_disable;
149: uniform sampler2D detail_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable;
150: uniform sampler2D normal_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable, hint_normal;
151: uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(1.0);
152: uniform vec4 emission_color : source_color = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
153: uniform float emission_strength = 0.0;
154: uniform float detail_scale = 14.0;
155: uniform float map_half = 60.0;
156: uniform float normal_strength = 0.35;
157: uniform float ground_roughness = 0.95;
158: uniform float bump_amount = 0.0;
159: 
160: varying vec3 wp;
161: 
162: void vertex() {
163: 	wp = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
164: 	// 野区微地形起伏（只动野区，分路/河道/高地保持平）；纯视觉，实体仍踩 y=0
165: 	if (bump_amount > 0.001) {
166: 		float lane_d = min(min(abs(abs(wp.x) - 55.0), abs(abs(wp.z) - 55.0)), abs(wp.x + wp.z) * 0.7071068);
167: 		float lane_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(7.0, 13.0, lane_d);
168: 		float river_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(10.0, 15.0, abs(wp.x - wp.z) * 0.7071068);
169: 		float hg_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(30.0, 38.0, min(length(wp.xz + vec2(60.0, -60.0)), length(wp.xz - vec2(60.0, -60.0))));
170: 		float edge_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(56.0, 70.0, max(abs(wp.x), abs(wp.z)));
171: 		float jungle_m = clamp(1.0 - lane_m - river_m - hg_m, 0.0, 1.0) * edge_m;
172: 		float n = sin(wp.x * 0.34) * cos(wp.z * 0.29) * 0.65 + sin(wp.x * 0.81 + 1.7) * cos(wp.z * 0.67 - 0.9) * 0.35;
173: 		VERTEX.y += n * bump_amount * jungle_m;
174: 	}
175: }

404: 		return null

Client HUD class draws its own, with `u` scaling. Host HUD draws HeroInfoControl and HealthBarControl at fixed px in 2400×1400 space; client scales by u = min(vp/1600,900). At 2400×1400 u=1.5, so client's health bars and HUD text 1.5× larger than host. That's a real "血条大小不一致".

But wait: host UI is designed for 2400×1400 virtual; clients in same window (2400×1400) → client 1.5×. So fix: set `_hud.u` to the host-consistent scale = 1.0? Host HUD doesn't scale at all (raw px). Host UI_Manager scales by ui_scale (1.35) for its panels, but HUD.gd bars raw px. Client's Hud draws world bars matching host HUD sizes (110×15 etc.) — should be raw px, so u should be 1.0 regardless of resolution (host also raw). But client HUD text sizes (status, gold) correspond to host HUD widgets? Host gold/KDA drawn in UI_Manager at 1.35 scale... hmm.

Simplest parity at the design resolution 2400×1400: set u = 1.0. But on devices with other virtual widths (e.g., 3200 wide), host HUD stays raw px (smaller relative), client u=1.0 too → consistent. Client set u=1.0 gives identical px sizes as host at all resolutions? Host raw px; yes identical. But client texts use u-scaled constants that were presumably authored to match host's 1.35-scaled UI elements... e.g., host UI_Manager font sizes ~14*1.35=19; client uses 17*u=17 at u=1. Host gold label font? Let me check host info labels fonts: `_create_info_labels` uses `_apply_label_style(label, 14...)` → 14*1.35=18.9. Client 17 at u=1 → close. At u=1.5 → 25.5 too big. So u=1.0 better parity.

But client bars: host HeroInfoControl size? hero bar custom size maybe 90×? client draws with bw? need compare. Client unit bars use w=110,h=15 (same as host HealthBarControl). With u=1.5 they'd be 165×22.5 → too big vs host. So set u=1.0 → matches host raw sizes. But then on smaller windows (e.g., 1600×900 device), host also raw (same px), so parity maintained. Good: set `_hud.u = 1.0`? But if `u` also used for touch button layout? NetTouchPad separate fixed px sizes (260 etc.) — untouched.

However client _hud_scale() also used for `_build_world`? No.

So change `_hud.u = _hud_scale()` → `_hud.u = 1.0`. But is that right for world bars: host HUD bars fixed px; yes.

Yet world bars in client at u=1.5 also would be 1.5× — user likely noticed. Change to 1.0.

But also host UI_Manager panels scale 1.35 (bigger than client's? client draws own panels replicating raw numbers e.g. skill bar at 92 px * u). With u=1, client skill slot 92 vs host touch buttons 260? Host hides legacy skill bar and uses TouchController buttons (260 px). Client pad_active hides skill bar too when touch active. In client NetTouchPad exists always (touch), so pad_active true → skill bar hidden. Fine.

Now world map: biggest. Implement in `_build_world`:
- Use `MapVisuals.ground_material(0.28)` 300×300 subdiv.
- Lane planes: replace `_add_lane_plane_net` body to use ground_material, y=0.05, rotate when diag.
- High ground: `_add_high_ground_fan` material = `MapVisuals.high_ground_material()` (host high ground color).
- River: `MapVisuals.water_material()` y=0.02.
- Decorations: `MapVisuals.scatter_decorations($World)` — but client also spawns bushes/walls from payload; host's scatter decorations are additional glb decorations (grass, river walls, pots) — those are static and identical; client should add them for visual parity. But wait: host scatter uses same seeds => identical positions. Client adding them duplicates bushes? Host bushes are Bush nodes (stealth) plus glb decorations; client receives Bush data via payload but does client create visual bush nodes? NetModels.bush() from payload → yes. Host's glb grass is separate decoration, so adding is correct for parity.
- Environment: `MapVisuals.setup_environment(self)` replacing custom WorldEnvironment+sun.
- Ground collision: client doesn't need (no raycasts for ground; `_ground_hit` analytic).

Camera: rotation -70 → -60 (host). Also client initial camera? `_cam_focus` etc. Also fov 70 matches. First-person host fov 90 and eye (0,2.4,0) matches.

Also host camera near/far? host default (near 0.05?); client 0.2/2000. Minor.

Also host has `cam.size=30` (irrelevant for perspective).

Also host background sky visible due to fog/sky; client BG_COLOR dark → with setup_environment fixed.

Also host `MapVisuals.scatter_decorations` at end of `_create_map`; client after building world/statics: call once.

Also client ground plane 300 but world visible far; client's ground at y=-0.02 with subdiv+shader (bump).

Need to keep client's `_make_mat` for other uses (fine).

Potential issue: client `_build_world` currently adds wild to `$World`; host adds to self. Client `$World` Node3D at origin; equivalent as long as World transform is identity. Fine.

Also client has `_add_lane_plane_net` used only here; modify.

Also `_add_fountain` client already host-like; keep, but host fountain disc material same; client uses CSG with `csg.material_override`; fine.

Also client high ground: host `_create_fan_plane` uses `MapVisuals.high_ground_material()`; client `_add_high_ground_fan` uses unshaded CHARTREUSE. Fix to material override.

Then health bars: after map+camera, fix `_hud.u` to 1.0. But careful: client `_hud_scale()` seems deliberately created; maybe client at 1600×900 base designed sizes in 1600 space to match host? Host raw px at 2400 wide → design 2400; client function min(vp/1600,900) suggests client designed at 1600×900 baseline, i.e., scaling to match host's ui_scale 1.35 at 2400? 2400/1600 = 1.5 ≈ 1.35? Not exact. Hmm. The client authors wrote "复刻主机 HUD / HealthBarControl" with numbers 110×15 etc. (host raw). If they intended 110 to be host px, then u should be 1.0. If they intended 110 in 1600-space, then at 2400 u=1.5 gives 165 (≠ host 110). So u=1.0 is correct for parity.

But then why compute _hud_scale? Leftover from earlier design (1600×900). Fix to 1.0; keep function maybe unused (remove? keep, but set _hud.u = 1.0 and delete _hud_scale? `_hud_scale` referenced only line 286. Set `_hud.u = 1.0` and leave function unused (warning ok) or remove function. Minimal: change line 286 to `_hud.u = 1.0` and remove function? Function unused fine but lint; keep.

Wait but host HUD label font 32 raw; client draws names font maybe 20*u? Let me check `_unit bar draw` label uses `_text(... 20.0*s)`? Host label font 32. If client 18*u at u=1.5=27; at 1.0=18 — mismatch smaller. Hmm need check client unit draw code lines 2845-2990. Read 2800-3000 to compare sizes with host HUD.

Given effort, maybe better approach: rather than fixing u blindly, compare client bar draw constants vs host:
- Host hero bar: HeroInfoControl custom_minimum_size? Read `scripts/ui/HeroInfoControl.gd` for drawing dims.
- Host unit bar: HealthBarControl sizes set 60×10 default, bar.size 110×15 minion,300×22 turret; label font 32 offset -84.
- Client `_unit_bar_row` passes w/h same as host; then drawing at `s=u` multipliers. If client uses w*s, u should be 1.0.
- Client hero bar drawing: need compare to HeroInfoControl.

Read HeroInfoControl.gd (probably ~200-400 lines) and client hero draw region.

This is getting big. Perhaps delegate this parity audit to a teammate while I implement map/camera fixes? The instruction: teammates only if parallelizable and beneficial. Map fix is one scope; health bar audit another; numeric displays another. Could spawn 2 teammates:
- One: compare and fix client world/camera (map) — but I want to do that myself.
- One: compare client HUD (health bars + numeric popups) vs host, adjust.

Given context budget, delegation is reasonable: spawn a teammate for HUD parity audit (read client Hud class + host HeroInfoControl/HealthBarControl/UI_Manager popups, fix `_hud.u` and constants), while I do map/environment/camera in client.

But both write to NetClientBattle.gd → write-scope conflict! Map edits in `_build_world`/`_build_camera` and HUD edits in class Hud + _process line 286 — same file; risk of concurrent edit collisions. Could ask teammate to only report findings (read-only), then I edit. But report costs tokens anyway... Actually teammate can edit disjoint line ranges but same file → FS version guard may cause stale errors; my edits and theirs interleave → conflicts. Better do it all myself sequentially; or delegate reading/report to one subagent (read-only analysis) and I apply.

Efficiency: I'll do map+camera edits now (well-defined). Then check HUD bars quickly by reading the client draw region + host controls, and set u appropriately.

Let me first read client hero/unit bar drawing (2800-3000) and HeroInfoControl/HealthBarControl quickly.

Damage popups: client uses `_hud_scale()` (1.5 at 2400) × base (16..50) vs host `base * ui_scale()` (1.35). So popups 1.5/1.35 = 1.11× bigger, and positions units: host Label positions raw px; sizes differ ~11%. Also client's `_hud_scale` = min(vp/1600, vp/900).

For exact parity, popup font should use host formula: `ui_scale() = max(1, vw/2400)*1.35`. Client has no ui_scale helper for HUD; but I changed `_hud.u = 1.0`. For popups use same host formula. Add a helper `_ui_scale()` in NetClientBattle? There's `_hud_scale()`; replace its body/uses with host formula, then u? Wait earlier HUD `u` set to 1.0 but popups use `_hud_scale()` → if I redefine `_hud_scale()` to host formula (`max(1, vw/2400)*1.35`), then popups match host exactly, while HUD `u` remains 1.0 (correct for bars). That works: popups scaled like host UI_Manager; bars raw like host HUD.

So: change `_hud_scale()` body to host formula and keep `_hud.u = 1.0`:
```gdscript
func _hud_scale() -> float:
	var vp := get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	if vp.x <= 0.0:
		return 1.35
	return maxf(1.0, vp.x / 2400.0) * 1.35
```
Rename semantics: it's now "UI scale for floating text", same as host. But `_hud.u = 1.0` fixed.

Also other uses of `_hud_scale()`? grep: line 286 (changed), 1011, 1045 and maybe others in event layer (exp popups?). grep for `_hud_scale()`. If used for HUD elements that should be raw, careful. Let me grep.

Also client popups lack crit four-point star (host CritMark) except outline; client `_spawn_dmg_label` no crit mark → mismatch in "数值显示". Could add CritMark replicate? Host CritMark draws star; client can draw a star via a small Control inner class. Effort moderate. Also host stagger offset differs slightly: host idx count window 0.35 timer, same. Host label position = screen - label.size/2 + Vector2(stagger,0); client same. Host elevation world +1.5 same.

Host damage label color purple/orange, outline sizes same, crit font base+10 same. So main mismatch is scale factor and crit star. Gold popup: host own_kill uses KillGoldPopup with vector sword + "amount" layout; client approximate blade. Fine.

Heal numbers: host show_heal_number size 24*ui_scale, green; client? grep `_spawn_heal`/`_spawn_exp`. Later.

Given user's "各种数值显示", align:

lines.text: ## 王者峡谷地面视觉层（不改任何 gameplay 逻辑，只换材质/光照/装饰）
## 1. 程序化「布局贴图」：草地/土路/高地砖石/河道一次画好，所有地面平面共用同一张图、
##    按世界坐标采样 → 平面之间没有硬接缝（原先是纯色 PlaneMesh 拼硬边）
## 2. 噪声细节贴图 + 法线贴图：近看有材质层次，不再像塑料板
## 3. 环境：天空盒 + 天空环境光 + ACES 色调映射 + 深度雾 + 暖阳光/冷补光
## 4. 装饰：现成 glb（草/墙/罐）用 MultiMesh 批量铺，移动端友好
## 5. 河道水面 shader：波纹 + 岸边泡沫（保持不透明，避免破坏贴地特效排序）
## 注意：project.godot 用 rendering_method="mobile"，SSAO/SSIL/体积雾不可用。
# 冷色补光（无阴影，提亮背光面）
# 高地/基地台座：同一套着色器，只是染色偏石材
uniform sampler2D normal_tex : filter_linear, repeat_enable, hint_normal;
// 野区微地形起伏（只动野区，分路/河道/高地保持平）；纯视觉，实体仍踩 y=0
float lane_d = min(min(abs(abs(wp.x) - 55.0), abs(abs(wp.z) - 55.0)), abs(wp.x + wp.z) * 0.7071068);
float hg_m = 1.0 - smoothstep(30.0, 38.0, min(length(wp.xz + vec2(60.0, -60.0)), length(wp.xz - vec2(60.0, -60.0))));
float jungle_m = clamp(1.0 - lane_m - river_m - hg_m, 0.0, 1.0) * edge_m;
// 世界坐标采样布局图：所有地面平面共用一张图，平面之间天然无缝
vec2 luv = clamp((wp.xz + vec2(map_half)) / vec2(map_half * 2.0), vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0));
// 运行时生成的贴图没有 sRGB 标记，手动转线性，避免整片发白
// 岸边泡沫：沿路缘 |x+z|/√2≈10 处一圈，随波纹闪烁
var img := Image.create_empty(size, size, false, Image.FORMAT_RGB8)
var x: float = (float(px) + 0.5) / float(size) * MAP_HALF * 2.0 - MAP_HALF
var z: float = (float(py) + 0.5) / float(size) * MAP_HALF * 2.0 - MAP_HALF
var n: float = grass.get_noise_2d(x, z) * 0.5 + 0.5          # 0..1 细噪声
var pt: float = patch.get_noise_2d(x, z) * 0.5 + 0.5         # 0..1 大斑块
# 1) 野区草地基底（深浅变化 + 大块阴影）
# 2) 河道河床（沿 x-z=0 对角线与中路垂直；比草地暗、偏青灰）
# 3) 三路（土黄石路，双色噪声 + 路缘更深）
# 4) 高地 / 基地台座（石砖，最后绘制盖住河道与路）
# 5) 地图边缘变暗（远景承接雾色，避免看到"断崖"）
# 距离场软边：d 在 half±feather 之间平滑过渡
static func _inside(d: float, half: float, feather: float) -> float:
return 1.0 - smoothstep(half - feather, half + feather, d)
# 三路覆盖度（0..1，软边）：四边路 + 中路对角线（x+z=0 方向，与 _is_on_lane 一致）
static func _lane_mask(x: float, z: float) -> float:
var along_z: float = _inside(absf(z), 44.0, 5.0)   # 竖向路长度（±40 再加软边）

Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier (completed): plan/implement realistic spell animations; then "请把法术的各种道具逼真化，比如小乔的扇子和旋风，甄姬的冰柱等" — done (P2.5 physical props).
- Then: "请你对比单机版和联机版的UI，争取让它们一致" — single-player vs multiplayer UI consistency.
- Current: "我需要让联机和单击的体验完全一样，包括从地图渲染、血条大小、相机位置、各种数值显示等等" — full parity between single-player (host) and multiplayer client: map rendering, health-bar sizes, camera position, numeric displays, etc.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable, GDScript, **mobile** renderer, Android target; canvas_items+expand stretch (virtual height 1400, width ≥2400); glow+ACES on; no test suite/build.
- Verification: editor parse `--headless --path . --editor --quit` (only pre-existing `Minimap` class warning), headless runs of `res://scenes/battle.tscn` and `lobby.tscn` with `--quit-after N`, plus `-- --net-test` / temporary self-test hooks. No git repo.
- Host battle scene: `scenes/battle.tscn` (Node3D BattleManager + CanvasLayer "UI" running `scripts/ui/HUD.gd`); host adds `UI_Manager` autoload-style layer, `Minimap`, `TouchController`.
- Net client: `scenes/net_client.tscn` (Node3D `NetClientBattle.gd`), reimplements HUD via `Hud.new()` + `Net*` panels on separate CanvasLayers (HUD 20, minimap 80, pad 100, modals 101/102, etc.).
- Lobby: `scenes/lobby.tscn` → `NetLobby.gd` (menu/room/select); single-player menu button "🎮  单机游戏（本地人机对局）" → `_start_singleplayer` → battle.tscn with in-battle select UI.
- Map visuals shared helper `scripts/core/MapVisuals.gd` (class_name MapVisuals, static API): `setup_environment(parent)`, `ground_material(bump)`, `water_material()`, `_paint_layout()` shader painting grass/road/highground/river into one layout texture; host uses it, client does NOT.
- Design language for lobby/pick: 42px gold title, 18px sub, role-colored 150×54 cards, 560×76 font-26 buttons, palette `COL_BG 0.045/0.062/0.095`, `COL_TITLE 0.98/0.84/0.36`, `COL_TEXT 0.92/0.94/0.97`, `COL_DIM 0.5/0.56/0.66`, `COL_GOLD 0.95/0.78/0.4`, `_card_style` radius 8 border alpha 0.15/0.3, `_btn_style` radius 10.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd` — prop system finished; consts `GROUP_PROP := "vfx_prop"`, `MAX_PROPS := 10`, `PROP_RANGE := 30.0`; debug prints and `--prop-test` block removed.
- `scripts/core/SpellFxTable.gd` — `SKILL_PROPS` mapping (小乔 fan/tornado, 甄姬 ice_pillars/ice_crystal, 王昭君, 安琪拉/妲己/东皇 orbs, 李白 swords, 后羿 sun_orb); `get_prop()`.
- `docs/spell-animation-plan.md` — sections 七/八/九/十 incl. P2.5 props record.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` (3228 lines):
  - `_ready`: `MapVisuals.setup_environment(self)`; camera `Camera3D.new()`, `fov=70.0`, `size=30`, `position=(0,20,10)`, `rotation_degrees=(-60,0,0)`; then `_create_map()`; hero select unless net host has picks; then `UI_Manager.new()`, `Minimap` with `MINIMAP_SIZE=300`, inset 40.
  - `_create_map()`: wild 300×300 plane, `subdivide_width/depth=100`, `material_override = MapVisuals.ground_material(0.28)`; 6 lane planes via `_add_lane_plane(center, size, lane)`; two 35-radius CHARTREUSE fans via `_create_fan_plane(Vector3(∓60,0.2,±60),35,∓90,0/180,...)`; `_add_fountain(Vector3(∓58,0.3,±58), blue/red)`; river plane `20×141` at `(0,0.02,0)` rot Y45 `MapVisuals.water_material()`; ground StaticBody layer 2; long list of bush positions; later walls/camps.
  - Camera follow (~line 2500-2540): first-person `cam.global_position = hero.global_position + Vector3(0,2.4,0)` fov 90; else `cam.global_position = hero.global_position + _follow_offset + cam_pan_offset`, rotation `(-60,0,0)`, fov 70.
  - Camera FX: `camera_shake`, `_apply_camera_shake`, `fov_punch`, `hitstop`.
  - Select UI fully rewritten (lines ~2071-2400): consts `SEL_BG/SEL_TITLE/SEL_SUB/SEL_TEXT/SEL_DIM/SEL_GOLD/SEL_SUMM_COLOR`; helpers `_sel_label`, `_sel_btn_style`, `_sel_card_style`, `_sel_btn`, `_style_card`; `_show_hero_select_ui()` builds CenterContainer→ScrollContainer(900..1440 × 480..980)→VBox: 42px gold title "选择英雄 · 召唤师技能", 18px sub, HBox(hero scroll 820×560 role-grouped 150×54 colored cards | summoner panel 380×560 with 150×54 name cards + `select_summ_detail`), 24px gold `select_summary_label`, 560×76 buttons "✔  开始游戏" + "返回大厅" (`_on_select_leave` → `change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/lobby.tscn")`).
