  - `_build_camera()` (1949): bespoke `Environment` (BG_COLOR 0.08/0.10/0.12, AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR 0.65/0.68/0.7 energy 1.0, ACES), single `DirectionalLight3D` rot (-55,-30,0) energy 1.1, `Camera3D fov=55 near=0.2 far=2000`.
  - `_update_camera()`: own mode fov 70, `_cam_focus + CAM_FOLLOW_OFF*zoom` with `CAM_FOLLOW_OFF=(0,12,8)`, `rotation_degrees=(-70,0,0)`; first person `+CAM_FP_EYE(0,2.4,0)`, fov 90, yaw `ry+PI`; spectator path `_cam_pitch/_cam_yaw/_cam_dist`, `look_at(focus+UP*1.2)`.
  - Consts: `HUD_BASE := Vector2(1600.0,900.0)`, `_hud_scale()` = `minf(vp.x/1600, vp.y/900)`; many `SNAP_*`, `FX_*` (FX_SPELL=1 … FX_XQ_WHIRL=22), `EV_*`; `COL_GRASS/COL_ROAD/...`.
  - `_build_hud()` (2000) CanvasLayer 20 + `Hud.new()` full rect; `_build_pad` NetTouchPad; `_build_minimap` NetMiniMap layer 80 inset 40 size 300; `_build_target_panel` 55; `_build_buff_row` 60; `_build_yuanliu_switch` 104; `_build_roster_panel` 101; `_build_shop_panel` 102; `_build_rec_bar` 65; `_build_kill_feed` 40; `_build_recall` 42; `_build_death_recap` 70; `_build_result_panel` 110.
  - Has own world-health-bar collection/update (~line 1734 comment "同主机 HUD._update_health_bars").
  - No death overlay / screen flash equivalent (host `UI_Manager` has `death_overlay` black 0.5 + `flash_screen` used by `Vfx.screen_flash` via group "ui").
- `scripts/net/NetTouchPad.gd` — touch layout "几何照抄 TouchController": `SKILL_SIZE 260`, fan angles 70/35/0, `EXTRA_SKILL_CENTER (1050,406)`, aux row from bottom (召唤/恢复/回城/装×2/取消), `_anchor_br` bottom-right with `TOUCH_CLUSTER_INSET`.

- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` (3480 lines) — host HUD: `UI_SCALE_EXTRA 1.35`, `ui_scale()` = `maxf(1.0, vw/2400)*1.35`; `_ready` creates fx_flash, death_overlay, target panel, skill bar (hidden legacy), info labels, buff icons, attribute panel, hero detail, recall, yuanliu, death recap, team decision; `BUFF_ROW_Y=980`, `BuffIcon.CELL_W=132`, `CELL_H=136`.

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.description: Change a reminder in place, keeping its id. Supply a new title, prompt, or at most one timing parameter; omitted fields keep their stored values. To change a relative delay, create a new reminder.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

## 已对齐的差异

**地图渲染（最大视觉差）**
- 环境由客户端自建的“纯色背景+单盏平行光”改为与单机同源的 `MapVisuals.setup_environment()`：天空盒、天空环境光、ACES（曝光 1.05）、深度雾、辉光、暖阳光+冷补光、阴影。
- 地面：120×120 纯色平面 → 300×300、100×100 细分，材质改用 `MapVisuals.ground_material(0.28)`（同一套草地/土路/野区微起伏着色器）。
- 六块分路平面：纯绿色 → 地面着色器材质、y=0.05、中路对角 −45°。
- 高地扇形：`CHARTREUSE` 无光照 → `MapVisuals.high_ground_material()` 青砖。
- 河道：`DEEP_SKY_BLUE` 平面 y=−0.012 → 水面着色器、y=0.02。
- 补齐单机独有的 `MapVisuals.scatter_decorations()` 装饰（草丛/河岸石墙/陶罐，固定种子 → 位置与单机一致）。

**相机**
- 俯角 −70° → **−60°**（与单机 `cam.rotation_degrees` 一致）；fov 70、跟随偏移 (0,12,8)、兰陵王隐身 ×1.25、第一人称 2.4 眼高/fov 90 原本已同，现在俯角也同，屏幕方向与移动方向 1:1 一致。
- near/far 回到单机默认（0.05/4000）。

**血条大小**
- 客户端 HUD 原来把整套 UI 放大 1.5 倍（世界血条 165×22.5），改为与单机 HUD 相同的**原始像素**：英雄条 280×28、小兵/野怪 110×15、防御塔 300×22、史诗怪每格 22（380–880 封顶）、字号 34/32、标签偏移 −84/−92 全部同值。
- 删掉客户端多出来的“左下自身血条/金币行”（单机第三人称没有，自身血量只由头顶世界条显示）；第一人称改为单机同位置（水平居中、底边 y−446）的 HeroInfoControl 版式自身条。

**数值显示**
- 顶部战况带按单机 `UI_Manager` 版式重做：固定 -140..+340、y8..190 黑底；第一行 计时 `MM:SS`（30px）+ `K/D/A: x/y/z`（26px，+160）；第二行经济比分（32px，蓝队金/比分白/vs 白/红队金），金币格式化同为 `%.1fk`。
- 属性面板几何对齐单机：列宽 200、行高 26、图例高 24、面板 x=30、顶边 `vp.y-385-panel_h`、字号 13。
- 伤害数字改用单机 `ui_scale()` 公式（`max(1, vw/2400)×1.35`），并补上暴击的金色四芒星爆点；金币/击杀金币弹出与错开逻辑原本已同。
- 阵亡不再显示单机没有的顶部“已阵亡…”文字，改为与单机一致的全屏压暗层（黑 0.5，复活消失，层 21：盖 3D+世界血条、不盖面板）。

## 验证
- 全项目脚本解析：仅剩既有的 `Minimap` 类名冲突告警（改动前就有）。
- 客户端场景 headless 实跑 150 帧（临时 `--world-test` 绕过 headless 早退，跑完已还原）：0 脚本错误，新地图/环境/装饰/HUD/压暗层均成功构建。

- 治疗数字：单机是本地直接弹，联机快照事件里没有 heal 事件，要补需主机侧加事件类型（会动协议，未擅自改）。
- 单机重击的 `Vfx.screen_flash` 全屏闪光、右键半屏拖拽取景，客户端尚未复刻（前者是特效层、后者客户端用“小地图拖动/轻点取景”代替）。

block.text:
Net panels are custom-drawn replicas. Comparing exact host panel geometry requires reading host `_create_shop_panel` / `_create_hero_detail_panel` (~large). These were likely written by AI earlier; user says still differ.

Big job. Perhaps best approach: rather than pixel-align custom replicas, replace client panels with actual host widgets? Host shop panel is built with Control children and relies on `ItemDatabase`, `UiManager` methods; if UI_Manager could work with client data... it uses `battle.hero` (BattleManager singleton group). On client no BattleManager. Not feasible without heavy refactor.

Alternative: extract shared style constants? Not enough; layouts differ.

Practical: compare key visual/style aspects (panel size/position, colors, title fonts, card sizes, row heights, tab style) and adjust Net panels to match host values. User complaint "不太一样" likely about overall look: e.g., host shop is full-screen-ish dark panel with category tabs 7 at bottom/top, item grid 6 cols, detail side panel; NetShopPanel maybe similar but sizes differ. Hero info panel: host hero_detail_panel with team stats, hero cards, skills/equipment, attributes; NetRosterPanel with rows of hero cards + attr strip. These are structurally different (host is a big rich panel; Net is a simplified card list) → "不太一样" fundamentally.

To truly match, we'd need host to send roster data (it does: NetSession._pack_roster_row) and client render same layout. Net roster already "复刻" but maybe simplified.

Need to see actual host panel code and current Net draw to assess gaps. This is large; use teammates? The task splits into two independent files (NetShopPanel.gd, NetRosterPanel.gd) + maybe NetTargetPanel/NetBuffRow/others. Teammates can read host UI_Manager (huge 3480 lines) and adjust their file. They share filesystem; disjoint files → safe. This is a good delegation case: two parallel big chunks.

Plan:
- Create tasks: (1) shop panel parity NetShopPanel vs host shop; (2) hero info/roster panel parity NetRosterPanel vs host hero_detail_panel (including attribute strip), plus maybe target panel? Keep to two.
- Spawn 2 teammates with fresh context, giving them key info: paths, host UI_Manager functions to read, must not edit NetClientBattle.gd/other files, verify via headless parse command, notify? (Lead does notify).
- Meanwhile I inspect host panel geometry myself and maybe align target/buff/result panels? Careful: write scopes: teammate1 NetShopPanel.gd; teammate2 NetRosterPanel.gd. I can inspect others but avoid editing those two.

Risk: teammates may need NetClientBattle wiring for new fields; they can request? Simpler instruct: keep public API (feed/refresh/show_panel/hide_panel/toggle, own/rows vars) unchanged; only change visual layout/colors/draw. If data missing, note it.

But host hero info panel may show data not available in roster payload (skills, equipment lists, KDA). NetSession roster row may include: nid, team, name, level, hp, etc. If host panel displays more, need protocol changes — out of scope; teammate should replicate layout as far as data allows, using existing payload, and report required missing fields.

Let me first read a bit of host shop panel + hero detail to know geometry, so I can give teammate precise anchors and judge output. Host `_create_shop_panel` location? grep.

Actually delegate reading/analysis too — teammates read host. Lead doesn't need full detail.

Before spawning, check git? none.

Also ensure not stepping on my earlier edits: I'm not editing NetShopPanel/NetRosterPanel.

Let me create two tasks and spawn teammates. Also maybe a third for other panels (target/buff/death recap/result/recall/recommend bar/yuanliu) — "等" implies more. Could spawn a third teammate for target+buff+result+recall+recommend+death recap+yuanliu parity? That's many files; one teammate could handle style alignment across those smaller panels by reading host counterparts. Might be too much; but these smaller panels likely simpler. I'll do two main + third optional later based on time.

Give each teammate: environment facts (no git, headless verify command, don't touch other files, style rules), host reference functions names via grep, requirement: match host 1:1 (panel geometry in virtual 2400×1400 coordinate space, colors, fonts). Note host UI_Manager scales by ui_scale()=1.35 at 2400 width; client panels currently use raw px matching? Teammates need understand scaling: host UI panels: sizes computed with ui_scale() at runtime (1.35 at 2400 wide). Client canvas same virtual space → to match at 2400 width, client should multiply host's ui_scale-based values by same factor: replicate formula max(1, vw/2400)*1.35. Current Net panels use fixed constants; may differ across resolutions. Instruct: use same `ui_scale` formula (add local helper) and lay out like host.

Hmm risk of divergence between teammates; give both same instructions on scaling.

Also tell them: verify with `--headless --editor --quit` and report diffs; don't run game.

Time: teammates need turns; context cost. Let's do it.

Spawn names: "shop-panel", "hero-info-panel". Use fresh.

Task board: create tasks with write scopes, then spawn with instructions to claim task? Simpler: create tasks, spawn teammates with task id, tell claim.

Let me create tasks first (2 calls parallel), then spawn (2 calls parallel) with prompts including task id needs — spawn after create returns ids.

Also I should meanwhile read host panels myself to review their work later.

Proceed: team_task_create x2.
联机侧面板目前是“简化复刻”，与单机的信息面板、商店面板在版式和尺寸上仍有差距。这两块互相独立，我并行拆给两个队友分别对齐，我这边同步核查其余面板并做最终验收。

So client panels that use raw font sizes (e.g., NetRecommendBar 26 raw; NetBuffRow BuffIcon from host class so fine; NetTargetPanel already uses rs for both sizes and font? It multiplies positions too — but host target panel: panel position 40,370 raw, size 330*rs, and child labels positions raw? Net multiplies all child positions by rs — mismatch! Comment in NetTargetPanel says "位置基底不乘 rs（同主机）" only for outer panel; inner positions multiplied by rs, maybe host does too? Need verify host target panel code. It says "同文件 2714 段" update.

The systemic issue: font scaling. Client panels using raw font sizes appear ~26% smaller than host. That's a likely root cause of "不太一样" across all panels. Fixing globally: in each Net panel, multiply font sizes by ui_scale and keep raw geometry as host. But panels vary.

背景：单机版（host）UI 由 scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd（约 3480 行）用 Control 拼装；联机客户端用自绘 Control 复刻。用户反馈“联机版和单机版的英雄信息面板、商店面板等都和单机不太一样”。英雄信息面板、商店面板已由另两位同事负责（分别改 NetRosterPanel.gd / NetShopPanel.gd），你负责**其余面板**。

第一步：先领取共享任务 task-3（team_task_get 读最新 revision → team_task_update action=claim），任务描述里有完整验收要求。

你只能改这 8 个文件（其他一律不许碰，尤其不要动 NetClientBattle.gd、NetSession.gd、UI_Manager.gd、NetShopPanel.gd、NetRosterPanel.gd）：
scripts/net/NetTargetPanel.gd、NetRecommendBar.gd、NetBuffRow.gd、NetRecall.gd、NetKillFeed.gd、NetDeathRecap.gd、NetResultPanel.gd、NetYuanliuSwitch.gd

核心判断（已确认的根因）：host 所有 Label/RichText 的字号都经 _apply_label_style/_apply_rich_label_style 乘过 ui_scale()，ui_scale()=maxf(1.0, 视口宽/2400.0)*1.35（2400 宽时 1.35），而面板位置/offset 多数是原始像素不乘。客户端这些面板把字号写死成原始值，整体比单机小约 26%。请为每个文件加私有 helper（例如 `func _us() -> float:`）复刻同一公式，把所有 host 字号改成 `host字号 × _us()`；位置/偏移是否乘以 host 源码为准（多数不乘）。

工作方式（省 token）：grep 定位 host 对应函数 → read offset/limit 定点读 → edit 定点替换。对应关系：
- NetTargetPanel → host _create_target_detail_panel + 其 _update 段
- NetRecommendBar → host recommended_equip_label / buy_plus_btn / gold_chip（UI_Manager.gd 约 477-544）
- NetBuffRow → host _create_buff_icons / _layout_buff_row / BuffInfoPanel（图标本身复用 UI_Manager.BuffIcon，不要改 UI_Manager）
- NetRecall → host 回城进度条；NetKillFeed → host 击杀播报；NetDeathRecap → host _show_death_recap；NetResultPanel → host 结算页（grep game_over / 结算 / result）；NetYuanliuSwitch → host 元流之子切换钮。
保持每个控件的公开 API 与父场景调用方式不变。

注意：不要启动游戏窗口；不要给用户发通知。验证命令：
cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit
仅允许既有的 Minimap 类名冲突告警，不得有新增 SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error。

完成后 send_message 给 lead：逐文件改动摘要（对齐了哪些字号/几何/颜色）+ 验证结论，再 team_task_update action=complete。"}

task.subject: 联机其余面板字号/几何对齐单机 UI_Manager
task.description:
目标：把联机客户端其余自绘面板的字号/尺寸/位置对齐单机 host UI_Manager 同名面板，使其视觉一致。涉及文件（每个都要改，仅允许改这些）：
- scripts/net/NetTargetPanel.gd（对齐 host _create_target_detail_panel + 其 _update）
- scripts/net/NetRecommendBar.gd（对齐 host recommended_equip_label / buy_plus_btn / gold_chip，UI_Manager.gd:477-544）
- scripts/net/NetBuffRow.gd（对齐 host _create_buff_icons / BuffInfoPanel 的几何与字号；图标本身复用 UI_Manager.BuffIcon）
- scripts/net/NetRecall.gd、NetKillFeed.gd、NetDeathRecap.gd、NetResultPanel.gd、NetYuanliuSwitch.gd（分别对齐 host 回城进度条、击杀播报、死亡回放面板 _show_death_recap、结算页、元流之子切换钮）

通用要求：
1. 绝不修改上述 8 个文件之外的任何文件（不改 NetClientBattle.gd / NetSession.gd / UI_Manager.gd / NetShopPanel.gd / NetRosterPanel.gd）。
2. 关键根因：host 所有 Label/RichText 字号都经过 _apply_label_style/_apply_rich_label_style → font_size × ui_scale()，其中 ui_scale()=maxf(1.0, 视口宽/2400)*1.35（2400 宽时 1.35）；而面板位置/偏移通常是原始像素（不乘）。客户端多数面板字号写死原始值，结果整体比单机小 26%。请给每个文件加私有 helper `_us()` 复刻同一公式，把所有字号改为 `原 host 字号 × _us()`，位置/偏移按 host 实际写法决定是否乘（以 host 源码为准）。
3. 逐文件带 offset/limit 定点读 UI_Manager.gd 对应函数，抄其几何常量、颜色、字号、层级；不要整文件回读。
4. 保持各面板公开 API 与父场景调用不变（NetClientBattle._build_* 里的 new/feed/refresh/show_panel/hide_panel 调用）。

验证：运行
cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit
仅允许既有 Minimap 类名冲突告警，不得有新增 SCRIPT ERROR。不要启动游戏窗口。

完成后 send_message 给 lead：逐文件改动摘要 + 验证结论；然后 complete 本任务。不要给用户发通知。

task.subject: 联机其余面板字号/几何对齐单机 UI_Manager
task.description:
目标：把联机客户端其余自绘面板的字号/尺寸/位置对齐单机 host UI_Manager 同名面板，使其视觉一致。涉及文件（每个都要改，仅允许改这些）：
- scripts/net/NetTargetPanel.gd（对齐 host _create_target_detail_panel + 其 _update）
- scripts/net/NetRecommendBar.gd（对齐 host recommended_equip_label / buy_plus_btn / gold_chip，UI_Manager.gd:477-544）
- scripts/net/NetBuffRow.gd（对齐 host _create_buff_icons / BuffInfoPanel 的几何与字号；图标本身复用 UI_Manager.BuffIcon）
- scripts/net/NetRecall.gd、NetKillFeed.gd、NetDeathRecap.gd、NetResultPanel.gd、NetYuanliuSwitch.gd（分别对齐 host 回城进度条、击杀播报、死亡回放面板 _show_death_recap、结算页、元流之子切换钮）

通用要求：
1. 绝不修改上述 8 个文件之外的任何文件（不改 NetClientBattle.gd / NetSession.gd / UI_Manager.gd / NetShopPanel.gd / NetRosterPanel.gd）。
2. 关键根因：host 所有 Label/RichText 字号都经过 _apply_label_style/_apply_rich_label_style → font_size × ui_scale()，其中 ui_scale()=maxf(1.0, 视口宽/2400)*1.35（2400 宽时 1.35）；而面板位置/偏移通常是原始像素（不乘）。客户端多数面板字号写死原始值，结果整体比单机小 26%。请给每个文件加私有 helper `_us()` 复刻同一公式，把所有字号改为 `原 host 字号 × _us()`，位置/偏移按 host 实际写法决定是否乘（以 host 源码为准）。
3. 逐文件带 offset/limit 定点读 UI_Manager.gd 对应函数，抄其几何常量、颜色、字号、层级；不要整文件回读。
4. 保持各面板公开 API 与父场景调用不变（NetClientBattle._build_* 里的 new/feed/refresh/show_panel/hide_panel 调用）。

验证：运行
cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit
仅允许既有 Minimap 类名冲突告警，不得有新增 SCRIPT ERROR。不要启动游戏窗口。

完成后 send_message 给 lead：逐文件改动摘要 + 验证结论；然后 complete 本任务。不要给用户发通知。

task.description:
目标：让联机客户端商店面板（scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd）在视觉版式、尺寸、配色、字号、留白、标签页样式、物品格、购买/出售按钮、出装路线区等方面与单机主机商店面板（scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd 中 _create_shop_panel/_rebuild_shop_grid 等商店相关函数、内部类 Shop* 绘制）保持一致。

要求：
1. 只改 scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd；不要改 NetClientBattle.gd、NetSession.gd、UI_Manager.gd 或其它文件。
2. 保持现有公开 API 不变：class_name NetShopPanel；属性 _gold/_hero_name/_equip/_rec/_tab/_scroll；方法 feed(o)、toggle()、hide_panel()、buy(id)、sell_slot(slot)、quick_buy()、_draw()、_gui_input/_unhandled_input 行为兼容。父场景按 102 层 CanvasLayer 挂载，面板自身坐标即 2400×1400 虚拟画布坐标。
3. 缩放：主机 UI_Manager 的尺寸大多基于 ui_scale() = maxf(1.0, 视口宽/2400)×1.35（2400 宽时=1.35）。客户端面板应在同一虚拟画布下复刻同一公式，新增私有 helper 即可，不要写死某一分辨率。
4. 以主机 API 实际渲染结果为准：先读 UI_Manager.gd 里商店创建/刷新/布局/样式函数（grep "shop" "_apply_panel_style" "_apply_label_style" "tab" 定位，带 offset/limit 定点读），抄其几何常量、颜色（面板底色/边框/圆角/分类 tab/选中态/价格/金币不足红/已购绿/推荐高亮）、字号与排布；再改 NetShopPanel 的 _draw 与命中区（_hot），保证点按区域与新布局一致。
5. 物品图标、名称、价格、合成需求等数据用 ItemDatabase（客户端可用）；无法可靠复刻的部分（需要主机专属运行时数据）保留现状并在完成消息里列出。
6. 验证：运行
   cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit
   确认没有新增 SCRIPT ERROR（仅允许既有 Minimap 类名冲突告警）。不要启动游戏窗口。

完成时用 send_message 给 lead：改动摘要（对齐了哪些几何/配色/字号）、仍需协议数据的缺口、验证结果。

# 临时验证脚本：实例化联机各面板并喂假数据，强制重绘，检查 _draw/_process 运行时报错。用后删除。

var _frames := 0
var _panels: Array = []

func _ready() -> void:
	var host := Control.new()
	host.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	host.size = Vector2(2400, 1400)
	add_child(host)

	# 商店
	var shop = load("res://scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd").new()
	host.add_child(shop)
	shop.feed({"gold": 5000, "hero_name": "李白", "equip": ["armor1"], "rec": ""})
	shop.toggle()
	_panels.append(shop)

	# 英雄信息（team + attr 两个实例）
	var row0 := [1, "李白", 0, 8, 3000.0, 5000.0, 3, 1, 2, 7000, ["armor1"], 300, 100, 150, 80, 400]
	var row1 := [2, "妲己", 1, 7, 1200.0, 4200.0, 1, 2, 0, 5200, [], 120, 260, 90, 120, 390]
	var sa: Array = []
	for i in range(18):
		sa.append(100.0 + i)
		sa.append(20.0 + i)
		sa.append(5.0 + i)
	for v in ["team", "attr"]:
		var roster = load("res://scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd").new()
		host.add_child(roster)
		roster.rows = [row0, row1]
		roster.own = {"name": "李白", "sa": sa}
		roster.show_panel(v)
		_panels.append(roster)

	# 目标信息框
	var tgt = load("res://scripts/net/NetTargetPanel.gd").new()
	host.add_child(tgt)
	tgt.refresh([2, 1, "妲己", 7, 1200.0, 4200.0, 120, 260, 90, 120])
	_panels.append(tgt)

	# 推荐带
	var rec = load("res://scripts/net/NetRecommendBar.gd").new()
	host.add_child(rec)
	rec.feed({"gold": 1234, "rb": {"id": "", "text": "推荐：无尽战刃", "show": true}})
	_panels.append(rec)

	# buff 行
	var buff = load("res://scripts/net/NetBuffRow.gd").new()
	host.add_child(buff)
	buff.refresh({"top": [["stun", "晕", [1.0, 0.5, 0.2], "眩晕", "无法行动", 1.2, 2.0, false, "控制"]],
		"bot": [["red", "红", [1.0, 0.3, 0.3], "红buff", "灼烧", 30.0, 60.0, true, "增益"]]})
	_panels.append(buff)

	# 回城
	var rk = load("res://scripts/net/NetRecall.gd").new()
	host.add_child(rk)
	rk.feed(1, 0.5)
	_panels.append(rk)

	# 击杀播报
	var kf = load("res://scripts/net/NetKillFeed.gd").new()
	host.add_child(kf)
	kf._on_kill_feed("李白", 0, "击杀", "妲己", 1)
	_panels.append(kf)

	# 死亡回放
	var dr = load("res://scripts/net/NetDeathRecap.gd").new()
	host.add_child(dr)
	dr._on_recap({"cc": 1.4,
		"rows": [{"src": "妲己", "total": 1500, "phys": 300, "mag": 1200,
			"bars": [["2技", 300.0, 600.0], ["3技", 0.0, 600.0]]}],
		"log": [["妲己", 400, 1, 0, "2技", 1.2], ["妲己", 1100, 1, 1, "3技", 0.4]]})
	_panels.append(dr)

	# 结算
	var res = load("res://scripts/net/NetResultPanel.gd").new()
	host.add_child(res)
	res._on_result({"winner": 0, "rows": [
		{"team": 0, "name": "李白", "lv": 10, "k": 8, "d": 2, "a": 5, "gold": 12000, "equip": ["a", "b", "c"]},
		{"team": 1, "name": "妲己", "lv": 9, "k": 3, "d": 7, "a": 2, "gold": 9000, "equip": []},
	]})
	_panels.append(res)

	# 元流之子切换钮
	var ys = load("res://scripts/net/NetYuanliuSwitch.gd").new()
	host.add_child(ys)
	ys.feed({"name": "元流之子", "x": 0.0, "z": 0.0, "team": 0, "yl_pick": 0})
	_panels.append(ys)

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_frames += 1
	for p in _panels:
		if is_instance_valid(p) and p is CanvasItem:
			p.queue_redraw()
	if _frames > 60:
		get_tree().quit()
"}

```gdscript
func _pack_roster_detail(h: Node) -> Array:
	var dead := bool(h.get("is_dead")) if h.get("is_dead") != null else h.health <= 0
	var total_gold := int(h.get("total_gold_earned")) if h.get("total_gold_earned") != null else int(h.gold)
	var role := str(h.get("role")) if h.get("role") != null else ""
	var chips: Array = []
	# 与 host UI_Manager._update_hero_detail 同源（属性徽章：形状/主题色/文本）
	chips.append(["heart", Color(0.45,1.0,0.55), "%d/%d" % [int(h.health), int(h.actual_max_health)]])
	chips.append(["sword", Color(1.0,0.62,0.24), "%d" % int(h.actual_attack_damage)])
	chips.append(["spark", Color(0.72,0.5,1.0), "%d" % int(h.actual_ability_power)])
	chips.append(["shield", Color(1.0,0.78,0.3), "%d" % int(h.actual_armor)])
	chips.append(["gem", Color(0.4,0.88,1.0), "%d" % int(h.actual_magic_resist)])
	chips.append(["chev", Color(0.45,0.9,0.7), "%.0f" % h.actual_move_speed])
	chips.append(["bolt", Color(1.0,0.85,0.3), "%.2f" % h.attack_speed])
	if h.actual_mana_max > 0: chips.append(["drop", Color(0.3,0.7,1.0), "%d/%d" % [int(h.mana), int(h.actual_mana_max)]])
	if h.actual_crit_chance > 0: chips.append(["cross", Color(1.0,0.42,0.36), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_crit_chance * 100)])
	if h.actual_crit_damage > 1.85: chips.append(["dmg", Color(1.0,0.36,0.3), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_crit_damage * 100)])
	if h.flat_phys_pen > 0: chips.append(["pierce", Color(1.0,0.72,0.3), "%d" % h.flat_phys_pen])
	if h.actual_phys_pen_percent > 0: chips.append(["pierce", Color(1.0,0.72,0.3), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_phys_pen_percent * 100)])
	if h.flat_magic_pen > 0: chips.append(["pierce", Color(0.7,0.55,1.0), "%d" % h.flat_magic_pen])
	if h.actual_magic_pen_percent > 0: chips.append(["pierce", Color(0.7,0.55,1.0), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_magic_pen_percent * 100)])
	if h.actual_phys_lifesteal > 0: chips.append(["heart", Color(1.0,0.56,0.34), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_phys_lifesteal * 100)])
	if h.actual_magic_lifesteal > 0: chips.append(["heart", Color(0.78,0.52,1.0), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_magic_lifesteal * 100)])
	if h.bonus_toughness > 0: chips.append(["tough", Color(0.96,0.9,0.5), "%.0f%%" % (h.bonus_toughness * 100)])
	if h.actual_cd_timer < 1.0: chips.append(["clock", Color(0.5,0.85,1.0), "%.0f%%" % ((1.0 - h.actual_cd_timer) * 100)])
	# 技能行（host 同款文本与配色）
	var sk: Array = []
	for i in range(min(h.skills.size(), h.skill_levels.size())):
		var s = h.skills[i]
		if s == null: continue
		var cd = float(h.skill_cooldowns[i]) if i < h.skill_cooldowns.size() else 0.0
		var ct := "(%.1fs)" % cd if cd > 0 else "(就绪)"
		sk.append(["%s Lv.%d %s" % [s.skill_name, int(h.skill_levels[i]), ct], Color.LIGHT_CYAN if cd <= 0 else Color.GRAY])
	if h.summoner_skill:
		var cd2 := float(h.summoner_cooldown)
		var ct2 := "(%.1fs)" % cd2 if cd2 > 0 else "(就绪)"
		sk.append(["%s %s" % [h.summoner_skill.skill_name, ct2], Color.GOLD if cd2 <= 0 else Color.GRAY])
	... famous_blade / revive as host
	# 装备行（host 同款文本+CD 后缀，颜色 LIGHT_GREEN）

	return [total_gold, 1 if h.is_ai else 0, role, 1 if dead else 0, float(h.respawn_timer) if dead else 0.0, float(h.respawn_time_total) if dead else 0.0, chips, sk, eq, int(h.gold)]

# 基础 16 段 = [nid,name,team,level,hp,maxhp,kills,deaths,assists,gold,equipment(id串),atk,ap,armor,mr,ms]
# 追加 9 段（P3g，客户端尺寸不足时按旧 16 段兼容）= [16]total_gold [17]is_ai [18]role [19]is_dead
#   [20]respawn_remain [21]respawn_total [22]attr_chips [[glyph,Color,text],…]（host 英雄卡徽章同源）

func _build_roster_payload() -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
		if not is_instance_valid(e):
			continue
		var dead: bool = bool(e.get("is_dead")) if e.get("is_dead") != null else e.health <= 0
		if e.team == TEAM_PLAYER or dead or e.visible or e.vision_expose_timer > 0.0:
			out.append(_pack_roster_row(e))
	return out

func _pack_roster_row(e: Node) -> Array:
	var equip: Array = []
	for it in e.equipment_slots:
		equip.append(str(it))
	var dead: bool = bool(e.get("is_dead")) if e.get("is_dead") != null else e.health <= 0
	var row := [_net_id_for(e), str(e.display_name), e.team, e.level, e.health, _maxhp_of(e),
		int(e.kills), int(e.deaths), int(e.assists), int(e.gold), equip,
		int(e.attack), int(e.ability_power), int(e.armor), int(e.magic_resist), int(e.move_speed)]
	row.append(int(e.total_gold_earned) if e.get("total_gold_earned") != null else int(e.gold))
	row.append(1 if bool(e.is_ai) else 0)
	row.append(str(e.role) if e.get("role") != null else "")
	row.append(1 if dead else 0)
	row.append(float(e.respawn_timer) if dead else 0.0)
	row.append(float(e.respawn_time_total) if dead else 0.0)
	row.append(_pack_roster_chips(e, dead))
	row.append(_pack_roster_skills(e))
	row.append(_pack_roster_equips(e))
	return row

# 英雄卡属性徽章：与 host UI_Manager._update_hero_detail（属性行 _achips）逐条同源（形状/主题色/文本）
func _pack_roster_chips(h: Node, dead: bool) -> Array:
	var chips: Array = []
	chips.append(["heart", Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55), "%d/%d" % [int(h.health), int(h.actual_max_health)]])
	chips.append(["sword", Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.24), "%d" % int(h.actual_attack_damage)])
	chips.append(["spark", Color(0.72, 0.5, 1.0), "%d" % int(h.actual_ability_power)])
	chips.append(["shield", Color(1.0, 0.78, 0.3), "%d" % int(h.actual_armor)])
	chips.append(["gem", Color(0.4, 0.88, 1.0), "%d" % int(h.actual_magic_resist)])
	chips.append(["chev", Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.7), "%.0f" % h.actual_move_speed])
	chips.append(["bolt", Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3), "%.2f" % h.attack_speed])
	if h.actual_mana_max > 0:
		chips.append(["drop", Color(0.3, 0.7, 1.0), "%d/%d" % [int(h.mana), int(h.actual_mana_max)]])
	if h.actual_crit_chance > 0:
		chips.append(["cross", Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.36), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_crit_chance * 100)])
	if h.actual_crit_damage > 1.85:
		chips.append(["dmg", Color(1.0, 0.36, 0.3), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_crit_damage * 100)])
	if h.flat_phys_pen > 0:
		chips.append(["pierce", Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.3), "%d" % int(h.flat_phys_pen)])
	if h.actual_phys_pen_percent > 0:
		chips.append(["pierce", Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.3), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_phys_pen_percent * 100)])
	if h.flat_magic_pen > 0:
		chips.append(["pierce", Color(0.7, 0.55, 1.0), "%d" % int(h.flat_magic_pen)])
	if h.actual_magic_pen_percent > 0:
		chips.append(["pierce", Color(0.7, 0.55, 1.0), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_magic_pen_percent * 100)])
	if h.actual_phys_lifesteal > 0:
		chips.append(["heart", Color(1.0, 0.56, 0.34), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_phys_lifesteal * 100)])
	if h.actual_magic_lifesteal > 0:
		chips.append(["heart", Color(0.78, 0.52, 1.0), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_magic_lifesteal * 100)])
	if h.bonus_toughness > 0:
		chips.append(["tough", Color(0.96, 0.9, 0.5), "%.0f%%" % (h.bonus_toughness * 100)])
	if h.actual_cd_timer < 1.0:
		chips.append(["clock", Color(0.5, 0.85, 1.0), "%.0f%%" % ((1.0 - h.actual_cd_timer) * 100)])
	return chips

# 英雄卡技能行：host 同款文本与颜色（就绪=亮/冷却=灰，召唤师金，名刀金/复活绿）
func _pack_roster_skills(h: Node) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	var sk: Array = h.skills
	var lv: Array = h.skill_levels
	var cds: Array = h.skill_cooldowns
	for i in range(mini(sk.size(), lv.size())):
		var s = sk[i]
		if s == null:
			continue
		var cd: float = float(cds[i]) if i < cds.size() else 0.0
		var ct := "(%.1fs)" % cd if cd > 0.0 else "(就绪)"
		out.append(["%s Lv.%d %s" % [s.skill_name, int(lv[i]), ct], Color.LIGHT_CYAN if cd <= 0.0 else Color.GRAY])
	if h.summoner_skill != null:
		var scd := float(h.summoner_cooldown)
		var sct := "(%.1fs)" % scd if scd > 0.0 else "(就绪)"
		out.append(["%s %s" % [h.summoner_skill.skill_name, sct], Color.GOLD if scd <= 0.0 else Color.GRAY])
		if h.equipment_slots.has("famous_blade"):
			var fb := "名刀CD:%.0fs(%d/3)" % [h.famous_blade_cd, h.famous_blade_uses] if h.famous_blade_cd > 0 else "名刀:就绪(%d/3)" % h.famous_blade_uses
			out.append([fb, Color.GOLD if h.famous_blade_cd <= 0 else Color.GRAY])
		if h.equipment_slots.has("revive"):
			var rv := "复活CD:%.0fs(%d/2)" % [h.revive_cd, h.revive_count] if h.revive_cd > 0 else "复活:就绪(%d/2)" % h.revive_count
			out.append([rv, Color.GREEN if h.revive_cd <= 0 else Color.GRAY])
	return out

# 英雄卡装备行：host 同款「装备名 + 主动CD后缀」，逐件浅绿
func _pack_roster_equips(h: Node) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for item_id in h.equipment_slots:
		var it: Dictionary = ItemDatabase.get_item(str(item_id))
		var t: String = str(it["name"]) if not it.is_empty() else str(item_id)
		if it.has("active"):
			var cd := 0.0
			match str(item_id):
				"golden_body": cd = float(h.golden_body_cd)
				"shadow_dart": cd = float(h.shadow_dart_cd)
				"purify": cd = float(h.purify_cd)
				"sunspire_bow": cd = float(h.sunspire_active_cd)
			t += (" CD:%.0fs" % cd) if cd > 0.0 else " [就绪]"
		out.append([t, Color.LIGHT_GREEN])
	return out

# 可见性口径，避免未探明敌方被透视；阵亡敌方主界面头像带本就公开）。
# 基础 16 段 = [nid,name,team,level,hp,maxhp,kills,deaths,assists,gold,equipment(id串),atk,ap,armor,mr,ms]
# 追加 9 段（P3g，客户端尺寸不足时按旧 16 段兼容）= [16]total_gold [17]is_ai [18]role [19]is_dead
#   [20]respawn_remain [21]respawn_total [22]attr_chips [[glyph,Color,text],…]（host 英雄卡徽章同源）
#   [23]skill_txts [[text,Color],…]（技能 Lv/CD + 召唤师 + 名刀/复活 CD，host 同源）
#   [24]equip_txts [[text,Color],…]（装备名 + 主动 CD 后缀，host 同源）
func _build_roster_payload() -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for e in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes"):
		if not is_instance_valid(e):
			continue
		var dead: bool = bool(e.get("is_dead")) if e.get("is_dead") != null else e.health <= 0
		if e.team == TEAM_PLAYER or dead or e.visible or e.vision_expose_timer > 0.0:
			out.append(_pack_roster_row(e))
	return out

func _pack_roster_row(e: Node) -> Array:
	var equip: Array = []
	for it in e.equipment_slots:
		equip.append(str(it))
	var dead: bool = bool(e.get("is_dead")) if e.get("is_dead") != null else e.health <= 0
	var row := [_net_id_for(e), str(e.display_name), e.team, e.level, e.health, _maxhp_of(e),
		int(e.kills), int(e.deaths), int(e.assists), int(e.gold), equip,
		int(e.attack), int(e.ability_power), int(e.armor), int(e.magic_resist), int(e.move_speed)]
	row.append(int(e.total_gold_earned) if e.get("total_gold_earned") != null else int(e.gold))
	row.append(1 if bool(e.is_ai) else 0)
	row.append(str(e.role) if e.get("role") != null else "")
	row.append(1 if dead else 0)
	row.append(float(e.respawn_timer) if dead else 0.0)
	row.append(float(e.respawn_time_total) if dead else 0.0)
	row.append(_pack_roster_chips(e, dead))
	row.append(_pack_roster_skills(e))
	row.append(_pack_roster_equips(e))
	return row

# 英雄卡属性徽章：与 host UI_Manager._update_hero_detail（属性行 _achips）逐条同源（形状/主题色/文本）
func _pack_roster_chips(h: Node, dead: bool) -> Array:
	var chips: Array = []
	chips.append(["heart", Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55), "%d/%d" % [int(h.health), int(h.actual_max_health)]])
	chips.append(["sword", Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.24), "%d" % int(h.actual_attack_damage)])
	chips.append(["spark", Color(0.72, 0.5, 1.0), "%d" % int(h.actual_ability_power)])
	chips.append(["shield", Color(1.0, 0.78, 0.3), "%d" % int(h.actual_armor)])
	chips.append(["gem", Color(0.4, 0.88, 1.0), "%d" % int(h.actual_magic_resist)])
	chips.append(["chev", Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.7), "%.0f" % h.actual_move_speed])
	chips.append(["bolt", Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3), "%.2f" % h.attack_speed])
	if h.actual_mana_max > 0:
		chips.append(["drop", Color(0.3, 0.7, 1.0), "%d/%d" % [int(h.mana), int(h.actual_mana_max)]])
	if h.actual_crit_chance > 0:
		chips.append(["cross", Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.36), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_crit_chance * 100)])
	if h.actual_crit_damage > 1.85:
		chips.append(["dmg", Color(1.0, 0.36, 0.3), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_crit_damage * 100)])
	if h.flat_phys_pen > 0:
		chips.append(["pierce", Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.3), "%d" % int(h.flat_phys_pen)])
	if h.actual_phys_pen_percent > 0:
		chips.append(["pierce", Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.3), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_phys_pen_percent * 100)])
	if h.flat_magic_pen > 0:
		chips.append(["pierce", Color(0.7, 0.55, 1.0), "%d" % int(h.flat_magic_pen)])
	if h.actual_magic_pen_percent > 0:
		chips.append(["pierce", Color(0.7, 0.55, 1.0), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_magic_pen_percent * 100)])
	if h.actual_phys_lifesteal > 0:
		chips.append(["heart", Color(1.0, 0.56, 0.34), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_phys_lifesteal * 100)])
	if h.actual_magic_lifesteal > 0:
		chips.append(["heart", Color(0.78, 0.52, 1.0), "%.0f%%" % (h.actual_magic_lifesteal * 100)])
	if h.bonus_toughness > 0:
		chips.append(["tough", Color(0.96, 0.9, 0.5), "%.0f%%" % (h.bonus_toughness * 100)])
	if h.actual_cd_timer < 1.0:
		chips.append(["clock", Color(0.5, 0.85, 1.0), "%.0f%%" % ((1.0 - h.actual_cd_timer) * 100)])
	return chips

# 英雄卡技能行：host 同款文本与颜色（就绪=亮/冷却=灰，召唤师金，名刀金/复活绿）
func _pack_roster_skills(h: Node) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	var sk: Array = h.skills
	var lv: Array = h.skill_levels
	var cds: Array = h.skill_cooldowns
	for i in range(mini(sk.size(), lv.size())):
		var s = sk[i]
		if s == null:
			continue
		var cd: float = float(cds[i]) if i < cds.size() else 0.0
		var ct := "(%.1fs)" % cd if cd > 0.0 else "(就绪)"
		out.append(["%s Lv.%d %s" % [s.skill_name, int(lv[i]), ct], Color.LIGHT_CYAN if cd <= 0.0 else Color.GRAY])
	if h.summoner_skill != null:
		var scd := float(h.summoner_cooldown)
		var sct := "(%.1fs)" % scd if scd > 0.0 else "(就绪)"
		out.append(["%s %s" % [h.summoner_skill.skill_name, sct], Color.GOLD if scd <= 0.0 else Color.GRAY])
		if h.equipment_slots.has("famous_blade"):
			var fb := "名刀CD:%.0fs(%d/3)" % [h.famous_blade_cd, h.famous_blade_uses] if h.famous_blade_cd > 0 else "名刀:就绪(%d/3)" % h.famous_blade_uses
			out.append([fb, Color.GOLD if h.famous_blade_cd <= 0 else Color.GRAY])
		if h.equipment_slots.has("revive"):
			var rv := "复活CD:%.0fs(%d/2)" % [h.revive_cd, h.revive_count] if h.revive_cd > 0 else "复活:就绪(%d/2)" % h.revive_count
			out.append([rv, Color.GREEN if h.revive_cd <= 0 else Color.GRAY])
	return out

# 英雄卡装备行：host 同款「装备名 + 主动CD后缀」，逐件浅绿
func _pack_roster_equips(h: Node) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	for item_id in h.equipment_slots:
		var it: Dictionary = ItemDatabase.get_item(str(item_id))
		var t: String = str(it["name"]) if not it.is_empty() else str(item_id)
		if it.has("active"):
			var cd := 0.0
			match str(item_id):
				"golden_body": cd = float(h.golden_body_cd)
				"shadow_dart": cd = float(h.shadow_dart_cd)
				"purify": cd = float(h.purify_cd)
				"sunspire_bow": cd = float(h.sunspire_active_cd)
			t += (" CD:%.0fs" % cd) if cd > 0.0 else " [就绪]"
		out.append([t, Color.LIGHT_GREEN])
	return out

func _pack_equip_bonus(h: Hero) -> Array:
	var total_stats := [
		["攻击力", h.bonus_attack],
		["法术强度", h.bonus_ability_power],
		["生命值", h.bonus_health],
		["护甲", h.bonus_armor],
		["魔抗", h.bonus_magic_resist],
		["移速", h.bonus_move_speed],
		["百分比移速", h.bonus_per_speed * 100.0],
		["攻速%", h.bonus_attack_speed],
		["暴击率", h.bonus_crit_chance * 100.0],
		["暴击伤害", h.bonus_crit_damage * 100.0],
		["冷却缩减", (1.0 - h.actual_cd_timer) * 100.0],
		["物理吸血", h.bonus_phys_lifesteal * 100.0],
		["法术吸血", h.bonus_magic_lifesteal * 100.0],
		["物穿", h.bonus_phys_pen_percent * 100.0],
		["法穿", h.bonus_magic_pen_percent * 100.0],
		["韧性", h.bonus_toughness * 100.0],
	]
	var out: Array = []
	for ts in total_stats:
		if float(ts[1]) != 0.0:
			var tc := Color.LIGHT_GREEN
			if ts[0] in ["攻击力", "护甲", "物穿", "物理吸血", "暴击率", "暴击伤害"]:
				tc = Color.ORANGE
			elif ts[0] in ["法术强度", "魔抗", "法穿", "法术吸血"]:
				tc = Color(0.7, 0.4, 1.0)
			out.append(["  %s: %+.0f" % [ts[0], float(ts[1])], tc])
	return out","old_string":"# P3c roster：属性(C)/队伍(T)面板行——我方 5 + 可见敌方（与 hero 快照同一套可见性口径，

			out.append(_pack_roster_row(e))
	return out

func _pack_roster_row(e: Node) -> Array:
	var equip: Array = []
	for it in e.equipment_slots:
		equip.append(str(it))
	return [_net_id_for(e), str(e.display_name), e.team, e.level, e.health, _maxhp_of(e),
		int(e.kills), int(e.deaths), int(e.assists), int(e.gold), equip,
		int(e.attack), int(e.ability_power), int(e.armor), int(e.magic_resist), int(e.move_speed)]"}

Do it: write probe scene+script, run headless, delete. Validates runtime of new packing including typed accesses.

extends Node
var f:=0
func _ready():
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/battle.tscn")
func _process(_d):
	f+=1
	if f==200:
		var rows:Array = NetSession._build_roster_payload()
		print("[PROBE] rows=", rows.size())
		for r in rows:

Tell both: run parse check; don't touch NetSession/other files.

Then run host probe while they work.

主机的 own 快照已新增 `bs` 字段（lead 已改 scripts/net/NetSession.gd，禁止再改该文件），内容是 host 商店「总装备加成」逐行烘焙好的 [text:String, Color] 列表（文本形如 "  攻击力: +120"，颜色 host 同源：攻击/护甲/物穿/吸血/暴击橙、法强/魔抗/法穿越紫、其它浅绿）。现在让联机商店消费它，替换客户端按 ItemDatabase 累加的近似值。

要求：
1. 只改 scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd。
2. feed(o) 里接收 o["bs"]（Array，可能为空/缺失），在详情列「── 总装备加成 ──」区逐行绘制 text + color（字号按 host 商店详情 12×_us()，行距沿用该区现有布局）；`bs` 为空时回退到现有近似实现。文本已含前导空格与 "+"，不要重复加符号。
3. 顺带补 host 的第 8 个分类 tab「辅助」（host 商店 _shop_categories() 里有「辅助」类；先 grep 确认其装备 ID 表，全部加入；tab 样式/尺寸/间距沿用你已实现的 7 tab 样式，8 个 tab 在 2000 宽抽屉里排布不溢出，必要时略微压缩间距但保持 96×42 基准）。若 host 实际只有 7 类则跳过并在回执说明。
4. 保持公开 API（feed/toggle/hide_panel/buy/sell_slot/quick_buy/_hot 命中）与父场景调用不变；命中区随新 tab 更新。
5. 验证：cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit （仅允许既有 Minimap 告警）。再临时探针（headless+窗口化）喂含 bs 的 own 打开商店，跑 60 帧确认无运行时错误、命中区数量正确，跑完删除探针。不要启动完整游戏、不要发通知。

完成后 send_message 给 lead：改动摘要 + 验证结论；然后 complete。

task.subject: 联机英雄面板消费 host 新 roster 字段（阵亡/职业/AI/徽章/技能/装备CD）
task.description:
主机的 NetSession roster 载荷已扩展（lead 已改 scripts/net/NetSession.gd，禁止再改该文件）。现在让联机英雄信息面板消费新字段，实现与单机一致的完整信息。

行数据（scripts/net/NetSession.gd `_pack_roster_row` 注释）：基础 16 段不变，**追加**：
- [16] total_gold_earned:int（累计总经济，host 英雄卡「总经济」）
- [17] is_ai:int（1=AI）
- [18] role:String（职业，如 战士/法师）
- [19] is_dead:int
- [20] respawn_remain:float
- [21] respawn_total:float
- [22] attr_chips:Array，每项 [glyph:String, Color, text:String]，glyph ∈ heart/sword/spark/shield/gem/chev/bolt/drop/cross/dmg/pierce/tough/clock，顺序/文本/颜色已由 host 烘焙（与 host 英雄卡属性徽章逐条同源）
- [23] skill_txts:Array，每项 [text:String, Color]（形如 "技能名 Lv.3 (4.2s)"、召唤师技能、名刀/复活 CD，host 同源配色）
- [24] equip_txts:Array，每项 [text:String, Color]（"装备名 CD:12s"/"装备名 [就绪]"）
阵亡英雄行现在也会出现在 payload 里（我方全员 + 可见/已阵亡敌方）。

要求：
1. 只改 scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd。
2. 兼容旧载荷：`row.size() > 16` 才用新字段，否则保持现有近似逻辑。
3. 用新字段替换现有近似：总经济用 [16]；名字加 "[AI]" 用 [17]；头像盘职业字用 [18]；阵亡卡显示 "阵亡 Xs"（用 [20]/[21]，卡片压暗、血条空）；属性徽章改用 [22] 的 glyph/tint/text（绘制时 glyph 对应 host StatIcon._draw_shape 的形状，颜色 tint，文本 tint.lightened(0.35)，字号 font_sub）；技能行改用 [23] 的 text+color；装备行改用 [24] 的 text+color（每件 min 80 宽、间距 3）。不要再自行拼技能名/CD 或用金币近似总经济。
4. 保持 _us() 缩放、show_panel/hide_panel/rows/own/view 与父场景调用不变；队列表不能因新增阵亡行溢出：保持总高自适应/内部滚动或压缩卡高逻辑。
5. 验证：cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; & 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit （仅允许既有 Minimap 告警）。再自建临时探针（headless 实例化面板、喂 10 行含阵亡行与全部新字段、窗口化跑 60 帧渲染）确认 _draw 无运行时错误，跑完删除探针文件。不要启动完整游戏、不要发用户通知。

完成后 send_message 给 lead：改动摘要 + 验证结论；然后 complete 本任务。

content.text:
Now host-side verification: parse + runtime probe of new pack functions. Write host probe scene/script as planned: scene loads battle, after frames calls NetSession._build_roster_payload and _pack_equip_bonus.

But care: `NetSession._build_roster_payload` returns rows only if heroes group non-empty and battle started. Headless battle auto-starts? Previously headless battle spawned minions at ~frame? The error came from spawn_single_minion, so yes battle running. But hero select may block? In headless, maybe auto-select via `--net-test`? Unknown; our earlier smoke had 3 environment errors only, and previously we observed "spawn_single_minion is_inside_tree" error in earlier sessions (baseline), so heroes exist.

Probe script:
```gdscript
extends Node
var f := 0
func _ready():
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/battle.tscn")
func _process(_d):
	f += 1
	if f == 180:
		var rows: Array = NetSession._build_roster_payload()
		print("[PROBE] rows=", rows.size())
		for r in rows:
			print("[PROBE] row size=", r.size(), " name=", r[1], " dead=", (r[19] if r.size() > 19 else -1))
		var hs := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("heroes")
		print("[PROBE] heroes=", hs.size())
		if hs.size() > 0:
			var h = hs[0]
			print("[PROBE] chips=", NetSession._pack_roster_chips(h, false).size(),
				" skills=", NetSession._pack_roster_skills(h).size(),
				" equips=", NetSession._pack_roster_equips(h).size(),
				" bs=", NetSession._pack_equip_bonus(h).size())
	if f > 210:
		get_tree().quit()
```
Run headless with scene probe. change_scene_to_file from a Node inside probe scene: fine.

Potential error: `f == 180` runs after scene change; `change_scene_to_file` deferred, ok.

Write & run; then delete probe.

Also parse check for NetSession edit.

func _ready():
	var ps = load("res://scenes/battle.tscn").instantiate()
	add_child(ps)   # probe node persists

Rewrite probe: instantiate Hero, add to tree, set some fields (actual_*, respawn, role, is_dead false, skills maybe create Skill resources via SkillDatabase.get_skill? Hero.skills empty → skip). Then call _build_roster_payload with our hero in tree → returns rows.

Also equipment: push "armor1" into equipment_slots; ItemDatabase lookup.

Do that; simpler, no scene change.

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier (done): realistic spell animations; realistic spell props (“请把法术的各种道具逼真化，比如小乔的扇子和旋风，甄姬的冰柱等”).
- Earlier (done): single-player vs multiplayer UI consistency (“请你对比单机版和联机版的UI，争取让它们一致”).
- Then (done in prior turn): full experience parity — map rendering, health-bar size, camera position, numeric displays (“我需要让联机和单击的体验完全一样，包括从地图渲染、血条大小、相机位置、各种数值显示等等”).
- Current: “联机版和单机版的英雄信息面板、商店面板等都不太一样” — align multiplayer client hero-info panel, shop panel, and other panels with single-player host UI.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable, GDScript, mobile renderer, Android; `canvas_items`+expand stretch (virtual height 1400, width ≥2400); glow+ACES on; no test suite/build.
- Verification: `--headless --path . --editor --quit` (only pre-existing `Class "Minimap" hides a global script class` + MiniMap.gd parse error allowed), plus headless scene runs with `--quit-after N` and temporary `-- --world-test` bypass of `NetClientBattle._ready` headless early-return.
- Host UI: `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` (3480 lines) builds panels from Controls; `ui_scale() = maxf(1.0, viewport_width/2400.0) * 1.35` (1.35 at 2400 wide); `_apply_label_style` multiplies font by `ui_scale()`; positions/offsets mostly raw px.
- Client panels: hand-drawn replicas on dedicated CanvasLayers (HUD 20, minimap 80, pad 100, roster 101, shop 102, pop 103, yuanliu 104, result 110).
- Host result screen lives in `scripts/ui/ResultsPanel.gd` with `_rs() = clampf(vw/2400,1.0,1.2)*1.7`.

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

# 临时集成验证：新 roster 26 段载荷 + own.bs 同时喂给英雄面板/商店，窗口化真实渲染。用后删除。
var _f := 0
var _panels: Array = []

func _ready() -> void:
	var host := Control.new()
	host.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	host.size = Vector2(2400, 1400)
	add_child(host)
	var rows: Array = []
	var roles := ["战士", "法师", "射手", "刺客", "辅助"]
	for i in range(10):
		var dead := 1 if i == 3 or i == 7 else 0
		var chips: Array = [
			["heart", Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.55), "%d/%d" % [3200 - i * 100, 5000]],
			["sword", Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.24), "%d" % (300 + i * 10)],
			["spark", Color(0.72, 0.5, 1.0), "%d" % (100 + i * 5)],
			["shield", Color(1.0, 0.78, 0.3), "%d" % (150 + i)],
			["gem", Color(0.4, 0.88, 1.0), "80"],
			["chev", Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.7), "400"],
			["bolt", Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.3), "0.85"],
			["drop", Color(0.3, 0.7, 1.0), "500/600"],
			["cross", Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.36), "20%"],
			["dmg", Color(1.0, 0.36, 0.3), "200%"],
			["pierce", Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.3), "30%"],
			["tough", Color(0.96, 0.9, 0.5), "15%"],
			["clock", Color(0.5, 0.85, 1.0), "20%"],
		]
		var skills: Array = [
			["神影突袭 Lv.3 (就绪)", Color.LIGHT_CYAN],
			["剑气纵横 Lv.2 (4.2s)", Color.GRAY],
			["万剑归宗 Lv.1 (22.0s)", Color.GRAY],
			["闪现 (就绪)", Color.GOLD],
			["名刀:就绪(1/3)", Color.GOLD],
		]
		var eqs: Array = [["暗影战斧 CD:12s", Color.LIGHT_GREEN], ["红莲斗篷 [就绪]", Color.LIGHT_GREEN]]
		rows.append([i, "英雄%d" % i, 0 if i < 5 else 1, 8 + i % 4, 0.0 if dead else 3200.0 - i * 100, 5000.0,
			3, 1, 2, 7000 + i * 300, ["armor1"], 300, 100, 150, 80, 400,
			9000 + i * 3000, 1 if i % 3 == 0 else 0, roles[i % 5], dead,
			5.0 if dead else 0.0, 12.0 if dead else 0.0, chips, skills, eqs, 1500 + i * 100])
	var roster = load("res://scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd").new()
	host.add_child(roster)
	roster.rows = rows
	roster.own = {"name": "英雄0", "sa": []}
	roster.show_panel("team")
	_panels.append(roster)
	var roster2 = load("res://scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd").new()
	host.add_child(roster2)
	var sa: Array = []
	for i in range(18):
		sa.append(100.0 + i)
		sa.append(20.0 + i)
		sa.append(5.0 + i)
	roster2.rows = rows
	roster2.own = {"name": "英雄0", "sa": sa}
	roster2.show_panel("attr")
	_panels.append(roster2)
	var bs: Array = [
		["  攻击力: +120", Color.ORANGE],
		["  生命值: +900", Color.LIGHT_GREEN],
		["  法术强度: +80", Color(0.7, 0.4, 1.0)],
	]
	var shop = load("res://scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd").new()
	host.add_child(shop)
	shop.feed({"gold": 8000, "hero_name": "英雄0", "equip": ["armor1"], "rec": "", "bs": bs})
	shop.toggle()
	_panels.append(shop)

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_f += 1
	for p in _panels:
		if is_instance_valid(p) and p is CanvasItem:
			p.queue_redraw()
	if _f > 90:
		get_tree().quit()
