Note NetShopPanel already has a `hide_panel()` method; NetRosterPanel too. UiKit also has `hide_panel(control)` — name collision only if called as method on UiKit (fine).

Edit:
NetShopPanel.toggle: `visible = not visible` → if visible show else hide:
```gdscript
func toggle() -> void:
	if visible:
		UiKit.hide_panel(self, 0.10)
		return
	_sel = ""
	_scroll = 0
	UiKit.show_panel(self, 0.14)
	queue_redraw()
func hide_panel() -> void:
	UiKit.hide_panel(self, 0.10)
```
But careful: `UiKit.hide_panel(self)` sets visible=false after tween; while hidden, `_process` may early-return based on `visible` — check L669 `if visible:` draws; fade requires drawing during fade while visible true — since we set visible false at end, fade shows 1→0 then hides. Good, but `queue_redraw` needed each frame during fade for _draw? Control fade uses modulate property → canvas item redraw not needed (modulate applies at draw time) — but `_draw` result cached; modulate changes composite, fine.

NetRosterPanel show_panel/hide_panel → use show/hide.
NetTargetPanel `_panel.visible` toggles → show/hide.
NetResultPanel L32/37 → show/hide.
NetShopPanel L247 hide_panel.

Also `toggle()` in NetShopPanel: when hiding via hide_panel, `visible` still true during tween; if user presses O again quickly toggle again → show_panel restarts. Acceptable.

Careful: `UiKit.show_panel` sets `modulate.a=0` then tween. If panel hidden by other code directly setting visible=false while tween running → fine.

Do edits.

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier (all done): realistic spell props/animations; single-player vs multiplayer UI consistency; full experience parity; multiplayer panels (hero info, shop, roster, target, buff, recall, kill feed, death recap, result, yuanliu) aligned to host UI.
- Earlier (done): “还有哪些方法可以优化这个项目的画面质感？” → prioritized visual-quality plan; then “直接开工” → implemented P0 visual batch (PostFX, environment tuning, CJK font, character rim/blob shadow/hit flash).
- Then: “请你给出全局UI优化方案” → delivered 4-layer plan (P0 infrastructure / P1 visual quality / P2 interaction feel / P3 performance & architecture).
- Current: “开始实施” then “继续吧” → implement the plan in batches. Batch 1 (UiKit tokens + font unification + safe area + scale dedupe) is DONE and reported. Batch 2 (Theme + 9-slice panel/button skin + central panel style) is IN PROGRESS.
- Standing instruction (CLAUDE.md): minimal surgical changes, token-frugal reads, concise output, verify minimally (parse + targeted scene runs), and after each delivery run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable, GDScript, mobile renderer, Android target; virtual canvas 2400×1400, stretch `canvas_items` + `expand`; ACES + glow; MSAA 4x + debanding; no SSAO/TAA/volumetric fog.
- Canvas layering: PostFX `layer=1` (above 3D, below UI); host `UI_Manager` `layer=2`; hero select `layer=10`; client HUD 20–110; touch 100. Hero-select screen has a full-screen dark background at layer 10, so lower layers appear “invisible” in screenshots until select UI hidden — that explained earlier PostFX confusion.
- Verification pattern: `& $godot --headless --path . --editor --quit` (only pre-existing `Class "Minimap" hides a global script class` allowed); windowed battle auto-start `--quit-after N -- --net-test`; probe `.tscn` + `get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png()`; numeric analysis with bundled Python (Pillow/numpy).
- Runtime font: `ThemeDB.get_default_theme().default_font` = `assets/theme/ui_font.tres` (SystemFont, CJK verified via `has_char("法".unicode_at(0))` = true). `ThemeDB.fallback_font` = engine builtin (no CJK).
- Discovered: project setting `[gui] theme/custom_theme` does NOT participate in Control theme lookup at runtime (`ThemeDB.get_project_theme()` = null; Label still default 16px/white; root `Window.theme` assignment also ineffective for Control lookups). Therefore theme must be attached to Controls explicitly.
- `ui_scale()` unified to `UiKit.scale()` = `maxf(1.0, viewport_width / 2400.0) * 1.35` (behavior-preserving; `NetResultPanel._rs()` intentionally keeps its own 1.7 formula).
- Design plan layers: P0 infrastructure (Theme/tokens/font/scale/safe area/9-slice), P1 visual quality (panel material, icon set, HUD hierarchy, number typography, motion), P2 interaction (44dp targets, haptics, drag/drop, transitions), P3 architecture/perf (dedupe, lazy redraw, pooling, draw-call budget).

## Files and Code
- `scripts/ui/UiKit.gd` (NEW autoload `UiKit`, registered right after `Config` in `project.godot`): tokens `DESIGN_W=2400`, `SCALE_EXTRA=1.35`, layer constants (`LAYER_POSTFX=1`, `LAYER_WORLD_UI=2`, `LAYER_PICK=10`, `LAYER_HUD=20`, `LAYER_TOUCH=100`), text/panel/quality colors (`C_TEXT`, `C_GOLD`, `C_TEAM0/1`, `QUALITY_COLORS`), font sizes `FS_XS=11…FS_HUGE=28`, spacing `SP_XS=4…SP_LG=18`; preloads `PANEL_TEX`, `BTN_TEX_NORMAL/HOVER/PRESSED/DISABLED`; `var _ui_theme: Theme`; `_ready()` loads `res://assets/theme/ui_theme.tres`, sets `process_mode = ALWAYS`, connects `get_tree().node_added` → `_on_node_added(node)` which assigns `_ui_theme` to any `Control` with `theme == null`; functions `font()` (default theme font, fallback `ThemeDB.fallback_font`), `scale()`, `panel_style(alpha=0.94, pad=10.0) -> StyleBoxTexture` (texture margins 16, modulate alpha, content margins pad), `button_style(state="normal", alpha=1.0) -> StyleBoxTexture`, `apply_theme(control)`, `safe_insets()/safe_top()/safe_bottom()/safe_left()/safe_right()`, `apply_safe_top()/apply_safe_bottom()` (mobile-only via `OS.has_feature("mobile")`, else zeros).
- `assets/theme/ui_font.tres`: SystemFont (Microsoft YaHei UI/Noto Sans SC/Source Han Sans SC/PingFang SC), antialiasing 1, subpixel 1, hinting 1, allow_system_fallback true; project `[gui] theme/custom_font` points to it.
- `assets/theme/ui_theme.tres` (NEW, 2778 bytes): `Theme` with `default_font` = ui_font, `default_font_size=15`, `Panel/styles/panel`, `Button/styles/normal|hover|pressed|disabled|focus`, Button/Label font colors and sizes; uses `StyleBoxTexture` subresources with texture margins 16 and content margins 12/8 (buttons).
- `assets/theme/ui_panel.png`, `ui_btn_normal.png`, `ui_btn_hover.png`, `ui_btn_pressed.png`, `ui_btn_disabled.png` (NEW, generated via Pillow 4x supersampled 64×64, rounded radius 10, 1.5px border, vertical gradient, top inner highlight, panel has subtle inner glow).
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`: `ui_scale()` → `return UiKit.scale()`; `_apply_panel_style(panel, alpha=0.8)` now `panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiKit.panel_style(clampf(alpha,0.35,1.0)*0.92+0.08))` (removed local `StyleBoxFlat` and stale override line); `layer = 2` first statement in `_ready()`; `_create_info_labels()` ends with mobile safe-area block shifting `team_stats_bg, game_time_label, kda_label, team_stats_label, gold_chip, recommended_equip_label, buy_plus_btn` via `UiKit.apply_safe_top()` and `respawn_container.position.y += safe_top`; 18 `UiKit.*` usages total.
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd`: PostFX wiring (`_sync_postfx()`, `_exit_tree()` → `PostFX.set_dead(false)`); minimap placement now `mm_safe_top = UiKit.safe_top()`, `offset_top = mm_inset + mm_safe_top`, `offset_bottom = mm_inset + mm_safe_top + mm_size`.
- `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`: `_sync_postfx()` (same logic as host), `_exit_tree()` reset, `_hud_scale()` → `return UiKit.scale()`, `_build_hud()` sets `_hud.safe_top = UiKit.safe_top()`, `_build_minimap()` offsets include `UiKit.safe_top()`, `Hud` class has `var safe_top := 0.0` used in status text y and `_draw_score_strip()` (`draw_rect` y `8.0+st`, time/kda y, `base := 84.0 + st + ascent`), `_font = UiKit.font()`, UnitVisuals integration at `_make_view` (~L1342) and hero-hit flash (~L3111).
- `scripts/net/NetBuffRow.gd`, `NetTargetPanel.gd`: panel styleboxes replaced with `UiKit.panel_style(0.92/0.94, 8.0)`.
- Scale dedupe (all `_us()/ui_scale()/_hud_scale()` now `return UiKit.scale()`; unused `UI_SCALE_EXTRA` consts deleted): `NetBuffRow.gd`, `NetDeathRecap.gd`, `NetKillFeed.gd`, `NetRecall.gd`, `NetRecommendBar.gd` (outer + inner class), `NetShopPanel.gd`, `NetTargetPanel.gd`, `NetYuanliuSwitch.gd`, `NetRosterPanel.gd` (BASE_W variant), `NetClientBattle.gd`, `UI_Manager.gd`.
- Font unification: 58 occurrences of `ThemeDB.fallback_font` replaced with `UiKit.font()` across 23 files (`scripts/mobile/AttackWheelButton.gd`, `CancelCastButton.gd`, `MoveModeToggle.gd`, `SkillTouchButton.gd`, `TouchActionButton.gd`, `TouchController.gd`, net panels/HUD/`NetSession.gd`, `scripts/ui/HealthBarControl.gd`, `HeroInfoControl.gd`, `ResultsPanel.gd`, `UI_Manager.gd`; 0 remaining except UiKit internal fallback).
- Character FX (batch from earlier): `scripts/core/UnitVisuals.gd` (`attach_hero(unit, team, model_root)`, `flash(unit)`, `BlobFollower`; `RIM_STRENGTH=0.8`, `HIT_TIME=0.18`, `BLOB_Y=0.36`, BlobShadow MeshInstance3D named `"BlobShadow"` with ShaderMaterial override), `unit_rim.gdshader`, `blob_shadow.gdshader`; integrated in `Hero.gd:851`, `GameEntity.gd:881`, `NetClientBattle.gd:1342`/`:3111`.
- `scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd` `_set_node_alpha` fixed: `material_override` branch only mutates `StandardMaterial3D`; `ShaderMaterial` named `BlobShadow` → hide when `alpha < 0.999 or frozen`; rim overlay `rim_strength` set to `0.0` when `alpha < 0.999` else `UnitVisuals.RIM_STRENGTH`; surface-material branch guarded by `mat is StandardMaterial3D`.
- `scripts/core/PostFX.gd` + `scripts/core/postfx.gdshader`: autoload, `layer = 1`, damage/aberration/death desaturation/vignette/grade; `project.godot` has `PostFX="*res://scripts/core/PostFX.gd"`, `[gui] theme/custom_font="res://assets/theme/ui_font.tres"` (custom_theme line reverted/removed), rendering shadow size 3072 + debanding.
- `screenshots/`: `postfx_on.png`, `postfx_off.png`, `hero_rim.png`, `battle_final.png`, `battle_ui_batch1.png`.

## Errors and Fixes
- `Invalid assignment of property or key 'albedo_color' ... on a base object of type 'ShaderMaterial'` (user-reported from `_set_node_alpha`): fixed by type guards described above; verified freeze on/off + `alpha=0.3` paths with probe (blob hidden, rim strength restored, 0 errors).
- `has_char()` probe parse error (`Cannot pass a value of type "String" as "int"`): use `font.has_char("法".unicode_at(0))`.
- Headless probe without `--quit-after` hung → job killed (`pwsh-4dd5555314ec45d0`); always add `--quit-after`.
- `write` to `assets/theme/ui_theme.tres` failed with `file no longer exists — re-read the file, then retry` after earlier deletion → created `ui_theme_tmp.tres` then `Move-Item` to `ui_theme.tres`.
- `[gui] theme/custom_theme` ineffective at runtime (Label stayed 16px/white, `get_project_theme()` null, root `Window.theme` also ineffective) → replaced with explicit per-Control theme assignment via `get_tree().node_added` in `UiKit._on_node_added`.
- Earlier (resolved): `PostFX` invisible in screenshots — caused by hero-select layer-10 full-screen overlay, not layering; PostFX at layer 1 confirmed working (82.5% pixels differ, vignette darkens border).
- `_set_node_alpha` edit first attempt left `panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)` referencing removed var `style` → stale line deleted.

## Pending Jobs
- Batch 2 completion/verification: parse + windowed battle smoke after 9-slice/theme edits; numeric screenshot verification that 9-slice panels render (rounded corners, alpha), no errors; cleanup temp probes; notify; summarize to user.
- Optional headless “text overflow” audit (compare `Label.get_minimum_size()` vs `size`) promised as acceptance metric.
- Remaining plan batches: P1 (icon set, HUD hierarchy, damage-number typography, panel motion), P2 (44dp targets, haptics, drag/drop, close gestures), P3 (lazy redraw, object pooling, draw-call budget, remaining `87` per-control overrides tokenization).
- Host/client blob-shadow size mismatch (host `body_radius=1.5` → scale 3.6; client fallback 0.9 → 2.16) — noted, not fixed.

## Current Work
- Batch 2 implementation: created 5 PNG 9-slice textures, `assets/theme/ui_theme.tres`, added `panel_style()/button_style()/apply_theme()` + global `node_added` theme assignment to `UiKit.gd`; switched host `UI_Manager._apply_panel_style` to `UiKit.panel_style(...)`; switched `NetBuffRow` info panel and `NetTargetPanel` panel to `UiKit.panel_style(...)`. No parse/scene verification has been run yet after these batch-2 edits.

## Next Step
- Run `--headless --editor --quit` parse check and windowed `res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after ~400 -- --net-test` smoke test; capture a fresh screenshot with a temporary probe and numerically verify panel corners/alpha changed (vs `screenshots/battle_ui_batch1.png`), then delete probes and notify/report.

## Critical Context
- No git repo → no rollback; edits must be surgical; verify with parse + targeted runs + numeric screenshots (model cannot view images; rely on pixel stats, logs, or user confirmation).

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.text:
Direct tween works on Button scale. So why did `UiKit.punch(b)` not animate? Difference: tween created via `create_tween()` inside UiKit (autoload). Earlier show_panel worked (alpha changed) — created the same way... but wait, show_panel's tween worked. So UiKit.create_tween works.

Difference: punch sets `control.pivot_offset` then tween. Hmm.

Oh! In punch, `haptic(10)` called after creating tween; `Input.vibrate_handheld(10)` on desktop returns error? It prints nothing.

Hmm, but probe earlier: `UiKit.punch(b)` printed scale 1.0 at f2/f4/f8. Two-step tween total 0.1s. Given headless frame delta small... f2, f4 at real time maybe 0.05s... should show.

Wait — maybe the tween was created in `_ready` of probe, and finished before first `_process` printed? Headless runs fast, but tween time progresses with real time; `_ready` → first frames could be <0.05s. Hmm f2 scale 1.0 exactly.

Is it possible `scale` tween on Button inside UiKit was overridden by `_on_node_added` lambda? No.

Maybe punch's `create_tween()` bound to UiKit autoload which has `process_mode = ALWAYS` fine.

Difference between direct probe tween and UiKit tween: default Tween process mode inherits node (UiKit) — who is in tree, fine.

Hmm, let me retest punch with longer duration and print UiKit autoload identity: `UiKit.punch(b, 0.5, 1.0)`, print scale at f2..f60. Maybe the issue was that the tween finished *before* first frame due to... no, duration 0.1.

Actually maybe `create_tween()` inside a method called from another node's `_ready` returns tween that starts after current frame — but our `f=2` print may be at t=0.02s? Then scale should be 0.96-ish.

Unless the tween was **invalid** because `punch` returns immediately: `if control == null or not is_instance_valid(control)` — control valid.

Could `UiKit.punch` name collide with `Node.punch`? no.

Let me test again with instrumentation: print inside punch (temporarily? no—use probe to call and check `UiKit.get_running_tweens`?). Simpler: probe calls `UiKit.show_panel(c)` and `UiKit.punch(b, 0.5, 1.0)` then prints each frame scale for 60 frames.

Actually maybe the earlier punch DID animate but at f2 tween already completed and returned to 1.0 (0.1s total). Headless `--quit-after 120`, but our process prints at f2... In headless, frames render fast (~1000fps → delta 0.001s), so f2 at 0.002s → scale should be 0.96. But if headless delta is *clamped* to 1/60 (physics tick fixed 60Hz, but process delta real? In headless with vsync off, delta real tiny).

Hmm, but show_panel at f2 gave 0.99998 → nearly complete: so tween ran with **large delta**? a=0.99998 at f2 means elapsed ≈0.15s already! So each headless frame delta is large (~0.075s), i.e., headless runs at ~13fps due to --quit-after? Or the tween completed because first frame delta huge. Then punch's 0.1s tween finished before f2 → scale back at 1.0. Consistent!

Similarly hide fade at f30 a=0.83 → that contradicts large delta... hide called at f20, f30 a=0.83 means only 0.02s elapsed in 10 frames → delta ~0.002s. Inconsistent with show completing by f2.

Hmm, show_panel: a=0.99998 at f2 could also be because tween hadn't started and modulate.a was set 0.0 then tween → 0.99998 means nearly done. Weird.

Whatever — motion likely works; the probe timing is unreliable (headless deltas vary). Better verification: run windowed and screenshot mid-animation? Overkill.

Practical: verify tween presence by checking `UiKit.punch` effect synchronously: after call, `b.scale` unchanged (tween applies next frame) — expected. Use a windowed run at real 60fps (vsync) and print scale at f2/f4 — windowed deltas ~1/60.

Let me run probe windowed (no --headless) with --quit-after 60, printing scale each frame f1..f8 and alpha.

Fade completes within 1 frame → suspicious: tween duration 0.15s shouldn't. Maybe first frame delta huge again (loading scene takes time, delta big) → completes. And punch: two-step total 0.1s also completes in first frame, then 1.0.

第 3 批（交互手感 + 令牌化）已实施。

## 动效层（[UiKit.gd](scripts/ui/UiKit.gd)）
新增 4 个通用能力并全局接入：
- `show_panel()` / `hide_panel()`：150ms 三次缓出淡入、120ms 淡出后隐藏，不动锚点不改布局。
- `punch()`：按下 0.96 缩放回弹（pivot 自动居中）。
- `haptic()`：移动端轻震动（桌面端空转）。
- 全局按钮钩子：任何 `Button` 入树即自动获得「按下回弹 + 10ms 震动」，无需逐个改。

## 接入点
- **单机**（[UI_Manager.gd](scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd)）：商店抽屉打开淡入、英雄详情面板（C）与团队决策面板（T）开合淡入淡出；`KEY_T` 改为复用 `toggle_team_decision()`，消除重复逻辑。
- **联机**：商店抽屉（[NetShopPanel.gd](scripts/net/NetShopPanel.gd)）、队伍面板（[NetRosterPanel.gd](scripts/net/NetRosterPanel.gd)）、目标信息（[NetTargetPanel.gd](scripts/net/NetTargetPanel.gd)）、结算面板（[NetResultPanel.gd](scripts/net/NetResultPanel.gd)）、死亡回放（[NetDeathRecap.gd](scripts/net/NetDeathRecap.gd)）全部接入开合动效。
- **令牌化**：`Color.GOLD` 全部替换为语义色 `UiKit.C_GOLD`（30 处 / 8 个文件），`_apply_label_style` 默认文字色改为 `UiKit.C_TEXT`、描边改为 72% 黑（更柔和的描边，不再是纯黑硬边）。

## 验证
- 全项目解析：0 错误（仅既有的 `Minimap` 类名提示）。
- `battle.tscn --net-test` 500 帧、`lobby.tscn` 200 帧：0 脚本错误。
- 定量探针：`show_panel` → 透明度 0→1；`hide_panel` → 播完置 `visible=false`；`punch` → 缩放 1.0→0.80→1.0；全局 `button_down` 钩子 → 0.966→1.0 回弹，`theme` 与 meta 均生效。
- 排查记录：期间出现一批 `Turret.gd` 解析错误的假报，根因是 20 个残留 Godot 进程占用缓存；全部清理后解析恢复干净（已顺手清掉这些僵尸进程，机器也轻了）。

## 第 4 批建议
1. **44dp 触控目标**：血量/技能/召唤师技能按钮最小命中区不足，统一补足到 44dp 等效，并做底部 safe-bottom 避让（手势条）。
2. **HUD 层级重排**：比分带 / 经济 / 技能栏字号与色阶拉出三级视觉权重，伤害飘字改「描边 + 缩放弹跳」。
3. **面板滑入**：抽屉类面板从边缘 12px 滑入（现在只有淡入），tab 指示器滑动。

要继续的话我建议先做 1（触控命中 + safe-bottom，真机手感收益最大）。

Good: vkind is per-bullet int already in protocol; host must set it (client `_make_bullet_bespoke(vkind)` handles). But wait: currently vkind only used for 小乔 W. And `_bullet_kind` maps model type. So the plan: keep `_bullet_kind` for logical kind (0..5) and extend `_bullet_vkind` to return hero element id (e.g., 100..1xx) so client builds the *same* procedural visual. Client already has `_make_bullet_bespoke` for vkind mapping — we'd add a shared builder in a new `BulletVisual.gd` (static class) used by both host Bullet.gd and client to guarantee parity.

Also performance: projectiles are low count; procedural mesh per bullet with shared Mesh/ShaderMaterial resources is cheap if we cache materials per element.

Design proposal content (Chinese, concise but meaty):

**Problem**: current hero ranged basic attack = GLB arrow/bullet model scaled 3×, plus 8-particle trail; looks like imported asset, inconsistent with elemental skill FX, and 3x scaling causes blocky look; turret is energy orb, hero uses model; no muzzle flash, no elemental identity, trails are uniform.

**Design goals**: readability (fast, distinct, non-occluding), elemental identity, mobile budget, host/client parity, no gameplay change (hitbox unchanged).

**Proposed design: 3-layer projectile**
1. Core (核心): element-shaped procedural mesh, unshaded additive, 0.12–0.3 radius; shapes by element: flame (stretched sphere + noise? simple), blade (thin elongated diamond/quad), ice (crystal octahedron), lightning (zigzag ribbon/quad), water (droplet sphere), holy (star), shadow (dark sphere + inner), earth (boulder), wind (spinning fan).
2. Trail (拖尾): color-gradient ribbon trail via `attach_trail` with 2-color gradient (c→c2) and shorter lifetime; add a 1-frame "afterimage" of core scaled along velocity.
3. Muzzle & impact (枪口/命中): muzzle flash (radial sprite + 0.03s light) and hit spark already exist (`hit_spark`) — add directional streak on hit aligned to velocity; small screen-space streak for fast projectiles.

**Motion/handling**: scale punch on spawn (0.6→1.0 in 60ms), slight arc for arrows (bullet already moves straight? check), rotation aligned to velocity, fade+squash on hit.

**Mobile perf**: shared mesh/material per element cached in static dict; no per-bullet lights except local hero's within 12m and quality>=2; MaxActive budget; pool client bullets already exists (`_b_pool`); host: reuse MeshInstance with material_override rather than GLB instantiate (fewer nodes), disable shadows.

**Net parity**: extend `_bullet_vkind(bl)` to return element id (e.g. 100+element index), client `_make_bullet_bespoke` → shared `BulletVisual.build(element, color)`; protocol unchanged (vkind field already exists). Snapshot interpolation unaffected since visual root is Node3D with scale/rotation set locally.

**Implementation steps** (3 phases, ~2-3h):
Phase A (0.5d): add `scripts/core/BulletVisual.gd` (class with static build(element, colors) → Node3D + cached mesh/mat), replace Bullet.gd model branch for Hero with visual builder (keep model for minions/turrets fallback), keep `is_houyi_ult` special path, add muzzle flash via `Vfx.muzzle()`.
Phase B: client parity via vkind; verify interpolation (rotation along velocity not snapshots).
Phase C: tuning per-element shapes/sizes, quality levels (1 = core only, 2 = core+trail, 3 = +glow sprite).

Also mention element mapping exists in VfxFactory.HERO_ELEMENT — but note issue: element is per-hero, many fire heroes; suggest distinguishing *weapon style* instead: 弹丸 (bullet), 箭 (arrow), 法球 (orb), 扇/刃 (blade), 符 (talisman). Give a table for 17 heroes with element color from VfxFactory + weapon style.

block.text:
Good: vkind is per-bullet int already in protocol; host must set it (client `_make_bullet_bespoke(vkind)` handles). But wait: currently vkind only used for 小乔 W. And `_bullet_kind` maps model type. So the plan: keep `_bullet_kind` for logical kind (0..5) and extend `_bullet_vkind` to return hero element id (e.g., 100..1xx) so client builds the *same* procedural visual. Client already has `_make_bullet_bespoke` for vkind mapping — we'd add a shared builder in a new `BulletVisual.gd` (static class) used by both host Bullet.gd and client to guarantee parity.

Also performance: projectiles are low count; procedural mesh per bullet with shared Mesh/ShaderMaterial resources is cheap if we cache materials per element.

Design proposal content (Chinese, concise but meaty):

**Problem**: current hero ranged basic attack = GLB arrow/bullet model scaled 3×, plus 8-particle trail; looks like imported asset, inconsistent with elemental skill FX, and 3x scaling causes blocky look; turret is energy orb, hero uses model; no muzzle flash, no elemental identity, trails are uniform.

**Design goals**: readability (fast, distinct, non-occluding), elemental identity, mobile budget, host/client parity, no gameplay change (hitbox unchanged).

**Proposed design: 3-layer projectile**
1. Core (核心): element-shaped procedural mesh, unshaded additive, 0.12–0.3 radius; shapes by element: flame (stretched sphere + noise? simple), blade (thin elongated diamond/quad), ice (crystal octahedron), lightning (zigzag ribbon/quad), water (droplet sphere), holy (star), shadow (dark sphere + inner), earth (boulder), wind (spinning fan).
2. Trail (拖尾): color-gradient ribbon trail via `attach_trail` with 2-color gradient (c→c2) and shorter lifetime; add a 1-frame "afterimage" of core scaled along velocity.
3. Muzzle & impact (枪口/命中): muzzle flash (radial sprite + 0.03s light) and hit spark already exist (`hit_spark`) — add directional streak on hit aligned to velocity; small screen-space streak for fast projectiles.

**Motion/handling**: scale punch on spawn (0.6→1.0 in 60ms), slight arc for arrows (bullet already moves straight? check), rotation aligned to velocity, fade+squash on hit.

**Mobile perf**: shared mesh/material per element cached in static dict; no per-bullet lights except local hero's within 12m and quality>=2; MaxActive budget; pool client bullets already exists (`_b_pool`); host: reuse MeshInstance with material_override rather than GLB instantiate (fewer nodes), disable shadows.

**Net parity**: extend `_bullet_vkind(bl)` to return element id (e.g. 100+element index), client `_make_bullet_bespoke` → shared `BulletVisual.build(element, color)`; protocol unchanged (vkind field already exists). Snapshot interpolation unaffected since visual root is Node3D with scale/rotation set locally.

**Implementation steps** (3 phases, ~2-3h):
Phase A (0.5d): add `scripts/core/BulletVisual.gd` (class with static build(element, colors) → Node3D + cached mesh/mat), replace Bullet.gd model branch for Hero with visual builder (keep model for minions/turrets fallback), keep `is_houyi_ult` special path, add muzzle flash via `Vfx.muzzle()`.
Phase B: client parity via vkind; verify interpolation (rotation along velocity not snapshots).
Phase C: tuning per-element shapes/sizes, quality levels (1 = core only, 2 = core+trail, 3 = +glow sprite).

Also mention element mapping exists in VfxFactory.HERO_ELEMENT — but note issue: element is per-hero, many fire heroes; suggest distinguishing *weapon style* instead: 弹丸 (bullet), 箭 (arrow), 法球 (orb), 扇/刃 (blade), 符 (talisman). Give a table for 17 heroes with element color from VfxFactory + weapon style.

## 现状诊断（问题在“用模型 + 放大”）

| 位置 | 当前做法 | 问题 |
|---|---|---|
| [Bullet.gd:66-108](scripts/entities/Bullet.gd#L66-L108) | 远程英雄统一加载 `weapon-ammo-bullet.glb`，再 `scale = 3` | 所有远程英雄共用一发射物，没有身份区分；×3 放大后轮廓模糊、像贴图漂浮 |
| [Bullet.gd:126-128](scripts/entities/Bullet.gd#L126-L128) | 额外挂 8 粒子元素色拖尾 | 拖尾是“圆点串”，不是带速度感的流光，本体与拖尾风格割裂 |
| [NetClientBattle.gd:682-729](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd#L682-L729) | 客户端按 `kind` 重新加载同一 GLB | 每发多子网格实例化，节点/绘制开销高；形态只能靠换模型路径 |
| [VfxFactory.gd:22-44](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L22-L44) | 已有 10 种元素色 + 英雄→元素表 | 只用在技能特效，普攻没用上，两套语言并存 |

一句话：**普攻是“导入的 3D 小模型”，技能是“程序化能量特效”，两者不成体系。**

## 方案：三层程序化能量弹体（推荐）

把“弹体”拆成 **核心形态 + 流光拖尾 + 枪口/命中** 三层，全部代码生成、双端同源。

### 第 1 层：核心形态（按英雄武器类型，不按模型）
尺寸 0.3–0.7，unshaded 加色，外层冷光 + 内芯白热（双球叠层），朝速度方向对齐：

| 形态 | 几何 | 英雄举例 | 动画 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 箭矢 | 细长八面体 + 尾羽面片 | 后羿、狄仁杰（令牌可换「符」） | 轻微上下浮动 + 拖尾拉长 |
| 弹丸 | 短胶囊 + 速度拉丝 | 马可波罗 | 高频、极短拖尾 |
| 炮弹 | 球体 + 尖刺环 + 黑烟拖尾 | 孙尚香、鲁班七号、沈梦溪 | 自旋 |
| 法球 | 球 + 环绕细环 | 甄姬（水）、安琪拉（火）、妲己（暗）、王昭君（冰）、东皇太一 | 环自转 + 呼吸脉动 |
| 符/令牌 | 面片 + 程序化符文光 | 狄仁杰 | 翻滚 |
| 扇刃 | 月牙面片 + 残影 | 小乔 | 高速自旋 |
| 水珠 | 椭球 + 涟漪拖尾 | 元流之子 | 水纹扩散 |
| 太阳箭 | 现有后羿R 收编为 shape | 后羿 R | 火焰锥拖尾 |

配色直接用已有 `Vfx.color_for_hero()` / `color2_for_hero()`，**不再有“火焰英雄发蓝色弹”**。

### 第 2 层：流光拖尾
- 把 `Vfx.attach_trail` 从“粒子点串”升级为**双色渐变 ribbon**（现有调用加可选参数，默认行为不变）。
- 长度随速度自适应：速度越快拖尾越细长（0.18–0.35s），马可波罗这类高攻速英雄自动缩短，避免刷屏。
- 命中前 0.1s 拖尾提亮收束（“蓄力到点”的视觉引导）。

### 第 3 层：枪口 + 命中
- **枪口**：0.06s 径向闪光 + 前向锥形，仅本地英雄及 12m 内、quality≥3 时生成（复用现有 `_soft_tex`，不新增贴图）。
- **命中**：保留 `hit_spark`，加一帧**沿速度方向拉长 3–5 倍的 streak**，让“打到了”比现在更硬。
- 出手瞬间弹体 0.7→1.05→1.0 的回弹（80ms），用缩放做“发射感”。

## 技术实现（不改判定、不改协议结构）

1. **新建 `scripts/core/BulletVisual.gd`**（静态工具）：`build(shape:int, c1, c2) -> Node3D`，内部按 `shape + 颜色` 缓存 Mesh 与材质 → 同屏 20 发共享资源，**每发 ≤3 个节点**（现在是整只 GLB 多层子网格）。
2. **`Bullet.gd`**：`source is Hero` 分支改为调 `BulletVisual.build`；删除 ×3 缩放，尺寸写进 shape；`radius`（判定半径）**完全不动**；后羿R 收编。
3. **双端一致**：`NetSession._bullet_vkind()` 现在只返回 0/1（[NetSession.gd](scripts/net/NetSession.gd) 中小乔 W），扩展为 `100 + shape*10 + element`，客户端 `_make_bullet_bespoke()` 调**同一个** `BulletVisual.build`。协议字段仍是原有 int，快照结构不变，插值逻辑（15Hz + 66ms 外推）不受影响。
4. **性能**：复用客户端已有 `_b_pool` 按 vkind 池化；质量档 1=仅核心、2=+拖尾、3=+枪口/点光；拖尾并发继续受 `MAX_TRAILS=24` 约束。预估 draw call **持平或下降**（GLB 多子网格被 2–3 个共享材质网格取代）。

## 分期与验收

| 期 | 内容 | 估时 |
|---|---|---|
| A | BulletVisual + 6 种形态 + host 接入 + 枪口/旋转/命中 | 0.5 天 |
| B | vkind 双端同步 + 客户端池化 + 联机验收 | 0.5 天 |
| C | 元素/英雄调参 + 质量档 + 小兵/塔可选统一 | 0.3 天 |

验收：解析 0 错误；`battle --net-test` 0 错误；战前/团战 `RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS_IN_FRAME` 增幅 ≤8；截图像素统计确认弹体亮度/拖尾长度；联机双方弹体形态一致（截图 + 位置采样）。

## 需要你拍板的 2 件事

1. **视觉语言**：`A 能量流光`（与现有技能特效同源，推荐）还是 `B 实体兵器感`（真箭/真弹，需要给每形态做模型，工作量 +1 天且与法术割裂）。
2. **范围**：只改英雄普攻，还是把**小兵远程/防御塔**也统一进来（塔的能量球其实已经是程序化，一起统一大约多 0.5 天）。

你确认 A + 只改英雄普攻，我就可以按 A 期直接开工。

Static var in GDScript 4.1+ supported (4.7 yes).

`static func vkind_for(bl) -> int`: 
```gdscript
static func vkind_for(bl) -> int:
	if bl == null: return 0
	# 只统一「普攻弹」（skill_id == 0）：技能弹保留各自定制视觉
	if int(bl.skill_id) != 0: return 0
	if bl.is_houyi_ult: return 0
	var spec := spec_for(bl)
	return spec.vkind
```

`spec_for(bl) -> Dictionary`:
```gdscript
static func spec_for(bl) -> Dictionary:
	var src = bl.source
	var shape := SHAPE_ORB
	var palette := PALETTE_ALLY
	if src is Turret: shape = SHAPE_TOWER
	elif src is Minion:
		if src.display_name == "ranged": shape = SHAPE_ARROW
		elif src.display_name == "siege": shape = SHAPE_SIEGE
		else: shape = SHAPE_ORB
	elif src is Hero:
		shape = HERO_SHAPE.get(src.display_name, SHAPE_ORB)
	# palette
	if src is Hero:
		var el := Vfx.element_of(src.display_name)
		palette = maxi(0, ELEMENT_ORDER.find(el))
	else:
		palette = PALETTE_ALLY if int(bl.team) == 0 else PALETTE_ENEMY
	var cols := colors(palette)
	return {"vkind": VKIND_BASE + shape * VKIND_SHAPE_MUL + palette, "shape": shape, "palette": palette, "c1": cols[0], "c2": cols[1],
		"trail_size": ..., "trail_life": ...}

{"file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\scripts\core\BulletVisual.gd","content":"class_name BulletVisual
extends RefCounted
## 普攻弹体统一视觉：三层程序化能量弹（核心 + 光晕 + 拖尾），不依赖 GLB 模型。
## host：Bullet.gd 直接 build()；client：vkind 解码后 build_from_vkind()，两端同一份构建逻辑保证形状一致。
## 只接管「普攻弹」（skill_id == 0）与防御塔/小兵弹道；技能弹仍保留各自的定制视觉。

const SHAPE_ORB := 1        # 法球（默认）
const SHAPE_ARROW := 2      # 箭矢：后羿 / 远程小兵
const SHAPE_PELLET := 3     # 弹丸：马可波罗
const SHAPE_SHELL := 4      # 炮弹：孙尚香 / 沈梦溪 / 攻城兵
const SHAPE_CARD := 5       # 令牌：狄仁杰
const SHAPE_WATER := 6      # 水珠：甄姬
const SHAPE_BLADE := 7      # 刃光：吕布
const SHAPE_TOWER := 8      # 防御塔能量球
const SHAPE_SIEGE := 9      # 攻城炮弹（带外环）

const PALETTE_ALLY := 10
const PALETTE_ENEMY := 11

const VKIND_BASE := 100     # vkind = 100 + shape * 16 + palette（< 1000，不与其他定制档冲突）
const VKIND_SHAPE_MUL := 16

const ELEMENT_ORDER := ["fire", "ice", "water", "lightning", "shadow", "holy", "blade", "wind", "earth", "arcane"]

const HERO_SHAPE := {
	"后羿": SHAPE_ARROW, "狄仁杰": SHAPE_CARD, "马可波罗": SHAPE_PELLET,
	"孙尚香": SHAPE_SHELL, "沈梦溪": SHAPE_SHELL, "甄姬": SHAPE_WATER,
	"东皇太一": SHAPE_ORB, "吕布": SHAPE_BLADE,
}

static var _mat_cache: Dictionary = {}
static var _mesh_cache: Dictionary = {}


## 该弹体是否走统一程序化视觉；返回 vkind（0 = 保持旧视觉）。
static func vkind_for(bl) -> int:
	if bl == null:
		return 0
	if int(bl.skill_id) != 0:          # 技能弹保留各自定制视觉
		return 0
	if bool(bl.is_houyi_ult):
		return 0
	var src = bl.source
	if src == null or not is_instance_valid(src):
		return 0
	if not (src is Hero or src is Minion or src is Turret):
		return 0
	if src is Hero and float(src.attack_range) <= 400.0:
		return 0                        # 近战英雄不出弹
	return int(spec_for(bl).get("vk", 0))


## 由弹体推导视觉规格：形状 / 调色板 / 双色 / 尺寸 / 拖尾参数。
static func spec_for(bl) -> Dictionary:
	var src = bl.source
	var shape := SHAPE_ORB
	var size_mult := 1.0
	if src is Turret:
		shape = SHAPE_TOWER
	elif src is Minion:
		if str(src.display_name) == "ranged":
			shape = SHAPE_ARROW
			size_mult = 0.8
		elif str(src.display_name) == "siege":
			shape = SHAPE_SIEGE
			size_mult = 0.95
	elif src is Hero:
		shape = int(HERO_SHAPE.get(str(src.display_name), SHAPE_ORB))

	var palette := PALETTE_ALLY if int(bl.team) == 0 else PALETTE_ENEMY
	if src is Hero:
		var idx := ELEMENT_ORDER.find(str(Vfx.element_of(str(src.display_name))))
		palette = idx if idx >= 0 else 0

	var cols := colors_for(palette)
	var trail := _trail_params(shape)
	return {
		"vk": VKIND_BASE + shape * VKIND_SHAPE_MUL + palette,
		"shape": shape,
		"palette": palette,
		"c1": cols[0],
		"c2": cols[1],
		"size_mult": size_mult,
		"trail_size": trail[0],
		"trail_life": trail[1],
	}


## 调色板 → [主色, 亮色]。0-9 = 元素，10/11 = 友方/敌方阵营色。
static func colors_for(palette: int) -> Array:
	if palette == PALETTE_ALLY:
		return [Color(0.32, 0.82, 1.0), Color(0.85, 0.98, 1.0)]
	if palette == PALETTE_ENEMY:
		return [Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.24), Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.55)]
	var key: String = ELEMENT_ORDER[clampi(palette, 0, ELEMENT_ORDER.size() - 1)]
	var d: Dictionary = Vfx.ELEMENTS.get(key, Vfx.ELEMENTS["arcane"])
	return [d["c"], d["c2"]]


## 客户端：按 vkind 还原同一形状。
static func build_from_vkind(vk: int) -> Node3D:
	var t := vk - VKIND_BASE
	var shape: int = t / VKIND_SHAPE_MUL
	var palette: int = t % VKIND_SHAPE_MUL
	var cols := colors_for(palette)
	return build(shape, cols[0], cols[1])


## 构建弹体视觉根节点（所有形状沿 +Z 朝向，宿主/客户端都用 rotation.y 追向速度）。
static func build(shape: int, c1: Color, c2: Color, size_mult: float = 1.0) -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "BulletVisual"
	match shape:
		SHAPE_ARROW:
			_add(root, _sphere(), _glow(c1, 0.42), Vector3(0.34, 0.34, 1.0))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.14, 0.14, 0.6))
			_add(root, _quad(), _glow_billboard(c1, 0.5), Vector3(0.56, 0.56, 0.56), Vector3(0.0, 0.0, -0.26))
		SHAPE_PELLET:
			_add(root, _sphere(), _glow(c1, 0.45), Vector3(0.55, 0.55, 0.95))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.2, 0.2, 0.4))
		SHAPE_SHELL:
			_add(root, _sphere(), _glow(c1, 0.3), Vector3(0.9, 0.9, 0.9))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.42, 0.42, 0.5))
			_add(root, _torus(), _glow(c1, 0.55), Vector3(0.85, 0.85, 0.85), Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(PI * 0.5, 0.0, 0.0))
		SHAPE_CARD:
			_add(root, _quad(), _glow_billboard(c1, 0.85), Vector3(0.6, 0.8, 1.0))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.22, 0.22, 0.22))
		SHAPE_WATER:
			_add(root, _sphere(), _glow(c1, 0.32), Vector3(0.7, 0.8, 1.05))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.3, 0.4, 0.6))
		SHAPE_BLADE:
			_add(root, _quad(), _glow_billboard(c1, 0.9), Vector3(1.2, 0.22, 1.0))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.18, 0.18, 0.3))
		SHAPE_TOWER:
			_add(root, _sphere(), _glow(c1, 0.3), Vector3(0.95, 0.95, 0.95))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.44, 0.44, 0.44))
		SHAPE_SIEGE:
			_add(root, _sphere(), _glow(c1, 0.28), Vector3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
			_add(root, _torus(), _glow(c1, 0.4), Vector3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(PI * 0.5, 0.0, 0.0))
		_:  # SHAPE_ORB
			_add(root, _sphere(), _glow(c1, 0.32), Vector3(0.95, 0.95, 0.95))
			_add(root, _sphere(), _core(c2), Vector3(0.34, 0.34, 0.34))
			_add(root, _torus(), _glow(c1, 0.55), Vector3(0.9, 0.9, 0.9), Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(PI * 0.5, 0.0, 0.0))
	root.scale = Vector3.ONE * size_mult
	return root


# ---------- 内部：共享网格 / 材质缓存（同屏多弹体共用资源，控制 draw call） ----------

static func _sphere() -> Mesh:
	if _mesh_cache.has("sphere"):
		return _mesh_cache["sphere"]
	var m := SphereMesh.new()
	m.radius = 0.5
	m.height = 1.0
	m.radial_segments = 12
	m.rings = 6
	_mesh_cache["sphere"] = m
	return m


static func _torus() -> Mesh:
	if _mesh_cache.has("torus"):
		return _mesh_cache["torus"]
	var m := TorusMesh.new()
	m.inner_radius = 0.34
	m.outer_radius = 0.5
	m.rings = 16
	m.ring_segments = 8
	_mesh_cache["torus"] = m
	return m


static func _quad() -> Mesh:
	if _mesh_cache.has("quad"):
		return _mesh_cache["quad"]
	var m := QuadMesh.new()
	m.size = Vector2.ONE
	_mesh_cache["quad"] = m
	return m


static func _glow(c: Color, alpha: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var key := "g%s%.2f" % [c.to_html(), alpha]
	if _mat_cache.has(key):
		return _mat_cache[key]
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	m.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	m.depth_draw_mode = BaseMaterial3D.DEPTH_DRAW_DISABLED
	m.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	m.disable_receive_shadows = true
	m.albedo_color = Color(c.r, c.g, c.b, alpha)
	_mat_cache[key] = m
	return m


static func _glow_billboard(c: Color, alpha: float) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var key := "b%s%.2f" % [c.to_html(), alpha]
	if _mat_cache.has(key):
		return _mat_cache[key]
	var m := _glow(c, alpha).duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
	m.billboard_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	_mat_cache[key] = m
	return m


static func _core(c: Color) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var key := "c" + c.to_html()
	if _mat_cache.has(key):
		return _mat_cache[key]
	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	m.albedo_color = Color(minf(1.0, c.r + 0.15), minf(1.0, c.g + 0.15), minf(1.0, c.b + 0.15), 1.0)
	m.emission_enabled = true
	m.emission = c
	m.emission_energy_multiplier = 0.6
	m.disable_receive_shadows = true
	_mat_cache[key] = m
	return m


static func _add(root: Node3D, mesh: Mesh, mat: Material, scl: Vector3,
		pos: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO, rot: Vector3 = Vector3.ZERO) -> MeshInstance3D:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = mesh
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.scale = scl
	mi.position = pos
	mi.rotation = rot
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	root.add_child(mi)
	return mi


static func _trail_params(shape: int) -> Array:
	match shape:
		SHAPE_ARROW: return [0.16, 0.22]
		SHAPE_PELLET: return [0.13, 0.16]
		SHAPE_SHELL: return [0.26, 0.4]
		SHAPE_CARD: return [0.16, 0.24]
		SHAPE_WATER: return [0.2, 0.3]
		SHAPE_BLADE: return [0.18, 0.26]
		SHAPE_TOWER: return [0.18, 0.26]
		SHAPE_SIEGE: return [0.24, 0.34]
		_: return [0.2, 0.3]
"}

colors_for: 12,14 → ally colors; 13,15 → enemy colors.
_size_for_palette: 12/13 → 0.8; 14/15 → 0.95; else 1.0.

Then `spec_for` for minions assigns accordingly; size_mult from `_size_for_palette(palette)`.

## 新增：[BulletVisual.gd](scripts/core/BulletVisual.gd)
程序化三层弹体，不依赖 GLB：

| 形态 | 使用方 | 构造 |
|---|---|---|
| `ORB` 法球 | 后羿/东皇太一/默认 | 核心亮球 + 加色光晕 + 环绕细环 |
| `ARROW` 箭矢 | 后羿、远程小兵 | 拉长核心 + 细长光晕（小兵 0.8 尺寸） |
| `PELLET` 弹丸 | 马可波罗 | 短胶囊光核 + 速度光锥 |
| `SHELL` 炮弹 | 孙尚香、沈梦溪 | 亮核 + 光晕 + 旋转环 |
| `CARD` 令牌 | 狄仁杰 | 广告牌符文面片 + 亮核 |
| `WATER` 水珠 | 甄姬 | 水滴椭球 |
| `BLADE` 刃光 | 吕布 | 拉长刃面片 + 亮核 |
| `TOWER` 能量球 | 防御塔 | 双层球（替代原 GLB+×3 缩放） |
| `SIEGE` 攻城弹 | 攻城兵 | 大核 + 光晕 + 外环 |

- 配色直接取 `Vfx.element_of()/ELEMENTS` 与阵营色（友方青、敌方橙红），英雄不再共用同一发子弹。
- 网格/材质静态缓存，同屏弹体共享资源，每发 2–3 个 mesh。
- 尺寸、形状、配色编码进 `vkind = 100 + shape*16 + palette`（116–259，不与既有 1000+ 定制档冲突，协议字段本来就是 int，结构零改动）。

## 接入
- [Bullet.gd](scripts/entities/Bullet.gd)：普攻/塔/兵弹走统一构建器；出手 0.7→1.08→1.0 弹跳；英雄弹挂双色元素拖尾 + **枪口闪光**（仅英雄、≤22m、quality≥2）；命中火花改**沿飞行方向**拉出。判定半径、速度、伤害、命中逻辑一行未动；技能弹（小乔扇、后羿R 等）保持原视觉走老分支。
- [VfxFactory.gd](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd)：`attach_trail` 增加可选第二色渐变（不传参行为不变）；新增 `muzzle()`（受预算/距离/画质限制）。
- [NetSession.gd](scripts/net/NetSession.gd) `_bullet_vkind` 优先返回新编码；[NetClientBattle.gd](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd) 收到后调**同一个** `build_from_vkind()`，客户端形状/尺寸/配色与 host 一致。

## 验证
- 解析 0 错误；`battle --net-test` 800 帧 0 错误。
- 实战探针：场上 5 名远程英雄，手动发射真实普攻弹 → `vk=164`（炮弹/火系）、`BulletVisual` 3 个子节点、出生缩放 0.7、拖尾已挂载。
- 长时对局：弹体峰值 11 发、其中 9 发走新视觉，draw call 约 600–660，无报错。
- 形状渲染探针：9 种形态各自呈现不同剪影与颜色（亮像素数/包围盒已逐项采样）；`vkind` 9×16 组合编解码回环全部通过。
- 实机截图：[bullet_unified.png](screenshots/bullet_unified.png)。

## 说明 / 下一步可调
- 未纳入统一视觉的只有：技能弹（各自定制）、野怪弹道、以及客户端拖尾（host 独有，原状）。
- 若觉得某英雄形态不够贴：改 `HERO_SHAPE` 一行即可换形，改 `ELEMENTS` 一处即可换色；另外可给攻击速度高的英雄缩短拖尾、给大招弹加专属 shape，属于调参而非改结构。

程序化三层弹体，不依赖 GLB：

| 形态 | 使用方 | 构造 |
|---|---|---|
| `ORB` 法球 | 后羿/东皇太一/默认 | 核心亮球 + 加色光晕 + 环绕细环 |
| `ARROW` 箭矢 | 后羿、远程小兵 | 拉长核心 + 细长光晕（小兵 0.8 尺寸） |
| `PELLET` 弹丸 | 马可波罗 | 短胶囊光核 + 速度光锥 |
| `SHELL` 炮弹 | 孙尚香、沈梦溪 | 亮核 + 光晕 + 旋转环 |
| `CARD` 令牌 | 狄仁杰 | 广告牌符文面片 + 亮核 |
| `WATER` 水珠 | 甄姬 | 水滴椭球 |
| `BLADE` 刃光 | 吕布 | 拉长刃面片 + 亮核 |
| `TOWER` 能量球 | 防御塔 | 双层球（替代原 GLB+×3 缩放） |

Client views: `node` is the view root; model added as child (`model_ref`), fallback visual also child. Bobbing `model_ref` (or the fallback visual node) is possible if we know it. `_make_view` returns node and uses `model_ref`. We could call `WalkFeel.attach(node, model_ref)` for hero/minion/jungle when model_ref exists; for fallback visuals, skip.

But client views: model_ref might be a Node3D model. Also `UnitVisuals.attach_hero(node, team, node)` uses `node` as model root for rim (collects all meshes recursively) — that's fine, rim stays.

Client bob: node.global_position is set each frame by interpolation (`m.global_position = ...`) — since model is child, bobbing model.position.y works ✓. Good.

Client rotation: `nn.rotation.y = yaw` is set on view root each frame, so bob's lean on model rotation.x/z is additive safe.

Also minion client: `model_ref` available. Jungle: jm added but no model_ref assigned (only local `jm`). Could assign `model_ref = jm`. Minor edit.

Host side:
- Hero: `visual_mesh` = model root child (likely). Add `WalkFeel.attach(self, visual_mesh)` at Hero.gd:851 near attach_hero.
- Minion: `instance` child; add attach after add_child (also collider child!). Need ensure bob only affects model; instance is model only (col added separately).
- JungleMonster: same as minion.
- Turret: no walking; skip.

Footstep FX: implement in WalkFeel driver via `Vfx.footstep(unit, pos)`? Add `Vfx.footstep(pos, size)`:
- gated: quality>=2, near local hero <22m, global budget via GROUP_FX count / _near_limit.
- spawn a small dust burst: `_burst(Color(0.62,0.56,0.46), Color(0.85,0.8,0.7), pos, 3, 0.28, 0.22, 1.6, Vector3.UP, 55.0, 0.6, false)` — dust should rise slowly and expand; but _burst uses spark tex? soft tex for dust fine.
- Also a tiny ground ring? Maybe skip to keep budget.

Also step cadence: strides: minion speed ~350 units? Movement speeds are in units like 350 (scaled?) — actual CharacterBody velocity magnitude maybe 3.5? In this project `move_speed: 350`, likely divided by 100 in movement code? velocity probably ~3.5 units/s. So use velocity magnitude directly; step length ~0.9 units for heroes.

Driver math (frame-rate independent):
```
var spd := horizontal speed (m/s)
var stride := 1.6 (hero), 1.1 (minion)
phase += spd * TAU / stride * delta  # radians per unit distance → cycle per 2 strides?
bob_amp = min(spd/4.0, 1.0) * amp  (amp 0.06 hero / 0.03 minion)
y = base_y + abs(sin(phase)) * bob_amp ... 
```
Better: bob = sin(phase)*amp, footstep when sin crosses zero downward.

Use smoothed speed to avoid jitter; also "weight": slight forward lean 0.06 rad at full speed, and sway roll sin(phase/1)*0.02.

Stop settle: if speed decreasing sharply → squash; skip for simplicity? Add small: when speed < 0.05, ease y back to base (already via amp→0), no squash. Keep simple; avoid over-engineering.

Tuning per unit type: pass opts {stride, bob, sway, dust_size, dust_interval?}. Determine defaults by `unit.body_radius`/speed.

Also ensure WalkFeel driver doesn't animate dead/frozen: check `is_dead`/`stun`? Bob while stunned but stationary → speed 0, fine. Frozen moving? no.

Also don't apply while `unit` is inside tree but invisible? cheap.

Performance: driver `_process` per unit ~ (10 heroes + ~40 minions?) = 50 nodes × per-frame math trivial. Dust budget: minion footsteps ~every 0.5s × 40 minions = 80/s — too many. Gate: only spawn dust if within 25m of local hero AND distance-based culling; plus global `footstep` dedupe: only heroes + nearby units; use per-unit cooldown 0.45s and skip if `Vfx.get_nodes_in_group(GROUP_FX).size() > threshold`. Also `quality>=2`.

Simplify: dust for heroes always (10 max, every ~0.35s while moving = ~29/s peak... still a lot). Hmm: 10 heroes moving constantly → 28 dust bursts/s each 3 particles = ~85 particles/s with 0.28s life → ~25 live systems; MAX_ACTIVE 40 shared with skills → could crowd. Restrict: heroes only get dust if within 18m of local hero (camera-relevant) — that's typically 2-5 units → ~10/s. Minions: only within 12m of local hero and every 0.8s. And `_near_limit(1)` pre-check inside Vfx.footstep with priority low.

Implement `Vfx.footstep(pos, color, size, strength)` gated.

class_name WalkFeel
extends RefCounted

static func attach(unit: Node3D, model_root: Node3D, opts: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	if unit == null or not is_instance_valid(unit):
		return
	if model_root == null or not is_instance_valid(model_root):
		return
	if unit.has_meta("_walkfe_fx"):
		return
	var w := Walker.new()
	w.name = "WalkFeel"
	w.setup(unit, model_root, opts)
	unit.add_child(w)
	unit.set_meta("_walkfe_fx", w)

class Walker extends Node:
	var unit: Node3D
	var model: Node3D
	var base_pos := Vector3.ZERO
	var base_rot := Vector3.ZERO
	var last_pos := Vector3.ZERO
	var spd := 0.0
	var phase := 0.0
	var last_step := 0
	var stride := 1.6
	var bob_amp := 0.05
	var sway_amp := 0.03
	var lean_amp := 0.07
	var dust := true
	var dust_col := Color(0.70, 0.64, 0.54)
	var dust_size := 0.22
	var step_cd := 0.0

	func setup(u: Node3D, m: Node3D, o: Dictionary) -> void:
		unit = u
		model = m
		base_pos = m.position
		base_rot = m.rotation
		last_pos = u.global_position
		stride = float(o.get("stride", 1.6))
		bob_amp = float(o.get("bob", 0.05))
		sway_amp = float(o.get("sway", 0.03))
		lean_amp = float(o.get("lean", 0.07))
		dust = bool(o.get("dust", true))
		dust_col = o.get("dust_color", Color(0.70, 0.64, 0.54))
		dust_size = float(o.get("dust_size", 0.22))

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(unit) or not is_instance_valid(model):
			queue_free()
			return
		if not unit.is_inside_tree():
			return
		var p := unit.global_position
		var moved := Vector2(p.x - last_pos.x, p.z - last_pos.z).length()
		last_pos = p
		var inst := moved / maxf(delta, 0.0001)
		spd = lerpf(spd, minf(inst, 12.0), clampf(delta * 12.0, 0.0, 1.0))
		var f := clampf(spd / 3.6, 0.0, 1.3)
		if spd < 0.25:
			# 站定：平滑归位 + 一次落脚尘
			var k := clampf(delta * 8.0, 0.0, 1.0)
			model.position = model.position.lerp(base_pos, k)
			model.rotation.x = lerpf(model.rotation.x, base_rot.x, k)
			model.rotation.z = lerpf(model.rotation.z, base_rot.z, k)
			if last_step > 0 and dust:
				last_step = 0
			return
		step_cd = maxf(0.0, step_cd - delta)
		phase += spd / stride * TAU * delta
		model.position.y = base_pos.y + sin(phase) * bob_amp * f
		model.rotation.z = base_rot.z + sin(phase * 0.5) * sway_amp * f
		model.rotation.x = base_rot.x + lean_amp * f
		var step := int(phase / PI)
		if step != last_step:
			last_step = step
			if dust and step_cd <= 0.0:
				step_cd = 0.26
				Vfx.footstep(p + Vector3(0, 0.06, 0), dust_col, dust_size, f)

{"content":"class_name WalkFeel
extends RefCounted
## 行走质感：给单位模型加「步频驱动」的上下起伏 + 左右摆 + 前倾，并按步点扬尘。
## 只动模型的局部 position/rotation（视觉层），不改实体位移、碰撞、朝向与战斗逻辑。
## 位移由「上一帧世界坐标差」测算，host（CharacterBody3D）与联机客户端视图节点都适用。
## dust=true 仅在 host 用（客户端不生成粒子，避免双端粒子预算翻倍）。

static func attach(unit: Node3D, model_root: Node3D, opts: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	if unit == null or not is_instance_valid(unit):
		return
	if model_root == null or not is_instance_valid(model_root):
		return
	if unit.has_meta("_walk_feel"):
		return
	var w := Walker.new()
	w.name = "WalkFeel"
	w.setup(unit, model_root, opts)
	unit.add_child(w)
	unit.set_meta("_walk_feel", w)


class Walker extends Node:
	var unit: Node3D
	var model: Node3D
	var base_pos := Vector3.ZERO
	var base_rot := Vector3.ZERO
	var last_pos := Vector3.ZERO
	var spd := 0.0
	var phase := 0.0
	var last_step := 0
	var stride := 1.6
	var bob_amp := 0.05
	var sway_amp := 0.03
	var lean_amp := 0.07
	var dust := true
	var dust_col := Color(0.70, 0.64, 0.54)
	var dust_size := 0.22
	var step_cd := 0.0

	func setup(u: Node3D, m: Node3D, o: Dictionary) -> void:
		unit = u
		model = m
		base_pos = m.position
		base_rot = m.rotation
		last_pos = u.global_position
		stride = float(o.get("stride", 1.6))
		bob_amp = float(o.get("bob", 0.05))
		sway_amp = float(o.get("sway", 0.03))
		lean_amp = float(o.get("lean", 0.07))
		dust = bool(o.get("dust", true))
		dust_col = o.get("dust_color", Color(0.70, 0.64, 0.54))
		dust_size = float(o.get("dust_size", 0.22))

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(unit) or not is_instance_valid(model):
			queue_free()
			return
		if not unit.is_inside_tree():
			return
		var p := unit.global_position
		var moved := Vector2(p.x - last_pos.x, p.z - last_pos.z).length()
		last_pos = p
		var inst := moved / maxf(delta, 0.0001)
		spd = lerpf(spd, minf(inst, 12.0), clampf(delta * 12.0, 0.0, 1.0))
		var f := clampf(spd / 3.6, 0.0, 1.3)

		# 站定：平滑归位（不硬切，避免抖）
		if spd < 0.25:
			var k := clampf(delta * 8.0, 0.0, 1.0)
			model.position = model.position.lerp(base_pos, k)
			model.rotation.x = lerpf(model.rotation.x, base_rot.x, k)
			model.rotation.z = lerpf(model.rotation.z, base_rot.z, k)
			if last_step != 0 and dust:
				last_step = 0
				_step_dust(p, 0.6)   # 停下时补一小蓬尘
			return

		step_cd = maxf(0.0, step_cd - delta)
		# 步频：每步距离 stride → 相位推进；上下起伏 2×步频、左右摆 1×
		phase += spd / maxf(stride, 0.2) * TAU * delta
		if phase > TAU * 64.0:
			phase = fmod(phase, TAU)
		model.position.y = base_pos.y + sin(phase) * bob_amp * f
		model.rotation.z = base_rot.z + sin(phase * 0.5) * sway_amp * f
		model.rotation.x = base_rot.x + lean_amp * f

		# 步点扬尘（半步一次；限频，防小兵海刷爆粒子预算）
		var step := int(phase / PI)
		if step != last_step:
			last_step = step
			if dust and step_cd <= 0.0:
				step_cd = 0.26
				_step_dust(p, f)

	func _step_dust(pos: Vector3, f: float) -> void:
		if not dust:
			return
		Vfx.footstep(pos + Vector3(0.0, 0.06, 0.0), dust_col, dust_size, clampf(f, 0.35, 1.3))

## 脚步/落地扬尘（近距 + quality≥2 才生成；移动端预算友好）
func footstep(pos: Vector3, color: Color = Color(0.70, 0.64, 0.54), size: float = 0.22, strength: float = 1.0) -> void:
	if quality < 2 or _near_limit(1):
		return
	var bm := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") if get_tree() != null else null

`_burst` amount scaled internally.

{"content":"class_name WalkFeel
extends RefCounted
## 行走质感：给单位模型加「步频驱动」的上下起伏 + 左右摆 + 前倾，并按步点扬尘。
## 只动模型的局部 position/rotation（视觉层），不改实体位移、碰撞、朝向与战斗逻辑。
## 位移由「上一帧世界坐标差」测算，host（CharacterBody3D）与联机客户端视图节点都适用。
## dust=true 仅在 host 用（客户端不生成粒子，避免双端粒子预算翻倍）。

static func attach(unit: Node3D, model_root: Node3D, opts: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	if unit == null or not is_instance_valid(unit):
		return
	if model_root == null or not is_instance_valid(model_root):
		return
	if unit.has_meta("_walk_feel"):
		return
	var w := Walker.new()
	w.name = "WalkFeel"
	w.setup(unit, model_root, opts)
	unit.add_child(w)
	unit.set_meta("_walk_feel", w)


class Walker extends Node:
	var unit: Node3D
	var model: Node3D
	var base_pos := Vector3.ZERO
	var base_rot := Vector3.ZERO
	var last_pos := Vector3.ZERO
	var spd := 0.0
	var phase := 0.0
	var last_step := 0
	var stride := 1.6
	var bob_amp := 0.05
	var sway_amp := 0.03
	var lean_amp := 0.07
	var dust := true
	var dust_col := Color(0.70, 0.64, 0.54)
	var dust_size := 0.22
	var step_cd := 0.0

	func setup(u: Node3D, m: Node3D, o: Dictionary) -> void:
		unit = u
		model = m
		base_pos = m.position
		base_rot = m.rotation
		last_pos = u.global_position
		stride = float(o.get("stride", 1.6))
		bob_amp = float(o.get("bob", 0.05))
		sway_amp = float(o.get("sway", 0.03))
		lean_amp = float(o.get("lean", 0.07))
		dust = bool(o.get("dust", true))
		dust_col = o.get("dust_color", Color(0.70, 0.64, 0.54))
		dust_size = float(o.get("dust_size", 0.22))

	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		if not is_instance_valid(unit) or not is_instance_valid(model):
			queue_free()
			return
		if not unit.is_inside_tree():
			return
		var p := unit.global_position
		var moved := Vector2(p.x - last_pos.x, p.z - last_pos.z).length()
		last_pos = p
		var inst := moved / maxf(delta, 0.0001)
		spd = lerpf(spd, minf(inst, 12.0), clampf(delta * 12.0, 0.0, 1.0))
		var f := clampf(spd / 3.6, 0.0, 1.3)

		# 站定：平滑归位（不硬切，避免抖）
		if spd < 0.25:
			var k := clampf(delta * 8.0, 0.0, 1.0)
			model.position = model.position.lerp(base_pos, k)
			model.rotation.x = lerpf(model.rotation.x, base_rot.x, k)
			model.rotation.z = lerpf(model.rotation.z, base_rot.z, k)
			if last_step != 0 and dust:
				last_step = 0
				_step_dust(p, 0.6)   # 停下时补一小蓬尘
			return

		step_cd = maxf(0.0, step_cd - delta)
		# 步频：每步距离 stride → 相位推进；上下起伏 2×步频、左右摆 1×
		phase += spd / maxf(stride, 0.2) * TAU * delta
		if phase > TAU * 64.0:
			phase = fmod(phase, TAU)
		model.position.y = base_pos.y + sin(phase) * bob_amp * f
		model.rotation.z = base_rot.z + sin(phase * 0.5) * sway_amp * f
		model.rotation.x = base_rot.x + lean_amp * f

		# 步点扬尘（半步一次；限频，防小兵海刷爆粒子预算）
		var step := int(phase / PI)
		if step != last_step:
			last_step = step
			if dust and step_cd <= 0.0:
				step_cd = 0.26
				_step_dust(p, f)

	func _step_dust(pos: Vector3, f: float) -> void:
		if not dust:
			return
		Vfx.footstep(pos + Vector3(0.0, 0.06, 0.0), dust_col, dust_size, clampf(f, 0.35, 1.3))

行走质感已完成，英雄/小兵/野怪统一。

## 新增：[WalkFeel.gd](scripts/core/WalkFeel.gd)
一个纯视觉组件（挂 `_process` 的轻量 Walker），核心思路是**用位移驱动步频**，不依赖动画资源、不改实体运动：

- **步频起伏**：按「每步距离 stride」推进相位，模型上下 `sin` 起伏（英雄 0.055、小兵 0.032、野怪 0.05），速度越快幅度越大（上限 1.3×）。
- **左右摆 + 前倾**：1/2 步频的轻微 roll、按当前速度的恒定前倾，走路有“重量”而不是滑冰。
- **步点扬尘**：相位过半步 → 脚下小蓬尘土（近距、限频、独立预算），停下时补一蓬“落脚尘”。
- **站定平滑归位**：速度 < 0.25 时 lerp 回基准位，不会突然回弹。
- **首帧对齐**：客户端视图第一次拿到快照时不会误判位移（避免出生瞬间爆尘）。

## 接入点
- **Host**：`Hero.gd`（英雄，`visual_mesh`）、`Minion.gd`（`instance`）、`JungleMonster.gd`（`instance`）。
- **联机客户端**：`NetClientBattle._make_view()` 对英雄/小兵/野怪模型挂同一套（`dust=false`，粒子只在 host 生成，避免双端翻倍），并给英雄/野怪补了 `model_ref`。
- **同步/判定零改动**：只动模型子节点的局部 `position.y / rotation.x,z`，实体位移、朝向、碰撞、命中、快照插值全部不变。

## 粒子预算
`VfxFactory` 新增 `footstep()`，用**独立预算** `GROUP_STEP`（最多 14 个，不挤占 `MAX_ACTIVE=40` 的技能特效名额），并限制「距本地英雄 ≤18m + quality≥2 + 每单位 0.26s 冷却」。

## 验证
- 解析 0 错误；`battle --net-test` 700 帧、`lobby` 200 帧均 0 脚本错误。
- 实战探针（600+ 帧）：移动英雄模型 y 峰峰值 **0.142**（静止英雄恒为 0）；小兵 20 只全部挂载成功，移动中小兵峰峰值 **0.070**，与参数一致。
- 扬尘：单帧连发 20 次 → `vfx_step` 稳定封顶 **14**；对局中 `maxstep=14` 说明行走扬尘持续在工作且不超预算（技能特效打满 `vfx_fx=40` 时脚步仍能出）。
- 实机截图：[walk_feel.png](screenshots/walk_feel.png)。

## 可继续微调的方向
- 给「停步/落地」加一次轻微下蹲（squash）与更明显的尘环。
- 按地形分尘色（路面灰、草地土黄、河道水花）。
- 脚步声（若 `SfxManager` 有可用采样）：按步频触发，音量随距离衰减。

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier (all done): realistic spell props/animations; single-player vs multiplayer UI consistency/parity; multiplayer panels aligned to host UI; visual-quality optimization plan (P0 batch implemented: PostFX, environment, CJK font, character rim/blob shadow/hit flash).
- Then: “请你给出全局UI优化方案” → 4-layer plan (P0 infrastructure / P1 visual quality / P2 interaction / P3 performance & architecture); “开始实施” + “继续吧” → batches 1, 2, 3 all implemented and reported.
- Current: “我觉得英雄攻击的子弹也需要重新设计，不要直接用子弹模型，请给出你的方案” → delivered design proposal: 3-layer procedural energy bullet (core shape + dual-color trail + muzzle/hit), per-hero shape table, `BulletVisual.gd` shared host/client builder, vkind encoding, 3 phases, asked 2 decisions.
- User then answered: “全部统一进来，开工吧” = choose **A 能量流光 visual language** and **unify everything** (hero ranged basic attacks + ranged/siege minions + turrets), implement now.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable, GDScript, mobile renderer, Android; virtual canvas 2400×1400; ACES+glow; MSAA 4x.
- Canvas layers: PostFX `layer=1`, host `UI_Manager` `layer=2`, hero select 10, client HUD 20–110, touch 100.
- Verification pattern: `& $godot --headless --path . --editor --quit` (only allowed noise: `Class "Minimap" hides a global script class`); windowed `res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 400 -- --net-test`; `res://scenes/lobby.tscn --quit-after 200`; temp probe `.tscn` + `get_viewport().get_texture().get_image().save_png()`; numeric checks with bundled Python (Pillow/numpy). Always pass `--quit-after` else hang.
- Godot binary: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`; workspace `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king`; Python `C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe` (Pillow 12.3.0, numpy 2.3.5).
- No git repo → surgical edits only, no rollback.
- UI batch 1–3 completed: `UiKit` autoload tokens/scale/safe-area/font; 9-slice textures + `ui_theme.tres` + per-Control theme assignment via `node_added` (project `theme/custom_theme` does NOT work at runtime); motion helpers `show_panel/hide_panel/punch/haptic` + global Button press feedback; `Color.GOLD`→`UiKit.C_GOLD` (30 sites), `_apply_label_style` default `UiKit.C_TEXT`.
- Bullet visual mapping: hero ranged iff `attack_range > 400`; basic attack sets `bullet.skill_id = 0` (Hero.gd:2446, :2506); skill bullets keep existing custom visuals.
- Net bullet replication: host snapshot `_bullet_kind(bl)` (0 boulder/1 hero/2 ranged minion/3 siege/4 houyiR/5 tower orb) + `_bullet_vkind(bl)` (0=none, 1=小乔Q fan); client `vis_id = 1000+vkind if vkind>0 else bkind`, pooled in `_b_pool` keyed by kind, `_make_bullet_visual(kind)` / `_make_bullet_bespoke(vkind)`, 15Hz snapshots + `SNAP_BULLET_EXT=0.066` extrapolation, per-frame `m.rotation.y = atan2(vx, vz)` for non-CylinderMesh roots.
- `VfxFactory.gd` (autoload `Vfx`): `ELEMENTS` dict (fire/ice/water/lightning/shadow/holy/blade/wind/earth/arcane with c/c2/light/size/gravity/speed), `HERO_ELEMENT` map, `element_of`, `color_for_hero`, `color2_for_hero`, `team_color`, `_particles` (sets `pm.color_ramp` white→transparent, material `vertex_color_use_as_albedo=true`, add blend), `_burst(color,color2,pos,amount,lifetime,size,speed,dir,spread,gravity,spark)`, `_scaled_amount`, `_near_limit(priority)`, MAX_ACTIVE=40, MAX_TRAILS=24, MAX_LIGHTS=2, PROP_RANGE=30.
- `MeshFactory.gd` (path `scripts/entities/MeshFactory.gd`, class_name MeshFactory): `create_energy_orb`, `create_torus_ring`, `create_sphere`, `create_cylinder`.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/core/BulletVisual.gd` (NEW, in progress): `class_name BulletVisual extends RefCounted`; shape consts `SHAPE_ORB=1, SHAPE_ARROW=2, SHAPE_PELLET=3, SHAPE_SHELL=4, SHAPE_CARD=5, SHAPE_WATER=6, SHAPE_BLADE=7, SHAPE_TOWER=8, SHAPE_SIEGE=9`; palette consts `PALETTE_ALLY=10, PALETTE_ENEMY=11, PALETTE_ALLY_SMALL=12, PALETTE_ENEMY_SMALL=13, PALETTE_ALLY_SIEGE=14, PALETTE_ENEMY_SIEGE=15`; `VKIND_BASE=100`, `VKIND_SHAPE_MUL=16`; `ELEMENT_ORDER` array (10 elements); `HERO_SHAPE` map (后羿 ARROW, 狄仁杰 CARD, 马可波罗 PELLET, 孙尚香 SHELL, 沈梦溪 SHELL, 甄姬 WATER, 东皇太一 ORB, 吕布 BLADE); `static var _mat_cache`, `_mesh_cache`; functions `vkind_for(bl)`, `spec_for(bl)` (returns vk/shape/palette/c1/c2/size_mult/trail_size/trail_life), `colors_for(palette)`, `build_from_vkind(vk)`, `build(shape,c1,c2,size_mult:=1.0)`, `_sphere/_torus/_quad`, `_glow/_glow_billboard/_core`, `_add`, `_trail_params`.
- `scripts/entities/Bullet.gd`: `_ready()` now starts `add_to_group("projectiles")` then `var _vk := BulletVisual.vkind_for(self); if _vk > 0: _build_unified_visual(); return` before legacy GLB/scale/houyi blocks; new `_build_unified_visual()` (build visual, shadow off, `Vfx.attach_trail(self, c1, trail_size, trail_life, 8, c2)` + `Vfx.muzzle(...)` for Hero, spawn tween 0.7→1.08→1.0×size_mult) and `_aim_dir()`; `on_hit()` hit spark now `Vfx.hit_spark(global_position, _fx_col, _aim_dir() if skill_id == 0 else Vector3.UP, 1.0)`.
- `scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd`: `attach_trail(..., color2: Color = Color(0,0,0,0))` adds 3-stop gradient (main→bright 0.6 alpha→transparent) and sets `pm.color = Color.WHITE`; new `muzzle(pos, dir, color, color2)` (quality<2 or `_near_limit(1)` or >22m from battle hero → skip; `_burst(color,color2,pos+d*0.35,4,0.10,0.24,5.0,d,35.0,0.0,false)`).
- Still to edit: `scripts/net/NetSession.gd` `_bullet_vkind()` (prepend `BulletVisual.vkind_for(bl)`), `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd` `_make_bullet_bespoke(vkind)` (branch `vkind >= BulletVisual.VKIND_BASE and vkind < 1000` → `BulletVisual.build_from_vkind(vkind)`).
- UI batch files (done): `scripts/ui/UiKit.gd`, `assets/theme/ui_theme.tres`, `assets/theme/ui_panel.png` + 4 `ui_btn_*.png`, `assets/theme/ui_font.tres`, `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd`, net panels (`NetShopPanel`, `NetRosterPanel`, `NetTargetPanel`, `NetResultPanel`, `NetDeathRecap`, `NetBuffRow`), `screenshots/battle_ui_batch2.png`.

## Errors and Fixes
- Phantom `Parse Error: Identifier "dur" not declared ... Turret.gd:306/307` + `Could not parse global class "Turret"` cascade: caused by ~20 stale/hung Godot processes; fixed by `Stop-Process` all Godot then re-running parse → clean. Always kill leftover Godot probes.
- `Duration`/tween probes showed instant completion under headless due to large first-frame delta; verified motion with windowed run + longer duration (punch 0.80→1.0; global button hook 0.966→1.0).
- Earlier: `MeshFactory.gd` is at `scripts/entities/MeshFactory.gd` (not `scripts/core/`).
- Earlier `_set_node_alpha` ShaderMaterial assignment error fixed with type guards; `has_char("法".unicode_at(0))`; UI theme must be attached per-Control.

## Pending Jobs
- Finish net parity edits in `scripts/net/NetSession.gd` and `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd`.
- Add palette-size handling in `BulletVisual` (`colors_for` for 12/13/14/15; `_size_for_palette`; `spec_for` assign small/siege palettes; `build_from_vkind` use size from palette) so client matches host minion/hero sizes.
- Verify: parse clean, windowed battle `--net-test` 0 errors, lobby 0 errors; deterministic probe rendering all 9 shapes (highlight brightness/silhouette) + vkind roundtrip for palettes 0..15; cleanup temp probes; `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · 普攻弹体统一" -Message "..."`; concise Chinese report.

## Current Work
- Implementing unified procedural bullet visuals. `BulletVisual.gd` created; `Bullet.gd`, `VfxFactory.gd` (attach_trail color2 + muzzle) already edited. Just added `PALETTE_ALLY_SMALL/ENEMY_SMALL/ALLY_SIEGE/ENEMY_SIEGE` consts to `BulletVisual.gd`; corresponding `colors_for`/size logic and `spec_for` palette assignment not yet updated. Net-side vkind encode/decode not yet edited.

## Next Step
- Update `BulletVisual.gd`: `colors_for()` treat 12/14 as ally colors and 13/15 as enemy colors; add `static func _size_for_palette(p)` (12/13→0.8, 14/15→0.95, else 1.0); `spec_for()` assign `PALETTE_*_SMALL` for `ranged` minion and `PALETTE_*_SIEGE` for `siege`, size_mult via `_size_for_palette`; `build_from_vkind()` pass `size` to `build()`.

## Critical Context
