tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.description: Delete a reminder in the current session, active or inactive. Deletion does not retract a reminder message that is already queued.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

Revealing:
- All 5 UI textures are 64×64, ~250 unique colors: simple gradient + border, alpha 218 at edges with **fully transparent corners** (tl = 0,0,0,0) → 9-slice corners are transparent/rounded, likely generated programmatically. They're okay but low-res for large panels (64px 9-slice stretched at 16px margins → upscaling artifacts on 2400-wide panels? 16px margins from 64px texture, fine).
- Big inconsistency: 30 inline StyleBoxFlat across 9 files vs ~21 uses of unified 9-slice. Shop cards/cat buttons/flat actions all custom flat styles. ResultsPanel 6 flats, NetRoster 4.
- Motion: only 6 tweens in UI_Manager, 3 in UiKit (open/close/punch). So most panels/feedback have no motion at all.

So beautification directions: 
1. **Design tokens → 一套皮肤**：把 30 处内联 StyleBoxFlat 收敛到 UiKit 的 `skin_panel/skin_card/skin_chip/skin_button`（带四态 + 品级色），统一圆角/描边/高光/内阴影。
2. **贴图升级**：现有 64×64、5 张（257 色）→ 生成一套程序化 UI 贴图：外层描金边角、内阴影、噪点、斜切高光、玻璃反光、发光外发光（用 Python/Pillow 或 Godot shader 生成，仍无美术资源）。或改用 `StyleBoxFlat`+`shadow`（Godot 支持 shadow_size/color）替代贴图，减小拉伸模糊。
3. **图标体系缺失**：商店分类用单字（刃/杖/盾/鞋…），buff 用 glyph 文本，技能/buff/召唤师/装备全部是纯色块 + 文字。可程序化生成矢量图标（Pillow 绘制 24 类图标或 Godot 自绘 `_draw` 图标集），配合品级描边。
4. **英雄/装备/技能头像**：用 hero_configs 的主色 + 首字生成程序化"纹章"头像（渐变底 + 菱形边框 + 队色），替代空白色块；装备卡用图标 + 品级光效。
5. **动效**：面板只有 fade，无位移/缩放；按钮除 punch 外无 hover/按下变化（移动端 hover 无关，但按下态）；技能就绪/升级/冷却有动画吗？检查 SkillIcon/TouchActionButton。建议 120–200ms 的"面板入场上浮 + 淡入 + 轻微过冲"，tab 切换滑动指示条，金币数字滚动，增/减益图标弹跳。
6. **状态与反馈**：血条分段刻度（每 1000 血）、护盾斜纹、受伤橙段（已有）、低血红脉冲（PostFX 有）；目标详情面板的队色强调条已有；可加：击杀横幅、连杀火焰边框、购买成功金色粒子、技能升级上升光柱。
7. **层级与留白**：上一轮 P0 修了结构，但视觉上仍是"面板叠面板"缺背景压暗/景深。加全局 HUD 暗角 vignette（PostFX 或 CanvasLayer），面板后 0.35 黑遮罩（部分面板已有 dim）。
8. **排版**：所有 HUD 走同一套字号/字重；目前混合 20/22/26/30/32/35/41；中文字体只有一种（ui_font.tres 是什么？检查），可加描边/阴影统一，数字用等宽数字（数字跳动不抖）。
9. **色彩**：配色分散（队色 cyan/red、金色、紫、绿），缺乏每个阵营的完整色阶；建立 C_TEAM0/1 的 3 档明暗（基础/高光/描边）。
10. **棋盘/地图 HUD 元素**：minimap 是程序化绘制，可加边框、扫描线、龙坑图标；塔血条样式统一。

Also check: hero select UI, results panel, lobby visuals — maybe all dark panels with basic text, big opportunity: 大厅/选人/结算 三屏可以用同样的"金色菱形纹章 + 深海军蓝 + 斜切高光"主题。

Check ui_font.tres to know font family & whether bold variant exists; check SkillIcon drawing (graphics level) and TouchActionButton visuals (buttons likely simple circles with text) — 技能按键是圆形色块+文字，这是最该美化的（游戏里最常看）。

- ResultsPanel visual (flats).

Findings rich enough:

- In-battle touch buttons: hand-drawn circles with dark fill `Color(0.1,0.1,0.14,0.75)` + ring + glyphs drawn via arcs — decent but flat/frosted-less; skill buttons have procedural "fx glyph" drawn icons (nice!), CD sector, level ring. So skill buttons are more elaborate than main HUD panels. Inconsistency: HUD panels use 9-slice textures; buttons use hand-drawn circles with different palette (0.1,0.1,0.14 vs navy 14,19,32); hero select UI uses its own constants SEL_* and 20/13px fonts, own card styles.

- Hero select UI: cards with `_sel_card_style`, its own color constants, font sizes 20/13 raw (no ui_scale!) — likely too small on mobile? Font 20 raw at 2400 virtual ≈ 20px, and 13px role label — tiny. This is a beautification + legibility target.

- ResultsPanel: 6 flats; check its style separately maybe.

- Lobby (NetLobby): 3 flats, check what lobby screen looks like: menu with title, buttons; likely minimal.

So the answer: 美化方向 organized as:
A. 一套统一皮肤系统（设计 token）：把 30 处内联 StyleBoxFlat 收敛到 UiKit 的 6 种 skin（panel/card/chip/button/tag/divider），统一圆角(8/12)、描边(1-2px)、内高光、外发光；把触摸按钮的底色从 0.1,0.1,0.14 统一到海军蓝调；把选人/结算/大厅的 SEL_* 常量并入。
B. 程序化贴图/纹理升级：现有 64×64 / 5 张（257 色，纯渐变+透明圆角）。生成更高层级的九宫格：1px 内描边 + 顶部 1px 高光 + 底部 8px 内阴影 + 2% 噪点 + 斜切高光带；按钮 4 态 + 金色"主行动"态；面板增加"描金转角"与"顶部色条"(阵营/品级)。也可直接升级为 StyleBoxFlat + shadow（更锐利、无拉伸），贴图只留给装饰件。给出实现方式（Pillow 生成脚本 or 运行时 Image 生成）。
C. 图标体系：store 分类单字 → 24 个线性图标（Pillow 生成 SVG-ish 路径或 Godot _draw 图标库）；装备 30+ 品级卡图标；buff 行 glyph → 类型图标（攻击/防御/移速/控制/被动）；召唤师技能图标；信号/语音图标。统一 2px 描边 + 单色 + 品级色。
D. 头像/纹章：英雄卡片/队友头像/选人卡使用程序化"纹章"（角色色渐变 + 英雄首字 + 菱形边框 + 队伍色描边）；装备卡/技能键已有 glyph 可作为基础。
E. 动效系统：面板入场（上浮12px+淡入+80ms 过冲）、tab 切换指示条滑动、列表项 stagger 60ms、金币数字滚动、击杀横幅滑入、技能升级光柱、buff 增减弹跳、冷却结束高亮脉冲、按钮按下 0.96 已有可扩展+描边亮起。
F. 层级与氛围：HUD 暗角 vignette、面板后 0.4 遮罩+8px 高斯模糊（Godot 用 BackBufferCopy+shader 或简单 ColorRect）、战斗中低血/死亡红晕已有 PostFX 可加"受伤方向指示"。地图顶部/底部 UI 边界用渐变遮罩防"硬切"。
G. 排版：字体权重（YaHei Bold 作为标题）、数字等宽（数字跳动不抖）、行高与基线统一、金/银/铜标题分层；选人界面字号 20/13 → 24/18 并接 ui_scale。
H. 场景化皮肤：大厅/选人/结算三屏统一"深海军蓝 + 描金描边 + 斜切高光 + 细噪点"；战斗 HUD 更极简（透明度更高、信息更少），形成"大厅华丽 / 对局克制"的对比。
I. 色彩体系：建立 3 档阵营色（base/hi/glow）、品级色 5 档（白绿蓝紫橙）；目前 tier 1-4 已有色，可补 tier0/5 + 发光；避免直接用 Color.PURPLE 等系统色（kill feed 用 Color.PURPLE）。
J. 一致性检查清单/验收：同一皮肤下 30 处内联样式归零、字号档位 6 档全覆盖、动效时长统一 120–200ms、无 64px 以下贴图拉伸、HUD 元素命名统一。

Priorities:
- P0（1天）: 皮肤 token 收敛 + 触摸按钮/面板配色统一 + 选人/结算/大厅配色对齐 + 字号接入 ui_scale（选人 13px 问题）。
- P1（2-3天）: 程序化图标集（分类/装备/buff/召唤师）+ 纹章头像 + 按钮四态/主行动态。
- P2（2-3天）: 动效系统 + 暗角/遮罩 + 数字滚动/横幅 + 低血/冷却反馈。

Also mention specific current measurements as evidence:
- 30 处 StyleBoxFlat vs 21 处统一 9-slice；UI 贴图仅 5 张、64×64、257 色。
- 触摸按钮底色 #1A1A24 vs 面板 #0E1320（两套色系）。
- 选人页 font 20/13 未乘 ui_scale；对局 HUD 字号 19–41。
- 动效：UI_Manager 6 个 tween、UiKit 3 个（仅 fade/punch），选人/结算无入场动画。
- 图标：商店分类用单字"刃/杖/盾"，buff 用 glyph 文本；kill feed 用 Color.PURPLE。

Should I ask which to implement? End with recommendation to start P0-P1.

Maybe capture a couple screenshots of lobby/hero select/results for evidence? Not necessary but helpful. I could capture lobby and hero select screenshots quickly and present them. That adds value (visual reference). But no expensive need. The user asked "看看…还有哪些美化方向" — report is enough; adding 2 screenshots (lobby + hero select) helps them see current state. Let me capture lobby & hero-select screenshots quickly (windowed probes) and present alongside. Multiplayer client HUD too? Keep to 2: lobby + hero select (battle without --net-test at frame ~200 shows hero select). I already have hud_p0.png for battle.

Let me capture lobby.tscn and battle hero-select screenshots (2 runs, background), then write report.

# 结论
Existing UI has a "系统雏形" but three problems: 皮肤不统一（30 处内联 StyleBoxFlat vs 21 处 9-slice；三套重复调色板；触摸键是另一套手绘圆形色）; 图标全缺（单字/文字充当图标）; 动效几乎为零（UI 里总共 9 个 tween，只有 fade/punch）；贴图只有 5 张 64×64 渐变。

## 一、现状（可量化）
- 贴图：5 张 64×64（ui_panel/ui_btn_*）257 色，纯渐变+透明圆角+顶部高光；面板都靠 9-slice 拉伸。
- 皮肤：UiKit 统一套 21 处；内联 StyleBoxFlat 30 处（UI_Manager 10、ResultsPanel 6、NetRoster 4、NetLobby 3…）。→ 两套视觉语言混用。
- 调色板：4 套（UiKit C_*、BattleManager SEL_*、NetLobby COL_*、ResultsPanel BLUE/RED/GOLD），SEL_*与COL_*数值完全重复，ResultsPanel 队色又与 UiKit C_TEAM 不一致。
- 图标：商店分类"刃/杖/盾/鞋"、结算角色"刺/法/射/战"、buff 行 glyph 字符、召唤师/装备/技能多为文字+色块。
- 动效：全局 UI tween 仅 9 处（UI_Manager 6、UiKit 3），只有 fade in/out + 按下 punch；选人/大厅/结算无入场动画。
- 字号：选人页 20/13/26 直接写死未乘 ui_scale；大厅 18/26；对局 HUD 19–41；三屏不同步。
- 字体：SystemFont（微软雅黑 fallback），没有粗体层级。

## 二、美化方向（P0/P1/P2）
P0 统一皮肤（半天）

**验收标准**：`StyleBoxFlat.new()` 只出现在 UiKit（其余文件 0 处）；UI 内无字面量颜色；单字占位图标 0 处；所有面板打开都走 `UiKit.show_panel` 且时长 120–200ms；大厅/选人/对局/结算四屏风格一致。

4. **三屏字号接 token**：选人 13→18、20→24，大厅/结算统一走 `UiKit` 字号档与 `scale()`。

## —— 统一扁平皮肤（P0）——
## 卡片 / 芯片 / 标签 / 按钮 / 提示条一律走这里，避免各文件自建 StyleBoxFlat
## 造成圆角、描边、内高光、选中发光不一致。
func flat(alpha: float = 0.92, radius: int = 12, border: int = 1,
		edge: Color = C_PANEL_EDGE, bg: Color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0),
		pad: float = 10.0, shadow: float = 0.0) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	var base := C_PANEL_BG
	base.a = alpha
	sb.bg_color = base if bg.a <= 0.0 else bg
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(radius)
	sb.set_corner_detail(8)
	sb.set_border_width_all(border)
	sb.border_color = edge
	sb.border_blend = true
	sb.content_margin_left = pad
	sb.content_margin_right = pad
	sb.content_margin_top = pad * 0.6
	sb.content_margin_bottom = pad * 0.6
	if shadow > 0.0:
		sb.shadow_size = int(shadow)
		sb.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
	return sb


## 卡片：品级/角色色描边；选中态加亮 + 同色外发光。
func skin_card(accent: Color, selected: bool = false, alpha: float = 0.92) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var edge := accent if selected else Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.32)
	var sb := flat(alpha, 10, 2 if selected else 1, edge)
	if selected:
		sb.bg_color = sb.bg_color.lightened(0.06)
		sb.shadow_size = 6
		sb.shadow_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.22)
	return sb


## 芯片/小面板：单个控件用的低对比底板。
func skin_chip(accent: Color = C_PANEL_EDGE, alpha: float = 0.9, radius: int = 10) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return flat(alpha, radius, 1, accent)


## 标签/徽章：带淡色底的强调标签。
func skin_tag(accent: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := flat(0.95, 8, 1, accent)
	sb.bg_color = Color(accent.r * 0.22, accent.g * 0.22, accent.b * 0.22, 0.95)
	return sb


## 按钮四态（filled=true 主行动键用实心强调色）。
func skin_button(state: String = "normal", accent: Color = C_GOLD, filled: bool = false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var a := 0.95
	var edge := accent
	match state:
		"hover":
			a = 1.0
		"pressed":
			a = 0.85
		"disabled":
			a = 0.55
			edge = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.18)
	var sb := flat(a, 10, 1, edge)
	if filled and state != "disabled":
		sb.bg_color = Color(accent.r * 0.8, accent.g * 0.8, accent.b * 0.8, a)
	return sb

func skin_notice(accent: Color = C_GOLD) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return flat(0.92, 10, 1, Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.55), Color(0, 0, 0, 0), 10.0, 8.0)

- UiKit.skin_tag(accent)

Now I do UI_Manager 3 helpers, BattleManager select palette/fonts, touch widgets colors.

### UI_Manager helpers rewrite

Current:
```gdscript
# 分类页按钮：暗底 + 细边框；选中时文字转金、加粗下边框
func _cat_button_style(cat: String, selected: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var tint: Color = _shop_cat_style(cat)[1]
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.18, 0.2, 0.26, 0.95) if selected else Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.11, 0.88)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(9)
	sb.set_border_width_all(1)
	sb.border_color = tint if selected else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14)
	if selected:
		sb.border_width_bottom = 4
	sb.content_margin_left = 14; sb.content_margin_right = 14
	return sb

# 装备卡：暗底 + 品级色描边；选中时品级色加亮
func _item_card_style(tier: int, selected: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var tcol := _shop_tier_color(tier)
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.1, 0.12, 0.2, 0.96) if selected else Color(0.04, 0.06, 0.1, 0.9)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.set_border_width_all(1)
	sb.border_color = tcol if selected else Color(tcol.r, tcol.g, tcol.b, 0.35)
	sb.content_margin_left = 8; sb.content_margin_right = 8
	sb.content_margin_top = 6; sb.content_margin_bottom = 6
	return sb

# 常用扁平小按钮（辅助按钮：金底/透明底两种）
func _flat_action_style(filled: bool, accent: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = accent if filled else Color(0.08, 0.1, 0.14, 0.9)
	sb.set_corner_radius_all(8)
	sb.set_border_width_all(1)
	sb.border_color = accent if filled else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.2)
	sb.content_margin_left = 10; sb.content_margin_right = 10
	return sb
```

New:
```gdscript
# 分类页按钮：统一皮肤；选中时用分类色描边 + 底边加粗强调
func _cat_button_style(cat: String, selected: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var tint: Color = _shop_cat_style(cat)[1]
	var sb := UiKit.skin_chip(tint if selected else UiKit.C_PANEL_EDGE, 0.95 if selected else 0.88, 10)
	if selected:
		sb.bg_color = Color(0.16, 0.18, 0.24, 0.96)
		sb.border_width_bottom = 3
	return sb

# 装备卡：统一卡片皮肤 + 品级色
func _item_card_style(tier: int, selected: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := UiKit.skin_card(_shop_tier_color(tier), selected, 0.94)
	sb.content_margin_left = 8; sb.content_margin_right = 8
	sb.content_margin_top = 6; sb.content_margin_bottom = 6
	return sb

# 常用扁平小按钮（辅助按钮：实心强调/描边两态）
func _flat_action_style(filled: bool, accent: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	return UiKit.skin_button("normal", accent, filled) if filled else UiKit.skin_chip(accent, 0.9, 8)
```
Wait `_flat_action_style` non-filled accent border currently white 0.2; skin_chip(accent) uses accent as edge — accent maybe gold; acceptable. content margins differ (10 vs 10*0.6 top). Fine.

Also `_shop_tier_color` could use UiKit.QUALITY_COLORS: tier 1-4 currently custom; map to QUALITY_COLORS[0..3]? QUALITY: white, green, blue, purple, orange, red. Shop tier 1=white,2=blue,3=purple,4=gold/orange. Map: 1->Q[0], 2->Q[2](blue), 3->Q[3](purple), 4->Q[4](orange, but current gold 1.0,0.78,0.2 ≈ Q[4] orange 1.0,0.60,0.20 slightly different). Use QUALITY_COLORS for consistency:
```gdscript
func _shop_tier_color(tier: int) -> Color:
	match tier:
		1: return UiKit.QUALITY_COLORS[0]
		2: return UiKit.QUALITY_COLORS[2]
		3: return UiKit.QUALITY_COLORS[3]
		4: return UiKit.C_GOLD
		_: return Color(0.85,0.85,0.85)
```
Good.

### Touch widget colors

AttackWheelButton.gd:106 `draw_circle(center, radius, Color(0.1, 0.1, 0.14, 0.78))`
TouchActionButton.gd:71 `draw_circle(center, radius, Color(0.1, 0.1, 0.14, 0.75))`
→ `UiKit.C_GLASS`. But careful: mobile widgets may not have UiKit access? Autoload global available ✓. Let me check import style in those files (class_name?). Also check ring colors for world palette.

Also update VirtualJoystick home circle: `Color(1,1,1,0.10)` base + arc 0.30 → make it glass/navy: base `Color(0.08,0.10,0.15,0.22)` + arc `UiKit.C_GLASS_HI`? - `const SEL_*` → vars from UiKit.
- fonts: 20→FS_LG×scale? Select UI builds at `_show_hero_select_ui` before viewport? Use helper `int(round(UiKit.FS_LG * UiKit.scale()))`.
- read the constants block and font override lines to edit.

Let me read BattleManager 2075-2135, and select UI font lines (2230-2410 area) — many. Instead of editing each, I could add a helper `_sel_font(base:int)->int` and replace `font_size", 20` occurrences with helper call. Simpler: replace raw numbers:

Since select UI does NOT use ui_scale, and 2400-wide virtual design, raw 24/18 consistent with HUD effective (HUD uses 19-41 effective). So just raise numbers: 20→24, 13→18. Fine (matches plan "选人 13→18、20→24").

```gdscript
	var tint: Color = _shop_cat_style(cat)[1]
	var sb := UiKit.skin_chip(tint if selected else UiKit.C_PANEL_EDGE, 0.95 if selected else 0.88, 10)

		sb.border_width_bottom = 3
	return sb

# 装备卡：统一卡片皮肤 + 品级色
func _item_card_style(tier: int, selected: bool) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var sb := UiKit.skin_card(_shop_tier_color(tier), selected, 0.94)
	sb.content_margin_left = 8; sb.content_margin_right = 8
	sb.content_margin_top = 6; sb.content_margin_bottom = 6
	return sb

func _flat_action_style(filled: bool, accent: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
```

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier completed (background): realistic spell props/animations; single-player vs multiplayer UI parity; multiplayer panels aligned to host UI; visual-quality P0 batch (PostFX, environment, CJK font, rim/blob shadow/hit flash); global UI optimization plan (P0 infra / P1 visual / P2 interaction / P3 performance) batches 1–3; unified procedural basic-attack bullets (`BulletVisual.gd`, vkind encoding); walk-feel polish (`WalkFeel.gd`); all 21 heroes' skill projectiles unified into procedural high-fidelity shapes (FAN/FLAME/SPEAR added).
- Request before last: **“分析对局UI，并给出优化方向”** → delivered an in-battle HUD analysis with measured geometry (two HUD instances, attribute panel covering joystick, font sizes too small, top-band text overlaps) plus a P0/P1/P2 optimization roadmap. User replied **“开始优化吧”**.
- P0 batch implemented and verified and reported: HUD singleton, attribute panel out of joystick zone, top-band reflow + 3-slot kill feed, font scale raise.
- **Current request: “你看看已有的UI还有哪些美化方向”** — inspect the existing UI (buttons/panels, HUD, icons/chat, typography, color language, motion states) and propose further visual-polish directions. No code change requested yet; this is an analysis + direction request like the previous one.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable, GDScript, mobile renderer, Android; virtual canvas 2400×1400, `window/stretch/mode="canvas_items"`, `aspect="expand"`; `theme/custom_font="res://assets/theme/ui_font.tres"`.
- Autoloads (project.godot): `Config, UiKit, ItemDatabase, SkillDatabase, GameManager, UiManager, CollisionSystem, PathFinder, TouchController, NetSession, SfxManager, Vfx, PostFX`.
- Canvas layers: PostFX 1, `UiManager` 2, hero select 10, client HUD 20–110, `TouchController` 100.
- Scenes: `scenes/battle.tscn` (BattleManager + `UI` CanvasLayer with `scripts/ui/HUD.gd`), `scenes/lobby.tscn`, `scenes/net_client.tscn` (NetClientBattle).
- 4-layer in-battle HUD: touch layer (`TouchController`: joystick 600²@(30,800), attack 350²@(1930,990), skills 260²@(1449,843)/(1654,576)/(1975,475), upgrade 120²×2, tower/minion 165²@(1940,820)/(2115,820), summoner/recall/item 220²@y1130, WASD toggle 330×46@(470,1204)); info layer (`UI_Manager`: band 480×182@(1060,8), gold chip 230×48@(2115,12), recommended 575×90@(1660,200)+"+"90², ally frames 130×150×5@(350,40), attribute panel 589×44.5 collapsed (bottom 788), target detail 330×170@(40,370), buff row, recall ring 100², kill feed 460×46×3@y200+); world layer (`HUD.gd`: `HeroInfoControl`, `HealthBarControl`, `fp_player_bar` 200×90@(vw/2-100, vh-446)); minimap `Minimap` 300²@(40,40) with tower-under-attack ping.
- UiKit tokens: `DESIGN_W=2400`, `SCALE_EXTRA=1.35`, `scale()=max(1,vp.x/2400)*1.35`; colors (`C_TEXT, C_TEXT_DIM, C_GOLD, C_EXP, C_DANGER, C_HEAL, C_ARMOR, C_AP, C_TEAM0/1, C_PANEL_BG/EDGE/HEADER, QUALITY_COLORS`); fonts now `FS_XS=16, FS_SM=18, FS_MD=20, FS_LG=24, FS_XL=28, FS_HUGE=34` (still only declared in UiKit.gd, not consumed elsewhere); spacing `SP_XS=4, SP_SM=8, SP_MD=12, SP_LG=18`; 9-slice `ui_panel.png`, `ui_btn_{normal,hover,pressed,disabled}.png`; helpers `show_panel/hide_panel/punch/haptic`, `safe_insets()/safe_top()/safe_bottom()/safe_left()/safe_right()/apply_safe_top()/apply_safe_bottom()`.
- `_apply_label_style(label, base_size, color)` multiplies base by `ui_scale()`; effective sizes ≈ base×1.35 at 2400 width.
- Verification pattern: `& $godot --headless --path . --editor --quit` (only benign noise: `Class "Minimap" hides a global script class`, cert-store/log-file errors are environment noise); windowed `res://scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 400 -- --net-test`; `res://scenes/lobby.tscn --quit-after 200`; temp probe `.tscn`+`.gd` printing geometry via `get_global_rect()`; always pass `--quit-after`; kill stale Godot processes (`Stop-Process`) before parsing.
- Godot binary: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`; workspace `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king`; Python `C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe` (Pillow/numpy).
- No git repo → surgical edits only; `read` tool must be used on a range before `edit` (PowerShell reads do NOT satisfy the read-before-edit policy).
- Model cannot view images → verify via geometry probes and numeric dumps, not screenshots.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` (~3550 lines) — host/client HUD:
  - `_ready()` now ends with `visible = false`; added `enter_battle()/exit_battle()/_clear_battle_hud()` right after `_ready`; `enter_battle` calls `_clear_battle_hud()` + `_layout_attribute_panel()`.
  - Kill feed rewritten: consts `KF_MAX=3, KF_W=460.0, KF_H=46.0, KF_GAP=10.0, KF_TOP=200.0`, `var kill_feed_slots: Array = []`; `show_kill_feed()` shows immediately, evicts oldest beyond 3, tween 3.2s+fade0.45; `_layout_kill_feed()` sets `p.offset_left=-KF_W*0.5*rs`, `p.offset_right=KF_W*0.5*rs`, `p.offset_top=KF_TOP + i*(KF_H+KF_GAP)*rs`, `p.offset_bottom=p.offset_top+KF_H*rs`; `_create_kill_feed_panel()` uses `PRESET_CENTER_TOP`, `MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE`, centered `HBoxContainer`, labels fs 18. Removed `kill_feed_queue/current_kill_feed_panel/_process_next_kill_feed`.
  - Info labels: `game_time` base 30→32; gold chip height 48 (`offset_bottom=60`), gold label 16→19; recommended label `rec_left=-740, rec_right=-165, top=200, bottom=290`, fs 26→22; `buy_plus_btn` `offset_left=-150, offset_right=-55, top=200, bottom=290`.
  - Attribute panel: `var attr_collapsed := true`; `_create_attribute_panel()` uses `legend_h=26*rs, row_h=28*rs, head_h=30*rs`, positions panel at `Vector2(30, vp_h-612-head_h)`, header text `"属性  ▸"`, header fs 14→16, legend 12→13, rows 13→15, ends with `_layout_attribute_panel()`; new `_layout_attribute_panel()` (height = collapsed `attr_header_h+4` or `attr_panel_h_full`; `position.y = vp_h - 612 - h`; toggles legend/rows visibility, header glyph) + simplified `toggle_attribute_panel()`.
  - Target-detail gate: `if attr_collapsed and target and is_instance_valid(target) and target.health > 0:` (attribute expansion hides target panel).
  - Recall label font 14→18.
  - Unchanged rich HUD panels: shop (`_open_shop`, `_refresh_shop_grid`, `_update_shop_detail`), hero detail (C), team decision, death recap, buff icons (`collect_buff_rows`, `_update_buff_icons`, row y 980), yuanliu pick/switch, `SkillIcon`, `RespawnWidget`, `DamageChart`, damage/gold/heal popups, `_get_stagger_offset`.
  - `update(battle)` still rebuilds `team_stats_label` BBCode every frame + `_update_buff_icons` + `_update_attribute_panel` (P2 perf item, not yet done).
- `scripts/ui/UiKit.gd` — font tokens raised (see above); `scale()`, `safe_insets()` etc. (unused FS_* constants).
- `scripts/core/BattleManager.gd` — `_ready` line ~185: `ui = UiManager as UI_Manager; if ui != null: ui.enter_battle() else: ui = UI_Manager.new(); add_child(ui)`; `_exit_tree()` now also `if is_instance_valid(UiManager): UiManager.exit_battle()`.
- `scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd` — `_ready()` first lines: `if is_instance_valid(UiManager): UiManager.exit_battle()` before headless guard.
- `scripts/mobile/TouchController.gd` — `_build_ui()`: joystick anchors bottom-left (`joy_home=(330,300)`, side 600), `_anchor_br(ctrl, from_br, size, inset=TOUCH_CLUSTER_INSET)` bottom-right helper (no safe-area), `_anchor_tl`; buttons: AttackWheelButton "普攻", tower/minion 165², skills 260², upgrade, summoner/recall 220², item actives, MoveModeToggle; `_ui_mgr = get_node("/root/UiManager")`; uses `_ui_mgr._get_active_equip_list/_trigger_active_equip/ui_scale`; no HP/MP bar, no ping, no quick chat, no safe-bottom.
- `scripts/ui/HUD.gd` — world bars `_update_health_bars()`, `hero_info_controls`, `fp_player_bar` own HP bar (`size 200×90`, `position (vw.x/2-100, vw.y-446)`), draws hp+shield only (no mana anywhere on HUD).
- `scripts/ui/Minimap.gd` — tower warning pings only (`PING_COOLDOWN=10, PING_DURATION=1.35, PING_CYCLES=3`), no manual ping wheel.
- `scripts/ui/ResultsPanel.gd` (47 KB), `HealthBarControl.gd`, `HeroInfoControl.gd` (hp/shield + dark-mark preview, no mana).
- Client panels: `NetShopPanel, NetRosterPanel, NetTargetPanel, NetResultPanel, NetDeathRecap, NetBuffRow, NetKillFeed, NetMiniMap, NetRecall, NetRecommendBar, NetTouchPad, NetYuanliuSwitch`.
- Screenshots kept: `screenshots/hud_audit.png` (pre-change), `screenshots/hud_p0.png` (post-change in-battle, 3.55 MB), earlier `bullet_unified.png`, `walk_feel.png`, `skill_bullets.png`, `skill_fan_battle.png`.

## Errors and Fixes
- `edit` tool "file changed since it was read": PowerShell reads don't satisfy policy → must `read` the exact range first.
- Duplicate `p.offset_top` line accidentally inserted during kill-feed fix → removed immediately.
- Kill-feed first version multiplied `KF_TOP` by `rs` (y=270, misaligned with raw-pixel band) → changed to `KF_TOP + i*(KF_H+KF_GAP)*rs` (y=200).
- Probe attribute-panel detection initially matched wrong Panel (team-decision 520×1280) → re-probed by finding child Label whose text starts with `"属性"`.
- Template: no tests; only syntax/load checks plus targeted runtime probes; `--quit-after` mandatory else hang.
- Noise to ignore: `Class "Minimap" hides a global script class`, `Failed to open 'user://logs/...'`, `Failed to read the root certificate store`, editor-settings save error.

## Pending Jobs
- Answer current request: list remaining visual-polish directions for existing UI (likely P1 visual batch: unified 9-slice glass panels, hover/press/disabled states, icon set instead of text glyphs, cooldown/mana-state color language, chip/badge hierarchy, minimap frame & ping visuals, kill-feed/banner styling, typography rhythm, motion: panel slide/punch, damage-number style, victory/defeat panels, lobby/menu polish).
- Not yet started from earlier roadmap: P1 (objective countdown bar, own HP/MP dual bar, signal ping, Tab scoreboard, 4-side safe area for `_anchor_br`/bottom row), P2 (HUD refresh throttling 10 Hz + dirty flags, HUD token centralization `UiKit.HUD_TOKENS`, multi-aspect regression, button state colors).

## Current Work
- P0 batch finished, verified, cleaned up (all `_probe_*` and temp dumps deleted), notified via `scripts\dev\notify.ps1` ("HonorKing · 对局UI P0优化"), summary delivered with file anchors and measured numbers.
- No inspection of UI styling/visual layer started yet for the newest request.

- Run a read-only audit of UI visual styling: `scripts/ui/UiKit.gd` (`_apply_panel_style`, `_apply_button_style`, `show_panel/punch`), `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` style funcs (`_shop_cat_style`, `_item_card_style`, `_flat_action_style`, `_apply_button_style`), `ResultsPanel.gd`, lobby `scenes/lobby.tscn`, client `NetShopPanel/NetTouchPad` styling — then produce a prioritized “美化方向” list (concrete widget-by-widget polish + style tokens/motion), with file anchors and no code changes yet.

## Critical Context
- User communicates in Chinese; deliverables concise, conclusion-first, with file anchors and verification numbers; always send Windows notification after delivery: `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`.
- Prior measured findings (pre-change) useful context: HUD 53 blocks, rect coverage 43.8% (top 55.9%/lower 54.3%), font sizes 19/22/32/35/41, joystick↔attribute overlap 126,549 px², recommend↔band overlap 110×84, two `UI_Manager` instances, 30 HUD controls visible in lobby.
- Post-P0 verification numbers: `ui_manager_instances=1`; lobby `lobby_ui_visible=false hud_controls_visible=0`; attribute collapsed (30,743.5,588.6×44.5) / expanded (30,339.8,588.6×448.2), joystick overlap 0; recommended (1660,200,575×90); kill feeds (889.5,200)/(889.5,275.6)/(889.5,351.2) size 621×62.1, `feed_count=3`; battle 400 frames & lobby 200 frames with zero `SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent`.
- Design constraints: mobile-first, virtual 2400×1400, 9-slice textures with no art assets (procedural meshes/badges OK), CJK font `ui_font.tres`, theme applied per-Control via `node_added` (project `theme/custom_theme` does not work at runtime).
- Known visual gaps to exploit for “美化方向”: no man bar anywhere; skill/tower/minion buttons use text labels not icons; `_apply_button_style` likely flat StyleBoxFlat only; buff icons drawn from `BuffIcon` (CELL 132×136, R52); damage numbers flat labels; no panel open/close animation besides `UiKit.show_panel/punch`; minimap has plain frame; kill feed uses simple 9-slice panel; lobby menu is plain `VBoxContainer` with buttons `560×76`.

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

- 选人：13→18、16→18、18→20、19→20、20→24、24→26、26→28；大厅/结算走 `FS_*×scale()`。

### UiKit button upgrade
Current skin_button uses flat(). Upgrade:
```gdscript
func skin_button(state := "normal", accent := C_GOLD, filled := false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var a := 0.95
	var edge := accent
	var bg := Color(0,0,0,0)
	var shadow := 8.0
	var lift := 0.0
	match state:
		"hover":
			a = 1.0
			lift = 0.06
			shadow = 14.0
		"pressed":
			a = 0.9
			lift = -0.05
			shadow = 2.0
		"disabled":
			a = 0.55
			edge = Color(1,1,1,0.18)
	var sb := flat(a, 10, 1, edge, bg, 10.0, shadow)
	if filled and state != "disabled":
		sb.bg_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, a).lightened(lift)
		sb.border_color = accent.lightened(0.35)
	elif state != "disabled":
		sb.bg_color = C_PANEL_BG.lightened(lift)
		sb.bg_color.a = a
	# 顶部高光 / 底部压暗，做出厚度
	sb.border_width_top = 2 if state != "pressed" else 1
	sb.border_color = sb.border_color
	if state == "hover":
		sb.shadow_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.25)
	return sb
```
Hmm border width top 2 with edge same color doesn't produce highlight (need lighter top). StyleBoxFlat single border color. Could use `border_blend`. Simpler: keep 1px; depth via shadow. Add `sb.shadow_offset = Vector2(0, 3)`.

Also global press feedback. In `_on_node_added(node)`:
```gdscript
	if node is BaseButton:
		var b := node as BaseButton
		if not b.button_down.is_connected(_on_btn_down.bind(b)):
			...
```
Careful with Callable binds. Simpler: connect to `gui_input`? Many buttons use touch; use `button_down`/`button_up` (available on BaseButton) ✓. Implement:
```gdscript
func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
	... existing theme apply ...
	if node is BaseButton:
		var btn := node as BaseButton
		btn.button_down.connect(_press_fx.bind(btn, true))
		btn.button_up.connect(_press_fx.bind(btn, false))

func _press_fx(btn: BaseButton, down: bool) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(btn): return
	btn.pivot_offset = btn.size * 0.5
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(btn, "scale", Vector2.ONE * (0.97 if down else 1.0), 0.07).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
```
Note buttons inside containers with scale might look fine.

### UiBackdrop.gd
New file `scripts/ui/UiBackdrop.gd`:
```gdscript
class_name UiBackdrop extends Control
## 全屏程序化背景：纵向渐变 + 中心辉光 + 斜向网格 + 缓慢漂浮粒子 + 暗角。
var accent := Color(0.25, 0.60, 1.0)
var particle_count := 42
var _t := 0.0
var _p := []  # each: Vector3(x, y, speed) normalized
func _ready():
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	randomize()
	for i in particle_count: _p.append(Vector3(randf(), randf(), randf_range(0.1, 0.5)))
	set_process(true)
func _process(dt): _t += dt; queue_redraw()
func _draw():
	var s := size
	# 1) 纵向渐变（分成 24 条）
	for i in 24:
		var t := float(i)/23
		var c := Color(0.024,0.033,0.055).lerp(Color(0.055,0.075,0.11), t)
		draw_rect(Rect2(0, s.y*t, s.x, s.y/23.0+1), c)
	# 2) 中心辉光：同心圆叠加
	var ctr := Vector2(s.x*0.5, s.y*0.42)
	for i in 18:
		var k := 1.0 - float(i)/18
		draw_circle(ctr, s.x*(0.16+0.60*float(i)/18), Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.012*k*... ))
```
Radial gradient via concentric circles with additive alpha: use `draw_circle(..., Color(...,0.008))` each ring produces banding but subtle. Better: draw ~40 circles with tiny alpha 0.006; cumulative gives smooth glow.


Current skin_button uses flat(). Upgrade:
```gdscript
func skin_button(state := "normal", accent := C_GOLD, filled := false) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var a := 0.95
	var edge := accent
	var bg := Color(0,0,0,0)
	var shadow := 8.0
	var lift := 0.0
	match state:
		"hover":
			a = 1.0
			lift = 0.06
			shadow = 14.0
		"pressed":
			a = 0.9
			lift = -0.05
			shadow = 2.0
		"disabled":
			a = 0.55
			edge = Color(1,1,1,0.18)
	var sb := flat(a, 10, 1, edge, bg, 10.0, shadow)
	if filled and state != "disabled":
		sb.bg_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, a).lightened(lift)
		sb.border_color = accent.lightened(0.35)
	elif state != "disabled":
		sb.bg_color = C_PANEL_BG.lightened(lift)
		sb.bg_color.a = a
	# 顶部高光 / 底部压暗，做出厚度
	sb.border_width_top = 2 if state != "pressed" else 1
	sb.border_color = sb.border_color
	if state == "hover":
		sb.shadow_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.25)
	return sb
```

```gdscript
func make_backdrop(parent: Control, accent: Color = C_TEAM0, glow: float = 1.0) -> Control:
	if parent == null:
		return null
	var bd: Control = BACKDROP_SCRIPT.new()
	bd.accent = accent
	bd.glow_strength = glow
	parent.add_child(bd)
	bd.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

	return bd
```

{"description":"目标（全屏 + 质感 + 背景 三原则）：把 scripts/net/NetLobby.gd 的大厅菜单页、房间页、联机选人页改成"铺满屏幕"版式，并接入统一背景与按钮质感。

现状：_build_base() 用 CenterContainer + VBoxContainer(560 宽按钮、居中)，三个页面都挤在中间一小块，四周大片空白。屏幕虚拟尺寸 2400×1400，缩放系数 UiKit.scale()（2400 宽时 1.35）。

必须遵守：
1) 只改 scripts/net/NetLobby.gd；不要动 UiKit.gd / BattleManager.gd / UI_Manager.gd / ResultsPanel.gd / NetResultPanel.gd。
2) 背景：在 _build_base() 里加 UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)（会铺满并置于底层），保留原全屏不透明底 ColorRect（可改成仅在本体使用）——注意背景要盖住默认 clear color。
3) 菜单页 _show_menu()：改为两栏铺满布局（用 anchor/offset 或 HBoxContainer + expand）：
   - 左栏（约 42% 宽）：品牌区——大标题"荣耀王者"（96px 级别，_fs(UiKit.FS_HUGE)*2 之类尽量大但同时用 _fs 档位表达）、副标题、下面留白、底部放版本/状态行；
   - 右栏（剩余宽度）：菜单按钮列，按钮尺寸 640×96、字体 _fs(FS_XL)、间距 20，垂直居中；
   - 左右内边距 64，上下 40；菜单按钮使用 UiKit.skin_button(state, accent, filled) 生成 normal/hover/pressed 三态（单机键用金色 filled，联机键用青色描边、退出/返回用危险色描边）。
4) 房间页 _show_room() 与选人页 _show_select()：同样铺满；房间页左侧座位列表占 65% 宽（行高更大、字号 _fs(FS_MD/FS_LG)），右侧状态/开始按钮列；选人页左英雄列表 760 宽、中间英雄预览、右召唤师技能列，底部确认按钮 680×92。

6) 需要时给页面块加 UiKit.skin_chip()/skin_card() 底板（半透明），不要出现纯亮底。
7) 验证：无头解析 `& 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit`（除既有 Minimap 告警外无 SCRIPT ERROR）；windowed `res://scenes/lobby.tscn --quit-after 200` 无 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent。报告里给出大厅菜单和房间页关键控件的实测几何（用临时探针脚本可，但完成后必须删除探针文件）。","subject":"大厅/房间/联机选人页全屏化 + 背景 + 按钮质感（NetLobby.gd）","write_scopes":["scripts/net/NetLobby.gd"]}

block.text:
Good. Now create tasks & spawn 3 teammates:

Task 1: NetLobby.gd fullscreen (menu/room/select) + backdrop + button quality.
Task 2: BattleManager.gd single-player select fullscreen + backdrop.
Task 3: ResultsPanel.gd + NetResultPanel.gd fullscreen + backdrop + buttons.

Then my own: UI_Manager shop/hero detail backgrounds + widen; plus lobby? no.

Write detailed prompts with design guidance & shared constants. Keep consistent style:

Design spec for full-screen:
- Root is a Control filling viewport (2400×1400 virtual). Add `UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)` behind content. Vec: gradient navy + glow + particles.
- Margins: 48 horizontal, 32 vertical; content fills.
- Lobby: two-column: left brand block (title 88-96px "荣耀王者", subtitle, version/status at bottom), right menu column (buttons 620×96, separation 20, right-aligned area), bottom status bar.
- Room page: full-screen left seats list (wide rows), right chat/status/start buttons.
- Select page: fullscreen: left roster scroll (760 wide, big cards 220×92?), center hero preview (hero name giant 72, role, skills list, stats), right summoner grid (cards 300×120) + bottom confirm bar (button 680×92) + countdown.
- Buttons: use UiKit.skin_button("normal"/"hover"/"pressed", accent, filled) for all button styleboxes; font via UiKit FS tokens × scale (already _fs). Add min size bigger. Keep functionality identical.

Teammates must not touch UiKit.gd/UI_Manager.gd/BattleManager (only their file). BattleManager teammate handles its select function only.

For ResultsPanel: already full-screen; ensure content fills width (main_vbox margins 40 → 32? cards expand), add backdrop, upgrade the 2 top buttons with skin_button filled gold/neutral, tab buttons skins with selected state; NetResultPanel mirrors host (fullscreen, backdrop, button styles), find file.

Let me check NetResultPanel size quickly to inform prompt... skip; teammate can read.

Create tasks then spawn with context fresh. Provide exact API and verification steps. Also instruct: no new files except allowed? UiBackdrop already exists; they can preload it via UiKit.make_backdrop.

Spawn all three in one message (parallel), then do my UI_Manager work while they run.

Task creation for board: 3 tasks with write scopes. Then spawn with prompt referencing task id. To save tokens, create tasks with concise descriptions? Instructions say complete details; but prompts contain detail. I'll put main spec in task description and shorter prompt referencing it (teammate reads task). Fine.

4) 房间页 _show_room() 与选人页 _show_select()：同样铺满；房间页左侧座位列表占 65% 宽（行高更大、字号 _fs(FS_MD/FS_LG)），右侧状态/开始按钮列；选人页左英雄列表 760 宽、中间英雄预览、右召唤师技能列，底部确认按钮 680×92。

task.description:
目标（全屏 + 质感 + 背景 三原则）：把单机选人界面 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd 的 _show_hero_select_ui() 改为铺满 2400×1400 的三栏版式并接入统一背景与按钮质感。

现状：CenterContainer + ScrollContainer(custom_minimum_size 900~1440 × 480~980) + VBox，内容挤在中间；英雄卡/召唤师卡是 8px 小字块，确认按钮 560×76。

必须遵守：
1) 只改 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd 里的选人 UI 相关函数（_show_hero_select_ui / _sel_label / _sel_btn / _sel_btn_style / _sel_card_style / _style_card / _sel_* 辅助）；不要动 UiKit.gd / NetLobby.gd / UI_Manager.gd。
2) 背景：在选人 CanvasLayer 的根 Control 上调用 UiKit.make_backdrop(root, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)，置于内容之下；保留原 SEL_BG 作为兜底底色（可改为不透明 ColorRect 置底）。
3) 版式铺满（左右边距 48、上下 32）：
   - 左栏 760 宽：按职责分组的英雄卡列表（可滚动），每张卡 220×88 级别、名称 _fs(FS_MD/LG)、职责小字 _fs(FS_SM)，选中态用 UiKit.skin_card(role_color, true)；

   - 所有现有回调与字段（select_ui / select_summary_label / select_summ_detail / 选人状态）保持不变，_on_* 逻辑不动。
4) 按钮质感：所有按钮 normal/hover/pressed 都用 UiKit.skin_button(state, accent, filled) 生成，不要再用裸 StyleBoxFlat 或 1px 白边；卡片用 UiKit.skin_card。
5) 字号统一走已有 _sel_label/档位（如需可新增 _sel_fs()）。布局用容器 expand 撑满，不留大片空白；确保 2400×1400 下内容占满且不溢出（可滚动区域允许滚动）。
6) 验证：无头解析无新增 SCRIPT ERROR（仅既有 Minimap 告警）；windowed `res://scenes/battle.tscn` 截选人页并实测：日志无 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent。用临时探针脚本可，完成后必须删除探针文件（不要留 _probe_*）。
7) 报告：给出选人页三栏与确认按钮的实测 rect（用 get_global_rect() 打印），并说明哪些旧控件被替换。

task.subject: 结算页全屏化 + 背景 + 按钮质感（ResultsPanel.gd / NetResultPanel.gd）
task.description:
目标（全屏 + 质感 + 背景 三原则）：把结算页 scripts/ui/ResultsPanel.gd（单机 host）和 scripts/net/NetResultPanel.gd（联机客户端）改为铺满屏幕、加程序化背景、按钮统一质感。

现状：ResultsPanel 已有 main_vbox 全屏锚点 + 40/24 边距，但内容（尤其英雄卡 740 宽、概览列）没有真正铺满，顶部只有 2 个按钮、背景是纯色半透明；NetResultPanel 是客户端自绘，尺寸/版式与 host 不完全一致。

必须遵守：
1) 只改 scripts/ui/ResultsPanel.gd 与 scripts/net/NetResultPanel.gd；不要动 UiKit.gd / UI_Manager.gd / NetLobby.gd / BattleManager.gd。
2) 背景：两个文件都在根节点调用 UiKit.make_backdrop(self, accent, 0.8)：host 胜负用 UiKit.C_TEAM0 / UiKit.C_TEAM1（胜=青、负=红）作 accent；NetResultPanel 同样按胜负取色。保留原半透明底色但降低不透明度，让背景透出来。
3) 铺满：主容器边距收到 32；概览页两队英雄卡按宽度均分铺满（现有 740 宽卡片在 2400 下可改为按行自适应：每队 5 张卡横向填满，或保持卡片但让行容器 expand）；数据/复盘页表格宽度拉满；tab 行与内容区之间间距合理。
4) 按钮质感：顶部"再来一局/退出游戏"、tab 按钮、返回按钮全部用 UiKit.skin_button(state, accent, filled) 生成 normal/hover/pressed（再来一局=金色 filled，退出=中性描边，tab 选中=金色 filled、未选中=中性 chip），字号走 _fs(FS_*)；按钮高度 ≥62、内边距更大，pressed 有下沉感。
5) 不改任何数据逻辑/字段/信号；host 结算尺度保留现有 1.7 公式（_ui_scale），NetResultPanel 保持其现有尺度公式，只改视觉与铺满。
6) 验证：无头解析无新增 SCRIPT ERROR；windowed 真机验证：用临时探针实例化 battle.tscn 并调用 bm._show_game_over() 截 host 结算页；NetResultPanel 若难以单独触发，至少静态解析通过并在报告说明。完成后删除探针文件。
7) 报告：改动摘要 + 关键 rect 实测 + 验证日志结论。

task.description:
目标（全屏 + 质感 + 背景 三原则）：把 scripts/net/NetLobby.gd 的大厅菜单页、房间页、联机选人页改成"铺满屏幕"版式，并接入统一背景与按钮质感。

现状：_build_base() 用 CenterContainer + VBoxContainer(560 宽按钮、居中)，三个页面都挤在中间一小块，四周大片空白。屏幕虚拟尺寸 2400×1400，缩放系数 UiKit.scale()（2400 宽时 1.35）。

必须遵守：
1) 只改 scripts/net/NetLobby.gd；不要动 UiKit.gd / BattleManager.gd / UI_Manager.gd / ResultsPanel.gd / NetResultPanel.gd。
2) 背景：在 _build_base() 里加 UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)（会铺满并置于底层），保留原全屏不透明底 ColorRect（可改成仅在本体使用）——注意背景要盖住默认 clear color。
3) 菜单页 _show_menu()：改为两栏铺满布局（用 anchor/offset 或 HBoxContainer + expand）：
   - 左栏（约 42% 宽）：品牌区——大标题"荣耀王者"（96px 级别，_fs(UiKit.FS_HUGE)*2 之类尽量大但同时用 _fs 档位表达）、副标题、下面留白、底部放版本/状态行；
   - 右栏（剩余宽度）：菜单按钮列，按钮尺寸 640×96、字体 _fs(FS_XL)、间距 20，垂直居中；
   - 左右内边距 64，上下 40；菜单按钮使用 UiKit.skin_button(state, accent, filled) 生成 normal/hover/pressed 三态（单机键用金色 filled，联机键用青色描边、退出/返回用危险色描边）。
4) 房间页 _show_room() 与选人页 _show_select()：同样铺满；房间页左侧座位列表占 65% 宽（行高更大、字号 _fs(FS_MD/FS_LG)），右侧状态/开始按钮列；选人页左英雄列表 760 宽、中间英雄预览、右召唤师技能列，底部确认按钮 680×92。
5) 所有按钮保持原有回调与文本，不改状态机/网络逻辑/字段名；字号统一走已有 _fs()。按钮 min size 只增不减，布局用容器 expand 让内容撑满。
6) 需要时给页面块加 UiKit.skin_chip()/skin_card() 底板（半透明），不要出现纯亮底。
7) 验证：无头解析 `& 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit`（除既有 Minimap 告警外无 SCRIPT ERROR）；windowed `res://scenes/lobby.tscn --quit-after 200` 无 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent。报告里给出大厅菜单和房间页关键控件的实测几何（用临时探针脚本可，但完成后必须删除探针文件）。

content.text:
Shop drawer uses anchors 0.02–0.56 grid and 0.60–0.98 detail → widening the drawer automatically stretches columns ✓. So simply widen drawer offset_left/right to ±1140 (2280 wide, 95% of 2400) and maybe grid columns 3 instead of 2 to use width. But item card sizes? `_refresh_shop_grid` creates cards with fixed size? Let's check card creation ~1121-1180 for width and columns behavior. If cards fixed width ~? and grid columns=2, wider area leaves gaps. Set columns=3 when drawer wide → cards flow. Let me check card size definition.

Also add backdrop to shop_ui (below drawer): `UiKit.make_backdrop(shop_ui, C_TEAM0, 0.6)`, but backdrop full rect (full screen) under drawer; drawer is opaque 0.92 panel; backdrop would be hidden behind drawer but visible at sides where drawer doesn't cover (only 2280 wide, 60px each side) — negligible. Better: add backdrop INSIDE drawer as its child (drawer has no clipping) → the shop's own background: gradient visible through translucent drawer (alpha .92) — too opaque; reduce drawer alpha to .88 and add backdrop child in drawer. Hmm z-order: backdrop first child of drawer then others.

Simplest: `_apply_panel_style(drawer, 0.86)` + add a backdrop control as child of drawer (positioned full rect of drawer) with glow low; then title etc. above it. Backdrop is Control full-rect anchored — inside drawer works.

Hero detail: panel 2160 wide, full height; add backdrop child similarly and reduce alpha .88→.86. Hero detail already has dim; check `_create_hero_detail_panel` lines 596-640 to add backdrop safely.

Also "提高各个按钮的质感" for battle HUD panels: close buttons, buy buttons, attribute? Use skin_button for shop close/buy buttons and hero detail close. Let me check those buttons: `close_btn` in shop, `_refresh_shop_detail` buy button styles `_flat_action_style` (already upgraded). `close_btn` has no stylebox override → theme default 9-slice texture. Set skin_button for close.

Also attribute panel toggle header? skip.

Additionally battle HUD main panels could get more "background": the dim behind shop exists (0.4). Add backdrop to shop drawer; hero detail has dim + panel.

Let me check hero detail panel dim variable and creation.

task.subject: 单机选人页全屏化 + 背景 + 按钮质感（BattleManager.gd）
task.description:
目标（全屏 + 质感 + 背景 三原则）：把单机选人界面 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd 的 _show_hero_select_ui() 改为铺满 2400×1400 的三栏版式并接入统一背景与按钮质感。

现状：CenterContainer + ScrollContainer(custom_minimum_size 900~1440 × 480~980) + VBox，内容挤在中间；英雄卡/召唤师卡是 8px 小字块，确认按钮 560×76。

必须遵守：
1) 只改 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd 里的选人 UI 相关函数（_show_hero_select_ui / _sel_label / _sel_btn / _sel_btn_style / _sel_card_style / _style_card / _sel_* 辅助）；不要动 UiKit.gd / NetLobby.gd / UI_Manager.gd。
2) 背景：在选人 CanvasLayer 的根 Control 上调用 UiKit.make_backdrop(root, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)，置于内容之下；保留原 SEL_BG 作为兜底底色（可改为不透明 ColorRect 置底）。
3) 版式铺满（左右边距 48、上下 32）：
   - 左栏 760 宽：按职责分组的英雄卡列表（可滚动），每张卡 220×88 级别、名称 _fs(FS_MD/LG)、职责小字 _fs(FS_SM)，选中态用 UiKit.skin_card(role_color, true)；
   - 中栏（剩余宽度）：英雄预览——英雄名 _fs(FS_HUGE)*1.6 级别大标题、职责/定位标签、技能 1/2/3 说明列表（UiKit.skin_chip 底）、基础属性两列；
   - 右栏 480 宽：召唤师技能卡片（2 列网格，卡片 220×96）与说明；
   - 底部：确认按钮 680×92（UiKit.skin_button("normal", UiKit.C_GOLD, true) 及 hover/pressed），旁边显示 summary 文本（_fs(FS_MD)）。
   - 所有现有回调与字段（select_ui / select_summary_label / select_summ_detail / 选人状态）保持不变，_on_* 逻辑不动。
4) 按钮质感：所有按钮 normal/hover/pressed 都用 UiKit.skin_button(state, accent, filled) 生成，不要再用裸 StyleBoxFlat 或 1px 白边；卡片用 UiKit.skin_card。
5) 字号统一走已有 _sel_label/档位（如需可新增 _sel_fs()）。布局用容器 expand 撑满，不留大片空白；确保 2400×1400 下内容占满且不溢出（可滚动区域允许滚动）。
6) 验证：无头解析无新增 SCRIPT ERROR（仅既有 Minimap 告警）；windowed `res://scenes/battle.tscn` 截选人页并实测：日志无 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent。用临时探针脚本可，完成后必须删除探针文件（不要留 _probe_*）。
7) 报告：给出选人页三栏与确认按钮的实测 rect（用 get_global_rect() 打印），并说明哪些旧控件被替换。

现状：_build_base() 用 CenterContainer + VBoxContainer(560 宽按钮、居中)，三个页面都挤在中间一小块，四周大片空白。屏幕虚拟尺寸 2400×1400，缩放系数 UiKit.scale()（2400 宽时 1.35）。

必须遵守：
1) 只改 scripts/net/NetLobby.gd；不要动 UiKit.gd / BattleManager.gd / UI_Manager.gd / ResultsPanel.gd / NetResultPanel.gd。
2) 背景：在 _build_base() 里加 UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)（会铺满并置于底层），保留原全屏不透明底 ColorRect（可改成仅在本体使用）——注意背景要盖住默认 clear color。
3) 菜单页 _show_menu()：改为两栏铺满布局（用 anchor/offset 或 HBoxContainer + expand）：
   - 左栏（约 42% 宽）：品牌区——大标题"荣耀王者"（96px 级别，_fs(UiKit.FS_HUGE)*2 之类尽量大但同时用 _fs 档位表达）、副标题、下面留白、底部放版本/状态行；
   - 右栏（剩余宽度）：菜单按钮列，按钮尺寸 640×96、字体 _fs(FS_XL)、间距 20，垂直居中；
   - 左右内边距 64，上下 40；菜单按钮使用 UiKit.skin_button(state, accent, filled) 生成 normal/hover/pressed 三态（单机键用金色 filled，联机键用青色描边、退出/返回用危险色描边）。
4) 房间页 _show_room() 与选人页 _show_select()：同样铺满；房间页左侧座位列表占 65% 宽（行高更大、字号 _fs(FS_MD/FS_LG)），右侧状态/开始按钮列；选人页左英雄列表 760 宽、中间英雄预览、右召唤师技能列，底部确认按钮 680×92。
5) 所有按钮保持原有回调与文本，不改状态机/网络逻辑/字段名；字号统一走已有 _fs()。按钮 min size 只增不减，布局用容器 expand 让内容撑满。
6) 需要时给页面块加 UiKit.skin_chip()/skin_card() 底板（半透明），不要出现纯亮底。
7) 验证：无头解析 `& 'D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe' --headless --path . --editor --quit`（除既有 Minimap 告警外无 SCRIPT ERROR）；windowed `res://scenes/lobby.tscn --quit-after 200` 无 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call/Nonexistent。报告里给出大厅菜单和房间页关键控件的实测几何（用临时探针脚本可，但完成后必须删除探针文件）。","status":"in_progress","blockedBy":[],"writeScopes":["scripts/net/NetLobby.gd"],"ownerName":"lobby-fullscreen","ready":false,"writeScopeWarnings":[]}

目标（全屏 + 质感 + 背景 三原则）：把 scripts/net/NetLobby.gd 的大厅菜单页、房间页、联机选人页改成"铺满屏幕"版式，并接入统一背景与按钮质感。

3) 菜单页 _show_menu()：改为两栏铺满布局（用 anchor/offset 或 HBoxContainer + expand）：

   - 左右内边距 64，上下 40；菜单按钮使用 UiKit.skin_button(state, accent, filled) 生成 normal/hover/pressed 三态（单机键用金色 filled，联机键用青色描边、退出/返回用危险色描边）。
4) 房间页 _show_room() 与选人页 _show_select()：同样铺满；房间页左侧座位列表占 65% 宽（行高更大、字号 _fs(FS_MD/FS_LG)），右侧状态/开始按钮列；选人页左英雄列表 760 宽、中间英雄预览、右召唤师技能列，底部确认按钮 680×92。

必须遵守：
1) 只改 scripts/ui/ResultsPanel.gd 与 scripts/net/NetResultPanel.gd；不要动 UiKit.gd / UI_Manager.gd / NetLobby.gd / BattleManager.gd。

content.text: 你知道王者真实的选择英雄界面吗？
你知道王者真实的选择英雄界面吗？

User asks: "你知道王者真实的选择英雄界面吗？" — Do you know the real Honor of Kings hero selection screen? This is a question, likely leading to "make ours look like it". I should answer from knowledge: describe HoK (王者荣耀) hero pick interface layout in detail, and compare with current implementation, propose how to align.

I know Honor of Kings's hero select (ban/pick) screen reasonably well: In HoK ranked/draft mode "征召模式" (draft pick), and normal mode "自选模式". The interface:

Layout (landscape mobile):
- Top center: countdown timer + phase label (禁用阶段/选择阶段) and team scores/KDA? Actually top bar shows both team names, ban slots.
- Left side: ally team list (5 slots) vertically. Right side: enemy team list vertically. Each slot shows hero portrait, player name, summoner spell, and hero locked/unlocked state. In draft, picks alternate.
- Bottom: large horizontal hero grid with role filters (坦克/战士/刺客/法师/射手/辅助) tabs, search, and hero cards with prices; above it the selected hero's big 3D model/portrait in center-left? Actually center shows the selected hero's large splash art/3D model with name, role tags, and "确定/锁定" button on the right bottom.
- The selected hero preview: large character art at center-left standing on a platform; hero name (large), title/epithet, role icons, and skill icons row below; "确定" button bottom right.
- Bottom left: chat, and "皮肤" (skin) selector; "更换召唤师技能" area at right.
- Ban phase: top row shows banned heroes with red X.
- In game HUD there's also the top scoreboard.

For Honor of Kings specifically (王者荣耀), the pick screen (钻石以上征召模式):
- 顶部: 双方头像/名字、BP 阶段倒计时、禁用英雄展示（顶部两排 ban 位，蓝色方左侧，红色方右侧）。
- 左右两侧: 5v5 队员槽位（头像+昵称+段位框），选择中高亮、已确定显示英雄头像+召唤师技能图标。
- 中央: 当前选中英雄的大幅立绘/3D 模型（侧面站立），下方英雄名、称号、职业定位标签；
- 右侧: 皮肤选择（若有）、召唤师技能选择、确定/锁定按钮；
- 底部: 英雄列表横向滚动（按职业分类 tab：全部/坦克/战士/刺客/法师/射手/辅助），每张卡显示头像、名称、熟练度/胜率；上方有搜索框；下方有"确定"按钮。
- 底部左侧: 聊天/快捷消息; 右下: 倒计时环形。

Also 王者 has "选英雄界面" in 排位 and 匹配: 匹配模式 (non-draft): 底部横向英雄网格 + 中央大立绘 + 右侧召唤师技能 + 确定按钮; teammates' picks shown at top-left/top-right small portraits; there's "取消" and countdown.

Also 皮肤预览, 英雄熟练度, 英雄台词语音, 推荐出装.

Key visual style: dark blue/navy gradient with gold trim, ornate Chinese-style frames, hero splash art dominating, glow behind selected hero, faction colors (blue for own team, red for enemy). Big countdown at top center in gold.

Current ours: after batch, 3-column layout with left hero list, middle text preview, right summoner list, bottom confirm. Missing: hero big splash/3D model, top phase header with both team slots, role tabs, right-side skin/summoner + lock, hero cards with portraits & role icons, chat, countdown ring.

## 一、真机界面结构

**通用骨架（横屏 16:9）**
- **顶部中央**：阶段标题（"选择英雄 / 禁用英雄 / 调整阵容"）+ 大号金色倒计时数字，外圈进度环；征召模式下方还有 BP 轮次指示（第 1 轮/第 2 轮）。
- **左右两侧**：10 个席位槽竖向排列（我方左、敌方右）。槽位 = 头像框 + 昵称 + 段位/边框 + 召唤师技能小图标；状态三态——未选（暗框）、选择中（高亮呼吸/描边）、已锁定（英雄头像 + 金框 + 召唤师技能）。征召模式下顶部另有两排 ban 位（红叉头像）。
- **中央**：当前选中英雄的**大立绘/3D 模型**，站在带光的圆形台上，背后一层同色辉光；下方是英雄名（特大）+ 称号 + 职业定位标签；有皮肤时左右切换箭头，立绘随之换装。
- **右侧**：召唤师技能选择（2 个槽 + 可选列表）、皮肤/星元入口、**"确定"大按钮**（金色，锁定后变"已确定"灰态），部分版本下方还有"交换英雄"。
- **底部**：横向英雄列表（可滚动），上方一排**职业 tab**（全部/坦克/战士/刺客/法师/射手/辅助）+ 搜索框；每张英雄卡 = 头像 + 名字 + 熟练度/胜率角标 + 价格（未拥有时）。点选后中央立绘即换。
- **左下角**：聊天/快捷消息；右下角：倒计时环与"取消"。
- **视觉语言**：深蓝紫底 + 金色描边 + 中式云纹/回纹装饰 + 大量发光，选中英雄时整屏有青色/金色氛围光。
