extends Node
var f := 0
var bm
var stage := 0
var cap := false
func _ready() -> void:
	PlayerPrefs.set_lane("发育路")
	var ps := load("res://scenes/battle.tscn") as PackedScene
	bm = ps.instantiate()
	add_child(bm)
func _roles(list: Array) -> Array:
	var out := []
	for h in list:
		var hn := str(h)
		if hn != "" and bm.hero_configs.has(hn):
			out.append(str(bm.hero_configs[hn].get("role", "")))
	return out
func _process(_d: float) -> void:
	f += 1
	if bm == null: return
	if bm.select_ui != null and stage == 0:
		stage = 1
		print("[L] lane=", bm.sel_lane_name, "/", bm.sel_lane_role, " initial=", bm.selected_hero_type, " ok_shooter=", bm._can_player_pick("孙尚香"), " ok_mage=", bm._can_player_pick("妲己"))
		var before: String = bm.selected_hero_type
		var ev := InputEventMouseButton.new()
		ev.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
		ev.pressed = true
		bm._on_hero_card_clicked(ev, "妲己", null, Color.WHITE)
		print("[L] after_mage_click unchanged=", bm.selected_hero_type == before, " tip=", bm.sel_tip_label.text if bm.sel_tip_label else "")
	if bm.sel_draft_active:
		bm.sel_draft_time = 0.0
	if bm.sel_draft_done and not cap:
		cap = true
		var aroles := _roles(bm.sel_ally_picks)
		var eroles := _roles(bm.sel_enemy_picks)
		var au := {}
		for r in aroles: au[r] = true
		var eu := {}
		for r in eroles: eu[r] = true
		print("[L] ally=", bm.sel_ally_picks, " roles=", aroles)
		print("[L] player_role=", str(bm.hero_configs.get(bm.selected_hero_type, {}).get("role", "")), " ally_unique=", au.size(), " enemy_unique=", eu.size())
		print("[L] allies_without_lane=", not (aroles.slice(0, aroles.size()).has("射手") and aroles.count("射手") > 1))
	if bm.select_ui == null and bm.hero != null:
		print("[L] game_started=true")
		PlayerPrefs.set_lane("对抗路")
		get_tree().quit()

## 一、主菜单：开始游戏下方新增「选择您的分路」

- 在「🎮 单机游戏」按钮正下方新增一行：「分路」标签与 5 个芯片 **对抗路、打野、中路、发育路、游走**（选中金填充、未选青描边），下方副行显示「发育路 · 射手」。
- 点击即写 `PlayerPrefs.set_lane()` 落盘（`user://player_prefs.json`，沙箱环境自动回退 `res://saves/`）并即时换样式，不重进页面。实测芯片 `y=422.2 / 高 56`，x=1429/1545/1661/1777/1893，点击发育路后 `get_lane()=="发育路"`、副行更新。
- 截图：[lobby_lane.png](screenshots/lobby_lane.png)

## 二、单机选人：玩家固定占用该分路

- 进 BP 即读分路：玩家只能选该分路对应职责的英雄，其它职责卡置灰 + 小字「分路不符」，初始预览直接落在该分路第一名英雄上；席位显示「我 · N 号位 · 发育路」、顶栏「我 · 发育路」、提示「分路：发育路 · 只能选择射手 · 每队每个职责限选 1 名英雄」。
- **队友 AI 不会选这个分路**（AI 候选池直接排除该职责），超时锁定也会自动挑本分路内未选英雄。
- 实测发育路：初始 狄仁杰（射手），`_can_player_pick("孙尚香")=true`、`("妲己")=false`；点妲己 → 提示「本局分路：发育路 · 只能选择射手英雄」且选择不变；终局我方 `沈梦溪/大禹/铠/狄仁杰/马超` = 法师/辅助/战士/射手/刺客，5 职责唯一、**队里只有玩家 1 名射手**；BP→加载→开局正常。
- 实测游走：玩家 太乙真人（辅助），队友 4 人无辅助。
- 截图：[select_lane.png](screenshots/select_lane.png)

## 三、联机模式

- **房间页**：右栏新增「本机分路：发育路（射手）· 回主菜单可更换」。
- **联机选人页**：分路对应职责被锁定 —— 默认 tab 切到该职责、其它 tab 置灰点击无效、非该职责英雄卡置灰「分路不符」不可点、锁定前再校验一次。实测（中路）：`lane_role=法师 locked=true`，点「战士」tab 无效、点吕布不被选、点安琪拉成功选中。
- 若该职责已被队友先锁：不强制锁，提示「本机分路「发育路」已被队友占用，可选其他职责」，可正常选其它职责（实测 fallback 6 个 tab 全开）。
- 未改网络协议：服务端仍严格一人一职，host 的 AI 补位沿用「按人类已锁职责排除」，所以 AI 不会补到玩家分路。
- 截图：[net_lane.png](screenshots/net_lane.png)

## 改动文件

- 新增 [PlayerPrefs.gd](scripts/core/PlayerPrefs.gd)（分路存取 + 落盘）
- [HeroPickData.gd](scripts/net/HeroPickData.gd:17)（`LANES` / `lane_role()` / `role_lane()`）
- [BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd:2155)（分路校验、AI 排除、卡片置灰、提示与席位文案）
- [NetLobby.gd](scripts/net/NetLobby.gd:83)（菜单分路行、房间分路显示、选人页分路锁定与 fallback）

## 验证

- 无头解析 exit 0（仅既有 `Minimap` 类名告警）；单机两局（发育路/游走）BP→加载→开局全部正常；`lobby.tscn --quit-after 220`、`battle.tscn --net-test --quit-after 300` 均 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent。
- 探针与测试存档已清，分路恢复默认「对抗路」。

## 说明

1. 菜单分路芯片取 112×56：5×150 放不进 640 宽的按钮列，112×56 可整行放下。
2. 一局里多名联机玩家选同一分路时：先锁定者占用，其余玩家自动降级为「可选其他职责」并提示，不会卡死。
3. 分路只决定选人阶段可用职责与 AI 补位，不改变出生点/站位（双方仍泉水出生）。

## 二、单机选人：玩家固定占用该分路

- 进 BP 即读分路：玩家只能选该分路对应职责的英雄，其它职责卡置灰 + 小字「分路不符」，初始预览直接落在该分路第一名英雄上；席位显示「我 · N 号位 · 发育路」、顶栏「我 · 发育路」、提示「分路：发育路 · 只能选择射手 · 每队每个职责限选 1 名英雄」。
- **队友 AI 不会选这个分路**（AI 候选池直接排除该职责），超时锁定也会自动挑本分路内未选英雄。
- 实测发育路：初始 狄仁杰（射手），`_can_player_pick("孙尚香")=true`、`("妲己")=false`；点妲己 → 提示「本局分路：发育路 · 只能选择射手英雄」且选择不变；终局我方 `沈梦溪/大禹/铠/狄仁杰/马超` = 法师/辅助/战士/射手/刺客，5 职责唯一、**队里只有玩家 1 名射手**；BP→加载→开局正常。
- 实测游走：玩家 太乙真人（辅助），队友 4 人无辅助。
- 截图：[select_lane.png](screenshots/select_lane.png)

## 三、联机模式

- **房间页**：右栏新增「本机分路：发育路（射手）· 回主菜单可更换」。
- **联机选人页**：分路对应职责被锁定 —— 默认 tab 切到该职责、其它 tab 置灰点击无效、非该职责英雄卡置灰「分路不符」不可点、锁定前再校验一次。实测（中路）：`lane_role=法师 locked=true`，点「战士」tab 无效、点吕布不被选、点安琪拉成功选中。
- 若该职责已被队友先锁：不强制锁，提示「本机分路「发育路」已被队友占用，可选其他职责」，可正常选其它职责（实测 fallback 6 个 tab 全开）。
- 未改网络协议：服务端仍严格一人一职，host 的 AI 补位沿用「按人类已锁职责排除」，所以 AI 不会补到玩家分路。
- 截图：[net_lane.png](screenshots/net_lane.png)

## 改动文件

- 新增 [PlayerPrefs.gd](scripts/core/PlayerPrefs.gd)（分路存取 + 落盘）
- [HeroPickData.gd](scripts/net/HeroPickData.gd:17)（`LANES` / `lane_role()` / `role_lane()`）
- [BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd:2155)（分路校验、AI 排除、卡片置灰、提示与席位文案）
- [NetLobby.gd](scripts/net/NetLobby.gd:83)（菜单分路行、房间分路显示、选人页分路锁定与 fallback）

## 验证

- 无头解析 exit 0（仅既有 `Minimap` 类名告警）；单机两局（发育路/游走）BP→加载→开局全部正常；`lobby.tscn --quit-after 220`、`battle.tscn --net-test --quit-after 300` 均 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent。
- 探针与测试存档已清，分路恢复默认「对抗路」。

## 说明

1. 菜单分路芯片取 112×56：5×150 放不进 640 宽的按钮列，112×56 可整行放下。
2. 一局里多名联机玩家选同一分路时：先锁定者占用，其余玩家自动降级为「可选其他职责」并提示，不会卡死。
3. 分路只决定选人阶段可用职责与 AI 补位，不改变出生点/站位（双方仍泉水出生）。

## Primary Request and Intent
- Earlier completed (background, all shipped): realistic spell props/animations; single/multiplayer UI parity; visual-quality P0; global UI optimization P0 batches 1–3; unified procedural basic-attack bullets; `WalkFeel.gd`; all 21 heroes' skill projectiles unified; battle HUD analysis + P0 fixes; visual audit roadmap; P0 skin-unification (UiKit); fullscreen lobby/room/select/results with `UiBackdrop.gd`; HoK-style select screens (`HeroPreview.gd` 3D hero art); 王者真实选人界面 alignment; 拟真 BP (random seat, alternating picks, 20s/turn), default recommended summoner, summoner hover tooltip, 出装调整 module in select.
- Then: “推荐出装中的装备应该是可以换为其他装备的（请在主菜单添加一个备战模块，点进去后跳转备战界面，可以为不同英雄自己设计出装方案并命名保存到本地，对战时选英雄界面可以把推荐出装改为此套出装方案）；所有人选定后应该出现一个加载界面（模仿真实王者）” → delivered: 备战 scene + local build store, select 出装 schemes, HoK loading screen.
- Then: “备战方案中鼠标悬浮在某个装备上时应该能够看到此装备的信息（分详细/简略两种，可自由切换），同时应该可以通过拖动来调整两个装备的出装顺序；选择英雄界面注意一方不能选择两个同一类型的英雄，比如有一个AI已经选择了射手，那么玩家和其他AI就不能再选择射手” → delivered both (verified).
- **Current request (not started):** “加载界面需要模仿真实王者，上下两排，每个英雄一张动态皮肤卡，皮肤卡底部有玩家称号和英雄、皮肤名称” — loading screen redesign: two rows (top = one team, bottom = other, HoK style), each hero gets a dynamic skin card (animated), card bottom shows player title (称号) + hero name + skin name.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable, GDScript, mobile renderer, Android; virtual canvas 2400×1400; `canvas_items` stretch, `expand` aspect; custom font `res://assets/theme/ui_font.tres`.
- Autoloads: `Config, UiKit, ItemDatabase, SkillDatabase, GameManager, UiManager, CollisionSystem, PathFinder, TouchController, NetSession, SfxManager, Vfx, PostFX`.
- `UiKit.scale()=max(1,vp.x/2400)*1.35`; tokens FS_XS16…FS_HUGE34, C_GOLD/C_TEAM0/C_TEAM1/C_DANGER/C_GLASS/C_PANEL_EDGE/C_TEXT/C_TEXT_DIM; helpers `flat()`, `skin_card()`, `skin_chip()`, `skin_tag()`, `skin_button(state,accent,filled)`, `skin_notice()`, `make_backdrop(parent,accent,glow)`.
- `HeroPreview` = SubViewportContainer with own_world_3d, transparent_bg, 900×1100, 3 lights + torus + floor, `set_hero(name)`, `set_accent(color)`; `Hero.HERO_MODEL_MAP` maps 28 heroes to few generic glb bases (6 female/6 male/3 wheelchair), so distinct 3D silhouettes repeat.

  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

Task: improve river visuals — currently shader has flat color + simple sin ripple, no normal map, no reflections, foam band, banks. Needs to look more realistic.

Plan (Lead alone, minimal): rewrite `_WATER_CODE` in MapVisuals.gd + add bank/rock/reeds/particles in BattleManager river region? Visual upgrade approach:

1. Water shader (spatial, mobile-compatible):
   - Vertex: gentle wave displacement (small amplitude) + varying world pos.
   - Fragment: 
     - multi-octave scrolling ripples combining sin/cos with different directions (flow along river direction: river direction is (1,0,1)/√2).
     - compute NORMAL from analytic derivative of ripple height (so specular reflects properly) — Godot spatial: set `NORMAL` in view space; easier use `NORMAL_MAP` with generated normal from derivative? Can set `NORMAL = normalize(vec3(dx, 0.35, dz))` transformed? In spatial shader NORMAL is in view space; simpler: compute normal in world, transform with VIEW_MATRIX: `NORMAL = normalize((VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(world_normal,0.0)).xyz)`.
     - Fresnel: `pow(1.0 - dot(NORMAL, VIEW), 5.0)` → mix deep color to sky-blue reflection tint, ROUGHNESS low at grazing.
     - Specular highlights via directional response using sin glints: `spec = pow(max(dot(NORMAL, normalize(LIGHT? ...` hard; rely on built-in specular with low roughness + normal variations → sparkle.
     - Depth/edge: use d = |x-z|/√2 to blend: center deep, near banks shallow lighter + foam with noise modulating in time; foam bands with two frequencies + flow.
     - Add scrolling "flow streaks" along the river direction: `st = dot(wp.xz, dir) * k - TIME*flow`; streak = smoothstep on sin(st + noise) with foam color.
     - Caustics/dapple: moving voronoi-ish via sum of sin pairs.
     - Emission subtle cyan glow near center to read at night lighting.
   - Keep opaque (no transparency) per existing comment (important: avoid sorting issues). Opaque but can fake depth with color.

2. Geometry/banks: add bank strips (two thin planes along edges) with sandy/mud color + rocks scattered along banks (random Instanced? a few MeshInstance3D spheres flattened, dark wet stones) + reeds (thin cylinders) — but keep minimal; maybe add `river bank` meshes in BattleManager `_create_map` near river: two long planes at d=±11 with rock instances (~24 rocks each side via MultiMesh for perf) and a couple of lily pads? Time budget moderate; visual gain mostly from water shader + bank foam + scattered wet rocks + floating glints.

3. Add flow particles? GPUParticles3D with small white dots drifting along river — nice but GPU cost; maybe a MultiMesh of ~40 quads animated in shader? Simpler: water shader already gives sparkle; skip particles.

Given "看起来不太逼真" — main wins: proper normals/specular/fresnel + wave animation + bank foam + shoreline rocks/reeds + slight riverbed depth.

Also water plane currently size (20,141) at y=0.02, rotation 45° — no waves displacement? Add vertex waves 0.06 amplitude so it's subtle and doesn't clip feet (heroes walk on y=0; river surface at 0.02; wave amplitude ±0.03 fine).

Do it myself: edit `_WATER_CODE` fully (MapVisuals.gd ~40 lines) + add shoreline decor function in MapVisuals (`river_bank_decor(center positions?)`) called from BattleManager after river creation. Since BattleManager and MapVisuals are Lead-owned? BattleManager written by select-fullscreen but now idle; fine Lead edits small blocks.

Let me read BattleManager around river creation (lines 380-460) and MapVisuals top (imports, helpers) to place decor function.

209: shader_type spatial;
210: render_mode diffuse_burley, specular_schlick_ggx, cull_back;
211: 
212: uniform vec3 shallow_color : source_color = vec3(0.20, 0.52, 0.55);
213: uniform vec3 deep_color : source_color = vec3(0.06, 0.22, 0.30);
214: uniform float map_half = 60.0;

216: varying vec3 wp;
217: 
218: void vertex() {
219: 	wp = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
220: }

222: void fragment() {
223: 	// 河道沿左上(-60,-60)→右下(60,60)对角线（x-z=0），与中路(x+z=0)垂直，半宽 10
224: 	float d = abs(wp.x - wp.z) * 0.70710678;
225: 	float center = 1.0 - smoothstep(4.0, 10.0, d);
226: 	vec2 p = wp.xz * 0.42;
227: 	float t = TIME * 0.55;
228: 	float w1 = sin(p.x * 1.9 + t) * 0.5 + 0.5;
229: 	float w2 = sin(p.y * 2.6 - t * 1.35) * 0.5 + 0.5;
230: 	float ripple = w1 * w2;
231: 	vec3 col = mix(deep_color, shallow_color, center);
232: 	col += vec3(0.10, 0.15, 0.13) * ripple;
233: 	// 岸边泡沫：沿路缘 |x+z|/√2≈10 处一圈，随波纹闪烁
234: 	float foam = smoothstep(0.55, 0.92, abs(sin(d * 3.4 + t * 2.1)));
235: 	foam *= 1.0 - smoothstep(8.0, 10.5, d);
236: 	col = mix(col, vec3(0.78, 0.88, 0.86), foam * 0.32);
237: 	ALBEDO = col;
238: 	ROUGHNESS = mix(0.05, 0.28, ripple);
239: 	SPECULAR = 0.65;
240: 	METALLIC = 0.0;
241: }
242: """

Uh oh: foam%=38% and bright%=95.5%, lum=199.5 — screen is very bright/white, likely water shader overexposed or foam covering huge area (my foam band with smoothstep(0.30,0.92) at d 6.6..10 covers 3.4m band, plus foam_wave high → white). But 38% of whole screen white suggests something more: maybe `map_half` unused fine... Could be the sky: camera angle (15.5,6.5,-7.5) looking at origin from close → sky occupies large area? `bright%`>95 means nearly everything is bright — sky top color (0.16,0.33,0.63) shouldn't be bright. Hmm 95% bright (>150 lum) means whole image bright: maybe environment exposure? setup_environment env exposure? But battle screenshots earlier (ui_battle_p0b) had normal lum probably ~60-100.

Wait maybe my probe camera is inside/under water? Camera at (15.5,6.5,-7.5) is above water; looking at origin. But the ground plane 140×140 only y=-0.02; camera sees ground and sky. Ground albedo 0.17 brightness moderate (~90 lum). Why 95% bright >150? Something's overexposing: maybe `MapVisuals.setup_environment` sets tonemap ACES with exposure etc. and glow? In actual battle, light setup includes sun. Earlier probe with environment? unknown.

Hmm, actually maybe the huge foam comes from water shader `EMISSION` (0.02,0.09,0.10) small.

Bright 95% maybe because image format saved from viewport with HDR sky white? Sky horizon color (0.80,0.78,0.70) = bright! Camera looking horizontally-ish at origin from 6.5 height: sky horizon band could dominate upper half. Horizon 0.8 -> lum 200; sky top darker. With fov 46 and look downward slightly, maybe half screen sky bright.

But cyan 40% + foam 38% overlap implies water region large and foam-heavy: cyan 70% mid band and 88% lower band = river occupies most of lower frame, foam 42%/29% → very foamy white. That's a problem: my foam too strong. The `foam_wave` sin(d*5.4...) with smoothstep(0.30,0.92) yields ~60% coverage of the band; times 0.85 mix → strong white. Plus wet_line + sparkle.

Also `col += vec3(0.16,0.22,0.24)*sparkle` adds brightness.

Need to tune: foam coverage should be ~25-40% within a narrow band near shore (d 8.2..9.8), not 6.6..10. Reduce:
- foam band: smoothstep(8.0, 9.2, d) * (1 - smoothstep(9.4, 10.0, d)) → narrow 2m band.

Simpler: take screenshot with river hidden → stats; if still bright, environment/camera issue (sky) not water.

But can't judge aesthetics. Key question: is the river actually visible as water in the actual game view? Camera at (8,21,20) looking -58°, river center ~ origin; frame center might be ground/water mix. Water occupies maybe lower half. Fine.

Concerns:
1. Water may look too light/cyan due fresnel+sky_color over entire surface at grazing angles → large area washed to sky color (center pixel 147,185,200 is basically sky color!). In game view distance, most of river surface viewed at grazing angle → fresnel high → river becomes sky-colored bright blue, losing water depth. That could look like "a blue stripe" but plausibly realistic (real water at grazing reflects sky). However with sun 2.2 and ACES, sky_color (0.58,0.74,0.91) * sunlight ~ bright; may look pale blue.

2. To make it read as river, keep deeper color dominant: reduce fresnel factor to max 0.35, power 5.0, and darken sky_color (0.42,0.58,0.78). Also increase deep color weight at center.

3. Ground plane near river in real map uses layout texture with river bank painted; our added sand strips might conflict/z-fight with painted ground? y=0.014 above ground (-0.02) fine but may look like two dark strips crossing lane... width 3.6 at offset 12 (10..13.8) — river is 20 wide so banks outside water ✓.

4. Bank decor rocks at off 9.2..14.6 partially over lane (lanes at x=±55 / z=±55)? No, they're near diagonal river, fine. But rocks near center crossing (along 0) could sit on the mid lane where heroes walk — visual only, could look odd (rocks on lane). Restrict along range to |along|>6? Mid lane crosses river at origin (x+z=0, i.e., along=0). Rocks at along near 0 would be on lane path. Better exclude |along| < 7 for rocks/reeds/lilies to keep lane crossing clean. Also river_sprite camps at (-58,?) etc not relevant.

5. Lilies at off 6.8..9.4 in water ✓, exclude along near 0 too.

6. Sand banks crossing mid lane at along=0 too — sand strip crosses the lane (visual). Could exclude sand in |along|<5 by splitting into two segments per side. Simplest: keep (painted ground already has lane blend) but a sand strip over lane looks like dirt path — acceptable.

Notify sent. Report: conclusion first, changes, verification numbers, caveats. Include screenshots links: river.png, battle_river.png.

Verification numbers: parse 0; battle --net-test 0 and net_client 0 errors, no SHADER ERROR; probe 60 FPS; banks 96 rocks/180 reeds/34 lilies; water pixels 40% of frame, foam 5.8%, animation changed 29.2% pixels in 0.5s; river plane subdivided 24×70 (1775 verts) for vertex waves; shader analytic gradient 8 transcendentals/px.

Caveat: 无贴图/反射探针，用菲涅尔+天空色近似反射；mobile 渲染器无 SSR；沙带为平面贴地；水仍是不可穿透（只视觉），英雄可涉水走过（原逻辑不变）。

河道已重做，水面现在有波光、天光反射与岸边细节。

## 水面（核心）

- **波高场 + 解析法线**：4 组不同方向、频率的波叠加成一整片流动水面，法线用解析梯度算（每像素 8 次三角函数，移动端省一半），高光与反射随波起伏，不再是"一块蓝板"。
- **顶点真实起伏**：河道平面细分 24×70（约 1775 个顶点），水面本身有小幅上下涌动；只向上起伏，避免波谷被地面吞掉。
- **菲涅尔天空反射**：视线越掠射越亮，远处河面染天光，近处保留深水色 —— 手机渲染器没有 SSR，这是最像"水"的近似。
- **顺流闪点**：沿河水方向的高频细纹被慢波调制，形成粼粼水光。
- **贴岸泡沫**：岸边 2m 窄带内两条随波推进的白色泡沫 + 一层贴岸湿沙高光（原来泡沫糊满整片水面，已收敛到只占岸边一条）。
- 颜色：河心深青（0.035,0.125,0.185）→ 近岸浅青（0.24,0.56,0.57），叠加顺流明暗带；仍保持**不透明**材质，不破坏甄姬大招等贴地特效的渲染排序。

## 两岸装饰（新增）

- **湿沙滩**：两岸各一条 3.6m 宽、132m 长的暗沙平面，压住水陆交界。
- **半浸礁石**：96 块扁球礁石，随机大小/角度，部分浸在水线下。
- **芦苇**：180 株细柱芦苇成片立在岸边，带随机倾斜。
- **睡莲**：34 片贴水面的圆盘睡莲，只长在近岸浅水。
- 都避开中路与河道的交叉口（±7m），不会挡住线上的视野；全部 MultiMesh 批量，无碰撞、不参与 gameplay，移动端只多 4 个 draw call。

## 实测

- 截图：[river.png](screenshots/river.png)（近景）、[battle_river.png](screenshots/battle_river.png)（真实对局中把英雄移到河道中心的实机视角）。
- 水面占画面 40%，泡沫占比 5.8%（旧版约 25~40% 的"肥皂水"已消除）；0.5 秒间隔两帧对比有 29.2% 像素发生变化，说明动画在跑。
- 探针场景 60 FPS（2400×1400）；两岸节点 96/180/34 全部生成。
- 无头解析 exit 0（仅既有 `Minimap` 告警）；`battle.tscn --net-test`、`net_client.tscn` 均 0 SHADER ERROR / SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call；联机客户端 `_add_river()` 同步做了细分与两岸装饰。

## 改动文件

- [MapVisuals.gd](scripts/core/MapVisuals.gd:208)（`_WATER_CODE` 重写 + 新增 `spawn_river_banks()`）
- [BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd:397)（河道平面细分 + 调两岸装饰）
- [NetClientBattle.gd](scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd:2137)（联机端同步）

## 说明

- 没有真实反射探针/水面贴图，反射是"菲涅尔 + 天空色"的近似；如果你想要更强的镜面感，可以再加一个 `ReflectionProbe`，但移动端会多一次立方体贴图开销。
- 水不阻挡移动（原逻辑），英雄仍可涉水过河，视觉上会踩到水面。

10. Comparison table vs HoK: joystick analog movement (360°), skill drag aiming with indicator + auto-aim, quick cast + wheel, basic attack button with "推塔/补刀" modes, camera drag on right side, lock-on enemy portrait, "头像锁定", skill cancel by dragging away, combo buffering, hit-stop, screen shake, damage feedback, sound.

Key observations:
- Movement: WASD in two modes (DIR screen-relative default? `_net_move_mode()` default = DIR or TURN). Also right-click move_target; joystick. No acceleration: instant velocity direction * move_speed (units 0.01 = cm?). No turn smoothing for joystick (snap rotation to direction). No movement input buffering / no deceleration.
- Attack gating: attacks only in the `else` branch (not moving!) — i.e., attacking requires standing still! In HoK, you can auto-attack while moving for ranged (attack while moving is standard: hero stops briefly? Actually in HoK heroes can move and attack simultaneously for most ranged with attack animation not stopping movement, e.g., 射手边走边A；近战攻击动作有前摇但可移动取消?). In this game: attack only when move_vec empty; but manual_target causes AI-chase only for AI. For player: holding attack key while moving does not attack; you must stop to attack. That's a big 手感 difference vs HoK where holding attack + moving → you can attack while moving (character keeps moving, attack fires).
- Also attack requires holding attack button (`ui_accept` or touch attack held) or manual_target set or mode_auto; no auto-attack when idle unless mode_auto.
- Attack retarget: `_get_attack_target` chooses nearest? Need check.
- Skill cast: `_handle_skill_input` — hold skill key to aim + preview; release to cast; touch drag; smart cast tap. Desktop: mouse aim; tap ≤180ms = smart cast. Skill cancel? Check release handling for cancel (drag out of button?). Also casting lock: `casting_skill`, cast_time; can you move during cast (stutter step)? Check `_physics_process` gating: movement allowed while casting? There's `casting_skill` used in some checks; movement block doesn't test casting_skill, so you can move during cast → animation not locked. Hmm.

Also damage numbers, SFX etc.

So this game is already heavily HoK-emulating. The analysis should be honest: 手感 is "desktop MOBA (LoL-ish) primary + mobile HoK-like overlay", and identify concrete mismatches.

Key areas to analyze with evidence & numbers:
1. 移动: 
   - Desktop: WASD 直接 8 方向 + 右键点地寻路（A*），摇杆 analog (mobile). Speed `actual_move_speed * delta * 0.01` — units per second = move_speed*0.01? e.g. move_speed 350 → 3.5 units/s; map 120 → 34s cross map. HoK ~ 350-400 units where 1 unit ~ 1cm? HoK map ~ 240m? pace similar.
   - 无加速度/惯性：方向瞬间切换（no accel/decel）; HoK also near-instant but has slight; 转身：摇杆时瞬间 snap `rotation.y = atan2(move.x, move.z)` — 无转身动画/rotate 缓冲, so 180° 反向时模型瞬转（HoK 有转身动作但快）。
   - 移动输入无 buffer, 松开即停。
2. 普攻:
   - 必须站定才攻击（只有 move_vec≈0 分支才攻击）→ 不能"走 A/边移动边普攻"。HoK 所有英雄可边走边 A（射手走 A 拉扯），这是最大手感差异。
   - 普攻需一直按住 `ui_accept`（空格/左键?）或锁 target；没有"自动攻击开关"选项（mode_auto 只在推塔/小兵模式）。
   - 攻击间隔 = 1/attack_speed（attacks per second? if attack_speed is attacks/sec, interval 1/AS — HoK uses AS% tiers). 已实现阈值表 (per CLAUDE) - check `attack_speed` usage.
   - 目标选择 `_get_attack_target`: nearest? check priority rules: manual_target > priority mode > nearest? inspect function.
   - 普攻轮盘 (drag pick) — HoK has 头像锁定+轮盘; ok-ish.
   - 攻击前摇动画无 cancels? `_perform_attack` immediate damage or delayed projectile. Check bullet spawn timing/animation.
3. 技能:
   - 按住技能键瞄准（鼠标/触摸拖拽）+ 松手施放 + 点按智能施法（≤180ms）; HoK 点按即智能施法 by default, 长按拖拽精确瞄准; equivalent but desktop uses mouse cursor, mobile uses touch. 
   - 预览：范围圈/箭头/位移箭头 ✓; 取消施法：touch 有 CancelCastButton；desktop 取消方式? Esc? Check `_handle_skill_input` release logic for cancel (drag back / release outside?). Also 鼠标右键取消?
   - 施法前摇 cast_time 期间可移动（no root）? check `casting_skill` gating in movement: movement code doesn't check casting_skill → can move during cast (可能破坏"施法动作"手感, HoK 施法有短前摇但可移动取消部分). Need confirm: search "casting_skill" usage and whether movement blocked.
   - 技能连招 buffer: 无 input buffer while casting/wind-up? check `_finish_casting`, queued skill. Search "queue".
4. 相机:
   - 固定 offset (0,12,8), rotation 固定 -60°, 无缩放/无旋转/无平滑（瞬间跟随），desktop 无拖拽视角（只有触摸右半屏 drag + 小地图拖拽）。HoK 有右半屏拖视角、镜头灵敏度、可开关"镜头跟随"、3D 自由视角（部分）。差异：桌面鼠标无法自由看视野（no edge pan/no drag）→ 视野受限。
   - 无镜头平滑/预测（HoK 有轻微延迟跟随），瞬移可能晕。
5. 反馈/表现:
   - 伤害飘字/血条/音效/击中停顿? Check hit stop / screen shake (`_apply_camera_shake` exists; screen shake on skills). 无 hit-stop (time freeze 20-40ms) - HoK 有受击顿帧? HoK has 打击感 via 顿帧/震屏/音效. Check screen shake usage count & time scale.
   - 技能取消/施法失败提示 (蓝不够/冷却) — UI has; "技能施放失败" feedback?
   - 动画: walk/attack/skill anim via glb AnimationPlayer; attack animations may not match attack interval (attack_speed tiers) → 动作与伤害不同步 (animation speed scaling? check `_play_anim` and `anim_player.speed_scale`).
6. 目标与信息:
   - 无头像锁定（点击敌方头像锁定）? HoK has. Attack wheel approximates.
   - 无"技能指示器取消区" on desktop; no "智能施法方向 = 面朝"? exists.
   - Minimap click/jump ✓, ping? no.
7. 移动端:
   - 摇杆死区/灵敏度? check joystick implementation (dead zone, dynamic center? HoK has "跟随手指" vs fixed). Check `get_move_vector` normalization/clamp, joystick radius.
   - 技能按钮大小 260, fan layout, 取消按钮 exists, 推塔/小兵 keys exist, skill detail long press exists, 升级按钮 exists.
   - 攻击轮盘 exists; 但"自动普攻" toggle? no.
8. 参数手感:
   - 输入采样: `_physics_process` 60Hz fixed; camera/input in `_process`. Mouse input cached.
   - 帧率 related responsiveness.
9. 延迟链: input in _physics_process (60Hz => up to 16.7ms) ; skill cast on release; camera update in _process; net 快照 20Hz? Client prediction? NetSession sends input at 20+tick? For online 手感, latency compensation? Probably input 30Hz & snapshot; check `_snap_timer` rates. Report.

Also skill animation plays at cast (immediate) — `_cast_anim_name` via `_play_anim(an)` at 3292; no speed scaling.

Also walk anim `_play_anim("walk")` every frame — no animation blend/transition? Maybe `_play_anim` handles same-anim check; check quickly? Not necessary; mention potential snapping between idle/walk/attack since separate AnimationPlayer plays.

One more relevant: 攻击时"停下"是硬条件，但停下时摇杆/按键仍可输入移动： pressing movement while attacking → moves immediately, attack canceled? Attack executed instantly so no windup to cancel; only attack_timer cooldown remains.

Also 技能可以在移动中释放，且不影响移动 — since instant.

Camera: no smoothing, also "camera shake" on big cast (fov punch) — with instant follow, shake may feel jittery.

Mobile parity: 技能释放/普攻/推塔小兵键/取消按钮/摇杆 all present; missing mobile-specific: 技能施法摇杆灵敏度、自动追击、目标头像、镜头灵敏度、按钮位置自定义（HoK 有布局自定义）。Check if there's layout customization: TouchController constants fixed; no settings screen? There's 设置? Possibly none. Mention.

Let me confirm no settings UI exists: grep "设置" in UI scripts quickly (menu?). Not crucial; I can say "未发现操作设置面板（无灵敏度/摇杆死区/自动追击/镜头跟随开关）" — but need confidence. grep "灵敏度|自动追击|设置" in scripts.

- 触屏端：输入层已经"王者化"（摇杆/普攻轮盘/推塔小兵/技能拖拽+取消/技能扇形/长按详情），差距在"动作层"：站定才能A、技能无前摇、无自动追击、无头像锁定。

- 联机：15Hz 快照、自己英雄不做本地预测 → 手感明显发钝。

1) 走A（移动中普攻）— Hero.gd:1637 gate; move attack out of `else` branch; allow attack while moving (attack timer independent), play attack anim layered or "attack while moving" blends; 0.5-1d.
2) 技能前摇/施法锁定 — Skill.cast_time unused; implement cast window in _start_casting with timer, root/slow 50%, interruptible by stun; ~0.5d + per-skill tuning.
3) 镜头（桌面自由视角 + 平滑）— add right-drag/edge pan, lerp follow, settings toggle; 0.5d.
4) 联机本地预测 + 30Hz — NetClientBattle predict own movement/cast, reconcile on snapshot; NetSession bump rate; 1-2d.

P1: 自动追击开关（PlayerPrefs）、头像锁定、攻击动画速度缩放/混合、普攻命中轻顿帧+音效分层、输入缓冲（施法/攻击前摇末 0.15s）、设置面板（摇杆死区/灵敏度/取消区/镜头跟随/按钮布局）、键位提示 overlay.

P2: 手柄、命中方向指示、技能施法失败 toast、镜头震动强度选项。

- 输入采样 60Hz; 施法延迟 ≤16.7ms; 相机 0 平滑; 快照 66.7ms; 移速 3.6-3.85 u/s; 攻击间隔 1.0-1.43s at AS 0.7-1.0; hitstop 35ms@0.12; 摇杆 max 120px、无死区; 轮盘拖 30px 才选敌、40px 取消; 技能点按阈值 180ms; 吸附 1.2m; 拖满 400px。

Ask: 我可以按 P0 顺序开始（先走A+技能前摇，再镜头，再联机预测）。

分析完成（未改代码）。结论：**触屏端的输入层已相当接近王者荣耀，差距集中在动作层；桌面键鼠端更像英雄联盟，和王者不是同一套操作逻辑。**

## 一、总体判断

| 层面 | 现状 | 评价 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入控件 | 摇杆 + 普攻轮盘 + 技能扇形按钮 + 取消施法按钮 + 推塔/小兵键 + 长按技能详情 + 右半屏拖动镜头 | 很接近王者荣耀（触屏） |
| 动作层 | 站定才能普攻、技能无前摇、玩家普攻不自动追击 | 与王者有明显差距（核心问题） |
| 镜头 | 固定跟随、无平滑、桌面无拖视角 | 手感偏僵硬，视野受限 |
| 打击反馈 | hitstop（仅重技能）、震屏、FOV punch、飘字、音效 | 已有基础，但普攻缺乏打击感 |
| 联机 | 15Hz 快照、自己英雄不做本地预测 | 联机手感明显延迟 |

## 二、逐项对比

**1) 移动**
- 本作：WASD 直接产生八方向输入 + 右键使用 A* 寻路；摇杆为线性映射（`MAX_RADIUS=120px`、激活半径 300px、**无死区、无曲线**），方向变化时**瞬间转向**（`rotation.y = atan2`），并且**瞬间停止移动，没有加减速** —— [Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:1549)、[VirtualJoystick.gd](scripts/mobile/VirtualJoystick.gd:13)
- 王者：虚拟摇杆有死区和跟随方式差异，角色转向有过渡，起步和停止有极短的缓冲。
- 差距：桌面用键盘移动会略显“机械”，手机摇杆手感接近，但缺少灵敏度和死区设置。

**2) 普攻 —— 最大差距**
- 本作：**只有站定（`move_vec≈0`）时才出手**（[Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:1623-1637)），按住 Space/普攻键连打，或左键锁敌后站定自动打；**玩家不自动追击**，超出射程直接失去锁定（[Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:58)）；攻击间隔为 `1/attack_speed`（基础 0.7~1.0 次/秒），但**攻击动画不随攻速缩放**。
- 王者：**走 A**（移动中持续普攻）、普攻有 0.15~0.3s 前摇、自动追击可开关、动画节奏跟随攻速。
- 差距：射手拉扯、近战“打一下退一步”都做不出来 —— 这是操作手感最明显的落差。

**3) 技能瞄准与施放**
- 本作做得很完整：按住瞄准、松开施放、点按≤180ms 智能施法、鼠标精确瞄准、拖拽吸附 1.2m、范围/箭头/位移三种指示器、拖回按钮取消 —— [Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:2930-3069)、[Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:3138)
- **但技能没有前摇**：`_start_casting()` 置标记后，下一物理帧 `_finish_casting()` 直接出手（[Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:3310、3375)），`Skill.cast_time` 字段基本没有用于施法锁定，而且**移动中可施法且不打断移动**。
- 王者：多数技能前摇 0.2~0.5s，施法期间定位或减速、可被控制打断 —— 这决定了“预判/反制”的博弈感。
- 差距：本作技能“即点即出”，手感偏快、偏轻，对手很难反应，也少了命中后的分量。

**4) 镜头**
- 本作：死跟 `hero + (0,12,8)`、俯角 -60°、FOV 70、**每帧硬设无平滑**（[BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd:3767)）；手机可右半屏拖、松手回正（上限 45m）；桌面**没有拖视角/边缘平移/缩放**；Tab 可切第一人称。
- 王者：右半屏拖视角 + 镜头灵敏度 + 跟随可关。
- 差距：桌面鼠标看不到侧翼，被抓/抓人少一次“抬眼”操作；硬跟随在高频走位时画面抖动。

**5) 选敌**
- 本作：左键点敌锁定、空格锁最近敌人、普攻轮盘拖动选敌 + 锁定环、推塔/小兵优先级键 —— [BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd:4351、4370)、[Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:3211)
- 王者：头像锁定（点敌方头像/拖头像切目标）+ 普攻轮盘 + 技能头像锁定。
- 差距：团战切后排不如王者直接，缺“头像锁定”这一层。

**6) 打击反馈**
- 本作：hitstop 35ms（`time_scale 0.12`，仅重技能）、震屏 0.10/0.28s、FOV punch 2.5°/0.4s、飘字、技能音效 —— [BattleManager.gd](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd:3682、3695)
- 王者：普攻/技能命中都有轻顿帧 + 分层音效 + 受击特效。
- 差距：普攻命中几乎“无体积感”；高攻速时动画重复导致像抽帧。

**7) 联机**

| 镜头 | 固定跟随、无平滑、桌面无拖视角 | 手感偏僵硬，视野受限 |

**3) 技能瞄准与施放**
- 本作做得很完整：按住瞄准、松开施放、点按≤180ms 智能施法、鼠标精确瞄准、拖拽吸附 1.2m、范围/箭头/位移三种指示器、拖回按钮取消 —— [Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:2930-3069)、[Hero.gd](scripts/entities/Hero.gd:3138)

- 现状：Hero.gd `_physics_process` 里只有 `move_vec≈0`（站定）的 else 分支才 `_perform_attack`（约 1623~1637 行）。移动中按住普攻/锁定目标完全不出手。

- 动画：现在移动分支每帧 `_play_anim("walk")` 会把攻击动作立刻覆盖。加 `var _aa_anim_until := 0.0`（`Time.get_ticks_msec()/1000.0` 或自增计时），`_perform_attack` 里设 `_aa_anim_until = now + clampf(0.6/attack_speed, 0.12, 0.30)`；移动分支只在 `now > _aa_anim_until` 时 `_play_anim("walk")`（攻击动作播完自动回 walk，继续移动不中断）。
- 不要破坏英雄专属强化普攻（马超/铠/后羿/元流之子、`_enhanced_aa_queued()`、`manual_target` 追击仅 AI 等既有分支）；玩家仍不自动追击（P1 再做）。

现状：`_process` 里 `cam.global_position = hero.global_position + _follow_offset + cam_pan_offset`（约 3765~3771 行），**每帧硬设无平滑**；`cam_pan_offset` 只有手机右半屏拖拽（TouchController）在更新；桌面无任何拖视角手段；小地图拖拽/跳转是直接硬设相机（保持）。

要求：
1) **桌面自由视角**：中键（MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE）按住拖动 → 平移 `cam_pan_offset`（复用现有字段与 45m 上限；水平=屏幕 x 映射世界 x，垂直=屏幕 y 映射世界 z，方向与手机端一致，灵敏度约 60px/m）。松手后**保持偏移**（自由镜头），按 `Y` 键回正（`cam_pan_offset=Vector3.ZERO`）。
2) **平滑跟随**：正常跟随时用指数平滑 `cam.global_position = cam.global_position.lerp(target, 1.0 - exp(-12.0*delta))`；目标变化剧烈（>25m，如小地图跳转/复活传送）时直接硬设避免拖影。手机端相机手感和上限不变（手机拖拽仍走 `cam_pan_offset` 增量和松手回正 lerp 逻辑，别改行为）。
3) 桌面鼠标划到屏幕边缘时不要自动平移（避免误触）；只中键拖 + Y 回正。
4) 不引入设置面板；Y 键提示可在 HUD 不加（本轮只做功能）。
5) 别影响第一人称模式（first_person_view）、兰陵王隐身拉远、`_apply_camera_shake`、小地图拖拽/跳转、`hitstop`。

验收（windowed 探针）：
- 进对局后模拟中键按下 + `InputEventMouseMotion`（relative 200,0）→ 打印 `cam_pan_offset` 非零、`cam.global_position` 偏移约 3~4m；再按 Y → 偏移归零。
- 打印正常跟随相邻帧位移差：走 A 测试中镜头应平滑（相邻帧位置变化 < 硬设直跳，可打印 `cam.global_position` 序列前 10 帧）。
- 手机路径：`TouchController.camera_pan_active()` 逻辑不改（可 grep 确认未动）。
- 截图 screenshots/camera_free.png（中键拖动后的视野偏移，能看出英雄不在画面正中）。
- `battle.tscn --quit-after 300` 与 `--net-test` 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent；探针删净；不要弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + 实测偏移/平滑数字 + 截图 + 结论。","subject":"手感 P0-B：桌面自由镜头（中键拖动）+ 跟随平滑","write_scopes":["scripts/core/BattleManager.gd"]}

block.text:
No `cast_time` field at all in Skill.gd; my earlier assumption wrong. So 技能前摇 needs new field + defaults + data overrides. Simpler: add `cast_time` to Skill.gd (default 0.0) and a per-type fallback table in Hero.gd; then per-hero overrides optional. But risk affecting many hero special cases (channeling, multi-stage heroes). Need safe design:
- Apply a **short universal 前摇** (0.12-0.2s) for normal "instant" skills only, excluding:
  - channeling skills (is_channeling) — handled separately,
  - heroes with multi-stage/held skills (沈梦溪, 太乙Q, 元流之子, 马超, 李白? no), 
  - net client cast path (client sends C_CAST → host `_start_casting`? host executes with same code → fine).
- During 前摇: movement slowed (×0.5) rather than rooted; can't attack; interrupted by stun/freeze/silence/knockup/suppress; death cancels.

But is this worth risk? User asked 走A + 技能前摇. Could implement 前摇 conservatively with whitelist by type: type 0 (targeted) 0.14s, 1 (AoE) 0.20s, 3 (linear) 0.16s, 4 (dash) 0.10s, 6 (shield) 0.10s; skip type 2 (buff), 5 (multi-stage), channeling, and heroes with special held logic. Verify no stuck states via probe.

Alternatively implement 前摇 in `_start_casting` by storing target and delaying `_finish_casting` until timer, but ensure preview updates and pending data persists. Also must handle repeated skill press during windup (ignore), cancel on stun.

This is moderate complexity; assign to character-fx-dev (hero combat specialist) with clear verification (probe cast states, BP→battle smoke, net test).

走A: also character-fx-dev.

Task-24 (select-fullscreen): 桌面镜头:
- Add middle-mouse drag pan + right-drag? right is move; use middle mouse and/or hold `Alt`+drag? Simplest: middle mouse drag pans; mouse wheel? no zoom; add key toggle follow lock (e.g., `Y` or `F`)? Keep: middle-drag pan (offset like cam_pan_offset with clamp 45), and smooth follow with lerp; add `镜头跟随` toggle key "Home"/"Y"? Also edge pan when mouse near screen edge while not dragging? Might annoy. Spec: middle-drag pan with smoothing return? HoK-LoL hybrid: middle drag sets free camera offset; press `Y`(or Home) recenters; smooth lerp on follow.
- Also make camera follow smoothed: current hard snap; add lerp with `cam_smooth` factor 12/s; keep minimap drag/jump behavior.
- Keep touch path unchanged.
- Also FOV? no.
- Verify: probe battle, simulate middle drag via InputEventMouseMotion with button mask? Can call handler directly; print cam offset changes; screenshot maybe; battle 300 frames no errors; net-test no errors.

Task-25 (lobby-fullscreen): 联机 own-hero prediction + snapshot 30Hz:
- NetSession SNAPSHOT_HZ 15→30 (risk bandwidth; test --net-test? headless self-connect test exists?). Check --net-test implementation: host+client in same process? Earlier "battle --net-test 300" ran clean — probably starts host and fake client. Raising to 30Hz should be fine.
- Own hero prediction: NetClientBattle — find where snapshots applied (`_on_snapshot`, `_apply_snapshot`), identify own hero (net_taken / pid). Implement: for own hero, after applying snapshot, maintain local predicted position: each frame apply input-driven movement locally (using C_DRIVE axis already computed `_d_ax` etc., same speed as hero.actual_move_speed, and collision? simple), then on each snapshot, if difference > threshold (e.g., 2.5m) snap, else lerp 35%/frame toward snapshot pos. Movement only; attacks/skills remain host-authoritative (damage etc. server).
- This is delicate: client hero is same Hero node with `net_driven` true; host snapshots set position each time via interpolation code for all heroes (line 357 v.node.global_position = pa.lerp(pb,f)). Need special-case for own hero: skip interpolation overwrite; instead use prediction+correction.
- Also ensure skills/animations triggered from snapshot? Probably events.
- Risk high; verify with `--net-test` runs and maybe two-process host/join headless test? There's `--net-host`/`--net-join`. Testing both processes in sandbox: possible with background jobs, but complex.

Given risk, maybe defer net prediction and instead deliver P0 1-3 + 30Hz bump? User asked "开工吧" with my suggested order including net. I'll dispatch net as task-25 with instruction to be conservative: if prediction proves too risky, at least raise snapshot rate + own-hero extrapolation using last velocity (simpler: after applying snapshot, if own hero, set position toward snapshot with smoothing and apply local axis movement each frame when no recent snapshot?). Hmm.

Alternative simpler net improvement with big feel gain: **client-side own-hero movement prediction** via `_d_ax` axis applied locally to hero position in `_process`, then snapshots correct with lerp. That's what I described; it's the standard. Let the teammate handle carefully, with fallback: keep prediction only for movement, disable during stun/death/recall (flags in snapshot state), and always correct if error > 3m.

Let me create tasks and send to teammates:
- task-23 → character-fx-dev (Hero.gd: 走A + 技能前摇)
- task-24 → select-fullscreen (BattleManager.gd: 桌面镜头)
- task-25 → lobby-fullscreen (NetClientBattle.gd + NetSession.gd: 联机预测+30Hz)

Lead: after they finish, verify combined (BP→battle smoke, net-test, screenshots), tune if needed.

Also check that these files don't overlap: Hero.gd, BattleManager.gd, NetClientBattle.gd+NetSession.gd ✓ disjoint.

Write detailed prompts.

For 走A details:
- Goal: while holding movement + attack, hero keeps moving and attacks at attack interval, prioritizing manual_target/priority mode/nearest in range.
- Implementation guidance: hoist target/should_attack computation before move/stand branches; in moving branch, if `should_attack and attack_timer <= 0 and not casting_skill` → `_perform_attack(target)` and set attack_timer; keep moving.
- Animation: add `_aa_anim_until` (wall/game time) set when attack plays; in moving branch, `_play_anim("walk")` only if now > _aa_anim_until; but then walk resumes. Or better: attack anim plays and movement continues; set _aa_anim_until = 0.18/attack_speed? Use `minf(0.35, 1.0/attack_speed*0.9)`? Simple: 0.18s.
- Also special heroes (马超/铠/后羿/元流之子) have enhanced AA gating — ensure their branches still work; don't break 马超 leap etc.
- Verify: debug print positions: hold move+attack in probe by setting Input actions? Can simulate `Input.action_press("ui_accept")` and hero move via `Input.action_press("move_forward")`? Hero reads ui_* axes for movement and `ui_accept` for attack; in probe call `Input.action_press("ui_up")`? Hero uses ui_left/right/up/down which are bound to arrow keys; can simulate with Input.action_press("ui_up") etc. Then assert hero position changes AND attack_timer triggered/bullets/minion damage occur.
- Verify still works with lane/BP; run full BP→battle smoke.

For 技能前摇:
- Add `cast_time` to Skill.gd (default 0.0), plus per-type defaults in Hero.gd: `CAST_TIME_DEFAULT := {0:0.14, 1:0.20, 3:0.16, 4:0.10, 6:0.10}`; skip if skill.is_channeling or type in [2,5] or display_name in special-held list (沈梦溪, 太乙真人, 元流之子, 马超?) — hmm 马超 R is type0? Keep whitelist approach: only apply when `skill.cast_time > 0.0`? But no data has cast_time → nothing changes. So defaults needed; risky special heroes: exclude `display_name in ["沈梦溪", "太乙真人", "元流之子"]` maybe; also skills with restore>0? 
- Movement slow ×0.55 during windup (not root) to preserve feel; attack disabled; if stunned/knockup/frozen/suppressed/silenced/dead during windup → cancel (no cost).
- Ensure `_finish_casting` called when timer elapses; existing preview/aim cleanup.
- Ensure AI unaffected? AI casting also gets windup — fine but could slow AI; acceptable/HoK-like. Actually AI cast path calls `_start_casting` too; windup applies to AI → AI skills slower; acceptable but might reduce difficulty; keep.
- Verify via probe: cast a targeted skill, check `casting_skill` true for ~0.15s, mana/CD not consumed until finish, stun during windup cancels (check mana unchanged), and normal skill still deals damage after windup. Use 妲己/亚瑟. Also smoke battle.

For camera:
- Add middle-mouse drag pan; smooth follow; key `Y` recenter/toggle; keep touch/minimap behavior; maybe also mouse wheel? no.
- Verify: probe: simulate InputEventMouseButton middle press + motion; print cam_pan_offset != 0; release returns? HoK/LoL: camera stays offset until recenter or hero moves? In LoL free cam stays; but follow offset resets gradually when hero moves? Simplest: middle drag sets offset, stays; if `Y` resets; also if hero moves, offset decays slowly? Spec: middle-drag pans; offset persists (free camera), `Y`/right? Hmm since 走A and 镜头 follow, better: offset decays back with 3s? Keep persistent + `Y` recenters; and snap to hero when hero dies? Also clamp 45.
- Smooth follow: `cam.global_position = cam.global_position.lerp(target_pos, 1-exp(-delta*12))` but only in follow mode; keep minimap drag direct.
- Verify: screenshot of camera panned; battle smoke; no errors; FPS.

For net:
- Raise SNAPSHOT_HZ to 30 (NetSession line 16).
- NetClientBattle: own hero movement prediction: locate own hero assignment (`_assign` or `NetSession.get_own_hero`?). Let teammate inspect.
- Correct only position (x,z); keep y from host? hero y=0.
- Clamp correction; disable during death/stun/recall (snapshot state has is_dead etc.).
- Verify with `--net-test` both host & client runs; also run host+client two processes? There may be built-in `--net-test` self test (host with fake client). Also check NetSession client input send rate: currently sends C_DRIVE when changed; with prediction need send at 20-30Hz to keep host updated? If only on change, host movement stalls? Probably it resends periodically (`_d_last`). Ensure continuous send at ~20Hz while moving.

Given risk, instruct: if prediction can't be made safe within scope, deliver 30Hz + own-hero extrapolation between snapshots, and report limitation.

Let me create tasks + messages. Also Lead sets up PlayerPrefs? Not needed.

Spawn/wake teammates via send_message (they're inactive). Use existing names: character-fx-dev, select-fullscreen, lobby-fullscreen.

Create tasks 23,24,25 first.

{"description":"目标：把手感拉向王者荣耀 —— ①移动中可普攻（走 A）；②技能加短前摇（施法期间减速、可被打断）。只改 scripts/entities/Hero.gd（如需新增字段可改 assets/Skill.gd）。

【A. 走 A（重点）】
- 现状：Hero.gd `_physics_process` 里只有 `move_vec≈0`（站定）的 else 分支才 `_perform_attack`（约 1623~1637 行）。移动中按住普攻/锁定目标完全不出手。
- 要求：把「目标获取 + 是否出手」从站定分支提到移动分支之前/共用（`_get_attack_target()`、`should_attack` 判定沿用：按住 ui_accept 或 TouchController.get_attack_held() 或 manual_target 有效或推塔/小兵模式），移动中若 `attack_timer<=0` 且无控制/无 `casting_skill` 也执行 `_perform_attack(target)` 并重置 `attack_timer=1.0/attack_speed`。
- 动画：现在移动分支每帧 `_play_anim("walk")` 会把攻击动作立刻覆盖。加 `var _aa_anim_until := 0.0`（`Time.get_ticks_msec()/1000.0` 或自增计时），`_perform_attack` 里设 `_aa_anim_until = now + clampf(0.6/attack_speed, 0.12, 0.30)`；移动分支只在 `now > _aa_anim_until` 时 `_play_anim("walk")`（攻击动作播完自动回 walk，继续移动不中断）。
- 不要破坏英雄专属强化普攻（马超/铠/后羿/元流之子、`_enhanced_aa_queued()`、`manual_target` 追击仅 AI 等既有分支）；玩家仍不自动追击（P1 再做）。
- 验收：探针里 `Input.action_press("ui_accept")` + `Input.action_press("ui_up")/("ui_right")` 持续 1.2s：打印玩家 `global_position` 在变化 AND 期间至少触发 2 次攻击（可用 `attack_timer` 或对木桩/小兵造成伤害/子弹计数验证）；停止移动后仍正常站桩普攻；BP→加载→开局冒烟正常。

【B. 技能前摇】
- 现状：`_start_casting()` 置 `casting_skill=true` 后下一物理帧 `_finish_casting()` 立刻出手（Skill.gd 里没有 cast_time 字段），移动中可施法且不减速。
- 要求：
  1) `assets/Skill.gd` 增加 `@export var cast_time: float = 0.0`。
  2) Hero.gd 加默认前摇表（按 type）：0 目标型 0.14s、1 范围 0.20s、3 线性 0.16s、4 位移 0.10s、6 护盾 0.10s；type 2/5、`is_channeling` 技能、以及沈梦溪/太乙真人/元流之子/马超 的专属多段技能保持 0（走原即时路径），避免破坏既有专属逻辑；若 skill.cast_time>0 以其为准。
  3) 实现：`_start_casting` 里若前摇>0 → 记 `_cast_windup_left`，`casting_skill=true`，本帧不出手；`_physics_process` 里 `if casting_skill:` 改为倒计时，归零才 `_finish_casting()`；前摇期间：移动速度 ×0.55（不要定死）、禁止普攻、预览/瞄准沿用现有。
  4) 打断：前摇期间受到 stun/knockup/froze/suppress/silence 或死亡 → 取消施法（清 casting_skill/pending_*、不扣蓝不进 CD、清预览）；`_finish_casting` 逻辑不动（扣蓝/进 CD/结算仍在那里）。
  5) 前摇期间重复按技能键忽略（不要重置 pending）。
- 验收（探针）：妲己 2 技能：按下→松手后 `casting_skill=true` 持续约 0.14~0.2s，蓝量与 CD 在 `_finish_casting` 之后才变化；前摇中 `stun_timer=0.5` 打断 → 蓝/CD 未变、技能未结算、无卡死（1s 后仍可正常施放）；正常施放能命中木桩；跑 1 局 BP→加载→开局 20s 冒烟 0 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call；`--net-test` 0 报错。

注意：Hero.gd 很大，改动最小化、别重排；LF/TAB 与原文件一致；探针临时文件用完删净（含 .uid）；不要弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + 走 A/前摇实测数字（前摇实测时长、打断结果、移动中攻击次数）+ 结论。","subject":"手感 P0-A：走 A + 技能前摇（Hero.gd）","write_scopes":["scripts/entities/Hero.gd","assets/Skill.gd"]}

{"description":"目标：桌面键鼠端镜头更接近王者/LoL 手感 —— 可自由看视野 + 跟随平滑。只改 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd。

现状：`_process` 里 `cam.global_position = hero.global_position + _follow_offset + cam_pan_offset`（约 3765~3771 行），**每帧硬设无平滑**；`cam_pan_offset` 只有手机右半屏拖拽（TouchController）在更新；桌面无任何拖视角手段；小地图拖拽/跳转是直接硬设相机（保持）。

要求：
1) **桌面自由视角**：中键（MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE）按住拖动 → 平移 `cam_pan_offset`（复用现有字段与 45m 上限；水平=屏幕 x 映射世界 x，垂直=屏幕 y 映射世界 z，方向与手机端一致，灵敏度约 60px/m）。松手后**保持偏移**（自由镜头），按 `Y` 键回正（`cam_pan_offset=Vector3.ZERO`）。
2) **平滑跟随**：正常跟随时用指数平滑 `cam.global_position = cam.global_position.lerp(target, 1.0 - exp(-12.0*delta))`；目标变化剧烈（>25m，如小地图跳转/复活传送）时直接硬设避免拖影。手机端相机手感和上限不变（手机拖拽仍走 `cam_pan_offset` 增量和松手回正 lerp 逻辑，别改行为）。
3) 桌面鼠标划到屏幕边缘时不要自动平移（避免误触）；只中键拖 + Y 回正。
4) 不引入设置面板；Y 键提示可在 HUD 不加（本轮只做功能）。
5) 别影响第一人称模式（first_person_view）、兰陵王隐身拉远、`_apply_camera_shake`、小地图拖拽/跳转、`hitstop`。

验收（windowed 探针）：
- 进对局后模拟中键按下 + `InputEventMouseMotion`（relative 200,0）→ 打印 `cam_pan_offset` 非零、`cam.global_position` 偏移约 3~4m；再按 Y → 偏移归零。
- 打印正常跟随相邻帧位移差：走 A 测试中镜头应平滑（相邻帧位置变化 < 硬设直跳，可打印 `cam.global_position` 序列前 10 帧）。
- 手机路径：`TouchController.camera_pan_active()` 逻辑不改（可 grep 确认未动）。
- 截图 screenshots/camera_free.png（中键拖动后的视野偏移，能看出英雄不在画面正中）。
- `battle.tscn --quit-after 300` 与 `--net-test` 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent；探针删净；不要弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + 实测偏移/平滑数字 + 截图 + 结论。","subject":"手感 P0-B：桌面自由镜头（中键拖动）+ 跟随平滑","write_scopes":["scripts/core/BattleManager.gd"]}

content.arguments:
{"description":"目标：联机手感不再"黏"——自己操控的英雄走位/普攻做客户端预测，快照只做校正；快照频率 15Hz→30Hz。只改 scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd 与 scripts/net/NetSession.gd（NetSession 仅改 SNAPSHOT_HZ，慎动协议）。

现状要点：
- NetSession.gd `SNAPSHOT_HZ := 15.0`（第 16 行附近）。
- NetClientBattle.gd：客户端每帧把 `_d_ax`（键盘轴）等作为 C_DRIVE 发主机；主机算完把全部实体的位置发快照（15Hz），客户端 `_on_snapshot` 后统一插值显示（约 357 行 `v.node.global_position = pa.lerp(pb, f)`）。自己英雄也被插值覆盖，因此有 100~200ms 延迟。
 
要求（保守、可回退）：
1) `NetSession.SNAPSHOT_HZ = 30.0`（带宽/CPU 观察 `--net-test` 日志无异常；若不能承受就 20.0 并说明）。
2) 客户端**本地预测自己英雄的移动**（只位置，伤害/技能结算仍以主机为准）：
   - 定位客户端"自己的英雄"节点（NetClientBattle 现有接管/`_assign`/`net_taken`/`peer` 字段里找；找不到就问 lead）。
   - 每 `_process`/`_physics_process` 用当前输入轴（`_d_ax`/摇杆）按 `hero.actual_move_speed * 0.01` 积分移动本机英雄的 `global_position`（保持 y；clamp 到地图 ±60；受到控制/死亡/回城中不做预测——可从快照状态 `is_dead`/`stun` 等字段或 hero 自身字段判断）。
   - 快照到达时校正：若预测位置与快照位置差 >3m → 直接吸附；否则向快照位置平滑靠拢（每帧 20%~35%），不要每帧硬设，避免拉扯。
   - 除自己英雄外，其它实体维持现有插值逻辑不变。
3) 输入发送：C_DRIVE 目前可能仅在变化时发；确保移动中至少 20Hz 持续发送（`_d_last` 已有，复用），否则主机侧会停。
4) 断言/护栏：预测只对"本机操控英雄"生效；观战/接管前不预测；退出战斗不残留。若实现后发现快照里没有可用状态字段，可只做"位置平滑校正 + 30Hz"，并在报告里说明。

验收：
- `battle.tscn --quit-after 300 -- --net-test` 与 `net_client.tscn --quit-after 300` 均 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent。
- 探针：客户端 hero 位置序列在接受快照后不再"跳变"（打印连续帧位移，最大单帧位移明显小于旧插值跳变，或预测与快照误差 <0.5m 收敛）；C_DRIVE 发送频率 ≥20Hz（计数 1 秒）。
- 若可行，单独跑一次 host+client（`--net-host`/`--net-join` 或 `--net-test` 内置双端）确认双端无报错。
- 不弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + SNAPSHOT_HZ、预测误差/发送频率实测 + 结论（做成了哪些、哪些留作后续）。","subject":"手感 P0-C：联机客户端预测 + 快照 30Hz","write_scopes":["scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd","scripts/net/NetSession.gd"]}

task.subject: 手感 P0-C：联机客户端预测 + 快照 30Hz
task.description:
目标：联机手感不再"黏"——自己操控的英雄走位/普攻做客户端预测，快照只做校正；快照频率 15Hz→30Hz。只改 scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd 与 scripts/net/NetSession.gd（NetSession 仅改 SNAPSHOT_HZ，慎动协议）。

现状要点：
- NetSession.gd `SNAPSHOT_HZ := 15.0`（第 16 行附近）。
- NetClientBattle.gd：客户端每帧把 `_d_ax`（键盘轴）等作为 C_DRIVE 发主机；主机算完把全部实体的位置发快照（15Hz），客户端 `_on_snapshot` 后统一插值显示（约 357 行 `v.node.global_position = pa.lerp(pb, f)`）。自己英雄也被插值覆盖，因此有 100~200ms 延迟。
 
要求（保守、可回退）：
1) `NetSession.SNAPSHOT_HZ = 30.0`（带宽/CPU 观察 `--net-test` 日志无异常；若不能承受就 20.0 并说明）。
2) 客户端**本地预测自己英雄的移动**（只位置，伤害/技能结算仍以主机为准）：
   - 定位客户端"自己的英雄"节点（NetClientBattle 现有接管/`_assign`/`net_taken`/`peer` 字段里找；找不到就问 lead）。
   - 每 `_process`/`_physics_process` 用当前输入轴（`_d_ax`/摇杆）按 `hero.actual_move_speed * 0.01` 积分移动本机英雄的 `global_position`（保持 y；clamp 到地图 ±60；受到控制/死亡/回城中不做预测——可从快照状态 `is_dead`/`stun` 等字段或 hero 自身字段判断）。
   - 快照到达时校正：若预测位置与快照位置差 >3m → 直接吸附；否则向快照位置平滑靠拢（每帧 20%~35%），不要每帧硬设，避免拉扯。
   - 除自己英雄外，其它实体维持现有插值逻辑不变。
3) 输入发送：C_DRIVE 目前可能仅在变化时发；确保移动中至少 20Hz 持续发送（`_d_last` 已有，复用），否则主机侧会停。
4) 断言/护栏：预测只对"本机操控英雄"生效；观战/接管前不预测；退出战斗不残留。若实现后发现快照里没有可用状态字段，可只做"位置平滑校正 + 30Hz"，并在报告里说明。

验收：
- `battle.tscn --quit-after 300 -- --net-test` 与 `net_client.tscn --quit-after 300` 均 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent。
- 探针：客户端 hero 位置序列在接受快照后不再"跳变"（打印连续帧位移，最大单帧位移明显小于旧插值跳变，或预测与快照误差 <0.5m 收敛）；C_DRIVE 发送频率 ≥20Hz（计数 1 秒）。
- 若可行，单独跑一次 host+client（`--net-host`/`--net-join` 或 `--net-test` 内置双端）确认双端无报错。
- 不弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + SNAPSHOT_HZ、预测误差/发送频率实测 + 结论（做成了哪些、哪些留作后续）。

task.subject: 手感 P0-B：桌面自由镜头（中键拖动）+ 跟随平滑
task.description:
目标：桌面键鼠端镜头更接近王者/LoL 手感 —— 可自由看视野 + 跟随平滑。只改 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd。

现状：`_process` 里 `cam.global_position = hero.global_position + _follow_offset + cam_pan_offset`（约 3765~3771 行），**每帧硬设无平滑**；`cam_pan_offset` 只有手机右半屏拖拽（TouchController）在更新；桌面无任何拖视角手段；小地图拖拽/跳转是直接硬设相机（保持）。

要求：
1) **桌面自由视角**：中键（MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE）按住拖动 → 平移 `cam_pan_offset`（复用现有字段与 45m 上限；水平=屏幕 x 映射世界 x，垂直=屏幕 y 映射世界 z，方向与手机端一致，灵敏度约 60px/m）。松手后**保持偏移**（自由镜头），按 `Y` 键回正（`cam_pan_offset=Vector3.ZERO`）。
2) **平滑跟随**：正常跟随时用指数平滑 `cam.global_position = cam.global_position.lerp(target, 1.0 - exp(-12.0*delta))`；目标变化剧烈（>25m，如小地图跳转/复活传送）时直接硬设避免拖影。手机端相机手感和上限不变（手机拖拽仍走 `cam_pan_offset` 增量和松手回正 lerp 逻辑，别改行为）。
3) 桌面鼠标划到屏幕边缘时不要自动平移（避免误触）；只中键拖 + Y 回正。
4) 不引入设置面板；Y 键提示可在 HUD 不加（本轮只做功能）。
5) 别影响第一人称模式（first_person_view）、兰陵王隐身拉远、`_apply_camera_shake`、小地图拖拽/跳转、`hitstop`。

验收（windowed 探针）：
- 进对局后模拟中键按下 + `InputEventMouseMotion`（relative 200,0）→ 打印 `cam_pan_offset` 非零、`cam.global_position` 偏移约 3~4m；再按 Y → 偏移归零。
- 打印正常跟随相邻帧位移差：走 A 测试中镜头应平滑（相邻帧位置变化 < 硬设直跳，可打印 `cam.global_position` 序列前 10 帧）。
- 手机路径：`TouchController.camera_pan_active()` 逻辑不改（可 grep 确认未动）。
- 截图 screenshots/camera_free.png（中键拖动后的视野偏移，能看出英雄不在画面正中）。
- `battle.tscn --quit-after 300` 与 `--net-test` 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent；探针删净；不要弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + 实测偏移/平滑数字 + 截图 + 结论。

task.subject: 手感 P0-A：走 A + 技能前摇（Hero.gd）
task.description:
目标：把手感拉向王者荣耀 —— ①移动中可普攻（走 A）；②技能加短前摇（施法期间减速、可被打断）。只改 scripts/entities/Hero.gd（如需新增字段可改 assets/Skill.gd）。

【A. 走 A（重点）】
- 现状：Hero.gd `_physics_process` 里只有 `move_vec≈0`（站定）的 else 分支才 `_perform_attack`（约 1623~1637 行）。移动中按住普攻/锁定目标完全不出手。
- 要求：把「目标获取 + 是否出手」从站定分支提到移动分支之前/共用（`_get_attack_target()`、`should_attack` 判定沿用：按住 ui_accept 或 TouchController.get_attack_held() 或 manual_target 有效或推塔/小兵模式），移动中若 `attack_timer<=0` 且无控制/无 `casting_skill` 也执行 `_perform_attack(target)` 并重置 `attack_timer=1.0/attack_speed`。
- 动画：现在移动分支每帧 `_play_anim("walk")` 会把攻击动作立刻覆盖。加 `var _aa_anim_until := 0.0`（`Time.get_ticks_msec()/1000.0` 或自增计时），`_perform_attack` 里设 `_aa_anim_until = now + clampf(0.6/attack_speed, 0.12, 0.30)`；移动分支只在 `now > _aa_anim_until` 时 `_play_anim("walk")`（攻击动作播完自动回 walk，继续移动不中断）。
- 不要破坏英雄专属强化普攻（马超/铠/后羿/元流之子、`_enhanced_aa_queued()`、`manual_target` 追击仅 AI 等既有分支）；玩家仍不自动追击（P1 再做）。
- 验收：探针里 `Input.action_press("ui_accept")` + `Input.action_press("ui_up")/("ui_right")` 持续 1.2s：打印玩家 `global_position` 在变化 AND 期间至少触发 2 次攻击（可用 `attack_timer` 或对木桩/小兵造成伤害/子弹计数验证）；停止移动后仍正常站桩普攻；BP→加载→开局冒烟正常。

【B. 技能前摇】
- 现状：`_start_casting()` 置 `casting_skill=true` 后下一物理帧 `_finish_casting()` 立刻出手（Skill.gd 里没有 cast_time 字段），移动中可施法且不减速。
- 要求：
  1) `assets/Skill.gd` 增加 `@export var cast_time: float = 0.0`。
  2) Hero.gd 加默认前摇表（按 type）：0 目标型 0.14s、1 范围 0.20s、3 线性 0.16s、4 位移 0.10s、6 护盾 0.10s；type 2/5、`is_channeling` 技能、以及沈梦溪/太乙真人/元流之子/马超 的专属多段技能保持 0（走原即时路径），避免破坏既有专属逻辑；若 skill.cast_time>0 以其为准。
  3) 实现：`_start_casting` 里若前摇>0 → 记 `_cast_windup_left`，`casting_skill=true`，本帧不出手；`_physics_process` 里 `if casting_skill:` 改为倒计时，归零才 `_finish_casting()`；前摇期间：移动速度 ×0.55（不要定死）、禁止普攻、预览/瞄准沿用现有。
  4) 打断：前摇期间受到 stun/knockup/froze/suppress/silence 或死亡 → 取消施法（清 casting_skill/pending_*、不扣蓝不进 CD、清预览）；`_finish_casting` 逻辑不动（扣蓝/进 CD/结算仍在那里）。
  5) 前摇期间重复按技能键忽略（不要重置 pending）。
- 验收（探针）：妲己 2 技能：按下→松手后 `casting_skill=true` 持续约 0.14~0.2s，蓝量与 CD 在 `_finish_casting` 之后才变化；前摇中 `stun_timer=0.5` 打断 → 蓝/CD 未变、技能未结算、无卡死（1s 后仍可正常施放）；正常施放能命中木桩；跑 1 局 BP→加载→开局 20s 冒烟 0 SCRIPT ERROR/Invalid call；`--net-test` 0 报错。

注意：Hero.gd 很大，改动最小化、别重排；LF/TAB 与原文件一致；探针临时文件用完删净（含 .uid）；不要弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + 走 A/前摇实测数字（前摇实测时长、打断结果、移动中攻击次数）+ 结论。

task.subject: 手感 P0-B：桌面自由镜头（中键拖动）+ 跟随平滑
task.description:
目标：桌面键鼠端镜头更接近王者/LoL 手感 —— 可自由看视野 + 跟随平滑。只改 scripts/core/BattleManager.gd。

现状：`_process` 里 `cam.global_position = hero.global_position + _follow_offset + cam_pan_offset`（约 3765~3771 行），**每帧硬设无平滑**；`cam_pan_offset` 只有手机右半屏拖拽（TouchController）在更新；桌面无任何拖视角手段；小地图拖拽/跳转是直接硬设相机（保持）。

要求：
1) **桌面自由视角**：中键（MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE）按住拖动 → 平移 `cam_pan_offset`（复用现有字段与 45m 上限；水平=屏幕 x 映射世界 x，垂直=屏幕 y 映射世界 z，方向与手机端一致，灵敏度约 60px/m）。松手后**保持偏移**（自由镜头），按 `Y` 键回正（`cam_pan_offset=Vector3.ZERO`）。
2) **平滑跟随**：正常跟随时用指数平滑 `cam.global_position = cam.global_position.lerp(target, 1.0 - exp(-12.0*delta))`；目标变化剧烈（>25m，如小地图跳转/复活传送）时直接硬设避免拖影。手机端相机手感和上限不变（手机拖拽仍走 `cam_pan_offset` 增量和松手回正 lerp 逻辑，别改行为）。
3) 桌面鼠标划到屏幕边缘时不要自动平移（避免误触）；只中键拖 + Y 回正。
4) 不引入设置面板；Y 键提示可在 HUD 不加（本轮只做功能）。
5) 别影响第一人称模式（first_person_view）、兰陵王隐身拉远、`_apply_camera_shake`、小地图拖拽/跳转、`hitstop`。

验收（windowed 探针）：
- 进对局后模拟中键按下 + `InputEventMouseMotion`（relative 200,0）→ 打印 `cam_pan_offset` 非零、`cam.global_position` 偏移约 3~4m；再按 Y → 偏移归零。
- 打印正常跟随相邻帧位移差：走 A 测试中镜头应平滑（相邻帧位置变化 < 硬设直跳，可打印 `cam.global_position` 序列前 10 帧）。
- 手机路径：`TouchController.camera_pan_active()` 逻辑不改（可 grep 确认未动）。
- 截图 screenshots/camera_free.png（中键拖动后的视野偏移，能看出英雄不在画面正中）。
- `battle.tscn --quit-after 300` 与 `--net-test` 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent；探针删净；不要弹通知。完成后 send_message 给 lead：摘要 + 实测偏移/平滑数字 + 截图 + 结论。

content.text: Team message from lobby-fullscreen:

task-25 完成（改动仅 2 文件）。

改动
1) `NetSession.gd`：`SNAPSHOT_HZ 15.0 → 30.0`（唯一改动，协议未动）。
2) `NetClientBattle.gd`：
   - 新增预测字段 `_pred_on/_pred_pos/_pred_snap/_pred_speed/_pred_sp_pos/_pred_sp_t/_pred_err`；`_process` 在原有插值循环之后调 `_tick_self_prediction(delta)`，只覆盖**本机英雄**位置（其它实体插值逻辑一行未动）。
   - 积分公式对齐主机 `Hero._physics_process`：`pos += dir.normalized() * speed * 0.01 * delta`，clamp ±MAP_SIZE/2（±60）；方向映射与主机直驱一致（摇杆 `(jx,0,-jy)` 优先，键盘 DIR 模式 `(ax,0,-az)`，TURN 模式沿 node 朝向 ×az）。
   - 客户端没有 `actual_move_speed`（hero 是纯 Node3D 模型），改为**快照位移自校准** `_calibrate_pred_speed`（相邻快照位移/0.01Δt，过滤 <150 或 >700 的静止/闪现异常值，初始 380）。
   - 校正：与最新快照位置误差 >3m 直接吸附；否则每帧按 `clamp(delta*12, 0.20, 0.35)` 向快照平滑靠拢（不硬设）。
   - 门禁：`_owned && _state==1 && _self_net>=0 && node 有效 && own.alive==1 && own.recalling==0`；并额外要求 `_pad != null && TouchController.touch_active`（与 `_poll_touch_input` 同门禁）。不加这条时实测会出现"本地动、主机不动"的幽灵位移：桌面端 `touch_active` 默认 false，直驱输入根本不发送。
   - `_reset_drive_state()` 复位 `_pred_on/_pred_err`（退出/重连不残留）。
   - C_DRIVE 移动心跳 0.2s → **0.03s**（≥20Hz）。
   - 顺带清掉一行外部遗留：`_rp.own = _own`（NetRosterPanel 13:22 重写后已无 `own` 属性，客户端每帧快照刷一条 `Invalid assignment ... (NetRosterPanel)`，实测 78 条/局；删掉后 0 条。若 roster 那边还要 `own` 请让他们加回属性再恢复该行）。

实测（真双端：host `battle.tscn --headless -- --net-host 7000 --net-test` + 客户端探针 `--net-join`，真实 takeover，hero=马超 net_id=2）
- 输入→位移响应：**1 帧**（约 25fps 下 40ms；旧路径需等快照+插值窗口 ≥100ms）。
- 移动：1.60s 位移 6.08m = 3.80m/s，与 `_pred_speed 378 * 0.01 = 3.78` 吻合；单帧位移 avg 0.115m / max 0.296m（客户端 25fps：3.78/25=0.151 为理论值，实测吻合 → 无插值跳变）。
- 预测误差：avg **0.115m**、max **0.897m**，全部远低于 3m 吸附阈值；松手 0.7s 后 err **0.001m**（收敛到权威位置）。
- C_DRIVE：35 次 / 1.60s = **21.8Hz**（客户端 25fps 上限内达标；60fps 时约 30Hz）。
- 快照频率：配置 30Hz（interval 33.3ms），客户端观测 19.3Hz / 均值间隔 53.6ms。原因：主机 `_snap_timer` 每帧只减 delta、到点重设为 1 个 interval → 受主机帧率量化；本机 headless 主机单独跑 600 帧/15.9s = **37.7fps** → 33.3ms/26.5ms = 2 帧一次 = 18.9Hz。主机 60fps 时才是 30Hz（旧 15Hz 在 37fps 下实际只有 ~12.6Hz，已提升约 50%）。
- 结论：预测 + 平滑校正**做成了**；30Hz 已配置但因主机帧率量化未跑满，若要低帧主机也逼近 30Hz 需要 1 行改动（`_snap_timer = maxf(_snap_timer + SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL, 0.0)`，累加而非重设，仍在 NetSession 内、非协议改动）——因你限定「NetSession 仅改 SNAPSHOT_HZ」我没有擅改，等你点头或列入后续。
- 状态字段说明：快照/own 里**没有**眩晕/击飞等控制字段（只有 `alive`、`recalling`），故死亡/回城不预测，被控期间靠 3m 吸附 + 平滑校正吸收（瞬时视觉差 <1m），要彻底解决需 host 在 own 里补 cc 标记 → 后续可做。
- 双端 0 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent；`battle.tscn --quit-after 300 -- --net-test` exit 0 无错误；`net_client.tscn --quit-after 300` exit 0 无错误。
- 说明：首次跑 battle 时报 `_cancel_cast_windup not found` 等，是并行队友当时正在写 `Hero.gd` 的瞬时半成品，重跑即消失，与本次改动无关。
- 探针已删净（_probe_pred.gd/.tscn/.uid）；未弹通知。文件换行保持原样（NetClientBattle/NetSession 本来就是 CRLF，未混入 LF）。

现状要点：
- NetSession.gd `SNAPSHOT_HZ := 15.0`（第 16 行附近）。
- NetClientBattle.gd：客户端每帧把 `_d_ax`（键盘轴）等作为 C_DRIVE 发主机；主机算完把全部实体的位置发快照（15Hz），客户端 `_on_snapshot` 后统一插值显示（约 357 行 `v.node.global_position = pa.lerp(pb, f)`）。自己英雄也被插值覆盖，因此有 100~200ms 延迟。
 
要求（保守、可回退）：
1) `NetSession.SNAPSHOT_HZ = 30.0`（带宽/CPU 观察 `--net-test` 日志无异常；若不能承受就 20.0 并说明）。
2) 客户端**本地预测自己英雄的移动**（只位置，伤害/技能结算仍以主机为准）：
   - 定位客户端"自己的英雄"节点（NetClientBattle 现有接管/`_assign`/`net_taken`/`peer` 字段里找；找不到就问 lead）。

   - 快照到达时校正：若预测位置与快照位置差 >3m → 直接吸附；否则向快照位置平滑靠拢（每帧 20%~35%），不要每帧硬设，避免拉扯。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.
