summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Long-running HonorKing (Honor of Kings–style 3D MOBA, Godot 4.7.2, GDScript) polish project; many batches already shipped/verified (spell FX, UI parity, fullscreen lobby/select/results, BP, loading screen, 分路, net play, feel P0).
- Completed earlier: feel P0 (走A, 技能前摇, desktop free camera, net client prediction + 30Hz snapshots); 28-hero skill-animation audit; P0 animation/FX batch (12 signature ults, cast-anim slot branching + replay + cast_charge alignment, per-slot bullet shapes).
- Then: “李元芳技能效果优化：1技能需要真的给敌人挂上飞镖，飞镖将绕敌人旋转；2技能的视觉效果也需要优化” → delivered (orbiting mark darts + 刃遁 visuals).
- Then: “甄姬的冰柱和妲己的1技能视觉效果也需要优化，比如妲己的一技能的挥波形状应该是半月形并带有拖尾” → delivered (ice-pillar array rework + crescent wave with trail).
- Current request: “安琪拉大招也需要优化，孙尚香的2技能和鲁班的1技能也需要优化，这两个技能都丢的是手榴弹” → optimize 安琪拉 R (炽热光辉 beam), 孙尚香 W (红莲爆弹 grenade), 鲁班七号 Q (河豚手雷 grenade).

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable, `rendering_method="mobile"`, virtual canvas 2400×1400, `canvas_items` stretch, `UiKit.scale()`.
- Autoloads: `Config, UiKit, ItemDatabase, SkillDatabase, GameManager, UiManager, CollisionSystem, PathFinder, TouchController, NetSession, SfxManager, Vfx, PostFX`.
- Skill pipeline: `_start_casting` → `_cast_feedback` (+`Vfx.cast_charge`) → windup → `_finish_casting` (mana/CD/effect + `Vfx.play_spell`); `SkillDatabase.apply_skills(hero, skill_id 1/2/3, pos)` is the effect dispatch entry (6978-line file).
- `Vfx.play_spell(hero_name, slot, caster_pos, target_pos, skill, facing, is_local)`: non-signature → type/element generic (`_burst`, `telegraph`, `beam`, `dash_fx`, `cast_glow`, `hit_spark`, `_spawn_skill_prop`); signature ults via `SpellFxTable.ULTS` (28/28).
- `_spawn_skill_prop(hero_name, slot, ...)` → `SpellFxTable.get_prop`: `"甄姬": {0: "ice_pillars", 1: "ice_crystal"}`, `"王昭君": {0: "ice_crystal", 1: "ice_pillars"}`; prop builders `fan_fx/tornado_fx/ice_pillars_fx/ice_crystal_fx/swords_fx/orbs_fx/sun_orb_fx`; caps `MAX_PROPS=10`, `MAX_TRAILS=24`, `PROP_RANGE=30`.
- `BulletVisual`: `vkind = 100 + raw*16 + palette`; skill bullets `raw=20+slot*12+(shape-1)`; slot2 size ×1.25 (1.8125), trail ×2.0/life ×2.1; AA raw = shape 1..12.
- `Bullet.gd` hit detection is distance-based (`global_position.distance_to`, `radius+body_radius`), not physics — dummy `set_physics_process(false)` still takes bullet hits.
- Net: `NetSession` FX kinds 1..8, 20..22 (`FX_LYF_STORM=7` etc.) pushed by position only; follow-target orbit visuals are host-only (no net sync yet).
- Verification: `& $godot --headless --path . --editor --quit`; temp `_probe_*.gd/.tscn` (delete with `.uid`); `--quit-after`; `--net-test`; windowed screenshot probes.
- Godot binary: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`; workspace `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king`.
- Known-benign noise: `Class "Minimap" hides a global script class` + `Failed to load script "res://scripts/ui/Minimap.gd" ... Parse error`; `Condition "!is_inside_tree()"`; `user://` log/root-cert errors; VSync warning.

## Files and Code
- `scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd` (~1530+ lines): added LYF orbit system `_lyf_orbits` dict + `LYF_DART_COL/COL2`, `lyf_dart_sync(target, darts, life, color)` (line 1343), `lyf_dart_clear` (1381), `_lyf_make_dart` (1392), `_lyf_orbit_free`, `_process` (1434) rotating darts; earlier `cast_charge(..., slot, duration)`; `dash_fx` (793), `attach_trail` (525 returns GPUParticles3D, needs node in tree), `beam` (490), `hit_spark` (94), `cast_burst` (86), `shockwave` (482), `cast_glow` (131), `sigil` (679), `_prop_mat` (870), `_fan_mesh` (~884), new `_crescent_mesh` (906), `crescent_wave(bullet, dir, color, width)` (938), reworked `ice_pillars_fx` (1065) + `_ice_shatter` (1168).
- `scripts/entities/GameEntity.gd`: `lyf_marks` dict, `LYF_MARK_RADIUS=1.6`, `MAX_STACKS=4`, `LYF_MARK_CD=4.0`; `lyf_cast_mark` (358) / `lyf_add_mark` (364) now call `_lyf_dart_visual(count, life)` (new helper, line 380); `lyf_detonate` (384) calls `Vfx.lyf_dart_clear(self, true)`; mark expiry loop tick at ~505-509; on-hit mark add at ~780 (`source.display_name=="李元芳" and not is_magic and skill_id==0`).
- `assets/SkillDataBase.gd`: 李元芳 `_lyf_q` (~2619) adds throw visual (`Vfx.beam` + `hit_spark`) after `tgt.lyf_cast_mark`; `_lyf_w` (~2652) adds `vcol`, local check, wheel trail, `dash_fx`, `cast_burst`, `shockwave`, `hit_spark`, layered burn trail (glow box + scorch box + fade tweens), ember sparks per 2 ticks, `scorch.queue_free()` cleanup; 妲己 Q (~1060-1070) now `hero.get_parent().add_child(d1_bullet)` then `Vfx.crescent_wave(d1_bullet, d1_dir, Color(1.0,0.42,0.62), 5.0)` (old box visual removed); 甄姬 Q dispatch starts ~490 (`create_preview` → 0.75s → `create_terrain` etc.).
- 甄姬 skill defs `:3171-3187` (`zhenji_q/w/r`); 妲己 defs `:3373-3387`; 孙尚香 defs `:3263-3280`; 鲁班七号 defs `:3400-3416`; 安琪拉 defs `:3347-3362`.
- 安琪拉 dispatch `:976-1000` (`"安琪拉":match skill_id:` — a2 bullet with `angela_w=true`, `angela_w_level`, `angela_w_timer=3.0`); R def `angela_r` type3, range 10, duration 3.0, cast_time 0.28 (line ~3328).
- 孙尚香 dispatch `:124`; `sunshangxiang_w` def ~3274 (2技能, grenade).
- 鲁班七号 dispatch `:1232-1297` (Q/W/R, `luban_skill_enhanced`, `luban_w_knockback`, `luban_r_active`); `luban_q` def ~3405 (1技能 grenade).
- `scripts/core/SpellFxTable.gd`: `ULTS` 28 entries, `SKILL_PROPS` (`甄姬`, `王昭君`, 小乔 fan, etc.), `get_skill_shape(skill)` type→zone/line/dash/aura/channel.
- Screenshots delivered: `screenshots/skill_fx_p1.png`, `screenshots/lyf_skill_fx.png`, `screenshots/ice_crescent_fx.png`.
- `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` 5 `cast_time` entries: 沈梦溪 R 0.32 (:3302), 安琪拉 R 0.28 (:3328), 后羿 R 0.30 (:3415), 大禹 R 0.36 (:3432), 王昭君 R 0.40 (:3451).
- `scripts/entities/Hero.gd`: `_cast_anim_name` slot branching (~3285), `_restart_anim` (~3328), `_cast_feedback` (~3339), `_cast_anim_until` gate (~1636), `_lyf_burrow` (~323, tick 1509).

## Errors and Fixes
- Probe hang: script parse failed (`SpellFxTable` not global) → use `Vfx.SPELL_FX`; root scene failed → no quit.
- 走A probe measured `target=false/hits=0`: dummy out of range and no manual target → `hero.set_manual_target(dummy)` + reposition dummy each frame; count attack via `attack_timer` increase; counted bullets via group `projectiles`.
- 走A dummy `set_physics_process(false)` breaks nothing for bullets (distance-based), but hp-only counting under-counts.
- `lyf_dart` trail missing: `attach_trail` called before node in tree (`get_tree()==null` → returns null) → move `Vfx.crescent_wave` after `hero.get_parent().add_child(bullet)`.
- Trails counted 0 due to `CPUParticles3D` check; actual class is `GPUParticles3D`.
- Multi-line lambda in `tween_callback` risky → replaced with `_ice_shatter.bind(...)` helper.
- Probe duplicate spawn every frame (missing `spawned` flag) → guard added; eventually clean run.
- Concurrent external edits: `Turret.gd` mid-write caused transient `Could not parse global class "Turret"`; recovered on rerun. Avoid `scripts/ui/MinimapDraw.gd`, `UI_Manager.gd`, `scripts/mobile/TouchController.gd` unless needed.

## Pending Jobs
- 安琪拉 R visual optimization (beam/炽热光辉 signature).
- 孙尚香 2技能 (红莲爆弹 grenade) visual optimization.
- 鲁班七号 1技能 (河豚手雷 grenade) visual optimization.
- Then: parse → probe (grenade flight/explosion, Angela beam) → windowed screenshot → smoke (`battle --quit-after 400`, `--net-test`, `net_client`) → delete probes → notify → concise Chinese report with anchors/numbers/screenshot.

## Current Work
- Just finished 甄姬冰柱 + 妲己 1 技能 batch: parse clean (only Minimap warning), smoke 0 errors, screenshot `screenshots/ice_crescent_fx.png`, probes deleted, notification sent, delivered.
- Started new request: located relevant code anchors only (see Files) — no edits yet for 安琪拉 R / 孙尚香 W / 鲁班 Q.
- Planned approach: grenades need a shared `Vfx` helper, e.g. `grenade_fx`/`grenade_attach(bullet, ...)` building a spinning faceted sphere/can with fuse spark + arc trail + ground shadow bubble, explosion ring + smoke + shrapnel; both heroes share it (孙尚香 W, 鲁班 Q); 安琪拉 R likely needs beam upgrade — currently generic `beam` via type3, may need sustained multi-beam/fire column, embers, heat distortion, ground scorch, plus camera FOV/hitstop.

## Next Step
- Read current 孙尚香 W and 鲁班七号 Q implementations (SkillDataBase ~120-200 and ~1232-1300) and 安琪拉 R block (~976-1000), then implement visuals (shared grenade helper in `VfxFactory.gd` + per-skill call sites), preserving damage/CC logic.

## Critical Context
- User writes Chinese; wants conclusion-first, terse reports with file links + measured numbers; Windows notification before delivery: `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`.
- Minimal diffs, no stray probe files; Lead does work directly (avoid spawning agents unless parallel gain).
- Visuals are local-only (host); clients don't see new grenade/dart visuals without new NetSession FX kinds — mention as limitation.
- Keep damage/CC unchanged; only `Vfx`/dispatch visual code.
- Grenade semantics: 孙尚香 W (`sunshangxiang_w`) throw to target point with AoE slow/damage; 鲁班 Q (`luban_q`) throw, enhanced auto after cast (`luban_skill_enhanced`), knockback on W only.
- 安琪拉 R (`angela_r`): type 3 line, range 10, duration 3.0, cast_time 0.28, magic damage channel-like beam.
- External process occasionally edits workspace files; re-check parse before/after edits; if parse breaks on unrelated file, wait/reparse.
- Skill clip mapping: 安琪拉/妲己/甄姬 etc. in `CAST_ANIM_TWOHAND`; ults use twohand `holding-both` clip; `shake/heavy` in `SpellFxTable.ULTS` consumed only by `BattleManager.on_big_cast` for local player.
- Audit numbers reusable: 85 hero skills; shape distribution zone 27/line 26/bolt 24/dash 6/aura 2; 28/28 signature ults; only 小乔 has sfx overrides; element counts fire 8, shadow 6, blade 4, holy 4, water 2, earth 2, wind 1, ice 1.

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

Key finding: direct on_hit() at dummy position → hp 999919→999503 = 416 damage ✓. So AoE damage logic works; the issue is arrival detection in flight: bullet passes goal y mismatch or tolerance. We tested goal y=1.0 and bullet pos y=1.0; but still after flight hp lost only 80 (test dmg) in previous run BEFORE we added direct on_hit. Actually in t2 (goal y=1) hp lost 80, meaning flight on_hit not triggered. But bullet freed by f+60. Why no arrival? distance check maybe bullet overshoots: speed*delta=0.166 per frame; arrival threshold 0.4; should trigger.

Unless bullet's `_physics_process` not running? Bullet is Area3D child of map; but if bullet added while `hero.get_parent()` is... it is added; process default true.

Wait bullet freed by f+60: could have been freed because source invalid? no.

Hmm: in t2 the bullet was created but probe called `pr.on_hit()` only in t3 version. In t2 we didn't find projectile at f+60 (proj_total 0) → freed. Could be freed by arrival → on_hit called at position, but AoE loop `if entity == target: continue` — target null. So damage should happen as t3 shows.

But t3: after direct on_hit at init hp 999503; later stage1 hp lost 496 = 416+80 → means flight on_hit did NOT damage (only my direct call + test dmg). So arrival on_hit apparently not called; bullet freed by something else.

What frees goal bullets? Let's search for queue_free in goal branch... only arrival. Or `life_time` default maybe 1.0? create_bullet may set life_time based on distance/speed; check end of create_bullet around line 2410-2440.

Actually simpler: bullet could hit `hero` himself? no.

Maybe bullet is freed because it collides via `_physics_process` with `if goal != Vector3.ZERO` then after moving, `if global_position.distance_to(goal) < 0.4 and source:` — in t2 goal y=1.0 but bullet global y? printed pos y=1.0 at init. Both 1.0. Distance after moving 6m → should trigger.

Unless `speed` isn't 10 for 鲁班 Q: default create_bullet speed maybe 20? Then movement 0.33/frame; 6m in 18 frames, arrival check after move: overshoot? At frame 18 pos moves 6.0 → dist 0 <0.4 ✓.

But maybe speed is huge (e.g., 35 for skill?) — still hit.

So why freed without damage? Could `queue_free` due to `life_time <= 0` quickly (life_time maybe 0.5?). Let's read create_bullet defaults at 2400-2440.

三个技能的特效都已完成，并且顺手修掉了“落点不引爆”的根因。

**安琪拉 R · 炽热光辉**
- 原来是一根半透明圆柱，现在换成一套能量光束：外层柔光柱 + 白热内核 + 2 条绕轴旋转的光带 + 端头脉动光球 + 枪口光 + 点光源；光束根部每 tick 跟随英雄，方向锁定不变；3 秒结束后用 0.25s 淡出，而不是直接消失（[VfxFactory.gd:1794](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L1794)、[SkillDataBase.gd:1027](assets/SkillDataBase.gd#L1027)）。伤害/护盾/霸体逻辑未动。

**孙尚香 2 · 红莲爆弹**（[SkillDataBase.gd:150](assets/SkillDataBase.gd#L150)）
- 弹体：暗红球形炸弹 + 两道发光束带 + 四片莲瓣 + 闪烁引信 + 自旋；按落点距离估算飞行时间做视觉抛物线；挂元素拖尾。
- 落地：3m 落点预警圈；火焰新星（冲击环 + 双层余烬爆点 + 火光）+ 贴地焦痕 1.3s 渐隐。

**鲁班七号 1 · 河豚手雷**（[SkillDataBase.gd:1233](assets/SkillDataBase.gd#L1233)）
- 弹体：青绿河豚（10 根尖刺 + 两只眼睛）+ 闪烁引信 + 自旋 + 抛物线 + 拖尾。
- 落地：水花四溅 + 泡泡 + 青墨色冲击环 + 焦痕。

**共用能力**：`Vfx.grenade_attach / grenade_impact / angela_beam / fade_out`（[VfxFactory.gd:1638](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L1638)、[VfxFactory.gd:1755](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L1755)、[VfxFactory.gd:1881](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L1881)）；`Bullet.on_hit` 用 meta 触发专属爆炸（[Bullet.gd:421](scripts/entities/Bullet.gd#L421)）。

**顺手修的 bug**：落点弹用 3D 距离判定，但弹体出生在 y=1、地面落点 y=0，永远差 1m → 孙尚香 2/鲁班 1 这类技能飞到落点却不引爆。改为水平距离判定（[Bullet.gd:243](scripts/entities/Bullet.gd#L243)）后实测：孙尚香 2 对木桩 304 伤害、鲁班 1 对木桩 416 伤害，爆炸表现正常触发。

**验证**：解析 0 错（仅已知 Minimap 警告）；战斗 400 帧 smoke 0 SCRIPT ERROR；headless 探针确认红莲弹体 8 个网格 / 河豚 14 个网格、光束 4 层网格、引导结束正确淡出；截图 `screenshots/grenade_fly_luban.png`、`grenade_boom_luban.png`、`grenade_fly_ssx.png`、`grenade_boom_ssx.png`、`angela_beam.png`。探针文件已清理。

限制：和上批一样，新弹体/爆炸表现只在本机（host）可见，联机客户端仍是通用弹道（未新增 NetSession FX kind）。

Net client has its own `_draw_attr_panel` (custom draw) and score strip. Updating net parity fully = more work: net attr panel drawn bottom-left with comment host position; we changed host; net should move under minimap too. Also net FPS add in score strip easily (`draw_string` "FPS x" at left). But net is a separate client UI; user likely tests single player. Given time budget, I'll do host only, but also update NetRecommendBar geometry for "推荐装备在金币下方" consistency (cheap), and net attr panel/FPS maybe cheap as well?

Net attr panel: `_draw_attr_panel` draws at top = size.y-385-panel_h (bottom-left). To move under minimap: net minimap? NetMiniMap position maybe 40..340? Check NetMiniMap size. If yes, change top = 350 and add collapsed toggle? Net has no collapse toggle (always draws panel when sa has data?). It draws full panel. Moving it under minimap would overlap? It's always expanded — top 350, height ~400 → bottom 750, fine, no joystick overlap (net touchpad bottom). Good, consistent.

Net FPS: in `_draw_score_strip`, add text at e.g. `Vector2(cx-150, 8+st+ascent(20))`? Space under time. But net score strip rect height 188; add FPS at left below clock: `Vector2(cx - 150, 8+st+ascent(30)+6)` font 18. Hmm might collide with nothing.

But do we want to touch NetClientBattle (~3674 lines, custom draw)? Risk parse errors but manageable; benefit consistency. The user asked "屏幕顶部信息面板" possibly main game only. Prior tasks were host-focused; net client is secondary. But leaving net inconsistent may be noticed in net play only.

Decision: implement host now, verify; then if time cheap, update net recommend bar geometry + net attr panel top + net FPS. Since these are simple coordinate changes/draw calls, do them after host verification.

Also mobile HUD? `scripts/mobile/TouchController.gd` may host another HUD? It's touch controls only.

Now host parse & then visual screenshot verify layout. Need windowed screenshot of HUD: could run battle start and capture at game start (no cast). Write probe similar to before, screenshot after ~2s.

But before, check `team_stats_bg` has size 460x144, fps child pos y50..74; band may have children? team_stats_bg only panel background; yes.

Wait: is the band actually drawn as panel style with rounded corners; child label at left. Fine.

Potential overlap issue: time_chip is a separate Panel from y8..52 spanning center-140..center+110; FPS at center-140..center-20 y56..80 directly below clock; team_stats_label y82..142. OK.

Another thought: Is `fps_label` occluded by `time_chip` panel? No vertical overlap.

Now parse + screenshot. Screenshot probe: start body, wait 120 frames, save "hud_fps_recommend_attr.png". Need recommended equip card visible (requires hero gold/rec data), likely shows after some time. Attribute collapsed bar under minimap visible. FPS label visible in band.

Write probe via pwsh (write tool had stale issues for new files; use pwsh Set-Content). Then run windowed console, capture, analyze pixel? Can't view image. Hmm—no image reading available. Verification limited to node geometry probes: check positions/sizes via headless probe:
- fps_label exists, team_stats_bg rect contains it, text matches "FPS %d".
- rec_card.offset_top == 53 and gold_chip bottom 45 (need gold chip ref not stored; can find via type? gold_label parent is chip).
- attribute_panel position (40,350), collapsed width 300, height ~44; toggle expands downward: call toggle, verify y unchanged, height grows (~448), header arrow "▴".
- Verify minimap bottom = 340 (from BattleManager minimap).

That's solid without images. Also screenshot for user deliverable anyway.

{"command":"cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; $py='C:\Users\18749\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe'; $code = @'
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open("screenshots/hud_fps_gold_attr.png").convert("RGB")
W,H = im.size
print("size", W, H)
regions = {
 "band_fps": (1060,56,1180,82),
 "rec_card": (1990,53,2380,137),
 "attr_bar": (40,350,340,395),
 "minimap": (40,40,340,340),
}
for name,(x0,y0,x1,y1) in regions.items():
    crop = im.crop((x0,y0,min(x1,W),min(y1,H)))
    px = list(crop.getdata()); n=len(px)
    mean = tuple(sum(c[i] for c in px)//n for i in range(3))
    green = sum(1 for r,g,b in px if g>150 and g>r+30)

content.text:
New task: 完善各种攻击击中特效，包括小兵和防御塔的普攻 (improve hit effects for various attacks, including minions and turrets' basic attacks).

Current state: `Bullet.on_hit` only spawns `Vfx.hit_spark` when `source is Hero and (target is Hero or Turret or JungleMonster)`. So minion/tower projectiles hitting anything, and hero attacks hitting minions, have minimal/no hit FX. Need:
- Hit FX for all attack sources: minion, turret, jungle monster? (jungle monsters melee?), hero→minion.
- Melee hits: Hero melee attacks (近战) — where is melee damage applied? In Hero._perform_attack instant damage → no hit FX? Need check.
- Turret attacks: Turret.gd spawns bullets with source=turret? Check Turret attack code.
- Minion attacks: Minion.gd spawns bullets (ranged minions) or melee instant.
- Impact types: physical vs magic; crit; armor pen; different targets (hero/tower/minion/monster); tower hit on hero maybe larger spark + screen shake?

Plan:
1. Inspect current `Vfx.hit_spark` implementation and existing hit FX ones (cast_burst, muzzle, etc.).
2. Inspect attack paths:
   - Bullet.on_hit (all projectile attacks incl minion/tower bullets).
   - Hero._perform_attack melee instant damage.
   - Turret.gd attack (may call bullet only).
   - Minion.gd attack (instant melee?).
   - JungleMonster attack.
3. Design shared `Vfx.impact_fx(pos, dir, color, power, is_magic, target_type)` that scales by attacker class:
   - Hero AA on hero: existing hit_spark (keep/upgrade).
   - Hero AA on minion: small spark + debris dust.
   - Minion AA: small dust/spark, color by minion type (melee/ranged/siege), no budget blow.
   - Turret AA: heavier beam impact: bright ring + sparks + turret color (blue/red), maybe ground scorch small.
   - Crits: bigger flash + text? UI damage popup exists.
   - Magic AA (some heroes? e.g. 干将? not needed) — color by source hero element color.
   - Tower being hit: metallic sparks + shield flash.
   - Jungle monster hits: claw/bite? maybe blood-ish dust.
4. Performance: many minion attacks → limit particle counts; reuse existing `_burst` with quality caps; per-frame budget already in Vfx? Check MAX_PARTICLES/budget.

Also "各种攻击" includes skill bullets? Already have hit_spark for skills on heroes. Maybe improve overall: differentiate hit effects by magic/physical and target.

Let me inspect VfxFactory relevant functions and attack code paths.

		target_kind: String = "hero", source_kind: String = "hero", crit: bool = false) -> void:

		target_kind: String = "hero", source_kind: String = "hero", crit: bool = false) -> void:
	if quality <= 0: return

			_flash(pos, c2, 0.30*sf, 0.10)

			if crit:
				_burst(Color(1,0.95,0.7), Color(1,1,1), pos, 6, 0.28, 0.34*sf, 7.5, d, 75.0, 7.0, true)

func _impact_flash(pos: Vector3, color: Color, size: float, dur: float) -> void:
	if quality <= 0 or get_tree() == null or _near_limit(1): return
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var sm := SphereMesh.new(); sm.radius = size; sm.height = size*1.8; sm.radial_segments = 8; sm.rings = 4
	mi.mesh = sm
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	mat.albedo_color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.95)
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = color
	mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 3.0
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	mi.position = pos
	mi.add_to_group(GROUP_FX)
	_add_root(mi)
	var tw := mi.create_tween()
	tw.set_parallel(true)
	tw.tween_property(mi, "scale", Vector3(1.8,1.8,1.8), dur)
	tw.tween_property(mat, "albedo_color:a", 0.0, dur)
	tw.chain().tween_callback(mi.queue_free)

func _near_local(pos: Vector3, dist: float) -> bool:
	if get_tree() == null: return false
	var bm := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
	if bm == null or bm.hero == null: return true
	return pos.distance_to(bm.hero.global_position) <= dist

func hit_impact(pos: Vector3, dir: Vector3, c1: Color, c2: Color, scale_f: float = 1.0,
		target_kind: String = "hero", source_kind: String = "hero", crit: bool = false) -> void:
	if quality <= 0 or get_tree() == null: return
	var near := _near_local(pos, 30.0)
	if not near and (source_kind != "hero" or target_kind == "minion"): return
	if _near_limit(1): return
	var d := dir.normalized() if dir.length() > 0.01 else Vector3.UP
	var sf := maxf(0.4, scale_f)
	match target_kind:
		"tower", "crystal":
			_burst(c1, Color(1.0,0.98,0.9), pos, int(9.0*sf), 0.32, 0.30*sf, 7.5, d, 65.0, 10.0, true)
			_impact_flash(pos, c2, 0.45*sf, 0.12)
			_ring(Vector3(pos.x, pos.y - 0.6, pos.z), 0.9*sf, c1, 0.22, 1.5)
			if near: _light(pos, c1, 1.6*sf, 0.10)
		"minion":
			_burst(c1, Color(0.85,0.8,0.68), pos, int(4.0*sf), 0.26, 0.26*sf, 4.6, d, 60.0, 8.0, true)
			_burst(Color(0.55,0.5,0.4), Color(0.72,0.66,0.55), pos, 2, 0.34, 0.30*sf, 1.2, Vector3.UP, 40.0, -1.0)
		"monster":
			_burst(c1, c2, pos, int(5.0*sf), 0.28, 0.30*sf, 5.5, d, 60.0, 9.0, true)
			_burst(Color(0.42,0.35,0.24), Color(0.55,0.48,0.34), pos, 2, 0.36, 0.32*sf, 1.4, Vector3.UP, 45.0, -0.8)
		_:
			_burst(c1, c2, pos, int((7.0 if crit else 5.5)*sf), 0.28, 0.28*sf, 6.6, d, 70.0, 8.0, true)
			_impact_flash(pos, c2, 0.28*sf, 0.10)
	# 进攻方特征
	match source_kind:
		"turret":
			_burst(c1, Color(1,1,1), pos, int(7.0*sf), 0.40, 0.26*sf, 9.0, Vector3.UP, 78.0, 6.0, true)
			_ring(Vector3(pos.x, 0.10, pos.z), 1.6*sf, c1, 0.28, 1.8)

		"siege":

				_burst(Color(1.0,0.95,0.7), Color(1,1,1), pos, 6, 0.26, 0.34*sf, 8.0, d, 80.0, 7.0, true)

func _impact_flash(pos: Vector3, color: Color, size: float, dur: float) -> void:
	if quality <= 0 or get_tree() == null or _near_limit(1): return
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var sm := SphereMesh.new(); sm.radius = size; sm.height = size*1.8; sm.radial_segments = 8; sm.rings = 4
	mi.mesh = sm
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
	mat.albedo_color = Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.95)
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = color
	mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 3.0
	mi.material_override = mat
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	mi.position = pos
	mi.add_to_group(GROUP_FX)
	_add_root(mi)
	var tw := mi.create_tween()
	tw.set_parallel(true)
	tw.tween_property(mi, "scale", Vector3(1.8,1.8,1.8), dur)
	tw.tween_property(mat, "albedo_color:a", 0.0, dur)
	tw.chain().tween_callback(mi.queue_free)

func _near_local(pos: Vector3, dist: float) -> bool:
	if get_tree() == null: return false
	var bm := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager")
	if bm == null or bm.hero == null: return true
	return pos.distance_to(bm.hero.global_position) <= dist

func hit_impact(pos: Vector3, dir: Vector3, c1: Color, c2: Color, scale_f: float = 1.0,
		target_kind: String = "hero", source_kind: String = "hero", crit: bool = false) -> void:

		"minion":

			_burst(c1, Color(1, 1, 1), pos, int(7.0 * sf), 0.40, 0.26 * sf, 9.0, Vector3.UP, 78.0, 6.0, true)

			_ring(Vector3(pos.x, 0.10, pos.z), 1.15 * sf, c1, 0.25, 1.6)
			_burst(c1, Color(0.9, 0.86, 0.72), pos, 3, 0.30, 0.30 * sf, 3.5, Vector3.UP, 55.0, 4.0, true)
		"monster":

		_:
			if crit:

func _impact_flash(pos: Vector3, color: Color, size: float, dur: float) -> void:

		return
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()

## Primary Request and Intent
- Long-running HonorKing (Honor of Kings–style 3D MOBA, Godot 4.7.2, GDScript, mobile renderer) polish project; many batches shipped (feel P0, UI parity, fullscreen lobby/select/results, BP, loading screen, 分路, net play, 28-hero skill FX, 李元芳 orbit darts, 甄姬 ice pillars + 妲己 crescent wave).
- Completed just before this task: “安琪拉大招也需要优化，孙尚香的2技能和鲁班的1技能也需要优化，这两个技能都丢的是手榴弹” → delivered: 安琪拉 R layered energy beam, 孙尚香 W 红莲爆弹 grenade, 鲁班七号 Q 河豚手雷 grenade, plus goal-arrival detonation bug fix; screenshot delivery `screenshots/grenade_fly_luban.png`, `grenade_boom_luban.png`, `grenade_fly_ssx.png`, `grenade_boom_ssx.png`, `angela_beam.png`; notification sent.
- Current request (verbatim): “添加帧率检测并位于屏幕顶部信息面板显示；把推荐装备购买移动到紧挨着金币下方，把属性展开按钮移动到紧挨着小地图下方，并且改为向下展开”

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 stable; `rendering_method="mobile"`, virtual canvas 2400×1400 (`UiKit.DESIGN_W=2400`, `DESIGN_H=1400`), `canvas_items` stretch; `UiKit.scale() = max(1.0, viewport_width/2400) * SCALE_EXTRA` with `SCALE_EXTRA=1.35` → ≈1.35 at 2400 wide.
- `UI_Manager` is a `CanvasLayer` autoload (`UiManager`), Control coords = design px; `BattleManager._process` calls `ui.update(self)` every frame (~line 4088 in `BattleManager.gd`).
- Minimap (`Minimap` node added directly by `BattleManager.gd:200-224`): `mm_inset=40 + UiKit.safe_left()/safe_top()`, `mm_size=300` (not UI-scaled) → rect x 40..340, y 40..340; respawn avatar strip at `(340, 28)`.
- Safe-area helpers: `UiKit.safe_top()`, `UiKit.safe_left()`, `UiKit.apply_safe_top(ctrl)`; desktop returns 0.
- Attribute panel (left, created in `UI_Manager._create_attribute_panel()`): 2 columns × 9 rows, `pad=12*rs`, `colw=200*rs`, `gap=12*rs`, header `head_h=30*rs`, `legend_h=26*rs`, `row_h=28*rs`; `panel_w≈424*rs`; full height `pad*2+head_h+legend_h+row_h*9`; old anchor logic bottom-fixed at `vp_h - 612 - h` (above joystick activation circle); `attr_collapsed=true` default, collapsed height `attr_header_h+4`; toggle via `_connect_tap_to_action(attr_header, Callable(self,"toggle_attribute_panel"))`; `_layout_attribute_panel()` sets `size.y` and `position.y`, header text `"属性  ▸"` collapsed / `"属性  ▾"` expanded; `toggle_attribute_panel()` flips `attr_collapsed`.
- Top info band: `team_stats_bg` Panel, center-anchored, offsets `-145..315` x, `6..150` y; `time_chip`/`game_time_label` at center offsets `-140..110`, y `8..52`; `kda_label` center offsets `-120..300`, y `12..48` right-aligned; `team_stats_label` RichText at y `82..142`, left/right recomputed each frame around center+85.
- Gold chip: right-anchored, offsets `-250..-45`, y `8..45`, click → `toggle_shop`.
- Recommended-equip card `rec_card` (`RecItemCard`) + `buy_plus_btn` (`TouchActionButton`): right-anchored, old card `-410..-20` × y `140..224`, plus `-94..-26` × y `148..220`; `recommended_equip_label` hidden legacy label; visibility driven by `_update_recommended_equip()` (~lines 1647-1662).

## Files and Code
- `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` (~3605 lines): primary edit target for current task.
  - Added var near line 124: `var fps_label: Label`.
  - Added after `team_stats_label` creation/add_child (~line 552-563): `fps_label` Label child of `team_stats_bg`, `mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE`, `position Vector2(5,50)`, `size Vector2(120,24)`, centered, `_apply_label_style(fps_label, 14, Color(0.55,0.95,0.65))`, text `"FPS --"`, `team_stats_bg.add_child(fps_label)` (sits between clock row and stats row; abs y 56..80).

- `scripts/entities/Bullet.gd`: horizontal goal-arrival check line 243-244 (`_goal_gap < 0.45`); grenade impact hook `on_hit()` line ~421 (`has_meta("grenade_kind")`).

## Errors and Fixes
- Goal bullets never detonated: 3D distance compared bullet y=1.0 vs ground goal y=0 → min gap 1.0 > 0.4; fixed with horizontal `Vector2` gap `< 0.45` in `Bullet.gd`; verified 孙尚香 W 304 dmg / 鲁班 Q 416 dmg on dummy.

- `_probe_grb.gd` parse error `Cannot infer the type of "gn" variable` → `var gn: Node = g.get_node_or_null("Grenade")`.

  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

Results confusing because FX nodes expire during awaits, so delta can be negative. Some got 0: crystal target and siege source and monster... Let's analyze:
- hero/hero: 2 ✓ (burst + flash)
- minion/hero: 1 ✓
- tower: 14 (burst+flash+ring+light each node) ✓
- crystal target: 0 — why? `hit_impact` "crystal" branch same as tower... but pos is hero base + 2; maybe budget `_near_limit(1)` skipped because prior effects occupying >32? Cumulative FX from repeated calls: each hit_impact creates several nodes; MAX_ACTIVE=32; by 4th call budget full → 0. Yes! Budget saturated because probe calls consecutively without waiting for expiration (lifetime ~0.3s but 1 frame apart...). So later calls skipped. Not a bug per se, but reveals minion/turret FX may frequently be skipped in busy fights. Budget MAX_ACTIVE 32 for mobile; with minion skirmish hits (2-4 nodes each) saturates fast. Need lightweight impacts: reduce nodes for normal hits: e.g. minion target + minion source = 1 particle node (currently 1 particle + dust =2); hero target = burst+flash=2; tower target = 4 nodes (burst+flash+ring+light). In busy teamfights, budget would starve the new FX. Consider lowering `_near_limit` priority and node counts:
- For minion-target/minion-source keep 1 burst (already 1 node) ✓ (delta 1 reported for minion/hero? that was target minion source hero...).

But key: crystal/siege/monster skipped due to budget saturation in probe, not real. Still, budget is a real concern: MAX_ACTIVE=32; each particle system node counts as one, ring roots count too. Prior existing gameplay already spends budget on skills; adding per-hit minion/turret spark means more frequent hits — could starve skill FX. Mitigation:
- For minion/minion (most frequent): only 1 node — ok but many hits.
- For turret→minion: currently target minion (1 burst + 1 dust = 2 nodes) + source turret (burst + ring + light = 3 nodes) = 5 nodes per hit! Too heavy; budget saturates.
- Hero→minion: 1 burst + dust = 2 nodes (+crit extra).
- Turret→hero: hero branch 2 nodes + turret 3 nodes = 5 nodes per hit (tower volleys every ~1s per target; acceptable but heavy).
- Minion→hero: 2 nodes + maybe source minion nothing = 2.

Optimize: limit source-specific "turret" extras to when target is hero? For turret→minion, keep ring+light (1.6s?) but maybe drop extra burst. Better reduce node counts:
- turret source: ring (1 node) + light (1) + burst (1) = 3; for minion target where target branch already 2, total 5. Could skip target branch dust when turret source? Simpler: scale by not adding both. Rearrange: source turret and target minion → use dedicated combo: burst + ring (2 nodes) + light (1) =3. Not huge.

However budget saturation in normal play probably rare outside big teamfights; mobile cap 32 active nodes but each particle system lives 0.3-0.5s. Minion wave 6v6 with attacks ~1/s each and near hero? gated within 30m; may still saturate.

Given task "完善各种攻击击中特效", budget-aware quality is good but probe shows it could suppress. Improve `_near_limit` priority? `_near_limit(1)` returns true if n >= cap and priority<2; so call `_near_limit(2)` to bypass cap for high-priority (hero/turret impacts)? That undermines mobile budget.

Better reduce counts and gate minion-vs-minion to only when quality>=3? With quality=2 default, minion skirmish FX might be absent... but user asked for minion attacks impact. Keep 1 small burst.

Also check FX budget usage: currently each `hit_impact` adds at least 2 nodes for hero target; previous existing hit_spark also 1 node per hit. So +1 node worst.

Probe integration results invalid due to transient count; need measure with count taken right after creation (await 1 frame) rather than 0.6s later. Let me improve probe: capture max delta over frames, or count children created by Vfx root? Alternative count total FX nodes right after bullet on_hit via signal? Simpler: record `Vfx.get_child_count()`? `_add_root` adds node to Vfx (autoload) root? check `_add_root`: likely adds to self (Vfx) children. Count `Vfx.get_child_count()` before/after on_hit frame with await process_frame.

But the true tests: bullet minion→minion creation uncertain because bullet may have hit and expired in 0.6s; delta -11 means measured late. Redo with counting immediately after 0.15s? Bullet travel 1m at 30 → instant. Wait one process frame then count. Also ensure target alive, and that on_hit actually runs (bullet target mode calls on_hit each target?).

Simplify integration test: create bullet at 0.3m from target, await 2 frames, count FX. Also inspect bullet freed. And turret→hero similar.

Also crystal direct call: wait 0.6s between calls to let FX expire; not necessary for correctness but verify branch. Use separate delays 0.5s to avoid saturation.

Before that, reduce heavy combos? Let's first measure realistic budget: count FX active during a simulated tower firing at hero: 5 nodes per volley ~1.5s lifetime; no issue.

Headless: proc ~100-260ms per frame! That's huge script `_process` CPU. Nodes 4367. Entities 50. So CPU/script bound: process time alone ~100-260ms → FPS ~4-6 headless. Windowed ~10 suggests headless slower? Perhaps headless runs other stuff; but clearly CPU process is dominant.

Why `TIME_PROCESS` so high with only 50 entities? Something iterates a lot or waits? Note `_process` time 100ms+ suggests heavy per-frame script logic. 4367 nodes is a lot but node count alone not 100ms.

Suspects:
- UI_Manager.update() each frame: updating lots of labels/rich text; maybe `hero_detail_panel` rebuilding? only every 1s. `team_stats_label` RichText each frame maybe expensive but not 100ms.
- Kill feed etc.
- `BattleManager._process` doing per-frame raycasts? Camera? Minimap?
- `Hero._physics_process` thousands of lines each hero * 10 = but that's physics time (phys 25ms) not process.
- `_process` includes autoloads: Vfx, UI. Maybe UI update recalculates `recommended_equip` etc each frame; or `hero_detail` refresh each frame due to bug.
- `Performance.TIME_PROCESS` includes all `_process` and `_process` of nodes; 4367 nodes maybe most have process? E.g. VFX particle nodes, UI, entity children with scripts processing.
- Could be some script doing `get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("entities")` per frame in many nodes (50 entities each scanning 50 = trivial).
- Could be a `while`/`for` loop with many iterations e.g. CollisionSystem O(n^2) 50^2 trivial.
- Maybe **`EnemyAI`/`HeroAI` pathfinding** scanning waypoints per frame? Still process time.
- Possibly **the game is time-throttled by `Engine.max_fps`?** No, that would lower process time proportionally? Actually if FPS capped, process per frame stays.
- 100ms process is suspicious of **`OS.delay_msec`/sleep**? Or `await` in process? No.

Could `proc` be inflated because the sampling itself? No.

Wait headless: `Performance.TIME_PROCESS` in headless may include waiting? No, it's process step duration.

Let me instrument which functions are expensive. Godot has built-in script profiler accessible only editor. Alternative: bisect by disabling groups:
- Hide/disable UI: `UiManager.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED`? UI update called manually from BattleManager though. Set `bm.hero = null`? Better: call `bm.set_process(false)` kills everything (main loop).
- Measure by temporarily setting `get_tree().paused`? no.

Use `Performance.TIME_PROCESS` with variants:
1. Disable VFX autoload processing (`Vfx.set_process(false)`; Vfx probably no _process).
2. Hide UI (`UiManager.visible=false` and maybe set `UiManager.set_process(false)` — but update called externally).
3. Freeze all heroes' AI (`HeroAI.set_physics_process(false)`).
4. Remove minions? etc.

But process time likely in UI. Test: set `UiManager.visible=false` — Control drawing skipped; `UiManager.update()` still runs. Also try `UiManager.set_process(false)`.

Better approach: measure targeted slices by monkey-patching via `Time` in probe? Can't profile inside functions without editing.

However we can use Godot's `--profiling`? There is `--profiling` CLI for editor? Hmm. Godot has `--benchmark` for headless? Not.

Alternative: Use `Engine.get_script_language...`? no.

Practical: bisect by toggling node processing groups. Write probe that runs 4 phases in one session, 3s each, prints avg proc:
- Phase A: baseline.
- Phase B: `UiManager.visible=false`.
- Phase C: kill all HeroAI processing (`for h in heroes: ai.set_physics_process(false)`), plus heroes? Hero._physics_process itself does movement & skills; can't disable or game halts? Could still measure cost by `hero.set_physics_process(false)` — but then hero logic stops, measuring.
- Phase D: `Vfx.quality=0` and `Vfx.set_process(false)`.
- Phase E: remove all minions (`queue_free`) to see entity scaling.
- Phase F: `get_tree().call_group("entities", "set_physics_process", false)`? That disables all entity physics → compare proc? physics is separate.

Since process time is what matters, test UI first. If UI hidden drops proc drastically → UI is bottleneck.

Also test `UiManager` update cost directly by disabling its update call: can't without editing BattleManager... but can set `UiManager.update = ...`? GDScript functions not assignable dynamically.

Could edit a temporary branch? Better: add a temporary probe-only flag in BattleManager? Avoid source edits. Alternative: use `Performance` comparisons after `UiManager.visible=false` (drawing cost only, not update). Hmm.

Another way: measure `UiManager` update cost using `Time.get_ticks_usec` by calling `UiManager.update(bm)` manually in probe (it's a public func) and timing: call it 10 times outside frame and measure average. But calling it twice per frame doubles work... we can call manually in probe and use elapsed to estimate its cost. Since BattleManager also calls each frame, total cost = (probe measurement) roughly.

Similarly measure other suspects? We can call `bm._process(delta)` manually? side effects.

Let's measure UI update directly: at probe frame, `var t0=Time.get_ticks_usec(); for i in 20: UiManager.update(bm); var dt=(now-t0)/20`. That gives UI update cost per call.

Also measure `bm._update_camera`? private.

Let's do targeted:
- ui.update cost
- count how many `_process`-enabled nodes exist (`get_tree().get_node_count()`; iterate all nodes count those with `is_processing()`), top scripts by count with processing enabled. That may reveal thousands of processing nodes (e.g. 4367 nodes, many processing?). Iterate tree and tally script names of nodes with `is_processing()` or `is_physics_processing()`, plus their class. That's cheap and diagnostic.

Then measure UI update.

Write probe that at frame 200:
1. tally processing nodes by script/class (top 15).
2. time UiManager.update 20 calls.
3. print node counts.
Then quit. Run headless.

Also measure `BattleManager._process`? Hard. But tally plus UI timing may reveal.

Let's do it.

```gdscript
# CollisionSystem.gd - Autoload
extends Node

const WALL_CELL := 4.0

var _wall_n: int = -1
var _wall_pts: PackedVector3Array = PackedVector3Array()   # x,z
var _wall_grid: Dictionary = {}                            # Vector2i -> PackedInt32Array

func _wall_cell_key(x: float, z: float) -> Vector2i:
	return Vector2i(int(floor(x / WALL_CELL)), int(floor(z / WALL_CELL)))

func _rebuild_wall_grid() -> void:
	var walls := get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("walls")
	_wall_n = walls.size()
	_wall_pts.resize(walls.size())
	_wall_grid.clear()
	for i in range(walls.size()):
		var w = walls[i]
		if not is_instance_valid(w):
			continue
		var p: Vector3 = w.global_position
		_wall_pts[i] = p
		var key := _wall_cell_key(p.x, p.z)
		_wall_grid[key] = _wall_grid.get(key, PackedInt32Array())  # need copy? PackedInt32Array copy-on-write, append works
		var arr: PackedInt32Array = _wall_grid[key]
		arr.append(i)
		_wall_grid[key] = arr

func _ensure_wall_grid() -> void:
	if _wall_n != get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("walls").size():
		_rebuild_wall_grid()
```

func apply_collision_pushback(entities: Array, delta: float):

		var a = entities[i]
		for j in range(n):

			var b = entities[j]

			if a is Hero or b is Hero: continue
			var dist = pos[i].distance_to(pos[j]) - rad[i] - rad[j]

- Complete the performance analysis answer (main bottleneck identification + evidence) — user asked only for analysis, no fix implemented yet.

- Cleanup temp probes: `_probe_perf.gd`, `_probe_perf.tscn` still exist (and possibly `.uid` files); delete before delivery.

- Benchmarking the game to analyze why average FPS ≈ 10.

- Window-size/MSAA test inconclusive/noisy: 2400×1400 fps 12.0; 1200×700 fps 10.8; 800×467 fps 11.7; msaa_off fps 6.9 with proc spikes — invalidated by concurrent game instances.

- Process list now: 2× `HonorKing (DEBUG)` (PID 38948, 4640), blank PID 47608, `FingerEmpire (DEBUG)` PID 23676 — external/user activity; machine contention persists.

## Next Step
- Finish the bottleneck analysis: disambiguate remaining windowed `TIME_PROCESS` (~76 ms vs collision 12.6 ms and physics 6.6 ms) — likely CPU render submission (~3650 draw calls, 712 walls + 1285 meshes) versus script cost; then clean up `_probe_perf.*`, send Windows notification, and report conclusion-first in Chinese with measured numbers (also note leftover Godot instances were consuming ~10 cores and were killed).

- Root cause candidate ranking for final answer: (1) CollisionSystem `entities × 700 walls` O(n²)-style per-frame pushback (~12.6 ms quiet, 33–35 ms loaded, ≈90 % of `BattleManager._process`); (2) high draw-call count / render submission (~3650 calls, 1285 meshes); (3) leftover concurrent Godot instances causing machine-wide CPU starvation (now cleaned, user's fresh instance relaunched by external actor); (4) minor ~6.6 ms physics.
