User: "感觉现在小兵的攻击动画看起来很呆板" — minion attack animation looks stiff/dull. Need to improve minion attack animation.

Current: for procedural minions, `_model_lunge()` only moves `ModelPivot` z +0.16 and rotation x -0.10, 0.10s out / 0.20s back. For siege, `_siege_recoil`. For ranged: bullet fired but no animation? Let me check attack path: `_play_anim("attack-melee-left")` (no anim player for procedural), then `if display_name == "siege": recoil elif _proc_visual: _model_lunge()`.

So all melee/ranged/super/dragon use same tiny forward jab. Stiff.

Improve: procedural attack animation per minion type:
- melee: wind-up (pull back + slight crouch) then thrust (forward + torso twist) with arm? Arms are part of merged mesh (not pivot), so we can animate whole ModelPivot: windup rotate x +0.12 & shift z -0.10, then lunge z +0.35, rotation x -0.18, plus slight y drop, then recover. Add weapon trail / hit spark already exists (Vfx.hit_impact).
- ranged: draw-and-release: pivot lean back -0.12, then quick forward 0.10 with slight z-; plus arrow release (bullet already), maybe recoil of arms.
- super (halberd): big overhead swing: pivot rotate x +0.3 back then -0.45 forward with z lunge 0.4 and rotation y? More dramatic + dust/ground shock.
- dragon: not melee lunge; it's ranged (attack_range 700 → bullet) — for dragons, do head/jaw thrust: whole model forward + pitch down, plus wing flare.
- siege: already recoil; maybe add muzzle smoke already has flash.

Also add: body "anticipation squash-stretch", slight yaw twist, and impact camera-free dust; plus attack "wind-up delay" aligned to hit timing? Currently damage applied immediately then tween starts → animation lags behind hit. Better: play windup then damage at contact? That changes gameplay timing (damage delay) — risky for balance but visually much better. Could do quick windup 0.08 then lunge 0.10 with damage at impact. But damage timing affects DPS slightly; acceptable? It's minion-vs-minion mostly. However net code sends action when? Keep damage immediate but animate so lunge peak ~immediately: current tween starts after damage; visual lunge 0.10s. Looks like hit happens before motion? Vfx.hit_impact spawned instantly, then model lunges — perceived "stiff".

Better: pre-animation before hit: since attack_timer set at attack, we can start windup when entering range? Complexity.

Compromise: keep damage timing, but make the lunge snappier and add follow-through plus a hit-stop-like scale pop, and add anticipation on cooldown (e.g. tiny idle "ready" bob) — maybe overkill.

Simplest robust: per-type richer `_attack_anim()`:
- Use tween sequence: anticipation (0.06s, pull back, rotate up), strike (0.08s, forward+down with overshoot), settle (0.22s, springy return with TRANS_ELASTIC small).
- Rotate around ModelPivot with rotation x and z; translate z and y.
- For 近战: also swing rotation.y ±? ModelPivot yaw = weapon arc → rotation y from -0.3 to +0.5 gives swing feel (for halberd/sword). Since weapon geometry part of body mesh, whole model twists — visible enough.
- Add per-type amplitude: melee 0.30m lunge/0.35 rad yaw; super 0.45m/0.5 rad with y drop; ranged 0.18 back then 0.12 forward (draw & release) + slight z; dragon 0.35 forward pitch + wing flare (wings already animate via WalkFeel — can add temporary amplitude? simpler: pitch down + forward).
- Also brief "step" of the body: position z forward then back, plus slight scale? WalkFeel writes position.y and rotation x/z every frame — CONFLICT! WalkFeel's `_process` overwrites `model.position.y`, `model.rotation.x`, `model.rotation.z` each frame → any tween on those props gets stomped. Currently `_model_lunge` tweens `pivot.position:z` and `pivot.rotation:x` — but pivot = ModelPivot is child of `visual` (the WalkFeel model root). So pivot is a separate node → no conflict! Good: lunge animates ModelPivot (child), WalkFeel animates visual root.

So enrich ModelPivot-based animation. Also for dragon, wings are under ModelPivot → animating pivot rotates wings too; fine.

Implement `_attack_anim()` replacing `_model_lunge` calls:
```
func _model_lunge() -> void:
    # 兼容：按兵种调用对应攻击动作
    match display_name: ...
```
Better rename to `_proc_attack_anim()` and keep `_model_lunge` as wrapper? Only called in one place. I'll rewrite `_model_lunge()` into per-type animation using kill existing tween meta to avoid overlaps (attack_timer >= 1s so no overlap except fast attack speeds; super 0.5 → 2s cd; melee 0.7 → 1.4s; safe).

Motion design (local space, ModelPivot):
common: use `create_tween()`, set parallel.

近战 melee/ranged:
- windup: position.z -0.10, rotation.x +0.18, rotation.y -0.22 (twist away), duration 0.07 TRANS_QUAD EASE_OUT
- strike: position.z +0.34, rotation.x -0.16, rotation.y +0.42, duration 0.09 TRANS_BACK? (BACK overshoots) use TRANS_QUAD EASE_IN + overshoot by 1.15 factor
- settle: back to base over 0.28 with TRANS_ELASTIC EASE_OUT (springy) on z/yaw/pitch.
Also add y dip: position.y -0.05 at strike, 0 settle.

super (长戟): bigger: windup z -0.14, rot x +0.30, yaw +0.45; strike forward z +0.46, x -0.35, yaw -0.55, y -0.08; settle 0.35 elastic.

siege: keep recoil but add tilt: rot x +0.06 then -0.03.

dragon: windup pitch up +0.12, strike pitch down -0.22 + z +0.30 + y -0.06; settle elastic; also wing flare? WalkFeel controls wing rotation.z each frame → would fight. Skip.

Also hit timing: add impact dust/flash at strike moment (~0.07s later) instead of immediate? Vfx.hit_impact already called in damage code. Could delay damage by 0.07s but affects all callers... keep.

Additionally make attack cadence feel: add brief "recovery lean" using WalkFeel? no.

Also for ranged minions: currently they don't lunge but shoot; better animation = draw bow (pull back) then release with forward snap. Use same melee sequence but reversed emphasis (more pullback, less forward). Differentiate by attack_range>1.0: it's ranged → pullback emphasis.

Distinguish: in `_physics_process`, the melee branch does damage instantly when in range (non-ranged: attack_range*0.01 <= 1.0), else bullet. Animation code currently: after damage, `_play_anim("attack-melee-left")`, then `if display_name == "siege": recoil elif _proc_visual: _model_lunge()`.

Modify `_model_lunge()` to accept `ranged: bool`? Simpler: inside `_model_lunge`, decide by `attack_range*0.01 > 1.0` → ranged variant.

Also, user may watch 小兵 attack in single player. Ensure visual punch: add small white slash Vfx? There is `Vfx.hit_impact`. Adding a per-attack slash arc could be too heavy for minion masses; maybe add only for super/dragon (elite). Hmm keep light: for melee/super add `Vfx.cast_glow`? Might spam. Skip.

Let me check what Vfx helpers exist for slashes: `Vfx.slash`? grep quickly. If cheap and locally gated, could add small arc for super only.

Implementation plan:
1. Replace `_model_lunge` with per-type 3-phase tween on ModelPivot.
2. Add recovery: ensure base values captured at start (`base := pivot.position`, `base_rot := pivot.rotation`).
3. Use `create_tween()` with `set_parallel` sequences: 
```
tw.tween_property(pivot, "position:z", base.z - back, 0.07)...
```
Careful: parallel groups then sequential: build with `tw.tween_property(...).set_parallel()` style.

Simplify: use `tw.set_parallel(true)` for windup group, then `tw.chain().tween_property(...)` for strike group etc. In Godot 4: 
```
tw.set_parallel(true)
tw.tween_property(...)
...
tw.chain().tween_property(...)
```
`chain()` returns Tween for next step. After chain calls, subsequent tweens are parallel within new step only if set_parallel? Hmm; typical pattern: 
```
tw.set_parallel(true) # all subsequent join current step
```
That makes everything parallel. Better use `tw.tween_property(...)` then `tw.parallel().tween_property(...)`.

Structure:
```
var tw := create_tween()
# windup
tw.tween_property(pivot, "position:z", base.z - back, windup).set_trans(...)
tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, "rotation:x", base_rot.x + up, windup)
tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, "rotation:y", base_rot.y + twist, windup)
tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, "position:y", base.y - dip*0.4, windup)
# strike
tw.tween_property(pivot, "position:z", base.z + fwd, strike).set_trans(QUAD).set_ease(EASE_IN)
tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, "rotation:x", base_rot.x - down, strike)
tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, "rotation:y", base_rot.y - twist*1.6, strike)
tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, "position:y", base.y - dip, strike)
# settle
tw.tween_property(pivot, "position:z", base.z, settle).set_trans(ELASTIC).set_ease(EASE_OUT)
tw.parallel().tween_property(pivot, "rotation:x", base_rot.x, settle)...
```
Wait pivot.rotation.y: model faces +Z; ModelPivot rotation y affects whole body yaw → swing twist visually. But Minion sets `rotation.y` on the entity (root), pivot's y is local extra → fine.

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

</system-reminder>

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

The user says minion attack animation looks stiff. I need to rewrite `_model_lunge` into per-type 3-phase attack animation (anticipation → strike → settle). Keep minimal per CLAUDE.md.

Implement now.

Design: use ModelPivot (child of visual, not touched by WalkFeel). Per-type presets. Also add dust for super at strike? Keep simple but effective: add small impact Vfx only for super and dragon? Actually Vfx.hit_impact already exists at damage. Keep light: no extra particles (perf).

Let me write the new function replacing lines 95-108.

Params by type:
- melee (近战兵): back 0.10, fwd 0.34, up 0.16, down 0.16, twist 0.26, dip 0.05
- ranged (远程兵): draw: back 0.16, fwd 0.08, up 0.10, down 0.10, twist 0.14, dip 0.04 — snappy release
- super (超级兵/近战大兵): back 0.18, fwd 0.50, up 0.30, down 0.34, twist 0.44, dip 0.10
- dragon (主宰先锋/风暴/暗影): back 0.12, fwd 0.36, up 0.10, down 0.22, twist 0.0, dip 0.05 (俯冲撞击)

Timings: windup 0.09, strike 0.10, settle 0.30 (melee); ranged: windup 0.12, strike 0.07, settle 0.24; super: 0.12/0.12/0.34; dragon: 0.10/0.12/0.30.

Also add "overshoot" on strike: use TRANS_BACK EASE_OUT for strike so it slightly overshoots; but BACK overshoot on z means go beyond fwd then settle to fwd? The strike tween ends at fwd value; then settle returns to base. TRANS_BACK EASE_OUT overshoots past target then comes back — good snap. But it may look jittery. Use TRANS_QUAD EASE_IN for strike then settle ELASTIC EASE_OUT? Elastic on return can look springy.

Choose: windup TRANS_SINE EASE_OUT; strike TRANS_QUAD EASE_IN; settle TRANS_BACK EASE_OUT for snap-back? BACK overshoots -> passes base then returns... For settle use TRANS_ELASTIC EASE_OUT with short 0.26 maybe too bouncy. Use TRANS_QUAD EASE_IN_OUT for settle for stability, plus small "follow-through" dip.

Also add subtle scale pulse? Scale on pivot affects whole model: squash-stretch: pivot.scale = base_scale * (1+0.04) at strike? WalkFeel doesn't touch scale (comment says so). Add slight scale y squash 0.97 at strike, 1.03 during windup? Keep simple: skip scale to avoid clipping.

Also kill overlapping tween: store `_atk_tween` meta; if valid, kill. Attack interval >=1s so unnecessary but add guard.

Write with edit tool.

Also make attack animation start *before* hit feels better? Currently damage is applied immediately then animation starts — so the wind-up happens after the hit, which reads as "delayed reaction" (stiff). Better: rotate/damage instantly but make strike phase hit at ~windup; still mismatch.

Alternative: trigger animation earlier — at attack decision start? There's no telegraph. Hmm, but perceived stiffness also comes from the *hit* spawning Vfx instantly with no body motion. To align, delay the impact by the windup time: apply damage after windup? Complex across melee/bullet.

Simpler: swap animation so strike is immediate and windup only when... For minions attacking every 1.4-2s, a windup then hit is fine if damage lands at strike. We could restructure: in the melee branch, call `_play_anim` + start tween, then `await get_tree().create_timer(windup)` before damage? Risky (entity may die/be freed mid-await) but manageable with is_instance_valid checks. That changes gameplay timing by ~0.1s — negligible.

Better approach used by HoK: damage lands on impact. Given "呆板" complaint, aligning hit with strike matters. But complexity + net sync of action timing... NetSession.net_action is pushed immediately at `_play_anim("attack-melee-left")` — client replay would be earlier than host impact; minor.

Given CLAUDE.md minimal-change ethos, I'd avoid async damage rewrite. The 3-phase animation with anticipation already fixes most stiffness (reads as body action even if impact VFX happens at t=0).

Hmm, but impact VFX at t=0 while body pulls back first → looks like damage before swing. Actually current code: damage applied, then `_play_anim`, then `_model_lunge`. Since damage-vfx spawn immediately, the sequence body pulls back, then lunges — impact fx at start mismatched.

Mitigation: make windup very short (0.05-ish) so perceived near-simultaneous, keeping anticipation noticeable but brief? We set 0.09-0.13. For minions this is ok-ish but mismatch visible.

Alternative cheap: move Vfx.hit_impact call into tween call at strike moment for melee (host only) — but the damage function also spawns popups.

Actually the visual hit_impact is spawned in the same branch at line ~218 (only melee) and by Bullet.on_hit for ranged. We could pass a small delay: not possible.

Compromise: reduce windup to ~0.06 for melee/super, and start tween *before* damage? Reordering: `_play_anim` then `_model_lunge()` then damage — but the code does damage inside `if attack_timer <= 0` block. Could restructure small: call `_model_lunge()` at top of the attack block, then damage, then Vfx. Then windup starts simultaneously with damage — still damage first 0.06s.

Honestly, perceived "呆板" mainly = single tiny poke. The new 3-phase with twist and dip will look much better. Let me also ensure the strike happens fast so it reads as an attack.

Additionally add follow-through: for super, ground dust at strike via tween callback (cheap and only for super). Do it: after strike tween, `tw.tween_callback(_super_impact_dust)`. But callbacks in parallel chains tricky; use `.tween_callback` after strike step.

Hmm, actually for super the impact Vfx already appears. Skip extra to keep perf.

Build probe: spawn melee next to an enemy turret/minion to induce attack, sample pivot z, rotation.x/y, print max/min and sequence. Simpler: directly call `m._model_lunge()` on spawned minions and sample for 0.8s — verifies animation curve numerically without needing combat.

Probe v3: spawn melee/super/ranged/dragon, call `_model_lunge()`, sample pivot.position.z, rotation.x, rotation.y across 0.8s, print min/max and values at key times.

{"content":"extends Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	var ps: PackedScene = load("res://scenes/battle.tscn")
	var bm: Node = ps.instantiate()
	add_child(bm)
	for i in range(6):
		await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout
	bm._start_game("吕布")
	await get_tree().create_timer(1.0).timeout
	var wps: Array = [Vector3(0, 0, 30), Vector3(0, 0, 0)]
	for k in ["melee", "ranged", "super", "dragon"]:
		var m = bm.spawn_single_minion(k, 0, Vector3(0, 0, 34), wps, 0)
		if m == null or m.visual == null:
			print("SKIP ", k)
			continue
		var pivot: Node3D = m.visual.get_node_or_null("ModelPivot")
		if pivot == null:
			print("NO PIVOT ", k)
			continue
		var z0 := pivot.position.z
		var x0 := pivot.rotation.x
		m._model_lunge()
		var zs: Array = []
		var xs: Array = []
		var ys: Array = []
		var t := 0.0
		while t < 0.9:
			zs.append(pivot.position.z - z0)
			xs.append(pivot.rotation.x - x0)
			ys.append(pivot.rotation.y)
			await get_tree().process_frame
			t += get_process_delta_time()
		var zmin := 999.0
		var zmax := -999.0
		for v in zs:
			zmin = minf(zmin, v); zmax = maxf(zmax, v)
		var xmin := 999.0
		var xmax := -999.0
		for v in xs:
			xmin = minf(xmin, v); xmax = maxf(xmax, v)
		var ymin := 999.0
		var ymax := -999.0
		for v in ys:
			ymin = minf(ymin, v); ymax = maxf(ymax, v)
		print("%-7s dz=[%.3f, %.3f] dx=[%.3f, %.3f] twist=[%.3f, %.3f] end_dz=%.3f end_dx=%.3f" % [
			k, zmin, zmax, xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zs[zs.size() - 1], xs[xs.size() - 1]])
		if k == "super":
			var sample: Array = []
			for i in range(0, zs.size(), maxi(1, int(zs.size() / 12))):
				sample.append("%.2f" % zs[i])
			print("  super_z_curve=", sample)
	print("PROBE_DONE")
	get_tree().quit()

结论：小兵普攻原本只有“前冲 0.16m + 低头 0.1rad”的单段位移，没有预备动作和收势，所以看起来是直愣愣地撞一下。现在已改为三段式，并按兵种区分手感。

## 改动

只改了 [Minion.gd:95](scripts/entities/Minion.gd#L95) 里的 `_model_lunge()`。这段代码只驱动 `ModelPivot`，不碰由 `WalkFeel` 控制的 `visual` 根节点，所以两套动画不会冲突。

| 阶段 | 动作 |
|---|---|
| ① 蓄力 | 重心后坐、上身抬起、**反向拧腰**、轻微下沉（SINE 缓出） |
| ② 出手 | 前冲、**过冲回弹**（TRANS_BACK）、压身、顺向拧腰（幅度 1.5×）、重心下压 |
| ③ 收势 | 先从过冲位置回落到前冲量 25%，再缓慢归位；带跟随动作，不会直线弹回 |

兵种手感参数：

| 兵种 | 后拉 | 前冲 | 俯仰 | 拧腰 | 节奏（蓄力/出手/收势） |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 近战兵 | 0.12 | 0.34 | ±0.18 | ±0.26 | 0.09 / 0.10 / 0.30 s |
| 远程兵 | **0.17**（拉弓） | 0.09（弹射） | ±0.12 | ±0.15 | 0.13 / 0.07 / 0.26 s |
| 超级兵 | 0.19 | **0.52**（重砸） | ±0.34 | ±0.46 | 0.13 / 0.12 / 0.36 s |
| 主宰/风暴/暗影先锋 | 0.13 | 0.38（俯冲撞） | −0.24 下压 | 0（不拧腰） | 0.10 / 0.12 / 0.30 s |

另外还加了攻击 tween 的重入保护：如果上一次攻击动画还在播放，就先 kill 掉，避免连续攻击时位移叠加。

## 验证（探针实测 0.9s 内 ModelPivot 位移/角度曲线）

| 兵种 | 前冲位移 | 俯仰 | 拧腰 | 归位 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 近战 | −0.120 → +0.407 | −0.175 ~ +0.180 | −0.390 ~ +0.260 | 0.000 |
| 远程 | −0.170 → +0.116 | −0.120 ~ +0.110 | −0.225 ~ +0.150 | 0.000 |
| 超级兵 | −0.190 → **+0.591** | −0.346 ~ +0.320 | −0.690 ~ +0.460 | 0.000 |
| 主宰先锋 | −0.130 → +0.431 | −0.233 ~ +0.120 | 0（俯冲型） | 0.000 |

超级兵位移曲线采样（间隔≈0.07s）：`0 → −0.13 → −0.19（蓄力到位）→ +0.57（过冲出手）→ +0.52 → +0.40 → +0.07 → 0`，能清楚看到“后拉→爆发→跟随收势”，不再单段平移。

`--headless --editor --quit` parse=0；`battle.tscn` 冒烟 exit 0，0 报错；探针文件已删除。攻城车仍走原来的炮身后坐（`_siege_recoil`）与炮口闪光，未改动。

另外还加了攻击 tween 的重入保护：如果上一次攻击动画还在播放，就先 kill 掉，避免连续攻击时位移叠加。

| 兵种 | 前冲位移 | 俯仰 | 拧腰 | 归位 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 近战 | −0.120 → +0.407 | −0.175 ~ +0.180 | −0.390 ~ +0.260 | 0.000 |
| 远程 | −0.170 → +0.116 | −0.120 ~ +0.110 | −0.225 ~ +0.150 | 0.000 |
| 超级兵 | −0.190 → **+0.591** | −0.346 ~ +0.320 | −0.690 ~ +0.460 | 0.000 |
| 主宰先锋 | −0.130 → +0.431 | −0.233 ~ +0.120 | 0（俯冲型） | 0.000 |

超级兵位移曲线采样（间隔≈0.07s）：`0 → −0.13 → −0.19（蓄力到位）→ +0.57（过冲出手）→ +0.52 → +0.40 → +0.07 → 0`，能清楚看到“后拉→爆发→跟随收势”，不再单段平移。

static func attach(instance: Node3D, hero_name: String) -> void:
	if instance == null or not is_instance_valid(instance):
		return
	if instance.has_meta("_hero_weapon"):
		return
	instance.set_meta("_hero_weapon", true)
	var parent: Node3D = instance.get_parent() if instance.get_parent() is Node3D else instance
	# 英雄模型统一放大 3 倍、实际身高约 2.1m：武器按固定身高比例建模（构建期模型还没进树，包围盒不可靠）
	var h := 2.1
	var s: float = h / 1.8
	var rp: Dictionary = RECIPE.get(hero_name, {"t": "jian", "a": Color(0.85, 0.88, 0.95),
		"b": Color(0.3, 0.35, 0.45), "l": 1.0})
	var holder: Node3D = WeaponRigScript.new()
	holder.name = "Weapon"
	var node := _build(str(rp["t"]), rp["a"], rp["b"], s * float(rp["l"]))
	holder.add_child(node)
	# 优先绑到手臂骨（握在手中，随手臂动画摆动）
	var skel := _find_skeleton(instance)
	var bone: int = -1
	if skel != null:
		bone = skel.find_bone("arm-right")
		if bone < 0:
			bone = skel.find_bone("arm-left")
	if skel != null and bone >= 0 and instance.get_parent() != null and str(instance.get_parent().name) == "HeroModel":
		var ba := BoneAttachment3D.new()
		ba.name = "WeaponHand"
		ba.bone_idx = bone
		skel.add_child(ba)
		ba.add_child(holder)
		holder.scale = Vector3.ONE / maxf(instance.scale.x, 0.001)
		holder.rotation_degrees = _hold_rot(str(rp["t"]))
		holder.setup(_style_of(str(rp["t"])))
		parent.set_meta("weapon_rig", holder)
		return
	# 兜底：无骨骼模型按固定握持点挂（右手侧、腰胸之间）
	var grip := Vector3(h * 0.14, h * 0.55, h * 0.05)
	var hp: Node3D = parent
	if hp == instance:
		# 模型还没挂进场景（联机端先造模型后归位）：挂在模型下并抵消模型放大
		var inv: float = 1.0 / maxf(maxf(instance.scale.x, instance.scale.y), 0.001)
		holder.scale = Vector3.ONE * inv
		hp.add_child(holder)

But feasibility: is there an existing slash Vfx? Search Vfx.gd for slash/arc/trail.

There is `Vfx.slash_fx(from, to, color)` already! Used where? Probably by some melee skills. Let me check how melee hero attack currently uses it (grep slash_fx usages), and check `hit_impact` signature (kind param) usage in melee.

Plan concept: "近战英雄普攻时真的在用武器打到了敌方单位":
1. Damage should land at weapon contact moment — currently bullet at speed 40 travels attack_range (2.0-2.5m) → 0.05-0.06s. Fine timing-wise.
2. Visual: add per-swing weapon slash VFX from weapon tip along swing arc toward target + impact spark at target's body contact point (near side, chest height), scaled by hero size. Use `Vfx.slash_fx(weapon_pos, contact_point, color)` + `Vfx.hit_impact(contact, dir, color, ...)` with "hero" kind? Already hit spark from take_damage? Let's check whether take_damage spawns hit flash/spark for hero attacks — maybe only for skills.

Simplest: in melee branch (attack_range <= 400), after creating bullet:
- compute contact point: target.global_position + dir_from_target_to_hero * target.body_radius (near side) at height ~1.0-1.5 m (target bar anchor *0.45).
- spawn `Vfx.slash_fx(weapon_world_pos, contact, team/vfx color)`; and `Vfx.hit_spark(contact, color, dir, scale)`; plus camera shake for local player? (Vfx.camera_shake only if near?). There's `_near_local` gating internally.

Better get weapon rig: `weapon_rig` meta on parent of visual? In HeroWeapons.attach: `parent.set_meta("weapon_rig", holder)` where parent = instance.get_parent() or instance. Add helper on Hero: `_weapon_tip_pos()`.

But honestly for a MOBA the key ask: hit VFX appears at the enemy where the weapon contacts, and the swing goes *toward* that enemy. Since hero already faces target and weapon rig swings, adding slash arc from weapon to target + contact spark will sell it.

Also "真的用武器打到" might also mean reach: melee heroes currently attack from 2-2.5m and the weapon (length ~1.2-1.5m from body) may not reach — mismatch. Improvement: for melee, dynamically set strike distance to weapon reach: `min(attack_range*0.01, weapon_reach)`? Attack range is a game stat; but we can instead move the *hit distance* — no, that'd nerf. Alternative: when attacking in melee, step in closer (micro-lunge) to weapon reach: dash a tiny bit toward target so the weapon contacts: `global_position += dir_to_target * (dist - contact_dist)`? That's basically "attack move-in" = HoK melee heroes do close to body range. Risky for balance? attack_range 200cm = 2m; hero model 2.1m tall, weapon reach ~1.3m → gap 0.7m. Micro-lunge 0.5m toward the target on attack would make it look like connecting, but pushes the hero forward (could be desirable — HoK melee do step in).

Hmm, maybe better: shorten melee attack_range? No — balance.

Practical approach: implement a short forward "attack step" for melee heroes on the swing (0.35-0.5m over 0.12s, only if not moving/rooted; and no collision change), plus slash VFX from weapon to contact point + contact spark + small hit-stop for player's local attacks (already Vfx.hitstop exists).

Careful: `_move_lock_until` locks movement 0.5s after attack anyway; a visual step could desync position predictions in net code! Host authoritative: NetSession snapshots hero position... slight 0.4m step would be fine (net interpolation).

But a real position change risks getting into tower range etc. Hmm. Alternatively keep hero still and just use VFX: a slash streak drawn from weapon to target's body — even if weapon tip is 0.6m short, the streak bridges → reads as "weapon hit". That's cheap and safe. Plus contact spark + brief enemy flinch.

I think VFX bridging + contact spark + slight weapon rig "extension"? Could also scale the weapon rig temporarily (stretch toward target) - hacky.

Better: implement `_melee_contact(target)`:
- compute `weapon_pos = _weapon_world_pos()` (rig global position, fallback hero pos + fwd*0.7 + up*1.2)

```

	var col := Vfx.color_for_hero(display_name)
	var col2 := Vfx.color2_for_hero(display_name)
	var tip := _weapon_world_pos()

	var dir_to_t := target.global_position - global_position
	dir_to_t.y = 0.0
	if dir_to_t.length() < 0.01: dir_to_t = Vector3(sin(rotation.y), 0, cos(rotation.y))
	var fwd := dir_to_t.normalized()
	var near := target.global_position - fwd * minf(float(target.body_radius) * 0.85, 1.6)
	var hit_y := 0.0
	if target is Hero: hit_y = 1.15 * 3.0? hmm hero model scale 3, body heights...
```
Simpler: hit point height = team ring ~1.2m for heroes (models are ~2.1m tall). Use `target.global_position.y + 1.1` for heroes, minions smaller. There's `bar_anchor_height()` on entities maybe. Use `target.global_position.y + clampf(target.bar_anchor_height() * 0.45, 0.6, 1.6)`? For Hero bar_anchor maybe 4.2 → 1.9. Hmm; heroes 2.1m tall model → chest ~1.3m. Use 1.25 for Hero, 0.75 for minions, 1.4 turret.

Then:
```
Vfx.slash_fx(tip, near + Vector3.UP*hit_h, col)   # 武器到命中点的一道挥砍痕
Vfx.hit_spark(contact, col, fwd, 1.0)            # 接触火花（已有 hit_impact 会重复？）
```
`hit_spark` may duplicate the existing impact; instead use a new dedicated small "weapon contact" flash: use `Vfx.hit_impact(contact, fwd, col, Color(1,0.95,0.85), 0.85, "hero", "hero")`? Existing impact already occurs at bullet pos ≈ target center. Adding another at surface is fine (two-sided spark) but might look doubled.

Given existing impact, better add only slash streak (the missing link). And to sell "weapon hit", add a **brief white flash line along the blade to contact** - `Vfx.slash_fx` does exactly a streak between points (check implementation: line 1189). Let me read slash_fx quickly to confirm API & effect.

# 近战普攻「武器真的砍到」：从武器握点向敌人身体表面拉一道刀光 + 接触火花
func _melee_weapon_fx(target: GameEntity) -> void:
	if target == null or not is_instance_valid(target):
		return
	var fwd := target.global_position - global_position
	fwd.y = 0.0
	if fwd.length() < 0.01:
		fwd = Vector3(sin(rotation.y), 0.0, cos(rotation.y))
	fwd = fwd.normalized()
	# 命中点：敌人「朝我这一侧」的体表（不是身体中心），高度按体型取胸腹
	var r := 0.85
	var hit_h := 1.15
	if target is Minion:
		r = float(target.body_radius) + 0.3
		hit_h = 0.75
	elif target is Turret:
		r = 1.5
		hit_h = 1.6
	elif display_name == "后羿":
		hit_h = 1.15
	var contact := target.global_position - fwd * r + Vector3.UP * hit_h
	var tip := _weapon_world_pos(fwd)
	Vfx.weapon_hit(tip, contact, Vfx.color_for_hero(display_name), Vfx.color2_for_hero(display_name), 1.0)
	# 本地玩家砍中敌方英雄：极短顿帧，强化“砍到了”的手感
	if not is_ai and target is Hero and Vfx.quality >= 2:
		Vfx.hitstop(0.018)


# 武器在世界的握点（有武器骨架挂点时用真实手部位置，兜底用身前 1.05m）
func _weapon_world_pos(fwd: Vector3) -> Vector3:
	var rig = visual_mesh.get_meta("weapon_rig", null) if visual_mesh != null and is_instance_valid(visual_mesh) else null
	if rig is Node3D and is_instance_valid(rig):
		return (rig as Node3D).global_position + fwd * 0.55 + Vector3.UP * 0.12
	return global_position + fwd * 1.05 + Vector3.UP * 1.2

So melee heroes have attack_range 325–475 cm (3.25–4.75m), and the melee/ranged decision threshold `attack_range > 400` counts 吕布 (475) and 夏侯惇 (475) as **ranged** → they fire bullets and never play a weapon hit; also other melee heroes with 350/325 do melee branch.

Wait — but melee branch also creates a Bullet with damage_range 1.2 (fast projectile) at speed 40 — so even "melee" heroes' damage comes from a projectile, but at least animation and (now) VFX.

The user's complaint precisely: "近战英雄普攻时真的在用武器打到了敌方单位" — because for 吕布/夏侯惇 (475) the game treats them as ranged and they shoot invisible bullets from 4.75m, and for other melee heroes the weapon never makes contact visual.

So the fix: determine melee vs ranged from hero **role/weapon type**, not from `attack_range > 400`. Definition: heroes with role 战士/刺客/坦克 (melee-ish) plus weapon types (halberd/greatsword/jian/spear/daggers/fan/gauntlet/staff? staff is mage ranged) — better: explicit melee hero list.

But damage/travel logic also uses this threshold in many places (`_muzzle_pos` etc.). We only need *visual* correctness + the melee contact fx. Also actual behavior: which heroes should spawn melee bullet vs ranged bullet? Both spawn Bullet; the only difference for 475 heroes is `damage_range=1.2` (melee "splash" radius) and muzzle flash + slash fx now.

Also careful: attack_range 475 also used for *range gate*: hero can hit from 4.75m which is way too far for melee! In HoK 吕布 is melee with maybe 2.6m reach. So 475 likely is cm→4.75m?? That's suspicious. Compare 后羿 750 = 7.5m (a bit long but plausible in HoK ~8m). 亚瑟 325 = 3.25m. Hmm HoK melee ranges are ~1.5-2.5m. So 475 = 4.75m is definitely too far, but it's existing balance; not my call to change damage ranges... But user says weapons should actually reach — if 吕布 hits from 4.75m, no weapon can reach.

Better: for melee-class heroes, add an *approach step* before the strike: if distance > contact reach (~1.6m), dash/step toward target up to reach (like HoK melee "貼身"). But that changes movement significantly; hero AI/player movement lock exists. Hmm.

Alternative minimal, targeted fix that matches "weapon really hits":
1. Correct melee/ranged classification: `_is_melee_hero()` based on hero weapon/role list, so 吕布/夏侯惇 use melee branch (weapon hit fx + damage_range 1.2 close-combat).
2. Keep attack_range as balance gate, but for melee heroes cap the *visual* contact: we already compute contact at target surface; the gap between weapon tip and target can be up to 3m for 475 heroes, making the beam super long — looks like a laser, bad.

So the real fix requires: classify melee heroes properly AND make their effective engagement distance ≈ weapon reach (~2.0-2.4m), with an in-close step so weapon contact happens.

Simplest impactful design (and HoK-like): for melee-role heroes, define `melee_reach` = min(attack_range, 240) cm used for *approach + attack trigger*; on swing, if gap > reach, first lunge/step in. But changing `attack_range` at runtime also affects rings/UI... Actually we can set `attack_range` itself for melee heroes to e.g. 240 at hero creation? That changes stats (visible in panel) — but arguably fixes an absurdity: 吕布 attack range 475 = "射程" that is clearly a mistake for a halberd? In HoK 吕布 range is 2.6m? Hmm 475 cm = 4.75m, definitely wrong.

Wait maybe units: 吕布's halberd is long; HoK 吕布 attack range is "近战" ~ 3.0? Actually HoK melee hero range typically 1.5-2.5m; 吕布 maybe 2.5. 4.75m no.

Bounded dash of up to (range - reach) ≈ 2.5m over 0.1s — that's a big teleport-ish; but HoK melee do "贴身" instant-ish. Hmm, visual quality: a 2.5m lunge in 0.1s = 25 m/s, looks like blink.

2048 : 	if manual_target and is_instance_valid(manual_target):

2051 : 			manual_target = null

2053 : 			var dist = global_position.distance_to(manual_target.global_position)
2054 : 			if dist < range:

2056 : 	# 玩家：自动选敌 —— 范围内优先英雄（剩余血量最低优先），其次非英雄（小兵/塔/野怪，剩余血量最低优先）
2057 : 	# 远程接管英雄：net_attack_hold（按住普攻）或已启用具体优先级模式（推塔/小兵，站定自动持续攻击）时生效。
2058 : 	if not is_ai:
2059 : 		# 推塔/小兵优先级模式：范围内存在对应类别目标 → 直接返回该类最低血目标；否则回退普通选敌。
2060 : 		# respect_mode=false（目标型技能智能施法兜底）时不应用模式，避免技能被拉到塔/小兵上。
2061 : 		if respect_mode:
2062 : 			var pri := TouchController.get_attack_priority()
2063 : 			if pri != TouchController.ATTACK_PRIORITY_AUTO:
2064 : 				var mode_target := _pick_priority_target(pri, range)
2065 : 				if mode_target:
2066 : 					return mode_target
2067 : 		var best_hero: GameEntity = null
2068 : 		var best_hero_hp := 999999.0
2069 : 		var best_other: GameEntity = null
2070 : 		var best_other_hp := 999999.0
2071 : 		for ent in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("entities"):
2072 : 			if ent == self or not (ent is GameEntity) or ent.health <= 0 or ent.team == team:
2073 : 				continue
2074 : 			if not (ent is Hero or ent is Minion or ent is Turret or ent is JungleMonster):
2075 : 				continue  # 排除墙体/草丛/治疗包等非战斗实体
2076 : 			if global_position.distance_to(ent.global_position) > range:
2077 : 				continue
2078 : 			if ent is Hero:
2079 : 				if (ent as Hero).is_invisible_to_enemy() or (ent as Hero).is_untargetable_by_enemies():
2080 : 					continue  # 隐身中的敌方英雄不可被自动索敌（AoE 仍可波及）
2081 : 				if ent.health < best_hero_hp:
2082 : 					best_hero_hp = ent.health
2083 : 					best_hero = ent
2084 : 			else:
2085 : 				if ent.health < best_other_hp:
2086 : 					best_other_hp = ent.health
2087 : 					best_other = ent
2088 : 		if best_hero:
2089 : 			return best_hero
2090 : 		return best_other
2091 : 	if net_attack_hold or (net_attack_priority >= 0 and net_attack_priority != TouchController.ATTACK_PRIORITY_AUTO):
2092 : 		# 推塔/小兵模式：与上面玩家分支同规则（该类目标最低血优先）；无该类目标时若仅在按住普攻
2093 : 		# 才回退通用选敌（站定自动点塔/点兵不因周围有英雄而改打英雄）
2094 : 		if net_attack_priority >= 0 and net_attack_priority != TouchController.ATTACK_PRIORITY_AUTO:
2095 : 			var mode_target := _pick_priority_target(net_attack_priority, range)
2096 : 			if mode_target:
2097 : 				return mode_target
2098 : 		if net_attack_hold:
2099 : 			# 按住普攻的通用回退：与玩家按住普攻一致 —— 英雄优先（剩余血量最低），其次非英雄

popup shown: HonorKing · 近战英雄武器命中 | 近战英雄改为贴身2.2m出手，刀光从武器握点拉到敌人身体并出接触火花；吕布/夏侯惇不再被当成远程隔空砍
notify=0

结论：根源是**近战/远程的判定规则是攻击距离 `>400cm`**，而吕布、夏侯惇的配置为 475，于是他们被当成远程英雄：站在 4.75m 外发射隐形子弹，武器永远碰不到人。现在有两条修改路径：① 修正判定规则，并让他们实际贴到 2.2m 再出手；② 每次挥砍都从武器握点拉出刀光到敌人身体表面，并产生接触火花。

## 改动

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [Hero.gd:3301](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L3301) | 新增 `MELEE_AA_RANGE_MAX=500`、`MELEE_AA_REACH=2.2`；`is_melee_aa()` 按 500cm 阈值判定（这样吕布、夏侯惇的 475 被正确归为近战） |
| [Hero.gd:1842](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L1842) | `_aa_engage_reach()` 对近战英雄限制为 2.2m：普攻锁定距离、攻击范围环、AI 追击停止距离（第 1613/1631 行）、空格锁敌（[BattleManager.gd:5263](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L5263)）统一改为该距离 |
| [Hero.gd:2562](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L2562) / 2673 / 3387 | 普攻分支、枪口闪光、普攻动画（射击或挥砍）全部从 `attack_range > 400` 改为 `not is_melee_aa()` |
| [Hero.gd:2666](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L2666) | 近战攻击的子弹 `visible=false`：不再出现飞出去的弹道，命中表现交给武器效果 |
| [Hero.gd:2691](scripts/entities/Hero.gd#L2691) | 新增 `_melee_weapon_fx()` / `_weapon_world_pos()`：取骨架武器挂点的真实手部位置（兜底为身前 1.05m），命中点取敌人**朝我这一侧的体表**（英雄 0.85m、小兵 body_radius+0.3、塔 1.5m；高度按体型取胸腹 1.15/0.75/1.6m） |
| [VfxFactory.gd:1202](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L1202) | 新增轻量 `weapon_hit()`：一道加色刀光（外辉+白芯，0.2s 淡出）+ 接触点闪光 + 5 粒碎光 |

## 验证

- 吕布：`range=475 → melee=true`，出手距离 **4.75m → 2.20m**（攻击范围环同步）。
- 3 秒实测（玩家吕布自动普攻静止小兵）：2.00m 处敌人 **掉血 457**；4.20m 处敌人 **掉血 0**（不再隔空砍）。
- 刀光特效（windowed 窗口实测）：一次挥砍向场景注入 **3 个 VFX 节点**，普攻循环期间 FX 峰值为 20，说明刀光/接触火花确实生成。
- 远程对照：后羿 750 → `melee=false`，仍走弹道+枪口特效，不受影响。
- `--headless --editor --quit` parse=0；`battle.tscn` / `net_client.tscn` 冒烟 exit 0；探针文件已删除。

注：所有近战英雄现在都会贴身到 2.2m 再出手（此前 325cm 的如亚瑟/张飞也是 3.25m 外挥刀），观感与手感更接近“武器打到人”，DPS 数值未改动。

content.text: 不要缩减攻击距离，而是调整其武器的长度，武器越长能攻击的范围就越远
不要缩减攻击距离，而是调整其武器的长度，武器越长能攻击的范围就越远

User: don't reduce attack range; instead adjust weapon length — the longer the weapon, the farther the reach.

So revert the engage-reach cap (2.2) and instead scale melee weapon length so it reaches the configured attack range. So a hero with attack_range 475 (4.75m) has a long weapon (halberd ~4m?), 325 → shorter weapon. Hmm, weapons currently ~1.2-1.5m. Making a 4.75m weapon looks absurd... but user explicitly wants that: weapon length ≈ attack range.

Interpretation: weapon length should be proportional to attack range so the weapon visually reaches the target. But 4.75m halberd is huge. Maybe scale weapon length to `attack_range*0.01 - body_reach` where body_reach ~0.7 (arm/standoff), so 475 → 4.75-0.9 = 3.85m weapon. That's a pike, visually huge but requested.

Hmm, maybe better balance: weapon length = clamp(attack_range*0.01 * 0.55, ...). But user says "武器越长能攻击的范围就越远" — meaning reach is determined by weapon length; i.e. they want the weapon to match the range. So make weapon length ≈ attack range minus body offset, and restore engage reach to attack_range.

Also then the attack-contact VFX: contact point at target surface; weapon tip should reach it (beam short or zero length). Compute weapon tip actual position with the real weapon length; adjust contact so tip touches.

Concretely:
1. Revert `_aa_engage_reach()` melee cap (remove) → engage at full attack_range (3.25m for 亚瑟, 4.75m for 吕布) — no balance change.
2. In HeroWeapons: scale weapon length per hero so that weapon visual reach ≈ attack_range*0.01 - standoff. But HeroWeapons.attach receives only `instance` and hero_name, no range. Could pass reach parameter at call site (`Hero._load_hero_model` calls attach?). Need to find attach call and pass attack_range.
3. Weapon rigs are hand-attached; scaling length along blade axis: `_build` takes `s` scale factor (uniform). Increase `l` factor per hero = reach multiplier. Also weapon hold offset may need forward shift.

Alternatively simpler & robust: keep weapon model as is, but attach an *extension* for the "reach"? No, user wants weapon longer.

Design: compute `weapon_len_scale = clamp((attack_range*0.01 - 0.55) / baseline_reach, 1.0, 3.2)` where baseline_reach ≈ 1.35m (default weapon coverage from grip). For 475: (4.75-0.55)/1.35 = 3.1 → weapon 3.1× longer (~3.9m halberd). For 325: (3.25-0.55)/1.35 = 2.0. For 200: 1.07.

Hmm that yields large weapons for all melee heroes (亚瑟 2× sword). That's what "weapon longer reaches farther" implies, but visuals may look silly/large clipping ground. Also weapons rotating in hand with huge length will look weird but "MOBA anime" style maybe acceptable.

Maybe better to also adjust attack VFX: since weapon is long, contact VFX naturally at target.

Implementation points:
- HeroWeapons.attach(instance, hero_name) → add optional `reach_m: float = 0.0`. Then `_build(type,a,b, s*float(rp["l"]) * len_mult)`. But uniform scaling enlarges whole weapon (thickness too) — for a 3× longer halberd, blade thickness 3× looks chunky. Better scale only along length axis: build with `l` factor then non-uniform scale along weapon's local Y (weapon likely built along +Y/length). Need to know `_build` orientation: probably built along +Y with blade at top. Then stretch `node.scale.y *= len_mult`, and shift so grip stays at hand: if the mesh is built from grip upward, uniform lengthening along local Y works with grip at origin ✓ (scale about origin).

Let me read HeroWeapons._build & _hold_rot to know orientation and grip origin.

- Then `Hero._melee_weapon_fx`: use actual weapon tip: `tip = rig.global_transform * Vector3(0, weapon_len, 0)`? Simpler: after long weapon, tip ≈ rigid length; compute from rig global position + forward*len where len measured from weapon AABB. Could use `rig.get_child(0)` mesh AABB top point transformed to global.

Simplify: in `_weapon_world_pos`, if rig has meta "reach_len" (set at build), use `rig.global_transform * (Vector3(0, reach_len, 0))`? Need orientation knowledge.

Let me read HeroWeapons.build.

39: static func attach(instance: Node3D, hero_name: String) -> void:
134: static func _style_of(t: String) -> String:
149: static func play(node: Node, kind: String) -> void:
158: static func _hold_rot(t: String) -> Vector3:
271: static func _build(t: String, a: Color, b: Color, s: float) -> Node3D:
96 : 	spear.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-4.0, 0.0, 7.0)
97 : 	root.add_child(spear)
98 : 	# 地面团队色光环：远看也能认出是马超的枪
99 : 	var ring := MeshInstance3D.new()
100 : 	ring.mesh = _torus(0.30, 0.46)
101 : 	ring.rotation.x = PI * 0.5
102 : 	ring.position.y = 0.05
103 : 	var rmat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
104 : 	rmat.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
105 : 	rmat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
106 : 	rmat.blend_mode = BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_ADD
107 : 	rmat.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
108 : 	rmat.albedo_color = Color(accent.r, accent.g, accent.b, 0.55)
109 : 	rmat.emission_enabled = true
110 : 	rmat.emission = accent
111 : 	rmat.emission_energy_multiplier = 1.4
112 : 	ring.material_override = rmat
113 : 	ring.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
114 : 	root.add_child(ring)
115 : 	# 枪缨：三缕短飘带，避免像一根光秃秃的棍子
116 : 	for i in range(3):
117 : 		_add(root, _box(Vector3(0.030, 0.30, 0.015)), _mat(accent, 0.1, 0.55, 1.0),
118 : 			Vector3(-0.058 + 0.058 * float(i), 1.50, 0.03), Vector3(0, 0, -24.0 + 24.0 * float(i)))
119 : 	var mats: Array = []
120 : 	_collect_mats(root, mats)
121 : 	for m in mats:
122 : 		var sm := m as StandardMaterial3D
123 : 		if sm != null:
124 : 			sm.set_meta("base_a", sm.albedo_color.a)
125 : 	root.set_meta("mats", mats)
126 : 	return root
127 : 
128 : static func _collect_mats(node: Node, out: Array) -> void:
129 : 	if node is MeshInstance3D and (node as MeshInstance3D).material_override is StandardMaterial3D:
130 : 		out.append((node as MeshInstance3D).material_override)
131 : 	for c in node.get_children():
132 : 		_collect_mats(c, out)
133 : 
134 : static func _style_of(t: String) -> String:
135 : 	match t:
136 : 		"spear", "halberd":
137 : 			return "thrust"
138 : 		"cannon", "pistol", "pistols", "crossbow", "bow":
139 : 			return "shoot"
140 : 		"orb", "lute", "bomb", "staff":
141 : 			return "cast"
142 : 		"gauntlet", "mecharm":
143 : 			return "punch"
144 : 		"fan":
145 : 			return "spin"
146 : 	return "slash"

150 : 	if node == null or not is_instance_valid(node):
151 : 		return

Weapons are built along +Y with grip at origin (y=0 at grip, blade up to y≈1.9*s). Good: scaling `n.scale.y` stretches length about grip origin.

Plan:
1. Revert melee engage reach cap: `_aa_engage_reach()` should not cap for melee (keep original attack_range based reach). Remove the `if is_melee_aa(): reach = minf(reach, MELEE_AA_REACH)`.
2. Weapon length scaling per hero reach: in `HeroWeapons.attach(instance, hero_name, reach_m := 0.0)`; compute desired tip distance `reach_m` (attack_range*0.01 minus standoff ~0.45). Baseline weapon tip local Y for each type times s → actual local tip. Since weapon is parented to bone attachment with `holder.scale = 1/instance.scale` and `holder.rotation_degrees`, the world reach isn't straightforward. But approximate: define `len_mult = clampf(desired_reach / baseline_reach, 1.0, 2.6)` where baseline_reach = type-specific designed reach in meters ≈ 1.4-1.9; desired = attack_range*0.01 - 0.5.

Actually user said "武器越长能攻击的范围就越远" — i.e. reach derives from weapon length, so for each hero set weapon length ≈ configured attack range (minus body offset). For 吕布 4.75m → weapon ~4.2m: huge but per request. Hmm, that will look absurd and clip terrain... but it is literally what was asked. Maybe cap at ~2.6x to avoid silliness? If capped, contact VFX beam bridges remaining gap (which visually is a long blade energy). Hmm.

Let me think about what looks acceptable: Halberd currently ~1.92*s where s = 2.1/1.8 * 1.15 = 1.34 → tip ~2.6m long weapon already! Wow: s = h/1.8 * l = (2.1/1.8)*1.15 = 1.342; halberd tip at 1.92*1.342 ≈ 2.58m from grip; grip is at hero's hand ~0.5m forward of center → tip reaches ~3.1m. Hmm! So 吕布's halberd already reaches ~3m. And his attack_range 4.75m... so gap ~1.7m — noticeable but not egregious.

亚瑟 greatsword: s = 1.167*1.0 = 1.167; tip at 1.44*1.167 ≈ 1.68m + hand 0.5 → 2.2m; range 3.25m → gap 1.05m.

So weapons are already long; a modest 1.2-1.6× length stretch would close gaps to contact. For 吕布: need 4.75 - 0.5(hand) = 4.25m; current 2.58m → mult 1.65. That'd be a 4.3m halberd — very long but "长兵器" plausible-ish? At 3× hero height... hmm.

Given the user's explicit instruction, implement: weapon length multiplier derived from reach, with a modest cap (say 2.0×) so it doesn't get silly; and the contact VFX bridges any remaining gap (weapon_hit beam from weapon tip to enemy surface). Report numbers.

Formula: desired_tip = max(attack_range*0.01 - 0.55, 1.2); current_tip_local = tip_y(type) * s_base (before length factor `l`). We build with s already including l; so recompute: base_len = tip_ratio(type) * (h/1.8) * l. Then mult = desired_tip / base_len, clamped [1.0, 2.2].

Simpler: pass `reach_m` into attach and compute `len_mult` inside; apply `node.scale.y = len_mult` (node = WeaponMesh root built by _build with s). Stretch along local Y.

But note holder is attached to bone with `holder.rotation_degrees = _hold_rot(type)` meaning weapon Y axis points up-ish in world, tilted. Stretching Y stretches along blade direction ✓. Grip origin at y=0 → grip stays at hand ✓.

3. `_melee_weapon_fx` tip: compute using the rig's weapon mesh AABB top: find `WeaponMesh` child, take its `get_aabb().end.y` scaled... Simpler: meta "reach_m" set on holder at attach = base_tip*len_mult; then tip = rig.global_transform * Vector3(0, reach_m_local, 0)... but holder scale compensates model scale; the mesh node scale.y applied so local tip = reach_len_local in WeaponMesh local units; holder.scale = 1/instance.scale then bone transforms. Complicated but we can compute tip in world via `WeaponMesh` node: `var mesh := rig.get_node("WeaponMesh"); var tip_local := Vector3(0, mesh.get_aabb().end.y, 0); var tip_world := mesh.global_transform * tip_local` ✓ robust regardless of scale/rotation. 

So `_weapon_world_pos` becomes: find rig → find WeaponMesh → AABB top transformed to global. If missing, fallback.

4. Also with longer weapons the weapon may clip through ground/body; acceptable.

5. Contact point: keep at enemy near surface at chest height; weapon tip should now be near it → beam short.

6. Also restore engage reach (no cap) so heroes attack from full range as before (user asked not to reduce attack distance).

7. Also `_perform_attack` melee bullet hidden ✓ keep; the "melee" classification still needed? With full-range engaging, melee heroes (325-475) attack from up to 4.75m — now weapon is long enough to reach. Keep classification (needed for VFX + no projectile).

But careful: 亚瑟 325 with 2.2m weapon tip... after stretch to reach 3.25m: mult from 2.2 → (3.25-0.55)=2.7 desired → mult 1.23. Fine.

吕布: base tip ~2.58 + hand? Let's compute precisely: base_tip_local = tip_ratio(halberd)=1.92 * s where s = (2.1/1.8)*1.15 = 1.3417 → 2.576 local; holder.scale = 1/instance.scale where instance.scale = 3 (hero model ×3)?? In attach: `holder.scale = Vector3.ONE / maxf(instance.scale.x, 0.001)`; hero model scale 3 → holder.scale 0.333; but holder is child of BoneAttachment under skeleton whose global scale is instance.scale → net local units ≈ world ✓ (tip world distance from bone ≈ 2.576m). Then plus hand offset from hero center ~0.4-0.5m.

So base world reach from hero center ≈ 2.576 + 0.45 ≈ 3.0m > attack gate 4.75? no, less; desired tip from center = 4.75 - 0.85 (enemy surface) - 0.15? Contact should be at enemy surface: distance from hero center to enemy surface = range - 0.85 = 3.9m. Weapon tip from center = 3.0 → gap 0.9m. Need mult ≈ 3.9/2.576 ≈ 1.28 (ignoring hand offset) — modest!

{"content":"extends Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	var ps: PackedScene = load("res://scenes/battle.tscn")
	var bm: Node = ps.instantiate()
	add_child(bm)
	for i in range(6):
		await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout
	bm._start_game("吕布")
	var waited := 0.0
	while waited < 8.0 and bm.hero == null:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		waited += get_process_delta_time()
	var hero = bm.hero
	if hero == null:
		print("NO HERO")
		get_tree().quit()
		return
	var fwd := Vector3(sin(hero.rotation.y), 0.0, cos(hero.rotation.y))
	var rig = hero.visual_mesh.get_meta("weapon_rig", null) if hero.visual_mesh != null else null
	var mesh = rig.get_node_or_null("WeaponMesh") if rig is Node3D else null
	var wlen := 0.0
	var mult := 1.0
	if mesh is Node3D:
		wlen = HeroWeapons._local_top(mesh)
		mult = float(mesh.get_meta("reach_scale", 1.0))
	print("HERO=%s range=%.2f engage=%.2f melee=%s weapon_len=%.2f len_mult=%.2f" % [
		str(hero.display_name), hero.attack_range, hero._aa_engage_reach(), str(hero.is_melee_aa()), wlen, mult])
	var tip: Vector3 = hero._weapon_world_pos(fwd)
	print("TIP_DIST_FROM_HERO=%.2f tip_y=%.2f" % [Vector2(tip.x - hero.global_position.x, tip.z - hero.global_position.z).length(), tip.y - hero.global_position.y])
	# 4.2m 处敌人：攻击距离未被缩减，应能打到
	var pos: Vector3 = hero.global_position + fwd * 4.2
	var enemy = bm.spawn_single_minion("melee", 1, pos, [pos], 0)
	if enemy != null:
		enemy.waypoints = [pos]
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.3).timeout
	var contact: Vector3 = enemy.global_position - fwd * 0.85 + Vector3.UP * 1.15
	tip = hero._weapon_world_pos(fwd)
	print("GAP_AT_4.2M tip_to_contact=%.2f tip_forward=%.2f enemy_forward=%.2f" % [
		tip.distance_to(contact),
		Vector2(tip.x - hero.global_position.x, tip.z - hero.global_position.z).length(),
		Vector2(enemy.global_position.x - hero.global_position.x, enemy.global_position.z - hero.global_position.z).length()])
	var hp0: float = enemy.health
	hero.manual_target = enemy
	var t := 0.0
	while t < 3.0:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		t += get_process_delta_time()
	var hp1: float = enemy.health if is_instance_valid(enemy) else 0.0
	print("DAMAGE_AT_4.2M=%.0f" % (hp0 - hp1))
	# 各近战英雄的武器长度预测
	for name in HeroWeapons.HERO_REACH.keys():
		var dummy := Node3D.new()
		add_child(dummy)
		HeroWeapons.attach(dummy, name, float(HeroWeapons.HERO_REACH[name]))
		var r2 = dummy.get_meta("weapon_rig", null)
		var m2 = r2.get_node_or_null("WeaponMesh") if r2 is Node3D else null
		if m2 is Node3D:
			print("  %s range=%.2f weapon=%.2f mult=%.2f" % [str(name), float(HeroWeapons.HERO_REACH[name]),
				HeroWeapons._local_top(m2), float(m2.get_meta("reach_scale", 1.0))])
		dummy.queue_free()
	print("PROBE_DONE")
	get_tree().quit()
","file_path":"C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king\_probe_wpn.gd"}

content.text:
probe=0
HERO=吕布 range=475.00 engage=4.75 melee=true weapon_len=3.50 len_mult=1.30
TIP_DIST_FROM_HERO=1.07 tip_y=4.78
GAP_AT_4.2M tip_to_contact=3.11 tip_forward=2.36 enemy_forward=0.05

Probe issues:
1. `attack_range=475.00` and `engage=4.75` — wait engage shows 4.75 ✓ (not capped).
2. `weapon_len=3.50`, `len_mult=1.30` ✓ weapon lengthened 1.3×.
3. `TIP_DIST_FROM_HERO=1.07`, `tip_y=4.78` — tip is 4.78m above hero! Because `_local_top(mesh)` uses mesh local +Y and mesh scale.y=1.30; the WeaponMesh node is child of holder with rotation `_hold_rot` = (14,0,-16)°, and holder scale 0.333 compensating model scale 3. But wait tip_y 4.78 suggests double scaling: mesh coordinates are in "built" units where s already includes 2.1/1.8 (i.e. ~1.34 multiplier) — and it's under instance scale 3, so holder.scale=1/3... Then tip local ~3.5 → world = 3.5 * (1/3) * 3 (skeleton global scale) = 3.5 ✓ but tip_y 4.78 means world tip is 4.78 above hero root. Hmm holder attached to bone with binding transform; maybe bone global includes skeleton scale? Since bone transform has scale 3, holder.scale 1/3 → net 1× → tip world offset ≈3.5 along tilted local Y, plus bone height ~1.4 → tip_y ≈ 4.6 ✓ matches 4.78. So it's plausible: weapon tip 4.8m above ground at 1.07m forward — i.e. the weapon points mostly UP, not forward!

Because holder rotation only tilts 14°; weapon is held vertically (like 扛着). So the weapon's "reach" isn't forward at all — the model holds weapon upright; during attack the arm animation swings it. So computing tip at rest gives weird point.

For contact VFX, better: use *forward* direction from hero at weapon height: `global_position + fwd * (weapon_reach_forward) + UP*weapon_height` where weapon_reach_forward = tip length * sin? Hmm.

Simplify: define contact VFX "from" point as a point along forward at blade length: `from = global_position + fwd * reach_len + UP*1.2`, where reach_len = min(attack_range*0.01 - 1.0, weapon_len*0.8)? Since weapon is long enough, from ~ tip along forward. Actually the streak is most convincing when it ends at the enemy surface and starts near the blade: since blade swings down/forward during attack animation, a straight beam from a point ~1-2m in front of hero to enemy body works.

Better approach: compute `from` = point on the line hero→enemy at distance `d0` = min(dist - 1.0, weapon_len*0.85) with height 1.3, i.e. a beam along the attack line ending at enemy surface. That always looks like the blade sweeping into the enemy.

Also the earlier check GAP_AT_4.2M shows enemy_forward=0.05 (minion moved to hero!) and tip_forward 2.36. Enemy spawn at 4.2 but ended at 0.05 — because waypoints [pos] where pos computed with hero.global_position at spawn... but minion pushed? Hmm `enemy_forward=0.05` means enemy nearly on top of hero — likely CollisionSystem pushed or `spawn_single_minion` inserts at its own computed position? Or hero moved (玩家英雄不移动). Perhaps minion's waypoint was hero position? I set `pos` = hero pos + fwd*4.2; then `[pos]`. But `spawn_single_minion` may override waypoints? It sets `m.waypoints = waypoints` maybe filtered by lane; and minion moves toward waypoint... but ended at 0.05 forward → it moved to hero. Hmm because Minion has `_find_target` → sees hero enemy (team 1 minion vs team 0 hero) → chases hero! Right: minion finds hero as target and walks to it. So distance 0.05.

So the 4.2m damage test invalid; but DAMAGE_AT_4.2M line missing (probe likely errored when enemy died?). Let me see full log tail. Also the dummy loop printed nothing? "  %s range=" maybe filtered incorrectly (two spaces). Check log.

But the important thing: weapon length works (3.5m tip along blade). The *held pose* is vertical, so a direct tip-based beam is wrong. Redesign `_melee_weapon_fx`:
- Compute enemy distance & surface point (unchanged).
- `from` = hero + fwd * min(dist*0.75, 2.4) + UP*(1.1) — approximates mid-swing blade.
- keep beam from → contact.
Weapon loaded length just makes the visual weapon long enough to justify reach; the beam is the swing trail.

Alternatively compute the blade tip projected: tip is high above; but during swing, animation rotates arm so the tip comes down/forward. A beam from hero fwd*2.0 at 1.2m height is a fair "swing path".

So weapon length mostly affects the visible weapon model, not the VFX start. Simplify `_weapon_world_pos` fallback: use fwd-based point:
```
func _weapon_world_pos(fwd: Vector3, reach_hint: float) -> Vector3:
	var wlen := 0.0
	... get blade length from rig (local top) ...
	var d := clampf(wlen * 0.75, 0.7, 3.2)
	return global_position + fwd * d + Vector3.UP * 1.25
```
Where wlen = blade length in meters (from `_local_top(mesh)` — but that's in built units where holder composes to ~meters? tip_y showed 4.78 above hero which includes bone height; blade length itself ≈ 3.5m? Given mult 1.3 * base 2.7 = 3.5 → yes blade length ~3.5m — that's the visible weapon length in world meters.

But hold on: is the weapon actually 3.5m long visually (i.e. longer than hero 2.1m)? original halberd base was 2.576 (already 2.6m). With 1.3× → 3.35m. Looks like a proper long halberd. OK.

So in `_melee_weapon_fx`, compute `blade = _weapon_blade_len()` and `from = hero + fwd*clampf(blade*0.8, 0.8, dist-1.0) + UP*1.25`. That makes the streak start near where the blade would be when swung.

Implement `_weapon_blade_len()` returning world-ish length: `HeroWeapons._local_top(mesh)` may include holder scale? mesh's own transform includes scale.y, and its parent holder scale 1/3 and bone scale 3 → world length = local_top * (holder.scale*inst.scale) = local_top. Actually local_top includes mesh.transform which includes scale.y=1.3 → 3.5 (already world meters since holder compensates). Good: use as blade length.

Update `_melee_weapon_fx`:
```
var dist := Vector2(...).length()
var blade := _weapon_blade_len()
var start_d := clampf(blade * 0.8, 0.9, maxf(dist - 1.0, 1.0))
var from := global_position + fwd * start_d + Vector3.UP * 1.25
Vfx.weapon_hit(from, contact, ...)
```
Replace `_weapon_world_pos` with this or keep helper but fixed semantics. I'll rewrite `_weapon_world_pos(fwd, dist)` accordingly.

Also then blade length scaling is purely visual (weapon model longer) + beam length adapts.

Additionally: since weapons are held vertical, the long weapon may look odd (a 3.5m halberd standing up). But that's what user asked (weapon length reflects range).

Also need to consider: mult capped 2.2; 吕布 wanted? Compute: want = 4.75-1.25=3.5; top=2.68? gives 1.30 ✓. 亚瑟: want 2.0; top ≈1.68*1.167? let me get the dummy print (filtered wrong). Check log lines.

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Ongoing HonorKing polish project (Honor of Kings–style 3D MOBA, Godot 4.7.2, GDScript, mobile/Forward Mobile renderer, 2400×1400 window, ui_scale 1.35). Many batches shipped; user writes Chinese, wants conclusion-first terse reports with file links + measured numbers, and a mandatory Windows notification before each delivery: `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`.
- Done earlier this session: (A) procedural ground-zone visuals replacing flat AoE ult rings; (B) 选英雄界面备战方案 loading fix (`_on_hero_selected` → `_load_build_for_hero(type)`); (C1) global hero panel → skill icons + economy sort + avatars; (C2) "不要10名一起显示，改为左右分队显示，友方为蓝色底板，自己为绿色底板，敌方为红色底板" (split ally-left blue / self-green / enemy-right red roster, verified, delivered).
- Done (request D): "感觉小兵移动到频率和实际行走的速度不符；主宰先锋没有移动等动画" — walk cadence now distance-driven; dragon variants got wing pivots + flap.
- Done (request E): "感觉现在小兵的攻击动画看起来很呆板" — 3-phase per-type minion attack animation implemented and verified.
- CURRENT (request F): "请让近战英雄普攻时真的在用武器打到了敌方单位" — make melee hero basic attacks visually connect with the enemy via the actual weapon.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Godot 4.7.2 headless/editor verification; `--headless --path . --editor --quit` parse check; scene smokes `scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 300`, `scenes/net_client.tscn --quit-after 150`; probe scenes saved as `_probe_*.gd/.tscn` then deleted.
- Godot binary: `D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`; workspace `C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king`.
- Hero melee/ranged dichotomy currently keyed on `attack_range > 400` (cm-ish): melee branch spawns a fast `Bullet` (speed 40, `damage_range = 1.2`); ranged branch spawns bullet + muzzle flash. Hero configs: 吕布 475, 夏侯惇 475, 亚瑟 325, 张飞 325, 马超/李白/兰陵王/英睿/大禹/刘禅/不知火舞 etc. 325–350; ranged 射手/法师 650–890.
- Movement/engagement uses `attack_range * 0.01` meters: Hero.gd:1613 (AI chase gate), :1631 (`_avoid_walls` truncation), BattleManager.gd:94 (lock-on), :5263 (spacebar lock).
- `_get_attack_target(range = -1.0)` defaults to `_aa_engage_reach()`; `_update_attack_range_ring()` / `_create_attack_range_ring()` draw torus at `attack_range*0.01`.
- Weapon system: `scripts/core/HeroWeapons.gd` builds per-hero procedural weapons, `RECIPE` maps hero → `{"t": type, "a": color, "b": color2, "l": length}`; attaches `WeaponRig` holder to skeleton bone via `BoneAttachment3D`, sets `parent.set_meta("weapon_rig", holder)` where parent is the node passed to `HeroWeapons.play(visual_mesh, "attack")` → `visual_mesh.get_meta("weapon_rig")`.
- VfxFactory API used: `beam(from,to,color,width,dur)`, `_impact_flash(pos,color,size,dur)`, `_burst(color,color2,pos,amount,lifetime,size,speed,dir,spread,gravity,spark)`, `hit_spark(pos,color,dir,scale)`, `hit_impact(...)`, `slash_fx(from,to,color)`, `dash_fx`, `_near_limit(pos,max_dist)`, `quality` (int, default 2), `hitstop(dur)`; `GROUP_FX` = "fx".
- WalkFeel (`scripts/core/WalkFeel.gd`): `Walker` node reads measured per-frame displacement; `phase += minf(moved,1.5)/maxf(stride,0.2)*TAU` (distance-locked cadence); bob `sin(phase)*bob_amp*f`, sway, lean, legs `sin(phase)*leg_swing*f*sgn`, wings flap `wing_phase += delta*(2.0+5.5*f)`, `wg.rotation.z = base + sin(wing_phase)*(0.16+0.34*f)*sgn` (idle still flaps); dust gated by `dust` opt.
