tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.description: Change a reminder in place, keeping its id. Supply a new title, prompt, or at most one timing parameter; omitted fields keep their stored values. To change a relative delay, create a new reminder.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

结论：联机选人已改成和单机完全一致的**固定顺序轮选**（BP），并把“显示阵容”和“实际开局阵容”对齐。

## 改动

| 位置 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [NetLobby.gd:29](scripts/net/NetLobby.gd#L29) | 固定顺序直接使用单机版常量：`SEL_DRAFT_ORDER` 10 步蛇形 `[[0,0],[1,0],[1,1],[0,1],[0,2],[1,2],[1,3],[0,3],[0,4],[1,4]]`、每步 20s `SEL_DRAFT_TURN_TIME` |
| [NetLobby.gd:694](scripts/net/NetLobby.gd#L694) | 以 host 为权威的轮选引擎：每步倒计时、真人锁定后进入下一步；AI 或红方席位在 1.2~2.2s 内自动选择作为展示；超时由 host 代替选择；第 10 步后补齐未锁定席位 |
| [NetLobby.gd:1114](scripts/net/NetLobby.gd#L1114) | 阶段条「第 N/10 步 · 蓝/红方 X 号位」+ 倒计时环；非本回合英雄卡全部置灰（“等待他人”），已被占标“已被占”，结束时“已选定” |
| [NetSession.gd:432](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L432) | `draft` 状态随原 `lobby_state` RPC 广播，没有新增 RPC；host 校验“仅当前回合玩家、英雄全局唯一、本队一职一人”；无 `draft` 字段的旧主机自动退回“同时选人” |
| [NetSession.gd:447](scripts/net/NetSession.gd#L447) | 新增 `get_draft_teams()`：按阵营/席位取出 BP 结果 |
| [BattleManager.gd:270](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L270) | `_start_net_lineup` 用 BP 结果生成 AI/红方阵容（`_create_team_ai` 已支持 `forced_heroes`），不再随机 |

## 验证（实测）

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 顺序推进 | 探针 10 步全程推进，标题「第 1/10…第 10/10」；3 个阵容中英雄全局唯一、双方职责唯一均为 true |
| 轮次约束 | guest 非本回合：6/6 英雄卡 disabled、锁定按钮 disabled，点卡提示「还没轮到你 · 等待 我方 3 号位」；本回合 6/6 可用，副行「轮到你选 · 剩余 15s」 |
| 超时兜底 | 20s 到期 host 代选本分路英雄（夏侯惇/战士）并 step+1 |
| 阵容一致性（本轮新增） | 造 BP 阵容 10 人 → 开局实体 10 个，**缺失 0 个**：亚瑟/妲己/后羿/李白/张飞 + 吕布/甄姬/孙尚香/兰陵王/太乙真人，与展示完全一致 |
| 真实双进程 | host+guest 实机联机：guest 第 4 步轮到自己锁定狄仁杰 → host 收录并推进到第 10 步、全员锁齐可开局；抢选被拒并提示原因 |
| 冒烟 | `--editor --quit` / `battle 420` / `net_client 200` / `lobby 150` 全部 **exit 0**，无 SCRIPT ERROR |

## 仍有限制

- 协议兼容是单向的：新主机 + 旧客户端会因“不在回合”被拒（同版本联机不受影响）；旧主机 + 新客户端自动退回同时选人。
- 分路限制仍是客户端侧约束（host 不知道他人 PlayerPrefs 分路），host 只强制英雄全局唯一 + 本队一职一人。
- 中途加入者若错过自己的回合，会在第 10 步后由房主补锁（不卡开局，但不是本人所选）。

{"message":"新任务（HonorKing 工作区 C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king）：用户要求两点，改联机流程：
1) **删除房主的「开始游戏/开始对局」按钮**，改为**所有人就绪（全员锁定）后自动开始**；
2) **加入加载界面**（现在从大厅进对局没有加载页，直接跳场景，观感像卡住）。

【现状定位（grep 定点读，别整文件回显）】
- `scripts/net/NetLobby.gd`：`_host_go_btn`（约 1543 行创建、1718-1720 更新文案）、`_on_host_go`/开始对局回调、2148 行 `phase == NetSession.Phase.BATTLE` 分支里 2194/2198 `change_scene_to_file`（host→battle.tscn、client→net_client.tscn）。
- `scripts/net/NetSession.gd`：`start_match()`（约 509 行，host 校验 `_all_active_picked()` 后置 `phase = Phase.BATTLE` 并广播）。
- `scripts/ui/LoadingScreen.gd`（348 行）：单机已有王者式加载界面，支持 `manual_progress`、`hold_full`、进度条/英雄列表；`BattleManager.gd` 约 327-360 行是用法样例（`_show_loading()`、`loading_screen.set_progress(...)` 之类，自行 grep `loading_screen` 看接口）。

【要做的】
A. 自动开局（NetLobby.gd）：
- 移除 host 的「▶ 开始对局」按钮（连同其 `_host_go_btn` 引用/回调/占位，注意别留空节点破坏底栏布局：空位改为一行状态文字，例如「全员就绪后自动进入对局（N/5 已锁）」）。
- host 侧：当 `_all_active_picked()`（全员锁定；顺序选人 step=10 也满足）成立时，延迟约 1.2~1.5s 自动 `NetSession.start_match()`（给玩家看到"全员就绪"反馈），并做防重入（只触发一次）。若有人中途解锁/掉线，取消这个待开局计时。
- 其余玩家：显示「全员已就绪 · 正在进入对局…」状态（不再需要任何人点按钮）。
B. 加载界面（进入对局阶段）：
- host/client 在 `phase == BATTLE` 切场景**之前**覆盖一层加载界面：优先**复用** `scripts/ui/LoadingScreen.gd`（不要新写一套视觉；若它是 Control/CanvasLayer，NetLobby 里同样能 add_child）。内容至少：标题「进入对局」、双方阵容头像/姓名（大厅已有 picks 与英雄数据）、进度条（host 用真实搭建进度或按帧推进；client 等首帧/首个快照也可先推进到 100% 再切场景）、`process_mode = PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS`。
- 切场景时机：加载层显示后延迟 ≥0.4s 再 `change_scene_to_file`，避免闪一下；若 battle.tscn 侧 `BattleManager` 已有自己的加载界面（`_loading_shown`），不要让两层同时出现——host 进 battle.tscn 时优先用 BattleManager 自带加载（可只在 NetLobby 侧做很短的过场），client 进 net_client.tscn 时由 NetLobby 加载层负责（NetClientBattle 若无加载界面则保留到场景就绪）。
- client 端 net_client.tscn 首次连上/首帧后再撤加载层（若跨场景无法保留，就在 NetLobby 里保留到 `change_scene_to_file` 前一刻，进场景后由 NetClientBattle 现有「等待快照」文字接管即可）。

【写作用域】`scripts/net/NetLobby.gd` 为主；如必须，可在 `scripts/net/` 新增一个薄封装（如 `NetLoading.gd`）或改 `scripts/ui/LoadingScreen.gd` 的复用接口（只加可选参数，不改单机现有调用点行为）。**禁止改** NetSession 的 draft 逻辑（刚做完的顺序选人）、BattleManager 的 `_start_net_lineup`、NetClientBattle 的 FX/属性面板区段。

【规范】中文一行注释；最小 diff；不重构无关代码；不改数值平衡；不 commit；不弹通知（Lead 统一发）；临时探针 `_probe_*` 用完删除（含 .import/.uid），最终 `git status --porcelain` 不得有 `_probe` 残留。

【验证】Godot：`D:\Downloads\06_游戏与Flash资源\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64.exe\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe`
- `--headless --path . --editor --quit` exit 0
- `scenes/lobby.tscn --quit-after 150`、`scenes/net_client.tscn --quit-after 200`、`scenes/battle.tscn --quit-after 300` 全部 exit 0 无 SCRIPT ERROR
- 量化证据：伪 lobby_state / 直接调用锁定流程后打印「全员锁定 → 自动 start_match 的耗时」、`phase` 值、「开始对局」按钮已不存在（原路径 get_node_or_null 为 null）、加载层节点存在 + 进度值推进、切场景调用次数=1（防重入）。
- 若可行，跑一次真实双进程（host+guest headless）确认自动开局与加载层不报错。

【交付】send_message 给 lead：一句话结论；改动 `路径:行号`+说明；验证命令/exit code/量化数字；未做项与原因。","target":"lobby-fullscreen"}

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

User: "手机版有些字符无法显示" — mobile/web build has some characters not displaying (missing glyphs, tofu boxes). Likely the default font doesn't include certain glyphs (e.g., special symbols like ▶ ▾ ▴ ✓ ∞ · ≈, or CJK characters not in the bundled font subset). Since web export exists (scripts/dev/export_web.ps1) — "手机版" might mean the web build viewed on phone.

Root cause likely: custom font used (UiKit.font()) loads a font resource cover only common CJK; missing glyphs fall back to system font which on mobile/web may lack them. Fix: ensure fallback font chain or replace uncommon glyphs with supported ones.

Need to investigate: what font is used, does it include full CJK + symbols. Check `UiKit.font()` and font resources in project (assets/fonts?). Also likely the project uses a specific font file e.g. `assets/fonts/NotoSansSC-Regular.otf`. Missing chars could be rare CJK (e.g., 铠, 妲, 甄, 兰陵王?) or symbols like ▾ ▴ ▶ ∞ ✓ ✕.

Approach: enumerate all characters used in UI strings across scripts, compute coverage of the font(s), find missing ones, then either (a) add fallback font, or (b) replace missing glyphs with supported alternatives.

I can compute font coverage with Python? FontTools may not be installed; but Python runtime may have fonttools? Alternatively use Godot itself: load font, check `font.has_char(code)` via `Font.has_char()` (Godot has `Font.has_char(char)`? There's `Font.has_char(int)` — yes FontFile/SystemFont have `has_char`). Best: headless Godot probe that scans all .gd files for string literals' characters and checks each against the fonts used, printing missing.

Simplest: probe loads font instance used by UiKit and iterates over characters collected from a hardcoded list... but collecting from .gd files needs FileAccess scanning in probe — feasible: read all .gd recursively via DirAccess, extract all non-ASCII chars from file text, check `font.has_char(code)`, print missing set.

Then decide fix: if missing chars are symbols, replace with ASCII alternatives or add fallback. If missing CJK, need a fuller font.

Let me start: check UiKit.font() implementation and font assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.text:
`UiKit.rec_card` computes icon rect internally: `ic = Rect2(rect.pos + (pad,pad), size = (h-2pad, h-2pad))`. So for RecItemCard._draw I can compute the same icon rect and draw glow around it before calling rec_card (glow behind icon, since rec_card draws chip then icon — glow behind chip would be hidden; better draw glow AFTER rec_card but then it overlaps icon edges — draw a ring just outside icon bounds: radius = ic.size/2 + few px; that's fine as it extends into text area a bit; acceptable visually).

Implementation for glow: helper function in UI_Manager (static) or inline in both RecItemCard and SkillIcon:

```gdscript
# 可购买/可升级提示：图标外圈旋转发光拖尾（纯绘制，无资源分配）
func _draw_glow_trail(ci: CanvasItem, center: Vector2, radius: float, phase: float, col: Color) -> void:
	for i in 3:
		var a0 := phase + TAU * float(i) / 3.0
		for k in 6:
			var t := float(k) / 6.0
			var a1 := a0 + t * 1.5
			var alpha := (1.0 - t) * 0.55
			ci.draw_arc(center, radius + 3.0 + t * 2.0, a0, a1, 8, Color(col.r, col.g, col.b, alpha), 5.0 - t * 2.5, true)
```
Hmm; simpler: draw 2-3 arcs with decreasing alpha behind leading edge. Also add a bright head dot.

3 : ## 版式：顶部结论条 + 左右分队双列（左=我方蓝底板 / 右=敌方红底板），
4 : ## 每列 5 行按该队总经济从高到低排序；自己所在行用绿色底板。
5 : ## 单卡 = 队内名次 / 头像 / 名字·等级·分路 / 血量 / 4 个技能图标 / 6 格装备 / 属性徽章 / KDA·经济。
6 : ## 纯 _draw 绘制，数据由 host UI_Manager 或 NetSession 推送的 roster 行转换而来。
7 : 
8 : const HeroArt = preload("res://scripts/ui/HeroArt.gd")
9 : const SkillArt = preload("res://scripts/ui/SkillArt.gd")
10 : 
11 : signal closed_by_user

13 : const PANEL_W := 2160.0
14 : const HEAD_H := 96.0
15 : const ROW_GAP := 12.0
16 : const COL_GAP := 24.0
17 : const TEAM_ROWS := 5
18 : const C_ALLY := Color(0.22, 0.66, 1.0)
19 : const C_ENEMY := Color(1.0, 0.33, 0.264)
20 : const C_OWN := Color(0.36, 0.95, 0.55)
21 : const C_GOLD := Color(0.98, 0.84, 0.38)
22 : const C_DIM := Color(0.66, 0.73, 0.85)
23 : const C_CARD_ALLY := Color(0.045, 0.145, 0.315, 0.92)
24 : const C_CARD_ENEMY := Color(0.235, 0.045, 0.065, 0.92)
25 : const C_CARD_OWN := Color(0.035, 0.215, 0.115, 0.94)
26 : const PAD := 0.965
27 : 
28 : var rows: Array = []
29 : var mode := "attr"
30 : var panel_h := 1200.0
31 : var _row_h := 200.0
32 : 
33 : func _ready() -> void:
34 : 	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
35 : 	visible = false
36 : 	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
37 : 
38 : func set_rows(r: Array, md: String = "attr") -> void:
39 : 	# 两队各自按总经济降序（并列时按击杀、再按名字稳定排序），列内名次即队内经济名次
40 : 	rows = r.duplicate()
41 : 	rows.sort_custom(func(a, b):
42 : 		var ga := int(a.get("gold", 0))
43 : 		var gb := int(b.get("gold", 0))
44 : 		if ga != gb:
45 : 			return ga > gb
46 : 		var ka := int(a.get("k", 0))
47 : 		var kb := int(b.get("k", 0))
48 : 		if ka != kb:
49 : 			return ka > kb
50 : 		return str(a.get("name", "")) < str(b.get("name", "")))
51 : 	mode = md
52 : 	# 只更新数据，不在这里显示面板：面板开关必须由持有者统一控制，
53 : 	# 否则关闭后下一次秒级刷新会把已关闭的面板重新弹出来。
54 : 	if visible:
55 : 		queue_redraw()
56 : 
57 : func _s() -> float:
58 : 	return clampf(UiKit.scale(), 0.88, 1.35)
59 : 
60 : func _split() -> Array:
61 : 	var ally: Array = []
62 : 	var foe: Array = []
63 : 	for r in rows:
64 : 		if Config.is_ally(int(r.get("team", 0))):
65 : 			ally.append(r)
66 : 		else:
67 : 			foe.append(r)
68 : 	return [ally, foe]
69 : 
70 : ## 版式：全部由自身矩形（= 屏幕可用区）推算，保证任何分辨率/缩放下不越界
71 : func _layout() -> Dictionary:
72 : 	var avail := size
73 : 	if avail.x <= 1.0 or avail.y <= 1.0:
74 : 		avail = Vector2(2400.0, 1400.0)
75 : 	var need_h := HEAD_H + 22.0 + 5.0 * 206.0 + ROW_GAP * float(TEAM_ROWS - 1)
76 : 	var s := minf(_s(), minf(avail.x * PAD / PANEL_W, avail.y * PAD / need_h))
77 : 	var ph := minf(avail.y * PAD / s, 1600.0)
78 : 	var rh := maxf((ph - HEAD_H - 22.0 - ROW_GAP * float(TEAM_ROWS - 1)) / float(TEAM_ROWS), 168.0)
79 : 	var w := PANEL_W * s
80 : 	var h := minf((HEAD_H + 22.0 + rh * float(TEAM_ROWS) + ROW_GAP * float(TEAM_ROWS - 1)) * s, avail.y * PAD)
81 : 	return {"s": s, "ph": ph, "rh": rh, "w": w, "h": h, "o": ((avail - Vector2(w, h)) * 0.5).floor()}
82 : 
83 : func _draw() -> void:
84 : 	var L := _layout()
85 : 	var s: float = L.s
86 : 	panel_h = L.ph
87 : 	_row_h = L.rh
88 : 	var origin: Vector2 = L.o
89 : 	draw_set_transform(origin, 0.0, Vector2(s, s))
90 : 	# 背板
91 : 	draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.96, 18, 1, Color(0.40, 0.50, 0.66, 0.55), Color(0.035, 0.045, 0.07, 0.97), 0.0, 20.0),
92 : 		Rect2(0.0, 0.0, PANEL_W, panel_h))
93 : 	draw_rect(Rect2(24.0, 0.0, PANEL_W - 48.0, 2.5), Color(0.98, 0.82, 0.32, 0.85))
94 : 	_header()
95 : 	var split := _split()
96 : 	var ally: Array = split[0]
97 : 	var foe: Array = split[1]
98 : 	var cw := (PANEL_W - 44.0 - COL_GAP) * 0.5
99 : 	var y := HEAD_H + 6.0
100 : 	for i in range(TEAM_ROWS):
101 : 		var ar: Dictionary = ally[i] if i < ally.size() else {}
102 : 		var er: Dictionary = foe[i] if i < foe.size() else {}
103 : 		_card(ar, i + 1, true, Rect2(22.0, y, cw, _row_h))
104 : 		_card(er, i + 1, false, Rect2(22.0 + cw + COL_GAP, y, cw, _row_h))
105 : 		y += _row_h + ROW_GAP
106 : 	# 关闭按钮
107 : 	var cr := _close_rect()
108 : 	draw_style_box(UiKit.flat(0.7, 8, 1, Color(0.45, 0.55, 0.72, 0.6), Color(0.10, 0.12, 0.18, 0.9), 0.0, 4.0), cr)
109 : 	UiKit.text(self, Vector2(cr.position.x, cr.position.y + cr.size.y * 0.74), "×", 22,
110 : 		Color.WHITE, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER, cr.size.x)
111 : 	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)
112 : 
113 : func _notification(what: int) -> void:
114 : 	if what == NOTIFICATION_RESIZED:
115 : 		queue_redraw()
116 : 
117 : func _header() -> void:
118 : 	var split := _split()
119 : 	var ally: Array = split[0]
120 : 	var foe: Array = split[1]
121 : 	var ag := 0

RosterView: draws with transform scale `s` = clamp(UiKit.scale(), 0.88, 1.35) then min with fit. So on mobile, if the panel doesn't fit, `s` shrinks → text tiny. Fix: raise the floor of the fit scale / increase overall font scale by multiplying text sizes. Practical minimal: add a constant `FONT_BOOST := 1.25` applied to all font sizes in `_card`/`_header`/`_close`, i.e. multiply each draw_string font size. Many call sites; simpler: since the whole drawing is under `draw_set_transform(origin, 0, Vector2(s,s))` — text font sizes are passed in "local" units then scaled by s. Instead of touching each, multiply `s` by a boost? That scales geometry too → panel overflows.

Better: introduce `_fs(base)` helper returning `int(base * 1.28)` and wrap font-size args. Need to edit each draw call in _card (maybe ~20 calls). Alternatively add a member `var font_boost := 1.3` and multiply at `UiKit.text(...)` calls — but those are also positional.

Hmm, more surgical: fold boost into `_s()`: `return clampf(UiKit.scale(), 0.88, 1.35) * 1.25` — but then `_layout` uses s for panel width too and min() with fit → panel would overflow width (min with avail). Actually `_layout` computes s = min(_s(), avail fit) → if boost makes s bigger than fit, min picks fit → no change. So no.

Instead: reduce PANEL_W/need_h base sizes? That makes panel bigger relative to text (text same local size, panel smaller) — no, text would then be relatively bigger ✓: if we shrink PANEL_W from 2160 → 1728 (÷1.25) and ROW_HEIGHT bases similarly, then fit scale s increases 1.25×, making text 1.25× bigger on screen while panel occupies same area. But geometry inside uses absolute local units tuned for 2160 width; scaling everything down uniformly via a global divisor = same as drawing with transform scale × 1.25 on a smaller panel.

Cleanest: wrap draw with extra text scale... not possible globally.

Alternative minimal: in `_card`, all font sizes come from either constants or computed from row_h. Let me read `_card` to count font size usages; maybe font sizes derive from `rh` (like `int(rh*0.16)`), in which case increasing those ratios by 25% is a small local change.

{"command":"cd 'C:\Users\18749\Documents\honor-king'; @'
import pathlib

# 1) 联机 HUD 环形头像：删除头像上方的英雄名 + 等级
p = pathlib.Path("scripts/net/NetClientBattle.gd")
t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old = '''		# 名字+Lv 移到头像圆圈正上方（同 host RespawnWidget；超宽按单元宽度自动缩字）
		var name_lv := "%s Lv.%d" % [str(r[2]), int(r[3])]
		var ncol := Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.5) if team == 1 else Color.WHITE
		var nfs := 18
		var ns := _font.get_string_size(name_lv, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, nfs).x
		if ns > 126.0:   # host: size.x - 4 = 126
			nfs = maxi(11, int(nfs * 126.0 / ns))
			ns = _font.get_string_size(name_lv, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, nfs).x
		draw_string(_font, Vector2(center.x - ns * 0.5, center.y - ring_r - 5.0), name_lv,
				HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, nfs, ncol)
'''
print("net name block found:", old in t)
t = t.replace(old, "")
p.write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")

# 2) TouchActionButton：可选旋转发光拖尾（联机技能“+”升级钮用）
q = pathlib.Path("scripts/mobile/TouchActionButton.gd")
u = q.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
u = u.replace('''var label_font_size := 0.0     # 0=自动按半径缩放；>0=固定字号（用于升级“+”等需要更醒目字号的按钮）''',
'''var label_font_size := 0.0     # 0=自动按半径缩放；>0=固定字号（用于升级“+”等需要更醒目字号的按钮）
var glow := false              # 可购买/可升级：外圈旋转发光拖尾（金色）
var _glow_t := 0.0''')
u = u.replace('''func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	var target := 1.0 if _active else 0.0''',
'''func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if glow:
		_glow_t += delta
		queue_redraw()
	var target := 1.0 if _active else 0.0''')
u = u.replace('''	UiKit.touch_button_frame(self, center, radius, accent, p, 3.0, dimmed)''',
'''	UiKit.touch_button_frame(self, center, radius, accent, p, 3.0, dimmed)
	# 可购买/可升级：图标外圈一圈旋转发光拖尾（与推荐装备同款）
	if glow:
		for gi in 3:
			var a0 := _glow_t * 3.2 + TAU * float(gi) / 3.0
			for gk in 6:
				var gt := float(gk) / 6.0
				draw_arc(center, radius + 4.0 + gt * 7.0, a0, a0 + 1.0, 10,
					Color(1.0, 0.86, 0.32, (1.0 - gt) * 0.6), 5.0 - gt * 2.6, true)''')
q.write_text(u, encoding="utf-8")

# 3) NetTouchPad：升级“+”钮显示时点亮发光
r = pathlib.Path("scripts/net/NetTouchPad.gd")
v = r.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
v = v.replace('''func set_upgrade_visible(i: int, v: bool) -> void:
	if i >= 0 and i < _upgrade_btns.size():''',
'''func set_upgrade_visible(i: int, v: bool) -> void:
	if i >= 0 and i < _upgrade_btns.size():
		(_upgrade_btns[i] as TouchActionButton).glow = v''')
r.write_text(v, encoding="utf-8")
print("net glow/name ok")

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

2303 : func _add_epic_pit_walls(center: Vector3):
2304 : 	var mouth := _get_nearest_lane_direction(center)
2305 : 	var radius := 8.5
2306 : 	var angle := 0.0
2307 : 	while angle < 360.0:
2308 : 		var rel := fmod(angle - mouth + 360.0, 360.0)
2309 : 		# 180° 半圈围墙（背向最近分路的一面），开口 180°，进坑与被勾出都更顺
2310 : 		if rel > 90.0 and rel < 270.0:
2311 : 			var a := deg_to_rad(angle)
2312 : 			var pos := center + Vector3(cos(a) * radius, 0, sin(a) * radius)
2313 : 			_add_wall(pos, Vector3(cos(a), 0, sin(a)))

2317 : 	if count <= 1: return
2318 : 	for i in range(count):
2319 : 		var a = deg_to_rad(facing_angle - arc_span / 2.0 + arc_span * i / (count - 1))
2320 : 		var pos = center + Vector3(cos(a) * radius, 0, sin(a) * radius)

2327 : 		Vector3(-55, 0, 0), Vector3(55, 0, 0),
2328 : 		Vector3(-30, 0, 30), Vector3(30, 0, -30),
2329 : 		Vector3(0, 0, 55), Vector3(0, 0, -55),

anchor = '''# ==================== 内部工具 ===================='''
pillar_code = '''## 墙端小柱：连续墙两端收口（基座 + 柱身 + 柱头 + 顶饰），与墙体同一石材质感
static func pillar_visual() -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "WallPillar"
	if _pillar_mesh == null:
		_pillar_mesh = _build_pillar_mesh()
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.mesh = _pillar_mesh
	mi.material_override = rock_material()
	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_ON
	root.add_child(mi)
	return root

static func _build_pillar_mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	var box := BoxMesh.new()
	box.size = Vector3.ONE
	_append(st, box, Vector3(0.0, 0.13, 0.0), Vector3(0.66, 0.26, 0.66), Vector3.ZERO)   # 基座
	_append(st, box, Vector3(0.0, 1.15, 0.0), Vector3(0.44, 1.80, 0.44), Vector3.ZERO)   # 柱身
	_append(st, box, Vector3(0.0, 2.13, 0.0), Vector3(0.58, 0.16, 0.58), Vector3.ZERO)   # 柱头
	_append(st, box, Vector3(0.0, 2.31, 0.0), Vector3(0.34, 0.20, 0.34), Vector3.ZERO)   # 顶饰
	return st.commit()

# ==================== 内部工具 ===================='''
assert anchor in u
u = u.replace(anchor, pillar_code, 1)
q.write_text(u, encoding="utf-8")
print("turret + pillar ok")

结论：两项已完成。防御塔底座缩到原来的 80%；野区弧墙和龙坑墙改为**连续墙体**（相邻墙段端面平齐、彼此搭接），并在墙段开放端头自动补上**小柱**。实测 218 段连续墙中 216 段与相邻段搭接、无缝隙。

## 改动

| 项目 | 位置 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 塔基 80% | [Turret.gd:127](scripts/entities/Turret.gd#L127) | 底座系数改为 `k = f/1.5 × 0.8`（外塔 1.333 → 1.067，水晶 1.667 → 1.333），缩放层同步 |
| 连续墙段 | [Wall.gd:12-24](scripts/entities/Wall.gd#L12-L24) | 新增 `continuous_len` / `pillar`：连续段使用端面平齐的墙网格（高度压到 62%，不挡视野）；碰撞盒沿墙长铺满 `(len × 1.76 × 0.55)`，避免从缝里钻过 |
| 端头小柱 | [DecorMesh.gd:372](scripts/entities/DecorMesh.gd#L372) | 新增 `pillar_visual()`：基座+柱身+柱头+顶饰，同一岩石材质，静态缓存 |
| 野区弧墙重做 | [BattleManager.gd:2380](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2380) `_add_arc_walls` | 原来每个采样点只放一块石头（间距 0.7~0.8m，石头之间全是洞）→ 改为采样点之间生成一段连续墙（长度=弦长+0.12 搭接） |
| 龙坑墙重做 | [BattleManager.gd:2303](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2303) `_add_epic_pit_walls` | 5° 采样的每个点改为逐段连续墙，141° 半圈形成一整段弧墙 |
| 端柱统一收口 | [BattleManager.gd:2352](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2352) `_cap_arc_wall_ends` | 生成后扫描所有连续墙端头：没有相邻段接合、也没有端柱的开放端头，各补一根小柱（`force` 落位，不会被高地/草丛过滤掉；幂等，不重复加柱） |

## 验证（窗口化实测）

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 塔基缩放 | 外塔 `1.333 → 1.0667`（= 80%），水晶同比；底座顶半径 1.68→1.79、1.24→1.32（相对塔身） |
| 连续墙数量 | 218 段（野区弧墙+龙坑墙），端柱 33 根 |
| 墙面接缝 | 最近邻墙面间距 `中位 -0.125 m`（**互相搭接**）、最小 -0.904、最大 0.644；**216/218 段与相邻段重叠或无缝隙** |
| 端头收口 | 每个开放端头 0.45m 内有柱子或 0.5m 内有相邻段接合（无悬空墙头） |
| 冒烟 | `--editor --quit` / `battle 420` / `net_client 200` / `lobby 150` 全部 **exit 0**，无 SCRIPT ERROR，无 `_probe` 残留 |

## 说明

- 墙体沿用外周城墙那一套石材质感网格（端面严格平齐），因此单机与联机、镜像两侧形状完全一致；节点数量与改造前基本持平（≈218 段 + 33 柱）。
- 连续墙高度压到常态的 62%（约 1.7m），既保持“墙”的阻挡感，又不至于像城墙那样挡住野区视野。
- 仅 2 段墙与最近邻间距 0.64m（位于弧墙端头、旁有端柱收口），属端部收口造型，不构成通道。

| 端柱统一收口 | [BattleManager.gd:2352](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2352) `_cap_arc_wall_ends` | 生成后扫描所有连续墙端头：没有相邻段接合、也没有端柱的开放端头，各补一根小柱（`force` 落位，不会被高地/草丛过滤掉；幂等，不重复加柱） |

## 验证（窗口化实测）

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 塔基缩放 | 外塔 `1.333 → 1.0667`（= 80%），水晶同比；底座顶半径 1.68→1.79、1.24→1.32（相对塔身） |
| 连续墙数量 | 218 段（野区弧墙+龙坑墙），端柱 33 根 |
| 墙面接缝 | 最近邻墙面间距 `中位 -0.125 m`（**互相搭接**）、最小 -0.904、最大 0.644；**216/218 段与相邻段重叠或无缝隙** |
| 端头收口 | 每个开放端头 0.45m 内有柱子或 0.5m 内有相邻段接合（无悬空墙头） |
| 冒烟 | `--editor --quit` / `battle 420` / `net_client 200` / `lobby 150` 全部 **exit 0**，无 SCRIPT ERROR，无 `_probe` 残留 |

## 说明

- 墙体沿用外周城墙那一套石材质感网格（端面严格平齐），因此单机与联机、镜像两侧形状完全一致；节点数量与改造前基本持平（≈218 段 + 33 柱）。
- 连续墙高度压到常态的 62%（约 1.7m），既保持“墙”的阻挡感，又不至于像城墙那样挡住野区视野。
- 仅 2 段墙与最近邻间距 0.64m（位于弧墙端头、旁有端柱收口），属端部收口造型，不构成通道。

```gdscript
## 通用能量球：核心发光球 + 加色外壳 + 两条倾斜旋转光环 + 环绕粒子 + 点光。
## 东皇能量球 / 亚瑟圣盾 / 施法法球共用，替代原来的单个纯色球（style: energy/void/holy）
func make_orb(color: Color, radius: float = 0.6, style: String = "energy") -> Node3D:
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "Orb"
	var hot: float = 0.55 if style == "holy" else 0.45
	var core := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var sm := SphereMesh.new()
	sm.radius = radius * 0.60
	sm.height = radius * 1.20
	sm.radial_segments = 18
	sm.rings = 10
	core.mesh = sm
	core.material_override = _add_mat(color.lerp(Color.WHITE, hot), 0.98, 2.6)
	core.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	root.add_child(core)
	# 外壳：加色球罩（层次感，不再是硬边单球）
	var shell := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var sh := SphereMesh.new()
	sh.radius = radius
	sh.height = radius * 2.0
	sh.radial_segments = 18
	sh.rings = 10
	shell.mesh = sh
	var sh_mat := _add_mat(color, 0.17 if style != "holy" else 0.24, 1.4)
	shell.material_override = sh_mat
	shell.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	root.add_child(shell)
	# 两条倾斜光环（由调用方每帧旋转，做“能量流”感）
	var rings: Array = []
	for i in range(2):
		var rm := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var tm := TorusMesh.new()
		tm.inner_radius = radius * (0.92 + 0.10 * float(i))
		tm.outer_radius = radius * (1.10 + 0.12 * float(i))
		tm.rings = 20
		tm.ring_segments = 6
		rm.mesh = tm
		rm.material_override = _add_mat(color.lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.3), 0.55, 1.8)
		rm.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
		rm.rotation = Vector3(PI * 0.5, 0.0, PI * 0.28 * float(i + 1))
		root.add_child(rm)
		rings.append(rm)
	root.set_meta("rings", rings)
	root.set_meta("core", core)
	# 环绕粒子
	if quality >= 1:
		var p := _charge_particles(12, 0.55, color, radius * 0.5, 1.0)
		p.emitting = true
		p.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
		p.emission_sphere_radius = radius * 0.85
		p.gravity = Vector3.ZERO
		p.initial_velocity_min = 0.05
		p.initial_velocity_max = 0.35
		root.add_child(p)
	# 点光
	var lt := OmniLight3D.new()
	lt.light_color = color
	lt.light_energy = 1.1
	lt.omni_range = maxf(3.0, radius * 6.0)
	root.add_child(lt)
	return root

## 让能量球的光环自转（调用方在 _process 里驱动）
func spin_orb(root: Node3D, t: float) -> void:
	var rings: Array = root.get_meta("rings", [])
	for i in range(rings.size()):
		var r = rings[i]
		if is_instance_valid(r):
			r.rotation.y = t * (2.2 + 0.9 * float(i)) * (1.0 if i == 0 else -1.0)
			r.rotation.z = PI * 0.28 * float(i + 1) + sin(t * 1.6 + float(i)) * 0.15
```

## 改动

| 对象 | 原本 | 现在 | 位置 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 东皇太一·能量球（2 技能 / 施法法球） | 单个紫色 `SphereMesh` + 纯色 unshaded 材质 | `Vfx.make_orb(紫, 0.62, "void")` 分层光球，光环每帧自转 | [HeroPassive.gd:104](scripts/entities/HeroPassive.gd#L104)、[:115](scripts/entities/HeroPassive.gd#L115) |
| 亚瑟·W 圣盾（3 颗金球） | 单个金色 `SphereMesh` | `make_orb(金, 0.52, "holy")` 圣光分层球（核心更亮、外壳更实） | [HeroPassive.gd:71](scripts/entities/HeroPassive.gd#L71)、[:79](scripts/entities/HeroPassive.gd#L79) |
| 安琪拉/妲己/东皇·施法法球 | 3 个纯色小球 | 全部换成 `make_orb`，带旋转光环与脉动 | [VfxFactory.gd:1901](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L1901) `orbs_fx` |
| 刘禅·W 机关魔爪 | 只有通用落点预览，无专属特效 | 新增 `mech_claw_fx`：三片机械爪刃自空中砸落、齿轮底盘、扩张齿轮环、火花蒸汽、轻微震屏 | [VfxFactory.gd:2079](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L2079) |
| 刘禅·R 暴走熊猫 | 通用光柱（圆柱） | 新增 `mech_stamp_fx`：双层旋转齿轮法阵、熊猫机甲虚影抬升消散、地面冲击波、上升蒸汽 | [VfxFactory.gd:2137](scripts/core/VfxFactory.gd#L2137) |

| 英雄 | 现状 |
|---|---|
| 后羿（太阳球）、甄姬/王昭君（冰柱/冰晶）、小乔（扇面+旋风）、李白（剑阵）、大禹（鼎）、沈梦溪/马可波罗/狄仁杰/张飞/太乙/英睿 | 已是多层程序化网格 + 粒子 + 点光 + 震屏，不是简单几何体 |
| 东皇/安琪拉/妲己普攻弹体（`BulletVisual` SHAPE_ORB） | 已有光晕壳 + 核心 + 光环三层，无需改 |
| 炮车/野怪/回城/再生等 | 原本就是分层 VFX |

唯一残留的“单球”是通用护盾泡，本轮已为它补上光环。

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 光球部件 | `{SphereMesh:2, TorusMesh:2, CPUParticles3D:1, OmniLight3D:1}` = 6 部件；`spin_orb` 后光环 rotY `0 → 2.64` |
| 刘禅道具分派 | `get_prop(刘禅,1)=mech_claw`、`(刘禅,2)=mech_stamp`、`(东皇,0/1)=orbs` |
| 特效生命周期 | 触发 3 个特效后 `vfx_fx` 组 6 节点 → 1.6s 后归 **0**（无泄漏） |
| 护盾泡 | `ShieldFx` 子节点 2（`ShieldRim0/1` 均存在），带自转与呼吸缩放 |
| 冒烟 | `--editor --quit`、`battle 420`、`net_client 200`、`lobby 150` 全部 **exit 0**，无 SCRIPT ERROR，无 `_probe` 残留 |

## 说明

- 新光球走 `_add_mat`（加色混合、免光照）+ 单个 `OmniLight3D`，每个球 4 个 draw 组件；东皇 3 球最多 18 个组件，仍在原有特效预算内（`MAX_PROPS=8` 只限制一次性道具数量）。
- 联机端：这些是客户端本地表现，host 侧 `Vfx` 的 24~28 号 FX 通道不覆盖“环绕球体”类持续特效，因此客户端看到的是自身英雄的本地球体（原本如此），未新增同步协议。

content.text:
Task: 龙坑墙 should be open-type (no closure). And convert other non-outer walls on the battlefield to the jungle wall standard (continuous walls with end pillars).

Currently pit walls: 180° arc (back side) — that's already open-ish (mouth 180°). User says "龙坑墙应该是开放型的，不要闭口" — maybe our continuous conversion closed the mouth ends with pillars making it look closed? Or the pit wall arc is too closed. Perhaps they want the pit wall to be an open arc (like a C shape, not enclosing). Hmm "开放型" = open-sided, not closed loop.

Wait: current pit wall spans rel in (90°,270°) = 180° of circle radius 8.5 — that's a half circle, open on the other half. That's already open. But maybe the continuous segments + end pillars now visually look like a wall with a cap... Or maybe user means: with 5° sampling and 180°, plus the mouth faces nearest lane; maybe two pits' walls form closed pens?

Alternatively the user refers to the fact that 龙坑 (epic pit) walls, after our continuous rebuild, became a nearly closed ring because the 180° half + 8.5 radius creates a big arc that appears closed from camera. They want it "开放型" — i.e., reduce arc span (e.g., 120° instead of 180°) so it's a C-shaped open enclosure.

Hmm risky. Let me look at what "龙坑" geometry: `epic_pit_centers` and how many. Maybe currently two epic pits (主宰/暴君) each with 180° wall; combined with map edge they form closed pit.

I think the reasonable interpretation: reduce the wall arc to an open C (e.g., 150°) and remove the end pillars closing the mouth? But they said "不要闭口" = don't close the opening.

Second part: convert other non-outer walls to continuous jungle-wall standard:
- `_generate_lane_edge_walls` (lane edges)
- `_generate_high_ground_walls` (high ground perimeter, hq style)
Both currently place point rocks at intervals. Convert them to continuous segments (like arcs) using the continuous polyline builder. Outer walls keep as-is.

So generalize: implement `_add_wall_polyline(points)` producing continuous segments between consecutive points + end pillars, and use it for lane edge walls, high ground walls, and arcs. But these generators currently sample positions along lines; we can convert their position arrays into chains.

Let me read `_generate_lane_edge_walls` and `_generate_high_ground_walls` to see structure.

Now user: "龙坑墙应该是开放型的，不要闭口" — current pit wall = 180° half circle + end pillars → visually a closed half-pen; the mouth is 180° open. Hmm but "不要闭口" maybe means: our `_cap_arc_wall_ends` adds pillars at both ends of the 180° arc — that's fine. Or the arc spans 180° which combined with minion path might look like closed.

Maybe user looks at the pit and sees a full ring? Are there TWO epic pits whose walls overlap? `epic_pit_centers` maybe 2 (主宰 pits) — each radius 8.5 half arc. If centers are near each other (e.g., two pits in each river side), their arcs could nearly meet forming a closed circle around the pit.

Interpretation: they want an open C-shape: shrink arc span from 180° to ~120-140°, i.e. open mouth wider... but they say "不要闭口" = don't close the opening. Our current mouth is 180° open — very open. Hmm.

Alternative reading: 龙坑墙 currently only exists as half-ring behind; maybe user perceives it as a closed "pit" because the arc ends curve inward? No.

Wait—maybe the issue: the continuous rebuild used `radial` rotation and capsule-length collision; the arc segments fill a 180° ring, and since it's a ring of radius 8.5 the pit looks like a closed walled arena. They want it "开放型" i.e. fewer walls: only a short wall on the back side (e.g., 90-120°), leaving the pit open like a clearing.

Safer: reduce arc span to 100° (a shallow back wall) — but that changes gameplay cover.

Hmm, another possibility: 龙坑 = "epic pit" but maybe pit walls currently generate TWO half-arcs (one per pit) that together close the pit entirely when the pits are close. ## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

q = pathlib.Path("scripts/core/BattleManager.gd")

new = '''func _emit_wall_chain(pts: Array, pillar: bool, open_ends: bool) -> void:
	if pts.size() < 2:
		return
	# 记录“实际落位”的连续段：被过滤掉的段会断开链，端柱只补在真实端头，避免悬空柱子
	var run_start := Vector3.ZERO

		var seg := delta.length()
		if seg < 0.05:
			continue
		var mid := (p0 + p1) * 0.5
		var tangent := delta / seg
		# 墙面法线：切线绕 Y 轴转 90°（墙长沿局部 X、局部 +Z 为正面朝向）

		_add_wall(run_end, Vector3.ZERO, true, false, false, 2.0, 0.0, true)

'''
u = u.replace(old, new)
q.write_text(u, encoding="utf-8")
print("chain ends ok")

popup shown: HonorKing · 龙坑与墙体 | 龙坑墙改为开放型（两端不封口），分路内缘/中路/高地墙全部改为连续墙+端柱

结论：龙坑的墙改成开放型（半圈墙，两端不封口、不补柱子），战场上其余非外周墙（分路内缘、中路两侧、高地弧线）全部改成与野区墙同款：连续拼接的矮墙，再加端柱。整张地图的连续墙从野区孤立的几段扩到 505 段，墙面缝隙中位数为 5 毫米。

## 改动

| 位置 | 之前 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| 龙坑（主宰或暴君） | 180° 半圈墙，两端各补一根端柱（像封上口子） | 180° 半圈连续矮墙，**两端不补柱、不参与自动收口**（`open_end` 标记），坑口彻底敞开 |
| 分路内缘墙（x=±47、z=±47，非外周） | 每 2 米放一块的单块墙，段与段之间的缝隙随机 | 先按每 2 米采样，在野区入口处断开，再把每段实际留下的点连成连续墙，两端各补一根小柱（[BattleManager.gd:2288](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2288)） |
| 中路两侧墙 | 单块墙 | 与分路内缘墙同一套处理，断口在高地内侧和三路入口处（[BattleManager.gd:2302](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2302)） |
| 高地弧线墙（r=35） | 单块方墙、`hq` 样式 | 改成连续弧墙，三路入口断开，各链端补小柱（[BattleManager.gd:2310](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2310)） |
| 外周墙（\|x\|=\|z\|=63、泉水石环） | 不变 | 不变（仍为外周城墙样式） |

统一采用一套「采点、连成墙链、端柱」的做法：`_add_wall_chain()` 和 `_emit_wall_chain()`（[BattleManager.gd:2333](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2333)）。**端柱只加在墙段真正放下的位置**：如果某一段被高地或草丛过滤掉，墙链会在这里断开并补柱，不会出现悬空的柱子。采样点间距大于 6 米时也自动拆成多条链。

## 实测（battle 场景跑通生成流程后统计）

| 指标 | 数值 |
|---|---|
| 墙体总数、连续墙段、端柱 | 1265、**505**、144 |
| 墙面缝隙（连续段端点到相邻段的最短距离） | 中位数 **0.005 m**，最大 2.0 m（括号内为人工留的断口处） |
| 龙坑口端柱 | 两坑均为 **0**；开放段分别为 35 和 34 段 |
| 高地弧墙连续段、分路内缘连续段 | 32、84 |

block.text:
结论：龙坑的墙改成开放型（半圈墙，两端不封口、不补柱子），战场上其余非外周墙（分路内缘、中路两侧、高地弧线）全部改成与野区墙同款：连续拼接的矮墙，再加端柱。整张地图的连续墙从野区孤立的几段扩到 505 段，墙面缝隙中位数为 5 毫米。

## 改动

| 位置 | 之前 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| 龙坑（主宰或暴君） | 180° 半圈墙，两端各补一根端柱（像封上口子） | 180° 半圈连续矮墙，**两端不补柱、不参与自动收口**（`open_end` 标记），坑口彻底敞开 |
| 分路内缘墙（x=±47、z=±47，非外周） | 每 2 米放一块的单块墙，段与段之间的缝隙随机 | 先按每 2 米采样，在野区入口处断开，再把每段实际留下的点连成连续墙，两端各补一根小柱（[BattleManager.gd:2288](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2288)） |
| 中路两侧墙 | 单块墙 | 与分路内缘墙同一套处理，断口在高地内侧和三路入口处（[BattleManager.gd:2302](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2302)） |
| 高地弧线墙（r=35） | 单块方墙、`hq` 样式 | 改成连续弧墙，三路入口断开，各链端补小柱（[BattleManager.gd:2310](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2310)） |
| 外周墙（\|x\|=\|z\|=63、泉水石环） | 不变 | 不变（仍为外周城墙样式） |

统一采用一套「采点、连成墙链、端柱」的做法：`_add_wall_chain()` 和 `_emit_wall_chain()`（[BattleManager.gd:2333](scripts/core/BattleManager.gd#L2333)）。**端柱只加在墙段真正放下的位置**：如果某一段被高地或草丛过滤掉，墙链会在这里断开并补柱，不会出现悬空的柱子。采样点间距大于 6 米时也自动拆成多条链。

Actually: after HP: y += bh+3 (31). Mana: y += mh+3 (14+3=17) → y=48. Then extra `+= 14+4 = 18` → 66: status bar starts 18px below mana bar bottom — big gap = "割裂".

Fix: remove extra offset; draw status bars flush 2-3px below mana bar. Also integrate visually: status bars should share the same width/frame alignment and use the same outer "capsule" frame as HP+mana (one continuous dark frame), plus flush 2px gaps.

Design (minimal but effective):
1. Remove the stray `y_offset += bar_height*0.5 + 4.0`.
2. Give status bars 2.0 px gap and height 11 with same left/right as HP (bx, w) — already same width.
3. Draw a single outer frame around HP+mana+status region: currently HP frame drawn at start only. Simplest: draw frame after all bars: compute total height and draw one dark rounded frame with team-color border around HP top .. last status bottom. Replace per-bar frames with just track+fill (no individual frame), so they read as one widget.

Implementation: in `_draw()`, record `var frame_y0: float = y_offset` before HP; after status bars, `var frame_h := y_offset_end - frame_y0`; draw frame with rounded StyleBox covering. But low-hp pulse frame also drawn. Simpler: keep HP frame as is, extend it downward to include mana+status by drawing an extra rect appended below: after status bars, draw a frame rect `Rect2(bx-2, hp_top-2, w+4, total_h+4)` ON TOP with border only? That would overdraw bars. Rather draw frame first: need entries count & heights before drawing. Compute upfront: `var entries := _status_entries()`, status h = 11, gap 2 → status_total = entries.size()*(11+2). total below HP = (mana? 14+2) + 2 + status_total. Then draw frame at start covering everything; then bars inside.

But mana bar has no frame currently (drawn flush under HP frame's bottom edge?). HP frame ends at y_offset+bh+4... At y=31 mana starts (3px gap) — the mana bar sits outside HP frame, looks separate, but user only complains about passive bar.

Plan:
- Compute `var status_entries := _status_entries()`; `var s_h := 11.0`, `var s_gap := 2.0`, `var status_total := status_entries.size() * s_h + max(0, n-1)*s_gap`.
- Frame: draw one continuous frame from HP top-2 to bottom of status area (+2): with corner radius 6 style, team border. Draw before bars.
- Draw HP bar (as now), mana (flush 2px), then status bars at 2px gap, each no own frame (track + fill + 1px inner top highlight), labels inside.
- Also keep low-hp pulse ring around HP only.

Risk: touching lots of HP code. Alternative minimal: keep all current HP/mana draws; only:
  a) remove extra offset (gap 18→3px);
  b) in `_draw_status_bars`, draw ONE continuous "glass backing" behind all status bars clipped to same width with rounded frame aligned to the HP frame, and no individual frames (draw track/fill only). Then status bars sit as a tight stack directly under mana.
  c) Make status bar height 13, gap 1.

That yields "connected" look without touching HP code. But the outline of HP bar remains only around HP; the status stack gets its own frame directly attached (1px gap) — visually joined.

Better: also draw a 2px vertical connector? Overkill.

I'll do: single shared frame for the whole status stack (rounded, team-tinted border), bars inside with 1px separation, no per-bar frames, labels/values same. And gap from mana bar = 2px.

Also add "same width as HP bar" (already 280) and align exactly with bx.

Implementation details in `_draw_status_bars(cx, top)`:
```gdscript
func _draw_status_bars(cx: float, top: float) -> void:
	var entries := _status_entries()
	if entries.is_empty():
		return
	var sh := 13.0
	var gap := 1.0
	var total := float(entries.size()) * sh + float(entries.size() - 1) * gap
	var w := bar_width
	var bx := cx - w * 0.5
	# 整体背板：与血条同宽、同色描边，紧贴法力条（不再逐条画独立边框）
	var team_col := Color(0.0, 0.886, 1.0)
	var bm := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("battle_manager") as BattleManager
	if bm != null and bm.hero == hero:
		team_col = Color(0.33, 0.95, 0.42)
	elif hero != null and not Config.is_ally(hero.team):
		team_col = Color(1.0, 0.33, 0.264)
	draw_rect(Rect2(bx - 2.0, top - 2.0, w + 4.0, total + 4.0), Color(0.02, 0.03, 0.06, 0.96))
	draw_rect(Rect2(bx - 2.0, top - 2.0, w + 4.0, total + 4.0), Color(team_col.r, team_col.g, team_col.b, 0.55), false, 1.5)
	for i in range(entries.size()):
		_draw_status_bar(bx, top + float(i) * (sh + gap), sh, entries[i])
```
with `_draw_status_bar(bx, y, sh, e)` simplified: track rect + fill gradient + segments + label/value (no frames).

Then in `_draw()`: replace
```
	y_offset += bar_height * 0.5 + 4.0
	_draw_status_bars(center_x, y_offset)
```
with
```
	# 状态条（附魔/炸弹等）紧贴法力条下方 2px，与血条共用同一外框语言
	_draw_status_bars(center_x, y_offset + 2.0)
```
Careful: after mana branch y_offset already advanced mh+3 → status top = y_offset+2. If no mana (e.g., 亚瑟 max_mana 0? many heroes have no mana): after HP y = y_offset = bh+3; status top = +2 → 5px below HP bottom (frame extends 2px) → 3px gap. Fine.

262: var r := 21.0	# 头像再放大 2 倍（原 10.5，初始 7.0）
scenes/battle.tscn=0
scenes/net_client.tscn=0
scenes/lobby.tscn=0
popup shown: HonorKing · 小地图与被动条 | 小地图英雄头像放大2倍；被动条并入血条同一外框，紧贴法力条下沿

结论：小地图英雄头像的半径从 10.5 改为 **21.0**（直径 42px，正好是原来 2 倍），朝向箭头、血环、本人绿环、阵亡倒计时同步按比例放大；被动条（附魔/炸弹/枪意等）原来在法力条下方还多空出 **18px**，现在与血条、法力条共用**同一个外框**，竖向压到只有 2px 间隙。

## 改动

| 项 | 之前 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| 小地图头像半径 | 10.5（直径 21px） | **21.0**（直径 42px）[MinimapDraw.gd:262](scripts/ui/MinimapDraw.gd#L262) |
| 头像附属元素 | 阴影 +2.8、箭头 +6.8、血环 +2.2、本人环 +4.0，线宽 1.2/2.4/2.6 | 全部 ×2：+5.6 / +13.6、血环 +4.4、本人环 +8.0，线宽 2.0/3.4/3.6；阵亡倒计时 13→**20px** |
| 被动条位置 | 血条→法力条→**再空 18px** 才画（`y += bar_height*0.5 + 4` 多算一次） | 法力条下沿 +**2px**，逐条独立边框改为整块共用外框 |
| 被动条样式 | 每条自带圆角边框 + 描边（看起来像独立小卡） | 统一外框内：槽 + 三段渐变填充 + 顶部高光 + 亮端脉冲 + 分段刻度 + 内嵌标签/数值；条高 12→13，条间距 4→1.5 |

外框现在一次性覆盖「血条 + 法力条 + 被动条」整块：`block_h = 28 + 3 + (14 + 3) + 2 + 条数×13 + 间距`，队伍色细边只画一圈（[HeroInfoControl.gd:241](scripts/ui/HeroInfoControl.gd#L241)）。宿主与联机端共用同一套绘制代码，两端表现一致。

## 验证

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 解析 | `--editor --quit` exit 0，无 SCRIPT ERROR |
| 冒烟 | battle 420 / net_client 200 / lobby 150 全部 exit 0 |
| 坐标核算 | 血条 0–28 → 法力条 31–45 → 被动条 50–63，外框 −2–67（原来被动条要到 68 才开始） |
| 头像覆盖 | 小地图 450px 内头像直径 42px（≈9.3%），不变的是点击/传送判定逻辑 |

```gdscript
## 玩家昵称 + AI 随机名库：昵称持久化到 user://profile.cfg（缓存）
class_name NameStore
extends RefCounted

const CFG_PATH := "user://profile.cfg"
const AI_FIRST := ["夜", "风", "云", "月", "星", "雪", "尘", "霜", "雷", "影", "光", "墨", "青", "白", "赤", "玄"]
const AI_SECOND := ["行者", "无声", "归客", "长歌", "问天", "逐月", "踏雪", "临渊", "听雨", "断浪", "折戟", "扶摇", "落霞", "惊鸿", "孤舟", "清欢"]

static func player_name() -> String:
	var cf := ConfigFile.new()
	if cf.load(CFG_PATH) != OK:
		return ""
	return str(cf.get_value("player", "name", "")).strip_edges()

static func save_player_name(n: String) -> void:
	var nm := n.strip_edges()
	if nm == "":
		return
	var cf := ConfigFile.new()
	cf.load(CFG_PATH)
	cf.set_value("player", "name", nm)
	cf.save(CFG_PATH)

static func random_ai_names(n: int, exclude: Array = []) -> Array:
	var pool: Array = []
	for a in AI_FIRST:
		for b in AI_SECOND:
			pool.append(str(a) + str(b))
	pool.shuffle()
	var out: Array = []
	var used: Dictionary = {}
	for e in exclude:
		used[str(e)] = true
	for p in pool:
		if out.size() >= n: break
		if used.has(p): continue
		used[p] = true
		out.append(p)
	while out.size() < n:
		out.append("AI-%02d" % (out.size() + 1))
	return out
```
